definition_en: starting at a place, time, or source
example1_en: This postcard is from my cousin in Nanjing.
example1_zh: 这张明信片是南京的表哥寄来的。
example2_en: Ideas from different subjects can be combined when students explain a real problem in their town.
example2_zh: 学生解释家乡的真实问题时，可以结合不同学科的想法。
collocations: from now on｜从现在起 ; come from｜来自 ; far from｜远离
tip_zh: from...to... 表示从……到……，时间和地点都可以用。

definition_en: used for a point in time or place
example1_en: We meet at the school gate at seven.
example1_zh: 我们七点在校门口见面。
example2_en: Looking at screens late at night can make it harder for teenagers to fall asleep.
example2_zh: 深夜看屏幕会让青少年更难入睡。
collocations: at night｜在夜里 ; at least｜至少 ; be good at｜擅长
tip_zh: 钟点和较小地点用 at；街道、城市一般用 in。

meanings_zh: conj. 引导从句，无实义 | pron. 那；那个
definition_en: used to introduce a clause | the one already mentioned
example1_en: I think that the answer is right.
example1_zh: 我认为这个答案是对的。
example2_en: Researchers argue that regular sleep is as important as extra lessons for students under exam pressure.
example2_zh: 研究者认为，对备考压力大的学生来说，规律睡眠和额外补课一样重要。
collocations: so that｜以便 ; that is｜也就是说
tip_zh: 引导宾语从句的 that 可以省略，但写作里保留更清楚。

meanings_zh: modal v. 将；愿意 | n. 意愿；遗嘱
definition_en: used for the future, or for willingness | a desire, or a legal document about one's property
example1_en: I will call you after the meeting.
example1_zh: 散会后我会给你打电话。
example2_en: A city that will face water shortages needs to teach children why saving water matters.
example2_zh: 一座将面临缺水的城市，需要让孩子明白为什么节水重要。
collocations: will be able to｜将能够
tip_zh: will 表示将来或意愿；遗嘱这一名词读音相同，写作里要靠词性区分。

definition_en: used for an agent, a deadline, or a means
example1_en: The poster was drawn by our art group.
example1_zh: 这张海报是我们美术小组画的。
example2_en: Please hand in the form by Friday so that the school can arrange seats before the test.
example2_zh: 请在周五前交表，以便学校在考试前排好座位。
collocations: by bus｜乘公共汽车 ; by the way｜顺便说 ; by oneself｜独自
tip_zh: by 加交通工具时不用冠词：by bus。截止时间也用 by。

definition_en: intended for someone, or lasting a length of time
example1_en: This seat is for our class monitor.
example1_zh: 这个座位是给我们班长的。
example2_en: Schools that set aside time for reading often see students become more willing to discuss difficult texts.
example2_zh: 留出阅读时间的学校，常常发现学生更愿意讨论难懂的文章。
collocations: for example｜例如 ; wait for｜等待 ; for a long time｜很长时间
tip_zh: for 接一段时间；since 接时间点。

meanings_zh: adj. 不同的 | adj. 各不相同的；各种的
definition_en: not the same | used to describe several separate people, things, or types
example1_en: Each student has a different style.
example1_zh: 每个学生都有不同风格。
example2_en: Students from different cultural backgrounds can contribute valuable perspectives to classroom discussions about global issues.
example2_zh: 来自不同文化背景的学生能为课堂上的全球议题讨论提供宝贵的视角。
collocations: different from｜与……不同 ; different perspectives｜不同视角 ; completely different｜完全不同
tip_zh: 与……不同常用different from，适合正式写作。

definition_en: used to make a verb or phrase negative
example1_en: I am not ready for the oral test.
example1_zh: 我还没准备好口语考试。
example2_en: A short plan is not a waste of time if it stops you from revising the same page twice.
example2_zh: 如果一份简短计划能避免你把同一页复习两遍，它就不是浪费时间。
collocations: not only｜不仅 ; not at all｜一点也不
tip_zh: 否定动词用 not；直接否定名词用 no，如 no time。

definition_en: on the subject of, or roughly
example1_en: We talked about the class trip.
example1_zh: 我们谈了班级出游的事。
example2_en: Reports about teenage sleep suggest that earlier school starts can harm attention in morning lessons.
example2_zh: 关于青少年睡眠的报告表明，过早上学可能影响上午课堂的注意力。
collocations: worry about｜担心 ; be about to｜即将 ; how about｜……怎么样
tip_zh: be about to do 表示马上要做，通常不再加具体将来时间。

definition_en: an informal talk
example1_en: They had a long conversation about books.
example1_zh: 他们就书籍进行了长时间交谈。
example2_en: Regular conversation with fluent speakers helps language learners develop confidence and improve their listening skills.
example2_zh: 经常与语言流利的人交谈有助于语言学习者建立信心并提高听力。
collocations: have a conversation｜交谈 ; start a conversation｜开始交谈 ; a conversation about｜关于……的谈话
tip_zh: 与某人谈某事：have a conversation with某人about某事。

meanings_zh: modal v. 能；可以 | n. 罐头
definition_en: to be able to, or to be allowed to | a metal container for food
example1_en: I can finish this exercise before lunch.
example1_zh: 我能在午饭前做完这道练习。
example2_en: Public libraries can give students a quiet place to work when their homes are too crowded.
example2_zh: 当家里太挤时，公共图书馆可以为学生提供安静的学习场所。
collocations: can not｜不能 ; as...as one can｜尽可能
tip_zh: 能力用 can；过去的能力常用 could 或 was able to。

definition_en: together with, or having
example1_en: I walk home with my classmate.
example2_en: Teams that plan a project with a clear timetable are less likely to leave the hard work until the last night.
example2_zh: 用清晰时间表规划项目的小组，不太会把难的部分留到最后一夜。
collocations: with the help of｜在……的帮助下 ; deal with｜处理 ; agree with｜同意
tip_zh: with 后面接名词或代词，不接动词原形。

definition_en: on the condition that, or whether
example1_en: If it rains, we will stay in the classroom.
example1_zh: 如果下雨，我们就留在教室。
example2_en: If schools teach students how to check a source, they are less likely to trust a false story online.
example2_zh: 如果学校教学生如何核对来源，他们就不太会轻信网上的假消息。
collocations: if necessary｜如果有必要 ; even if｜即使 ; as if｜好像
tip_zh: 主将从现：if 从句常用一般现在时，主句用 will。

definition_en: inside a place, or during a period
example1_en: The keys are in my schoolbag.
example2_en: Students who read in short daily sessions often remember new words longer than those who study only before an exam.
example2_zh: 每天分段阅读的学生，往往比只在考前突击的人记得更久。
collocations: in the morning｜在早上 ; in time｜及时 ; in fact｜事实上
tip_zh: 地点或一段时间前常用 in；具体某一天用 on，钟点用 at。

definition_en: the one near the speaker
example1_en: This question is easier than the last one.
example2_en: This result suggests that short breaks can improve attention during long study hours.
example2_zh: 这一结果说明，长时间学习中的短休息有助于保持注意力。
collocations: this morning｜今天早上 ; this kind of｜这种
tip_zh: this 指近处或即将说到的事；those 是 that 的复数。

meanings_zh: n. 例子 | n. 榜样
definition_en: something that shows a rule | A person or action that others can learn from or copy
example1_en: Give an example to support your idea.
example1_zh: 举一个例子支持你的观点。
example2_en: Public buildings can set an example by using renewable energy and reducing unnecessary water consumption.
example2_zh: 公共建筑可以通过使用可再生能源和减少不必要的用水来树立榜样。
collocations: for example｜例如 ; give an example｜举例 ; set an example｜树立榜样 ; a typical example｜典型例子
tip_zh: for example用于举例；set an example意为树立榜样。

definition_en: to enjoy or want | similar to
example1_en: I like reading by the window.
example2_en: Teenagers like being trusted with real tasks, not only praised for high marks.
example2_zh: 青少年喜欢被托付真正的任务，而不只是因为高分受到夸奖。
collocations: would like｜想要 ; feel like｜想要 ; like doing｜喜欢做
tip_zh: like 后接 doing 表示习惯喜好；would like to do 表示此刻想要。

meanings_zh: v. 同意 | v. 商定；答应
definition_en: to have the same opinion | Decide something together or promise to do something
example1_en: I agree with your suggestion.
example2_en: Most researchers agree that regular physical activity can improve both mental health and academic performance.
example2_zh: 大多数研究人员认为，经常运动可以改善心理健康和学业表现。
collocations: agree with someone｜同意某人的观点 ; agree on a plan｜就计划达成一致 ; agree to do something｜答应做某事 ; agree to a proposal｜同意一项提议
tip_zh: 同意某人用with；商定某事用on；答应做用to do。

meanings_zh: adv. 如此；所以 | conj. 所以
definition_en: to such a degree, or therefore | and for that reason
example1_en: The hallway was so noisy that we could not hear.
example2_en: The town has few buses, so many students cycle to school even on cold mornings.
example2_zh: 镇上公交很少，所以许多学生即使在寒冷的早晨也骑车上学。
collocations: so that｜以便 ; so far｜到目前为止 ; or so｜大约
tip_zh: so...that... 表示“如此……以至于”；such 后面接名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 困难的 | adj. 难相处的；难应付的
definition_en: hard to do | Not easy to please, manage, or deal with.
example1_en: The question is difficult.
example2_en: Many graduates find it difficult to secure stable employment without previous experience in their chosen field.
example2_zh: 许多毕业生发现，如果没有所选领域的工作经验，就很难找到稳定的工作。
collocations: a difficult decision｜艰难的决定 ; difficult to understand｜难以理解 ; a difficult customer｜难应付的顾客
tip_zh: 常用find it difficult to do，勿把difficulty当形容词。

definition_en: the whole number or amount
example1_en: All the lights in the lab are off.
example2_en: Not all famous people are suitable role models for teenagers who are still forming their own values.
example2_zh: 对仍在形成价值观的青少年来说，并非所有名人都是合适的榜样。
collocations: all over｜遍及 ; above all｜最重要的是 ; all day｜整天
tip_zh: all 与 not 连用常表示部分否定：Not all students agree.

definition_en: a very short time ago, or only
example1_en: I have just seen the notice on the board.
example1_zh: 我刚看到布告栏上的通知。
example2_en: A slogan that just sounds exciting may still fail if it does not tell people what to do.
example2_zh: 一句只是听着振奋的口号，如果没有告诉人们该做什么，仍然可能没有用。
collocations: just now｜刚才 ; just then｜就在那时
tip_zh: just 常放在助动词后、实义动词前。

definition_en: touching a surface, or on a particular day
example1_en: The notice is on the classroom door.
example2_en: Many cities now limit cars on weekdays in order to cut air pollution around schools.
example2_zh: 许多城市现在工作日限行，以减少学校周边的空气污染。
collocations: on Monday｜在星期一 ; on time｜准时 ; on the Internet｜在网上
tip_zh: 星期、具体日期用 on；钟点用 at，上午/年/月用 in。

definition_en: to say what something is like
example1_en: Can you describe the scene in detail?
example1_zh: 你能详细描述那个场景吗？
example2_en: The report describes how access to public parks influences physical activity among residents of crowded cities.
example2_zh: 该报告描述了公共公园的可达性如何影响人口密集城市居民的体育活动。
collocations: describe something in detail｜详细描述某事物 ; describe something as｜把某事物形容为 ; describe a process｜描述一个过程
tip_zh: 说describe something to someone，不说describe someone something。

meanings_zh: prep. 作为；像 | conj. 当……时；因为
definition_en: in the role of, or while something happens | while, or because
example1_en: She works as a library assistant after school.
example1_zh: 她放学后在图书馆当助理。
example2_en: As cities grow, schools have to find new ways to give every child a safe route to class.
example2_zh: 随着城市扩大，学校必须找到新办法，让每个孩子都有安全的上学路线。
collocations: as well｜也 ; as soon as｜一……就 ; such as｜例如
tip_zh: as 可表示“作为”或“当……时”；like 更常用于口语中的“像”。

meanings_zh: num. 一；一个 | pron. 一个人；一个事物
definition_en: the number 1, or a single person or thing | a single person or thing
example1_en: I need one more pencil for the test.
example1_zh: 我考试还需要一支铅笔。
example2_en: One reason cities plant trees along roads is that shade can lower the temperature in summer.
example2_zh: 城市沿路种树的一个原因是，树荫能降低夏天的气温。
collocations: one another｜互相 ; one by one｜一个一个地
tip_zh: one of 后面接复数名词，谓语常用单数。

meanings_zh: v. 有；吃，进行 | aux. 构成完成时
definition_en: to own, or to experience something | used with a past participle
example1_en: We have a maths test tomorrow.
example1_zh: 我们明天有一场数学测验。
example2_en: Students who have a regular place to study at home usually find it easier to start homework on time.
example2_zh: 家里有固定学习角落的学生，通常更容易按时开始写作业。
collocations: have to｜不得不 ; have breakfast｜吃早饭 ; have a look｜看一看
tip_zh: have to do 表示客观上不得不；must 更强调主观认为必须。

definition_en: in this place
example1_en: Please wait here until your name is called.
example1_zh: 请在这里等到叫你的名字。
example2_en: Communities that plant trees here, along the hottest streets, can make walking to school safer.
example2_zh: 在最热的街道旁种树的社区，可以让步行上学更安全。
collocations: here and there｜各处 ; come here｜过来
tip_zh: Here is / Here are 后面的主语决定动词单复数。

definition_en: used to stress something surprising
example1_en: Even a short walk can clear your head.
example1_zh: 即使是短短的散步也能让头脑清醒。
example2_en: Even a rich city can have neighbourhoods where children have no safe park nearby.
example2_zh: 即使是富裕的城市，也可能有孩子附近没有安全公园的社区。
collocations: even if｜即使 ; even though｜尽管
tip_zh: even 放在所强调的词前；even if 后面接让步从句。

meanings_zh: v. 设计 | n. 设计；设计方案 | n. 装饰图案
definition_en: to plan how something looks or works | the planning of something's appearance or function, or its plan | a decorative pattern on an object or surface
example1_en: They will design a new school logo.
example1_zh: 他们将设计一个新的校徽。
example2_en: Cities should design public spaces that encourage social interaction while remaining accessible to people with disabilities.
example2_zh: 城市应设计既能促进社交互动、又方便残障人士使用的公共空间。
collocations: design a building｜设计建筑 ; be designed to do something｜旨在做某事 ; graphic design｜平面设计 ; interior design｜室内设计
tip_zh: be designed to do表示“旨在做……”。

definition_en: skill or power to do something
example1_en: Language ability grows with practice.
example1_zh: 语言能力随练习而增长。
example2_en: Regular reading can strengthen children's ability to understand complex ideas and express their own views clearly.
example2_zh: 经常阅读可以增强儿童理解复杂概念和清晰表达自身观点的能力。
collocations: the ability to learn｜学习能力 ; develop an ability｜培养一种能力 ; academic ability｜学业能力 ; natural ability｜天赋
tip_zh: 表示“做某事的能力”用ability to do。

definition_en: in fact, or very
example1_en: I really want to understand this poem.
example2_en: A programme is not really successful if only the students who already read a lot take part.
example2_zh: 如果只有本来就读得很多的学生参加，一个项目并不能算真正成功。
collocations: really want｜真的想
tip_zh: really 修饰形容词或动词，强调程度或真实性。

definition_en: used for polite requests, habits, or imagined results
example1_en: Would you help me carry these books?
example1_zh: 你愿意帮我搬这些书吗？
example2_en: Many students would revise more calmly if tests were spread across the term instead of piled into one week.
example2_zh: 如果考试分散在整个学期，而不是堆在一周里，许多学生会复习得更从容。
collocations: would like｜想要 ; would rather｜宁愿
tip_zh: would like to do 是礼貌的“想要”；would rather do 表示宁愿。

definition_en: in addition
example1_en: She plays the piano and also sings in the choir.
example1_zh: 她弹钢琴，还在合唱团唱歌。
example2_en: Parks also reduce noise, which matters for schools built beside busy roads.
example2_zh: 公园还能降低噪音，这对建在繁忙道路旁的学校很重要。
collocations: not only...but also｜不仅……而且
tip_zh: also 多放在句中；too 和 as well 多放在句末。

definition_en: in what way, or to what degree
example1_en: How do you spell your family name?
example2_en: How a city treats its rivers often shows how seriously it takes public health.
example2_zh: 一座城市如何对待河流，常常说明它有多重视公共健康。
collocations: how about｜……怎么样 ; how long｜多久 ; how far｜多远
tip_zh: How 加形容词或副词构成感叹句；What 加名词。

meanings_zh: n. 距离 | n. 疏远；隔阂 | v. 使疏远；撇清关系
definition_en: space between two points | A lack of emotional closeness between people | To separate yourself from someone, something, or their views
example1_en: Keep a safe distance from the fire.
example2_en: Reducing the distance between residential areas and workplaces could lower transport emissions and improve urban quality of life.
example2_zh: 缩短住宅区与工作地点之间的距离，可以减少交通排放并改善城市生活质量。
collocations: walking distance｜步行可达的距离 ; in the distance｜在远处 ; keep your distance｜保持距离 ; distance yourself from｜与……划清界限
tip_zh: in the distance指在远处；at a distance指隔一段距离。

definition_en: for what reason
example1_en: Why is the lab closed this afternoon?
example1_zh: 实验室今天下午为什么关门？
example2_en: Understanding why a species disappears is the first step toward protecting the habitat it needs.
example2_zh: 弄清一个物种为何消失，是保护它所需栖息地的第一步。
collocations: why not｜为什么不 ; that is why｜那就是为什么
tip_zh: Why not do...? 用来提出建议，后面接动词原形。

definition_en: also, or more than enough
example1_en: This box is too heavy for one person.
example1_zh: 这个箱子一个人搬太重了。
example2_en: If tickets are too expensive, a museum built with public money will not serve the public.
example2_zh: 如果门票太贵，用公共资金建造的博物馆就服务不了公众。
collocations: too...to｜太……而不能 ; me too｜我也是
tip_zh: too...to do 表示太……而不能；also 不能放在这个结构里。

meanings_zh: n. 精力；能源 | n. 能量；能源
definition_en: power to work; power source | Power used to produce heat, movement, light, or electricity
example1_en: Young people have lots of energy.
example2_en: Investing in renewable energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels while creating new employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，同时创造新的就业机会。
collocations: full of energy｜精力充沛 ; renewable energy｜可再生能源 ; energy consumption｜能源消耗 ; save energy｜节约能源
tip_zh: 表示精力或能源时通常不可数，不说 an energy。

meanings_zh: n. 比赛；竞争 | n. 比赛；竞赛
definition_en: a contest | An organised event in which people try to win.
example1_en: She won first prize in the competition.
example1_zh: 她在比赛中获得一等奖。
example2_en: Competition between businesses can lower prices, but effective regulation is needed to protect consumers from unfair practices.
example2_zh: 企业间的竞争可以降低价格，但仍需有效监管来保护消费者免受不公平商业行为的侵害。
collocations: fierce competition｜激烈竞争 ; competition for jobs｜求职竞争 ; enter a competition｜参加比赛 ; win a competition｜赢得比赛
tip_zh: 表示竞争通常不可数；表示一场比赛时可数。

meanings_zh: v. 讨论 | v. 论述
definition_en: to talk about | to examine a subject in speech or writing
example1_en: Let's discuss the plan after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后我们讨论一下计划。
example2_en: Students should discuss different solutions before deciding how to reduce waste on their campus.
example2_zh: 学生应先讨论不同的解决办法，再决定如何减少校园垃圾。
collocations: discuss a problem｜讨论问题 ; discuss something with someone｜与某人讨论某事 ; discuss in detail｜详细讨论
tip_zh: 直接接讨论内容：discuss sth，不加about。

definition_en: to find for the first time
example1_en: Scientists discover new planets every year.
example1_zh: 科学家每年都发现新行星。
example2_en: Scientists may discover new ways to treat diseases by studying plants in tropical forests.
example2_zh: 科学家可能通过研究热带森林中的植物，发现治疗疾病的新方法。
collocations: discover a cure｜发现疗法 ; discover a new species｜发现新物种 ; discover the truth｜发现真相
tip_zh: discover发现原本存在的事物；invent创造新事物。

definition_en: to move or travel to a place
example1_en: We go to the stadium on Friday afternoons.
example1_zh: 我们周五下午去体育馆。
example2_en: If food prices go up too quickly, families may buy less fresh fruit for their children.
example2_zh: 如果食品价格涨得太快，家庭可能会给孩子少买新鲜水果。
collocations: go on｜继续 ; go over｜复习 ; go to school｜上学
tip_zh: go 的过去式是 went，过去分词是 gone。

meanings_zh: adj. 电的 | adj. 令人激动的
definition_en: using electricity | Full of excitement and energy.
example1_en: electric cars produce less smoke.
example1_zh: 电动汽车产生更少烟雾。
example2_en: Electric buses can reduce urban air pollution, especially when their power comes from renewable sources.
example2_zh: 电动公交车可以减少城市空气污染，尤其是在使用可再生能源供电时。
collocations: electric car｜电动汽车 ; electric current｜电流 ; electric shock｜电击 ; electric atmosphere｜热烈的气氛
tip_zh: 电动设备多用electric；电气系统多用electrical。

meanings_zh: adj. 方便的 | adj. 附近的；便于到达的
definition_en: easy to use or reach | Situated close to somewhere you need to reach.
example1_en: Online payment is convenient.
example2_en: Online learning offers a convenient way for working adults to develop skills without travelling to a campus.
example2_zh: 在线学习为在职成年人提供了无需前往校园就能提升技能的便捷途径。
collocations: a convenient time｜合适的时间 ; convenient for someone｜对某人方便 ; a convenient location｜便利的位置 ; a convenient way to｜做……的便捷方式
tip_zh: 说 It is convenient for me，不说 I am convenient。

meanings_zh: adj. 积极的；活跃的 | adj. 运作中的；起作用的 | adj. 主动语态的
definition_en: busy doing things | currently working or producing an effect | describing a verb whose subject performs the action
example1_en: Stay active after school.
example2_en: Schools should encourage an active lifestyle to improve students' physical health and overall wellbeing.
example2_zh: 学校应鼓励积极运动的生活方式，以改善学生的身体健康和整体身心状态。
collocations: stay active｜保持活力 ; an active lifestyle｜积极运动的生活方式 ; play an active role｜发挥积极作用 ; active ingredient｜有效成分
tip_zh: active指积极活动或参与；不等于表示乐观的positive。

definition_en: at what time, or at the time that
example1_en: When does the library close tonight?
example1_zh: 图书馆今晚什么时候关门？
example2_en: When young people only meet friends online, they may lose practice in reading faces and tones.
example2_zh: 当年轻人只在网上见朋友时，他们可能缺少辨认表情和语气的练习。
collocations: when it comes to｜当涉及 ; since when｜从什么时候起
tip_zh: when 引导时间状语从句时，从句常用一般现在时表将来。

meanings_zh: v. 依靠；取决于 | v. 依赖；信赖
definition_en: to need support; to be decided by | to need or trust someone or something for support
example1_en: Success may depend on hard work.
example2_en: Many rural communities depend on reliable public transport to access healthcare, education, and employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 许多农村社区依靠可靠的公共交通来获得医疗、教育和就业机会。
collocations: depend on｜取决于；依赖 ; depend heavily on｜严重依赖 ; depend on someone to do something｜指望某人做某事
tip_zh: 常接on或upon；It depends意为“看情况”。

definition_en: to notice with the eyes, or to understand
example1_en: I can see the playground from this window.
example1_zh: 我从这扇窗户能看见操场。
example2_en: When people see the cost of wasted food, they are more willing to change what they buy.
example2_zh: 当人们看到浪费食物的代价时，他们更愿意改变购买习惯。
collocations: see sb off｜送行 ; see to｜处理 ; I see｜我明白了
tip_zh: see 强调看见的结果；look 强调看的动作；watch 强调持续观看。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……之后 | conj. 在……以后
definition_en: later than a time or event | at a later time than
example1_en: We clean the lab after each experiment.
example1_zh: 每次实验后我们都打扫实验室。
example2_en: After a major flood, schools may have to share buildings until their own classrooms are safe again.
example2_zh: 大洪水之后，学校可能不得不共用校舍，直到自己的教室再次安全。
collocations: after all｜毕竟 ; look after｜照顾 ; one after another｜一个接一个
tip_zh: after 是介词或连词；副词“后来”常用 afterwards 或 later。

meanings_zh: v. 发展；培养 | v. 开发；研制 | v. 逐渐出现；患上
definition_en: to grow or improve | to create a new product, method, or idea | to begin to have a condition, problem, or feeling
example1_en: Reading helps develop your vocabulary.
example1_zh: 阅读有助于培养词汇量。
example2_en: Governments should fund research to develop affordable technologies that address water shortages in rural communities.
example2_zh: 政府应资助研究，开发价格可负担的技术，以解决农村社区的缺水问题。
collocations: develop skills｜培养技能 ; develop a habit｜养成习惯 ; develop new technology｜开发新技术 ; develop symptoms｜出现症状
tip_zh: 可及物也可不及物：develop skills；skills develop。

definition_en: in or to what place
example1_en: Where did you leave your sports shoes?
example1_zh: 你把运动鞋放在哪儿了？
example2_en: Cities need places where teenagers can meet without having to spend money.
example2_zh: 城市需要一些地方，让青少年不必花钱也能见面。
collocations: where there is｜在有……的地方
tip_zh: where 引导地点状语或定语从句，先行词是地点。

meanings_zh: n. 差异 | n. 分歧；意见不合 | n. 差额；差值
definition_en: the way things are not the same | A disagreement between people or groups | The amount by which one quantity exceeds another
example1_en: Age makes little difference in friendship.
example1_zh: 年龄在友谊中几乎没有差异。
example2_en: Understanding cultural differences can help international students adapt more successfully to life in a new country.
example2_zh: 了解文化差异有助于留学生更顺利地适应新国家的生活。
collocations: the difference between｜……之间的区别 ; make a difference｜产生影响 ; a significant difference｜显著差异 ; settle differences｜解决分歧
tip_zh: 比较两者用the difference between A and B。

definition_en: in that place
example1_en: There is a new poster on the back wall.
example2_en: There are still towns where the nearest hospital is more than an hour away by bus.
example2_zh: 仍有一些城镇，乘公交到最近的医院要一个多小时。
collocations: over there｜在那边 ; here and there｜到处
tip_zh: There be 句中，be 的单复数跟后面真正的主语走。

meanings_zh: adj. 有帮助的 | adj. 乐于助人的
definition_en: useful | Willing to help other people.
example1_en: Your notes were very helpful.
example2_en: Clear feedback is particularly helpful for students who are learning to organise their ideas in academic essays.
example2_zh: 对于正在学习如何组织学术论文思路的学生来说，清晰的反馈尤其有帮助。
collocations: helpful advice｜有用的建议 ; helpful information｜有用的信息 ; helpful staff｜乐于助人的员工 ; find something helpful｜觉得某物有帮助
tip_zh: helpful可形容事物有用，也可形容人乐于助人。

definition_en: an illness
example1_en: Clean water helps prevent disease.
example1_zh: 干净的水有助于预防疾病。
example2_en: Access to clean drinking water can significantly reduce the spread of infectious diseases in vulnerable communities.
example2_zh: 获得清洁饮用水可以显著减少传染病在脆弱社区中的传播。
collocations: heart disease｜心脏病 ; infectious diseases｜传染病 ; prevent disease｜预防疾病 ; the spread of disease｜疾病传播
tip_zh: 重音在第二音节；泛指疾病可不加冠词。

meanings_zh: v. 取消 | v. 抵消
definition_en: to stop a planned event | To balance an opposing effect so neither changes the result.
example1_en: They had to cancel the trip because of rain.
example1_zh: 因为下雨他们不得不取消旅行。
example2_en: Improved energy efficiency may cancel out some environmental benefits if it encourages people to consume more.
example2_zh: 如果能源效率提高促使人们增加消费，就可能抵消部分环境效益。
collocations: cancel a booking｜取消预订 ; cancel a flight｜取消航班 ; cancel out｜抵消
tip_zh: 英式过去式cancelled，美式常用canceled；抵消用out。

definition_en: a period of twelve months
example1_en: This is my second year at this school.
example1_zh: 这是我在这所学校的第二年。
example2_en: A dry year can raise food prices, which hits families who already spend most of their income on meals.
example2_zh: 干旱的一年会推高食品价格，打击那些收入大部分已用于吃饭的家庭。
collocations: year after year｜年复一年 ; all the year round｜一年到头
tip_zh: 在哪一年用 in：in 2024。

meanings_zh: adj. 国际的 | n. 国际比赛；国家队选手
definition_en: between countries | A match between countries, or a player representing a country.
example1_en: English is an international language.
example2_en: International cooperation is essential for tackling environmental problems that extend beyond the borders of individual countries.
example2_zh: 国际合作对于解决超越单个国家边界的环境问题至关重要。
collocations: international trade｜国际贸易 ; international cooperation｜国际合作 ; an international flight｜国际航班 ; international students｜国际学生
tip_zh: international涉及多国；domestic指国内的。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……之前 | conj. 在……以前
definition_en: earlier than | earlier than the time when
example1_en: Please wash your hands before lunch.
example2_en: Cities should test their flood plans before the rainy season, not after the first street is under water.
example2_zh: 城市应该在雨季之前检验防汛方案，而不是等第一条街被淹之后。
collocations: before long｜不久 ; the day before｜前一天
tip_zh: before 可作介词、连词或副词。

definition_en: to carry, to need time, or to do an exam or trip
example1_en: It takes me twenty minutes to walk to school.
example1_zh: 我步行上学要二十分钟。
example2_en: It can take a generation to repair a forest that was cut down in a single decade.
example2_zh: 修复一片十年内被砍光的森林，可能需要一代人的时间。
collocations: take part in｜参加 ; take care of｜照顾 ; take place｜发生
tip_zh: It takes sb time to do 表示花时间；spend 的主语是人。

meanings_zh: n. 方向；指导 | n. 路线指引；使用说明 | n. 指导；管理
definition_en: the way to go; guidance | instructions explaining how to reach somewhere or do something | the control or guidance of an activity or group
example1_en: Ask for direction if you get lost.
example2_en: Government investment can influence the direction of technological development by supporting research into cleaner energy sources.
example2_zh: 政府投资可以通过支持清洁能源研究来影响技术发展的方向。
collocations: in the opposite direction｜朝相反方向 ; ask for directions｜问路 ; follow the directions｜遵照说明 ; under the direction of｜在……的指导下
tip_zh: 表示路线指引或操作说明时，通常用复数directions。

definition_en: very surprising
example1_en: What an amazing view from the hill!
example1_zh: 山顶的景色多么令人惊奇！
example2_en: Recent medical research has produced amazing results, offering new hope to patients with previously untreatable conditions.
example2_zh: 近期医学研究取得了惊人的成果，为患有过去无法治疗的疾病的患者带来了新希望。
collocations: absolutely amazing｜极其精彩的 ; amazing results｜惊人的成果 ; an amazing experience｜一次奇妙的经历
tip_zh: amazing形容令人惊叹的事物；amazed形容人的感受。

definition_en: to create, or to cause something to happen
example1_en: We make posters for the book fair.
example2_en: Noise from a busy road can make it difficult for children to concentrate in class.
example2_zh: 繁忙道路的噪音会让孩子很难在课堂上集中注意力。
collocations: make sure｜确保 ; make up｜编造；组成 ; make use of｜利用
tip_zh: make sb do 不带 to；被动式则是 be made to do。

meanings_zh: v. 接受；承认 | v. 承认；认可 | v. 承担；接受现实
definition_en: to take or agree to something offered | Recognize that something is true or valid | Take responsibility or stop resisting an unpleasant situation
example1_en: She decided to accept the job offer.
example1_zh: 她决定接受这份工作邀约。
example2_en: Governments must accept responsibility for ensuring that all children have access to basic education.
example2_zh: 政府必须承担责任，确保所有儿童都能接受基础教育。
collocations: accept an offer｜接受提议 ; accept responsibility｜承担责任 ; accept an invitation｜接受邀请 ; accept that｜承认……
tip_zh: 接受建议用accept；接受某物不等于仅仅收到receive。

meanings_zh: adj. 基本的 | adj. 简单的；无额外设施的
definition_en: simple and most important | Having only necessary features, without anything extra.
example1_en: Learn the basic rules first.
example2_en: Governments should ensure that all citizens have access to basic healthcare, regardless of their income.
example2_zh: 政府应确保所有公民都能获得基本医疗服务，不论其收入如何。
collocations: basic skills｜基本技能 ; basic needs｜基本需求 ; basic knowledge｜基础知识 ; basic principles｜基本原则
tip_zh: 名词“基础知识”用复数 the basics。

meanings_zh: adv. 回原处；向后 | n. 背部；后面
definition_en: to the place where someone or something was before | the rear part of the body or of an object
example1_en: I will be back before the bell rings.
example2_en: Bringing back local markets can give neighbourhoods a place to meet as well as a place to shop.
example2_zh: 恢复本地集市不仅提供购物的地方，也给社区一个见面的地方。
collocations: come back｜回来 ; give back｜归还 ; back to back｜背靠背
tip_zh: back 作副词不需要介词：go back home，不要说 go back to home。

meanings_zh: v. 允许 | v. 使可能；容许 | v. 留出；预留
definition_en: to let someone do something | to make something possible | to provide enough time or resources for something
example1_en: Parents should allow kids to make choices.
example1_zh: 父母应允许孩子做选择。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to balance their professional responsibilities with family commitments more effectively.
example2_zh: 灵活的工作安排使员工能够更有效地兼顾工作职责与家庭义务。
collocations: allow someone to do something｜允许某人做某事 ; allow enough time｜留出足够时间 ; allow for delays｜考虑到可能的延误
tip_zh: 用allow sb to do；无宾语时可用allow doing。

definition_en: continuing until now
example1_en: She is still in the library.
example2_en: Many rural schools still share one science teacher among several classes.
example2_zh: 许多乡村学校仍然是几个班共用一位科学老师。
collocations: still alive｜仍然活着
tip_zh: still 多用于肯定句表示还在继续；yet 多用于否定和疑问，表示尚未。

meanings_zh: v. 破坏；摧毁 | v. 彻底破坏；使丧失
definition_en: to ruin completely | To completely end something valuable, such as trust or hope.
example1_en: Fire can destroy a whole forest.
example2_en: Uncontrolled urban expansion can destroy natural habitats and threaten the survival of species that depend on them.
example2_zh: 不受控制的城市扩张会摧毁自然栖息地，威胁依赖这些栖息地的物种生存。
collocations: destroy habitats｜摧毁栖息地 ; destroy evidence｜销毁证据 ; destroy confidence｜摧毁信心 ; completely destroy｜彻底摧毁
tip_zh: destroy比damage程度重，通常指彻底毁坏。

definition_en: the ones farther away or already mentioned
example1_en: Those bags by the door are for the trip.
example1_zh: 门边的那些包是出行用的。
example2_en: Those who grow up near parks are more likely to spend time outside as adults.
example2_zh: 在公园附近长大的人，成年后更可能把时间花在户外。
collocations: those who｜那些……的人
tip_zh: those 是 that 的复数。those who 后接复数含义的谓语。

definition_en: after that, or at that time
example1_en: We finished the quiz and then checked the answers.
example1_zh: 我们做完小测，然后核对了答案。
example2_en: If a river is polluted, the fish leave, and then the birds that feed on them leave too.
example2_zh: 如果一条河被污染，鱼会离开，接着以鱼为食的鸟也会离开。
collocations: since then｜从那时起 ; now and then｜偶尔
tip_zh: then 是“然后、那时”；比较级后面的“比”是 than。

definition_en: minutes and hours, or an occasion
example1_en: We do not have much time before class.
example1_zh: 上课前我们没有多少时间了。
example2_en: Screen time late at night can reduce the hours of deep sleep that teenagers need.
example2_zh: 深夜的屏幕时间会减少青少年所需的深度睡眠。
collocations: on time｜准时 ; in time｜及时 ; from time to time｜不时
tip_zh: time 表示时间通常不可数；表示次数或时代时可数，如 three times、modern times。

definition_en: to obtain, become, or arrive
example1_en: I get home at about six.
example2_en: Students who get enough daylight during the day often find it easier to fall asleep at night.
example2_zh: 白天接受足够日光的学生，往往更容易在夜里入睡。
collocations: get up｜起床 ; get on｜上车 ; get along with｜与……相处
tip_zh: get 加形容词表示变化：get tired。上车用 get on，小汽车也可用 get into。

meanings_zh: n. 程度；学位 | n. 程度 | n. 度；度数
definition_en: level; a university title | the amount or level of something | a unit used to measure temperature or angles
example1_en: To some degree, luck plays a role.
example1_zh: 在某种程度上，运气起作用。
example2_en: Although a university degree can improve employment prospects, practical experience remains highly valuable in many industries.
example2_zh: 虽然大学学位能改善就业前景，但实践经验在许多行业仍然十分重要。
collocations: a degree in economics｜经济学学位 ; a bachelor's degree｜学士学位 ; to some degree｜在某种程度上 ; degrees Celsius｜摄氏度
tip_zh: 某专业的学位用a degree in；程度义常见to some degree。

meanings_zh: n. 行为 | n. 运行特性；反应方式
definition_en: the way someone acts | the way a substance or system acts under particular conditions
example1_en: Good behavior is expected in class.
example1_zh: 课堂上期望有良好行为。
example2_en: Schools can encourage responsible behavior by giving students meaningful opportunities to participate in decisions affecting their community.
example2_zh: 学校可以让学生有实质性机会参与影响其社区的决策，以此鼓励负责任的行为。
collocations: good behavior｜良好行为 ; consumer behavior｜消费者行为 ; animal behavior｜动物行为 ; patterns of behavior｜行为模式
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式为behaviour。通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 可获得的；有空的 | adj. 有空的
definition_en: able to be used or free | Not busy and able to meet or help someone.
example1_en: Is the book available in the library?
example2_en: Affordable housing should be available to all residents, regardless of their income or employment status.
example2_zh: 所有居民都应能获得负担得起的住房，不论其收入或就业状况如何。
collocations: readily available｜容易获得的 ; available to everyone｜人人都可获得的 ; available for use｜可供使用的 ; make something available｜使某物可供使用
tip_zh: available to接使用者；available for接用途。

definition_en: towards a higher place, or completely
example1_en: Please pick up the paper on the floor.
example2_en: Cleaning up a river takes years, but students can still start by sorting waste at school.
example2_zh: 清理一条河要花很多年，但学生仍可以从学校垃圾分类做起。
collocations: get up｜起床 ; give up｜放弃 ; look up｜查阅
tip_zh: 许多动词加 up 表示完成或向上，如 eat up、stand up。

meanings_zh: adj. 仔细的；小心的 | adj. 仔细的；细致的
definition_en: taking care to avoid mistakes | giving close attention to details
example1_en: Be careful when you cross the road.
example2_en: Careful planning can help cities expand public transport while keeping construction costs under control.
example2_zh: 周密的规划可以帮助城市扩展公共交通，同时控制建设成本。
collocations: be careful with｜小心对待 ; careful planning｜周密规划 ; careful consideration｜慎重考虑 ; careful analysis｜细致分析
tip_zh: be careful with后接物；be careful to后接动词。

definition_en: a large amount, used with uncountable nouns
example1_en: There is not much time left.
example2_en: Too much packaging makes recycling harder, even when the food inside is necessary.
example2_zh: 过多的包装会让回收更难，即使里面的食物是必需的。
collocations: too much｜太多 ; much better｜好得多 ; how much｜多少
tip_zh: much 修饰不可数名词；可数名词用 many。

definition_en: an opinion about what to do
example1_en: Thank you for your useful advice.
example2_en: Schools should provide practical career advice so that students can make informed decisions about their future.
example2_zh: 学校应提供实用的职业建议，让学生能够对自己的未来作出明智决定。
collocations: give advice｜提供建议 ; seek advice｜寻求建议 ; follow advice｜听从建议 ; a piece of advice｜一条建议
tip_zh: 不可数，不用an advice；动词advise末尾读/z/。

definition_en: very good
example1_en: She did an excellent job.
example2_en: Excellent public transport can reduce car dependence and make cities more accessible to all residents.
example2_zh: 优质的公共交通可以减少人们对汽车的依赖，让所有居民出行更便利。
collocations: excellent service｜优质服务 ; excellent results｜优异成绩 ; excellent opportunity｜绝佳机会
tip_zh: 已含“极好”之意，通常不用very修饰。

definition_en: the ones near the speaker
example1_en: These chairs belong to the music room.
example1_zh: 这些椅子是音乐教室的。
example2_en: These figures do not include students who study at home, so the total may be higher.
example2_zh: 这些数字不包括在家学习的学生，所以总数可能更高。
collocations: these days｜如今
tip_zh: these 是 this 的复数，指较近的人或物。

definition_en: a choice made
example1_en: Making a decision can take time.
example2_en: Governments should base every major transport decision on reliable evidence and consultation with the communities affected.
example2_zh: 政府的每项重大交通决策都应以可靠证据及与受影响社区的协商为基础。
collocations: make a decision｜作出决定 ; reach a decision｜达成决定 ; informed decision｜基于充分了解的决定 ; final decision｜最终决定
tip_zh: 作决定用make a decision，不用do。

definition_en: not at any time
example1_en: I have never been to the science museum.
example1_zh: 我从没去过科学博物馆。
example2_en: A city should never treat clean water as something only wealthy neighbourhoods can expect.
example2_zh: 一座城市绝不该把干净的水看成只有富裕社区才能指望的东西。
collocations: never mind｜没关系 ; never before｜以前从未
tip_zh: never 放在助动词后、实义动词前；位于句首时句子要倒装。

meanings_zh: v. 出现；似乎 | v. 似乎；显得 | v. 登场；出庭
definition_en: to become visible; to seem | To seem to be a certain way. | To take part in a performance or attend court formally.
example1_en: A rainbow may appear after the rain.
example2_en: Online courses appear to offer greater flexibility, although some learners still prefer traditional classroom interaction.
example2_zh: 网络课程似乎提供了更大的灵活性，但一些学习者仍更喜欢传统课堂互动。
collocations: appear suddenly｜突然出现 ; appear to be｜似乎是 ; appear in court｜出庭
tip_zh: 表“似乎”可接形容词或to do；不能直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: adj. 当地的 | n. 当地人 | adj. 局部的
definition_en: of a particular area | a person who lives in a particular area | affecting only a limited part of something
example1_en: Buy local food when you can.
example2_en: Supporting local businesses can strengthen community ties and keep more money circulating within the regional economy.
example2_zh: 支持本地企业可以加强社区联系，并让更多资金在区域经济内部流通。
collocations: local community｜当地社区 ; local authorities｜地方当局 ; local residents｜当地居民 ; local anaesthetic｜局部麻醉药
tip_zh: 名词复数locals指当地人；locally是副词。

definition_en: to have information, or to be familiar with someone
example1_en: I know the answer, but I cannot explain it yet.
example1_zh: 我知道答案，但还解释不清。
example2_en: Students who know how to question a chart are less likely to be misled by a dramatic headline.
example2_zh: 知道如何质疑一张图表的学生，不太会被夸张的标题误导。
collocations: know about｜了解 ; be known for｜因……闻名 ; as far as I know｜据我所知
tip_zh: know 后面不接不定式表示“知道去做”，要用 know how to do。

meanings_zh: v. 安排；整理 | v. 排列；整理
definition_en: to plan or put in order | Put things in a particular order or position.
example1_en: Please arrange the books on the shelf.
example1_zh: 请把书架上的书整理好。
example2_en: Schools can arrange visits to local businesses to help students understand the practical demands of different careers.
example2_zh: 学校可以安排学生参观当地企业，帮助他们了解不同职业的实际要求。
collocations: arrange a meeting｜安排会议 ; arrange to meet｜约好见面 ; arrange for someone to do something｜安排某人做某事 ; arrange flowers｜插花
tip_zh: 安排某人做某事用arrange for sb to do。

meanings_zh: v. 创造；创作 | v. 造成；引起
definition_en: to make something new | to cause a situation, feeling, or problem to develop
example1_en: Artists create works that move people.
example1_zh: 艺术家创作打动人心的作品。
example2_en: Investment in renewable energy can create jobs while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源能创造就业机会，同时减少对进口化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: create opportunities｜创造机会 ; create jobs｜创造就业机会 ; create a problem｜造成问题 ; create a work of art｜创作艺术作品
tip_zh: create强调创造新事物，也可接problem表示造成问题。

meanings_zh: adj. 古代的；古老的 | adj. 非常古老的
definition_en: very old | having existed for a very long time
example1_en: We visited an ancient temple.
example2_en: Studying ancient civilisations helps researchers understand how early societies managed water, trade, and public health.
example2_zh: 研究古代文明有助于研究人员了解早期社会如何管理用水、贸易和公共卫生。
collocations: ancient history｜古代史 ; ancient civilisation｜古代文明 ; ancient ruins｜古代遗址 ; ancient monument｜古代历史遗迹
tip_zh: ancient强调年代久远，不宜代替一般的old。

meanings_zh: n. 数量；总额 | v. 总计；相当于
definition_en: a quantity | To total something or be equivalent to it.
example1_en: A large amount of rain fell last night.
example2_en: Reducing the amount of food wasted by households could significantly lower the environmental impact of food production.
example2_zh: 减少家庭食物浪费量可以显著降低食品生产对环境的影响。
collocations: a large amount of｜大量的 ; total amount｜总量；总额 ; amount to｜总计；相当于
tip_zh: amount of接不可数名词；动词常用amount to。

definition_en: used to ask for information
example1_en: What did the teacher say about the quiz?
example1_zh: 老师关于小测说了什么？
example2_en: What a community chooses to protect, whether a park or a dialect, shows what it values.
example2_zh: 一个社区选择保护什么，无论是公园还是方言，都显示它看重什么。
collocations: what about｜……怎么样 ; what if｜如果……会怎样
tip_zh: 感叹句 What a/an + 名词；How 后面接形容词或副词。

definition_en: a period of 24 hours, or the time when it is light
example1_en: We have a fire drill on the first day of term.
example1_zh: 学期第一天我们有消防演习。
example2_en: A heatwave can turn an ordinary school day into a health risk for students in rooms without fans.
example2_zh: 热浪会把普通的上学日变成健康风险，尤其是没有风扇的教室。
collocations: day by day｜一天天地 ; one day｜有一天 ; the other day｜前几天
tip_zh: on 加具体的某一天；in the day 表示在白天。

definition_en: to the inside of, or so as to become
example1_en: She walked into the hall with the register.
example1_zh: 她拿着点名册走进大厅。
example2_en: Old factories can be turned into museums, which keeps the story of a town visible.
example2_zh: 旧工厂可以改成博物馆，让一座城镇的故事仍然看得见。
collocations: look into｜调查 ; turn into｜变成 ; get into｜进入
tip_zh: into 强调进入的过程；in 强调在里面的状态。

definition_en: human beings in general
example1_en: Many people wait for the bus in the rain.
example2_en: Older people in a neighbourhood can help children feel safe on the walk home from school.
example2_zh: 社区里的老人可以帮助孩子在放学路上感到安全。
collocations: people say｜人们说 ; young people｜年轻人
tip_zh: people 本身是复数；一个人用 a person 或 one person。

meanings_zh: adj. 现代的 | adj. 新式的；时髦的
definition_en: of present times | Using the latest ideas, methods, or styles.
example1_en: modern technology changes life.
example2_en: Modern technology allows students in remote areas to access educational resources previously available only in cities.
example2_zh: 现代技术让偏远地区的学生能够获取过去只有城市才有的教育资源。
collocations: modern society｜现代社会 ; modern technology｜现代技术 ; modern architecture｜现代建筑
tip_zh: modern强调现代或新式；不一定表示刚刚制造。

meanings_zh: adj. 确切的 | v. 强求；索取
definition_en: completely correct | Demand and obtain something, often through authority or force.
example1_en: What is the exact time?
example2_en: Researchers need exact measurements to determine whether changes in air quality are linked to new transport policies.
example2_zh: 研究人员需要精确的测量数据，以判断空气质量变化是否与新的交通政策有关。
collocations: exact location｜确切位置 ; exact amount｜准确数量 ; exact copy｜完全相同的复制品 ; exact a heavy toll｜造成惨重损失
tip_zh: exact强调分毫不差；副词形式为exactly。

definition_en: to wish for something
example1_en: I want to join the school choir.
example2_en: Not every teenager wants a career that looks impressive; many want work that feels useful.
example2_zh: 并非每个青少年都想要一份看起来光鲜的职业；许多人想要感觉有用的工作。
collocations: want to do｜想做 ; want sb to do｜想让某人做
tip_zh: want 后面接 to do，不接 doing 表示想要做某事。

meanings_zh: v. 比较 | v. 把……比作 | v. 比得上；可相比
definition_en: to look at differences and similarities | To describe something as similar to another thing. | To be as good as, or similar to, something else.
example1_en: Please compare these two essays carefully.
example1_zh: 请仔细比较这两篇文章。
example2_en: Researchers should compare the long-term costs of renewable energy with those of traditional power sources.
example2_zh: 研究人员应比较可再生能源与传统能源的长期成本。
collocations: compare prices｜比较价格 ; compare A with B｜将A与B比较 ; compare A to B｜将A比作B；比较A和B ; compare favourably with｜比起来不逊于
tip_zh: 比较可用with或to；表示比喻时通常用to。

definition_en: used to ask which person, or to refer to a person
example1_en: Who is the boy standing by the window?
example2_en: Students who sleep less than seven hours are more likely to feel sleepy in the first lesson.
example2_zh: 睡眠少于七小时的学生更可能在第一节课犯困。
collocations: who else｜还有谁
tip_zh: 先行词是人时用 who；物用 which 或 that。

definition_en: to have an opinion, or to use one's mind
example1_en: I think the second answer is better.
example1_zh: 我认为第二个答案更好。
example2_en: People tend to think a problem is simple until they have to explain it to someone else.
example2_zh: 人们往往觉得一个问题很简单，直到必须把它讲给别人听。
collocations: think of｜想到 ; think about｜考虑 ; think over｜仔细考虑
tip_zh: think of 常表示想起；think about 表示正在考虑。

meanings_zh: adv. 好地；充分地 | adj. 健康的
definition_en: in a good or thorough way | in good health
example1_en: She explains grammar well.
example2_en: A team that listens well can solve a problem faster than a team of people who all talk at once.
example2_zh: 善于倾听的团队，能比所有人同时说话的团队更快解决问题。
collocations: as well｜也 ; as well as｜也；和 ; do well｜做得好
tip_zh: well 修饰动词；good 修饰名词。身体好也用 well。

definition_en: tools needed for a task
example1_en: The lab has modern equipment.
example2_en: Schools need suitable laboratory equipment to give students practical experience and encourage an interest in science.
example2_zh: 学校需要合适的实验室设备，让学生获得实践经验并培养科学兴趣。
collocations: sports equipment｜体育器材 ; medical equipment｜医疗设备 ; safety equipment｜安全装备 ; a piece of equipment｜一件设备
tip_zh: 不可数；一件设备说a piece of equipment。

meanings_zh: v. 争论；主张 | v. 论证；主张
definition_en: to disagree in words; to claim | To give reasons supporting an opinion or position.
example1_en: They often argue about small things.
example2_en: Some researchers argue that affordable public transport is essential for reducing inequality in large cities.
example2_zh: 一些研究者认为，价格可负担的公共交通对于减少大城市中的不平等至关重要。
collocations: argue with someone｜与某人争论 ; argue about something｜就某事争论 ; argue that｜主张…… ; argue for｜据理支持
tip_zh: argue that常用于议论文，表示提出有理由的主张。

definition_en: not existing before, or recently arrived
example1_en: There is a new clock in the reading room.
example2_en: A new bus line can change which school a family is able to choose.
example2_zh: 一条新公交线路会改变一个家庭能够选择的学校。
collocations: brand new｜全新的 ; new to｜对……陌生
tip_zh: news 是不可数名词，不是 new 的复数。

definition_en: one, some, or every, often in questions and negatives
example1_en: Do you have any questions about the homework?
example1_zh: 作业方面你有什么问题吗？
example2_en: Any plan to cut traffic must also consider how students travel when buses are full.
example2_zh: 任何减少交通的计划，都必须考虑公交拥挤时学生怎么上学。
collocations: any longer｜再 ; if any｜如果有的话 ; in any case｜无论如何
tip_zh: 肯定句里的“一些”常用 some；any 多用于疑问句、否定句或“任何”。

definition_en: used to say what is right or sensible
example1_en: You should check the name on the paper.
example1_zh: 你应该核对试卷上的姓名。
example2_en: Governments should publish clear data if they ask citizens to change the way they travel.
example2_zh: 如果政府要求公民改变出行方式，就应该公布清晰的数据。
collocations: should have done｜本应该做
tip_zh: should 表示建议或责任，后面接动词原形。

meanings_zh: n. 环境 | n. 生活或工作环境
definition_en: the natural world around us | The conditions and surroundings in which someone lives or works.
example1_en: We must protect the environment.
example2_en: A supportive learning environment can improve students' confidence and encourage them to participate more actively.
example2_zh: 支持性的学习环境能够增强学生的信心，鼓励他们更加积极地参与。
collocations: protect the environment｜保护环境 ; natural environment｜自然环境 ; working environment｜工作环境 ; learning environment｜学习环境
tip_zh: 泛指自然环境常用the environment。

definition_en: at the present time
example1_en: The shop is closed now.
example2_en: Cities that act now on rubbish sorting will spend less later on cleaning land and water.
example2_zh: 现在就开始垃圾分类的城市，以后在清理土地和水体上的花费会更少。
collocations: from now on｜从现在起 ; now and then｜偶尔 ; just now｜刚才
tip_zh: just now 常与过去时连用，表示刚才。

definition_en: words that tell what something is like
example1_en: Write a short description of your hometown.
example1_zh: 写一段对家乡的简短描述。
example2_en: A clear description of research methods allows other scientists to evaluate the reliability of a study.
example2_zh: 清楚描述研究方法，有助于其他科学家评估研究的可靠性。
collocations: a detailed description｜详细描述 ; give a description of｜描述 ; a job description｜岗位职责说明 ; an accurate description｜准确描述
tip_zh: 表示对某物的描述，用a description of，不用about。

meanings_zh: n. 原因；事业 | v. 导致；引起 | n. 事业；奋斗目标
definition_en: a reason; a movement to support | make something happen, especially something unpleasant | an aim or principle that people support and work towards
example1_en: Pollution is a major cause of illness.
example1_zh: 污染是疾病的一个主要原因。
example2_en: Heavy traffic is a major cause of air pollution in many rapidly growing urban areas.
example2_zh: 在许多快速发展的城市地区，繁忙的交通是空气污染的主要原因。
collocations: cause of｜……的原因 ; cause damage｜造成损害 ; root cause｜根本原因 ; a good cause｜公益事业
tip_zh: 名词常接of；动词可用cause sb to do sth。

definition_en: nearly all, or to the greatest degree
example1_en: Most students walk or cycle to school.
example1_zh: 大多数学生步行或骑车上学。
example2_en: The most effective rules are the ones people understand, not the ones that are only posted on a wall.
example2_zh: 最有效的规则是人们理解的那些，而不只是贴在墙上的那些。
collocations: at most｜至多 ; most of｜……中的大多数
tip_zh: most 直接加名词表示大多数；the most 用于最高级。

definition_en: different from the one already mentioned
example1_en: The other books are still on the shelf.
example2_en: Other factors, such as noise and light, can affect sleep as much as the hour a student goes to bed.
example2_zh: 其他因素，比如噪音和光线，对睡眠的影响可以和上床时间一样大。
collocations: each other｜互相 ; the other｜另一个（特指） ; other than｜除了
tip_zh: the other 指两者中的另一个；another 指再一个、不确定的另一个。

meanings_zh: v. 决定 | v. 决定结果
definition_en: to make a choice | To determine the result of something.
example1_en: We must decide where to go.
example2_en: Governments must decide how to distribute limited resources between healthcare, education and public transport.
example2_zh: 政府必须决定如何在医疗、教育和公共交通之间分配有限资源。
collocations: decide to do something｜决定做某事 ; decide on｜选定 ; decide against｜决定不采用 ; decide the outcome｜决定结果
tip_zh: 用decide to do，不用decide doing。

definition_en: for the reason that
example1_en: I stayed behind because I had a club meeting.
example1_zh: 我留下了，因为我有社团会议。
example2_en: Some streets flood because the drains were built for a smaller town than the one that exists today.
example2_zh: 有些街道会积水，是因为排水系统是按比今天更小的城镇修建的。
collocations: because of｜因为 ; just because｜仅仅因为
tip_zh: because 后接句子；because of 后接名词或短语。

meanings_zh: adj. 正确的；右边的 | n. 右边；权利 | adv. 正好；立刻
definition_en: correct, or on the right side | the right side, or something one is allowed to have | exactly, or immediately
example1_en: You got the right answer on the first try.
example2_en: The right to a quiet night's sleep is hard to protect when a city never turns its lights down.
example2_zh: 当一座城市从不调暗灯光时，安静睡眠的权利就很难保障。
collocations: right now｜此刻 ; on the right｜在右边 ; all right｜好的
tip_zh: right 还可作名词，表示权利：the right to do。

definition_en: used when comparing
example1_en: This bag is heavier than mine.
example2_en: Cycling to school can be faster than taking a crowded bus in the morning rush.
example2_zh: 上学骑车有时比早高峰挤公交更快。
collocations: more than｜多于 ; rather than｜而不是 ; less than｜少于
tip_zh: 比较级后面用 than，不要用 then。then 是“然后”。

definition_en: away from a place, or not operating
example1_en: Please turn off the lights when you leave.
example2_en: Taking a day off can prevent a small illness from becoming a week away from school.
example2_zh: 休息一天可以避免小病变成离校一周。
collocations: turn off｜关掉 ; take off｜起飞；脱下 ; off duty｜下班
tip_zh: off 常与动词组成短语，含义要整词记忆，如 put off 是推迟。

meanings_zh: v. 避免 | v. 避开；躲避
definition_en: to keep away from | to stay away from someone or something
example1_en: Try to avoid eating too much sugar.
example2_en: Cities should improve public transport to avoid further increases in traffic congestion and air pollution.
example2_zh: 城市应改善公共交通，以避免交通拥堵和空气污染进一步加剧。
collocations: avoid doing something｜避免做某事 ; avoid mistakes｜避免犯错 ; avoid contact｜避免接触
tip_zh: 后接名词或动名词：avoid doing，不用to do。

meanings_zh: v. 工作；运转 | n. 工作；作品
definition_en: to do a job, or to function | a job, or something produced
example1_en: The printer does not work this morning.
example1_zh: 打印机今天早上不工作。
example2_en: Long hours of paid work can leave older students too tired to review what they learned.
example2_zh: 长时间的有偿工作会让高年级学生累得无法复习所学内容。
collocations: work out｜算出；解决 ; at work｜在工作 ; work on｜从事
tip_zh: work 表示工作不可数；a job 才是一份工作。

meanings_zh: modal v. 可以；可能；能够
definition_en: used for ability, possibility, or a polite request
example1_en: Could you pass me the dictionary?
example2_en: Cities could cut morning traffic if more students were able to walk to a nearby school.
example2_zh: 如果更多学生能步行去附近的学校，城市就能减少早高峰的车流。
collocations: could not｜不能
tip_zh: 委婉请求用 Could you...?；过去有能力做成某件具体的事常用 was able to。

definition_en: to a high degree
example1_en: The reading room is very quiet after four.
example1_zh: 四点以后阅览室非常安静。
example2_en: A very small change in a timetable can affect thousands of students who share the same buses.
example2_zh: 时刻表上一个很小的改动，也会影响共用同一批公交的数千名学生。
collocations: very much｜非常
tip_zh: very 修饰形容词和副词原级，不修饰比较级；比较级用 much 或 far。

definition_en: a greater amount or degree
example1_en: I need more time to check the answers.
example1_zh: 我需要更多时间检查答案。
example2_en: Cities that build more bike lanes often find that short car trips become less necessary.
example2_zh: 修建更多自行车道的城市常常发现，短途开车变得不那么必要。
collocations: more than｜多于 ; more and more｜越来越 ; once more｜再一次
tip_zh: 多音节形容词的比较级用 more，不要再加 -er。

definition_en: to perform an action, or to support a verb
example1_en: I do my homework at the kitchen table.
example2_en: People who do voluntary work at weekends often report a stronger sense of belonging.
example2_zh: 周末做志愿工作的人常常说自己更有归属感。
collocations: do one's best｜尽力 ; do with｜处理 ; do some reading｜读点书
tip_zh: do 常接具体活动；make 多接制作或产生的结果，如 make a mistake。

meanings_zh: adj. 确定的；某一 | adj. 必然的；确定的 | adj. 某个；某些
definition_en: sure; particular | definitely going to happen | particular but not named or fully described
example1_en: I am certain that she will come.
example2_en: Certain types of public transport are more suitable for densely populated cities than rural areas.
example2_zh: 某些类型的公共交通更适合人口密集的城市，而非农村地区。
collocations: certain of｜对……有把握 ; certain to happen｜必然发生 ; make certain｜确保 ; certain types of｜某些类型的
tip_zh: 人作主语时，certain of表确信；certain to表必然。

definition_en: an amount or number that is not exact
example1_en: There is some hot water in the thermos.
example2_en: Some schools now start later so that teenagers can sleep through the early morning.
example2_zh: 一些学校现在推迟上课，以便青少年能睡过清晨。
collocations: some of｜……中的一些 ; some time｜一段时间
tip_zh: 肯定句和礼貌请求常用 some；疑问和否定常用 any。

definition_en: used to choose, or to add information about a thing
example1_en: Which bus goes to the museum?
example2_en: Plastic bags, which are used for only a few minutes, can remain in the soil for decades.
example2_zh: 只用几分钟的塑料袋，却可能在土壤里留几十年。
collocations: which one｜哪一个
tip_zh: 非限制性定语从句说明事物时用 which，不用 that。

definition_en: a method, or a route
example1_en: This is a simple way to remember the word.
example1_zh: 这是记住这个词的简单方法。
example2_en: One way to reduce waste is to repair clothes and phones instead of replacing them at once.
example2_zh: 减少浪费的一个办法是修理衣服和手机，而不是立刻更换。
collocations: in this way｜用这种方式 ; on the way｜在路上 ; by the way｜顺便说
tip_zh: way to do 和 way of doing 都可以表示做某事的方式。

meanings_zh: v. 需要 | n. 需要；必需品
definition_en: to require something | something that is necessary
example1_en: I need a quiet hour before the exam.
example1_zh: 考试前我需要一小时安静的时间。
example2_en: Growing cities need more than new buildings; they need schools, clinics, and clean air.
example2_zh: 成长中的城市需要的不只是新楼，还需要学校、诊所和干净的空气。
collocations: in need of｜需要 ; need to do｜需要做 ; there is no need｜没有必要
tip_zh: need doing 表示某物需要被做，如 The clock needs repairing。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……上方；超过 | adv. 结束；翻过
definition_en: above, across, or more than | finished, or across
example1_en: A bridge goes over the river behind the school.
example1_zh: 学校后面有一座桥跨过河。
example2_en: Over the past decade, more families have moved to cities in search of better schools and hospitals.
example2_zh: 过去十年里，更多家庭搬到城市，以寻找更好的学校和医院。
collocations: over and over｜反复 ; get over｜克服 ; over there｜在那边
tip_zh: over 可以表示正上方或越过；above 多表示位置更高，不一定垂直。

meanings_zh: v. 连接；联系 | v. 联系；把…关联起来 | v. 与人建立良好关系
definition_en: to join or link | to recognize or establish a relationship between things | to develop a good relationship with someone
example1_en: Roads connect the village to the city.
example1_zh: 公路把村庄与城市连接起来。
example2_en: New rail services can connect rural communities with cities, improving access to education and employment.
example2_zh: 新的铁路服务可以连接农村社区与城市，让人们更容易获得教育和就业机会。
collocations: connect to the internet｜连接互联网 ; connect A with B｜把A与B联系起来 ; connect with people｜与人建立联系
tip_zh: 连接设备常用connect A to B。

definition_en: very big
example1_en: They made a huge effort.
example2_en: Investing in public transport could bring huge benefits to cities struggling with congestion and air pollution.
example2_zh: 对于饱受交通拥堵和空气污染困扰的城市，投资公共交通可以带来巨大益处。
collocations: huge amount｜巨大的数量 ; huge difference｜巨大差异 ; huge impact｜巨大影响 ; huge success｜巨大成功
tip_zh: 本身表示极大，常用absolutely huge加强语气。

definition_en: a large number, used with countable nouns
example1_en: Many students bring their own water bottles.
example2_en: Many of the jobs that will exist in twenty years do not have names yet.
example2_zh: 二十年后将存在的许多工作，现在还没有名称。
collocations: a great many｜许多 ; how many｜多少 ; many of｜……中的许多
tip_zh: many 修饰可数名词复数；不可数用 much。

meanings_zh: n. 事故；意外 | n. 意外；偶然发生的事
definition_en: an unexpected harmful event | Something that happens without being planned or intended.
example1_en: A car accident blocked the road.
example2_en: Better street lighting can reduce the risk of accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians at night.
example2_zh: 改善街道照明可以降低夜间涉及骑车人和行人的事故风险。
collocations: a road accident｜道路交通事故 ; by accident｜偶然；无意中 ; prevent accidents｜预防事故
tip_zh: by accident表示无意中，反义短语是on purpose。

definition_en: used for possibility or permission
example1_en: It may rain before the match ends.
example1_zh: 比赛结束前可能会下雨。
example2_en: A new rule may look fair on paper but still hurt families who live far from the school.
example2_zh: 一条新规则在纸面上可能显得公平，却仍会伤害住得离学校很远的家庭。
collocations: may be｜可能是 ; maybe｜也许
tip_zh: may be 是“可能是”；maybe 是一个副词，不能分开写。

definition_en: away from the inside
example1_en: The cat ran out of the classroom.
example2_en: Finding out who wrote a post is harder online, where names can be changed in a minute.
example2_zh: 在网上查明一篇帖子是谁写的更难，因为名字可以随时更换。
collocations: out of｜从……出来 ; find out｜查明 ; run out of｜用完
tip_zh: out of 表示从里面到外面，或“缺乏”。

meanings_zh: n. 机会；可能性 | n. 可能性 | n. 偶然；运气
definition_en: an opportunity | The likelihood that something will happen. | Events happening without planning or a predictable cause.
example1_en: This is your chance to speak up.
example2_en: Affordable training gives unemployed adults a chance to gain new skills and return to the workforce.
example2_zh: 费用可负担的培训让失业的成年人有机会掌握新技能，重返职场。
collocations: a chance to learn｜学习的机会 ; a good chance of｜很有可能 ; by chance｜偶然 ; take a chance｜冒险一试
tip_zh: 机会用chance to do；可能性常用chance of doing。

definition_en: and nobody or nothing else
example1_en: I only need five minutes to check the list.
example1_zh: 我只需要五分钟核对名单。
example2_en: If a city only builds roads for cars, children have fewer safe places to walk or cycle.
example2_zh: 如果一座城市只为汽车修路，孩子就更少有安全的地方走路或骑车。
collocations: only if｜只有 ; not only｜不仅
tip_zh: only 的位置会改变句子强调的部分，写作时尽量靠近被限定的词。

meanings_zh: n. 经验；经历 | n. 经历；体验 | v. 经历；感受
definition_en: knowledge from doing; an event lived through | something that happens to you or that you do | to have something happen to you or feel something
example1_en: Travel is a valuable experience.
example2_en: Work experience can help graduates develop practical skills that employers value alongside academic qualifications.
example2_zh: 工作经验能帮助毕业生培养实践技能，而雇主不仅重视学历，也看重这些技能。
collocations: gain experience｜积累经验 ; work experience｜工作经验 ; a rewarding experience｜有收获的经历 ; experience difficulties｜遇到困难
tip_zh: 表“经验”不可数；表具体“经历”可数。

meanings_zh: v. 庆祝 | v. 赞颂；颂扬
definition_en: to mark a happy event | To praise someone or something publicly.
example1_en: We will celebrate her birthday this weekend.
example1_zh: 我们这个周末会庆祝她的生日。
example2_en: Community festivals celebrate local traditions while giving residents opportunities to strengthen relationships with their neighbours.
example2_zh: 社区节庆活动在弘扬当地传统的同时，也让居民有机会增进邻里关系。
collocations: celebrate a birthday｜庆祝生日 ; celebrate an achievement｜庆祝一项成就 ; celebrate diversity｜赞颂多样性
tip_zh: 庆祝某事用celebrate；祝贺某人用congratulate。

definition_en: of high quality, or able to do something well
example1_en: This is a good place to revise quietly.
example1_zh: 这是一个适合安静复习的地方。
example2_en: A good public library does more than lend books; it gives people a place to learn together.
example2_zh: 一座好的公共图书馆不只是借书，它还给人们一个一起学习的地方。
collocations: be good at｜擅长 ; do good｜有好处 ; a good deal of｜大量
tip_zh: good 修饰名词；修饰动词用 well，如 speak English well。

definition_en: not any, or not allowed
example1_en: There is no milk left in the fridge.
example2_en: There is no single method that helps every student, so teachers need more than one kind of practice.
example2_zh: 没有一种方法适合所有学生，所以老师需要不止一种练习方式。
collocations: no longer｜不再 ; no doubt｜无疑 ; no matter｜无论
tip_zh: no 直接放在名词前；not 用来否定动词。

definition_en: a white or grey mass in the sky
example1_en: A dark cloud sat over the yard.
example1_zh: 一团乌云停在院子上空。
example2_en: Cloud on the hill is a reason to send the team indoors before the rain.
example2_zh: 山上的云是在下雨前让队伍进室内的理由。
collocations: a cloud of｜一团
tip_zh: cloud 可数。表里这一行的音标是 clothing，本库不用。

definition_en: the money used in a country
example1_en: The currency on the poster is the dollar.
example2_en: A currency sign without the real fee still leaves families guessing.
example2_zh: 只有货币符号、没有真实费用，家庭仍然在猜。
collocations: foreign currency｜外币
tip_zh: currency 可数。dollar 已在本库。

definition_en: a room or building of books to read or borrow
example1_en: The library closes at six on Friday.
example2_en: A public library gives students a quiet table when home is too crowded for homework.
example2_zh: 当家里挤得写不了作业时，公共图书馆给学生一张安静的桌子。
collocations: school library｜学校图书馆 ; in the library｜在图书馆
tip_zh: library 重音在第一音节。不要和 bookstore 混淆。

definition_en: living, not dead
example1_en: The plant is still alive after the frost.
example1_zh: 霜冻之后这棵植物还活着。
example2_en: A river is alive with fish only when the water stays clean enough to breathe.
example2_zh: 只有水质干净到能够呼吸，河里才会有成群的鱼。
collocations: stay alive｜活下去 ; come alive｜变得生动
tip_zh: alive 只作表语，不说 an alive fish。定语常用 living 或 live。

definition_en: a room for sleeping
example1_en: The bedroom is too small for a desk.
example1_zh: 卧室小得放不下一张书桌。
example2_en: A quiet bedroom is not available to every student, which is why the library stays open.
example2_zh: 不是每个学生都有安静的卧室，所以图书馆一直开着。
collocations: in the bedroom｜在卧室
tip_zh: bed 已在本库。bedroom 是房间。

definition_en: to surprise greatly
example1_en: The magic trick will amaze the children.
example1_zh: 这个魔术会让孩子们惊奇。
example2_en: Advances in medical technology continue to amaze researchers and offer new hope to patients with complex conditions.
example2_zh: 医疗技术的进步不断令研究人员惊叹，也为病情复杂的患者带来新的希望。
collocations: never cease to amaze｜始终令人惊叹 ; amaze an audience｜令观众惊叹 ; be amazed at｜对…感到惊奇
tip_zh: 人感到惊奇用amazed；事物令人惊奇用amazing。

definition_en: things you wear
example1_en: Wet clothes dry slowly in this room.
example1_zh: 湿衣服在这个房间里干得很慢。
example2_en: Spare clothes at school matter when a child falls in the rain on the way.
example2_zh: 孩子在路上淋雨摔倒时，学校里的备用衣服就很重要。
collocations: a change of clothes｜一套换洗衣物
tip_zh: clothes 是复数，不说 a clothes。一件衣服用 a piece of clothing。

meanings_zh: n. 圆；圈子 | v. 圈出；盘旋
definition_en: a round shape, or a group of people | to draw a circle, or to move round
example1_en: Draw a circle around the answer.
example2_en: A reading circle works when every student gets a turn, not only the loud ones.
example2_zh: 读书小组要让每个学生都有一轮，而不只是嗓门大的人。
collocations: in a circle｜围成一圈 ; a circle of｜一圈；一群
tip_zh: circle 作动词是盘旋或圈出。

definition_en: having power, or intense
example1_en: A strong wind shook the young trees.
example2_en: Strong public support can keep a village clinic open when the budget is thin.
example2_zh: 当预算紧张时，强烈的公众支持能让乡村诊所继续开着。
collocations: be strong in｜在……方面强
tip_zh: strong 的名词是 strength，不是 strongness。

definition_en: for that reason
example1_en: The road is icy; therefore the trip is delayed.
example1_zh: 路有冰，因此行程推迟了。
example2_en: The well is dry, and therefore the village has to share the school's water tank.
example2_zh: 井干了，因此村子必须共用学校的水箱。
collocations: and therefore｜因此
tip_zh: therefore 是副词，不是连词。前面常用分号或 and。

definition_en: the usual order of things
example1_en: The morning routine includes the bell at eight.
example1_zh: 早晨的常规包括八点的铃。
example2_en: A routine that never names the late bus will fail the club.
example2_zh: 从不写晚班车的常规会让社团失败。
collocations: daily routine｜日常生活
tip_zh: routine 也可作形容词“常规的”。

definition_en: to achieve what you wanted
example1_en: The plan will succeed if the time is written.
example1_zh: 如果时间写下来，这个计划就会成功。
example2_en: Students succeed more often when the source is named.
example2_zh: 写明来源时，学生更常成功。
collocations: succeed in doing｜成功做成
tip_zh: 名词 success 已在本库。succeed in doing。

meanings_zh: n. 志愿者 | v. 自愿做
definition_en: a person who works without being paid | to offer to do something
example1_en: The volunteer locked the library.
example2_en: A volunteer still needs a seat on the late bus.
example2_zh: 志愿者在晚班车上仍然需要一个座位。
collocations: a volunteer for｜……的志愿者
tip_zh: volunteer 作动词是自愿做。

meanings_zh: n. 开关 | v. 转换；打开或关掉
definition_en: a device for turning something on or off | to change, or to turn on or off
example1_en: The switch is by the door.
example2_en: A switch that students can reach matters in a lab where the teacher is not always first.
example2_zh: 在老师不总是最先到的实验室里，学生够得着的开关很重要。
collocations: switch on｜打开 ; switch off｜关掉 ; switch to｜转换到
tip_zh: switch 作动词是打开、关掉或转换。

definition_en: the physical form of a person, or a group
example1_en: Exercise helps the body and the mind.
example1_zh: 锻炼对身体和头脑都有帮助。
example2_en: A student body that is never asked for advice will not feel the school rules are theirs.
example2_zh: 从未被征求意见的学生群体，不会觉得校规是自己的。
collocations: body language｜肢体语言
tip_zh: body 表示身体；anybody 才是“任何人”。

meanings_zh: n. 街区；大块 | v. 阻挡；堵塞
definition_en: an area of buildings, or a solid piece | to stop something from passing
example1_en: The bookshop is two blocks from school.
example2_en: A fallen tree can block the only road that an ambulance uses at night.
example2_zh: 一棵倒下的树能堵住救护车夜里唯一使用的路。
collocations: a block of｜一大块 ; office block｜办公楼
tip_zh: block 作动词是阻挡。街区是美式口语里很常见的距离说法。

definition_en: one of the twelve parts of a year
example1_en: We will visit the museum next month.
example1_zh: 我们下个月去参观博物馆。
example2_en: One dry month can empty a village tank if nobody measured how fast the water was used.
example2_zh: 如果没人测量用水有多快，一个干旱的月份就能抽干村里的水箱。
collocations: next month｜下个月 ; month after month｜月复一月
tip_zh: in 加月份：in March。next month 前不加 the。

definition_en: to allow someone to do something
example1_en: Let me check the answer before we go on.
example1_zh: 继续之前让我核对一下答案。
example2_en: Cities that let cars park on pavements force pedestrians, including children, into the road.
example2_zh: 允许汽车停在人行道上的城市，会把包括孩子在内的行人逼到马路上去。
collocations: let sb do｜让某人做 ; let's｜让我们 ; let go｜放开
tip_zh: let sb do 不带 to；allow sb to do 要带 to。

definition_en: a small amount
example1_en: I am a bit tired after the match.
example2_en: A bit of shade at a bus stop can matter on a day when the temperature is already high.
example2_zh: 在气温已经很高的日子，车站上一点荫凉也会有用。
collocations: a bit of｜一点 ; a bit｜有点儿 ; bit by bit｜逐渐
tip_zh: a bit 修饰形容词；a bit of 后接不可数名词。

definition_en: a source you look at, or a mention
example1_en: The reference is at the bottom of the page.
example2_en: A speech without a reference is hard to trust when the number sounds too round.
example2_zh: 数字听起来太整齐时，没有出处的演讲很难让人相信。
collocations: in reference to｜关于 ; reference book｜参考书
tip_zh: reference 也可指推荐信。动词是 refer to。

definition_en: a unit of length
example1_en: The crack is one inch wide.
example2_en: An inch of water in the hall is already a reason to move the class.
example2_zh: 大厅里一英寸深的水，已经是换教室的理由。
collocations: inch by inch｜一点一点地
tip_zh: 1 inch 约 2.54 厘米。inch 可数。

definition_en: a basic rule or belief
example1_en: The principle is simple: write the time.
example1_zh: 原则很简单：把时间写下来。
example2_en: A principle that ignores the last bus is not yet fair.
example2_zh: 无视末班车的原则还不算公平。
collocations: in principle｜原则上 ; the principle of｜……的原则
tip_zh: 不要和 principal（校长；主要的）混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 男的；雄的 | n. 男子；雄性
definition_en: of the sex that does not give birth | a male person or animal
example1_en: The form asks whether the cat is male or female.
example1_zh: 表格问这只猫是公的还是母的。
example2_en: A team that selects only male speakers misses voices the whole school needs to hear.
example2_zh: 只选男性发言人的活动，会错过全校需要听到的声音。
collocations: male student｜男生
tip_zh: male 可作形容词或名词。指人时要注意场合，正式表格里更常见。

definition_en: a book for photos, or a collection of songs
example1_en: She showed us a photo album of the trip.
example1_zh: 她给我们看了旅行的相册。
example2_en: A class album of the river, taken each spring, can show change better than one speech.
example2_zh: 每年春天拍摄的班级河流相册，能比一次演讲更好地展示变化。
collocations: photo album｜相册
tip_zh: album 是可数名词。

definition_en: a compact disc
example1_en: The CD of the concert is in the library.
example1_zh: 音乐会的光盘在图书馆。
example2_en: A CD still helps when the network cannot play the song.
example2_zh: 网络放不了这首歌时，光盘仍然有用。
collocations: a music CD｜音乐光盘
tip_zh: CD 是 compact disc 的缩写。书写常用大写。

definition_en: the reflexive form of she
example1_en: She made the poster herself.
example2_en: A girl who speaks for herself in a meeting practices a skill the mark sheet never shows.
example2_zh: 在会上为自己说话的女孩，是在练习成绩单上看不到的能力。
collocations: by herself｜她独自
tip_zh: herself 是反身代词。by herself 表示独自。人称代词 her 不作为本库词头。

definition_en: brought into life
example1_en: She was born in this town.
example2_en: A child born beside a busy road breathes dirtier air than one born beside a park.
example2_zh: 出生在繁忙道路旁的孩子，比出生在公园旁的孩子呼吸更脏的空气。
collocations: be born｜出生 ; be born in｜出生于
tip_zh: be born 只用被动，过去式仍用 was/were born，不说 borned。

definition_en: the first light of day
example1_en: The bus starts at dawn.
example2_en: A practice at dawn still needs a light on the path.
example2_zh: 黎明的训练仍然需要小路上有灯。
collocations: at dawn｜在黎明
tip_zh: at dawn 不加 the。

meanings_zh: n. 油漆；颜料 | v. 涂漆；绘画
definition_en: a coloured liquid used to cover a surface | to cover with paint, or to make a picture
example1_en: The paint on the door is still wet.
example2_en: Fresh paint in a hallway needs a sign, or the coats will carry it home.
example2_zh: 走廊里的新漆需要一块牌子，否则外套会把它带回家。
collocations: a coat of paint｜一层漆 ; paint a picture｜画画
tip_zh: painting 已在本库。paint 作动词是涂漆或绘画。

meanings_zh: v. 燃烧；烧伤；晒伤 | n. 烧伤；晒伤
definition_en: to be on fire, or to hurt with heat | an injury from fire or the sun
example1_en: Do not burn paper in the lab.
example2_en: A burn from the sun is a reason to offer shade, not only a warning.
example2_zh: 晒伤是提供树荫的理由，而不只是一句警告。
collocations: burn down｜烧毁 ; burn out｜烧尽；耗尽
tip_zh: 本条只作安全词汇。不写如何点火或伤害别人。过去式 burned 或 burnt。

definition_en: to hit a door or surface | an act of knocking
example1_en: Knock before you enter the lab.
example2_en: A knock at the clinic door should get an answer, not silence.
example2_zh: 敲医务室的门应当得到回答，而不是沉默。
collocations: knock at｜敲 ; knock down｜撞倒
tip_zh: knock 也可作名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；令人敬畏的
definition_en: extremely good, or causing awe
example1_en: The view from the hill was awesome.
example2_en: An awesome stadium photo does not show whether local rents rose because of the event.
example2_zh: 一张极好的体育场照片，并不能说明本地房租是否因这场活动上涨。
collocations: awesome view｜极好的景色
tip_zh: awesome 在口语里常只表示“太棒了”。

definition_en: the study of the mind and behaviour
example1_en: Psychology is an optional course.
example2_en: A psychology claim in an ad should name the study.
example2_zh: 广告里的心理学说法应当写明研究来源。
collocations: psychology of｜……的心理学
tip_zh: psychology 作学科时谓语用单数。p 不发音。

meanings_zh: n. 内容 | adj. 满意的；知足的 | v. 使满足；使满意
definition_en: what is inside | Happy with what you have or with your situation | To make someone satisfied with what is available
example1_en: Check the content of the box carefully.
example2_en: Schools should teach students to evaluate online content critically rather than accepting every claim as reliable information.
example2_zh: 学校应教学生批判性地评估网络内容，而不是把每一种说法都当作可靠信息。
collocations: online content｜网络内容 ; sugar content｜含糖量 ; content with｜对……满意 ; content yourself with｜使自己满足于
tip_zh: 名词重音在前，形容词和动词在后；目录用contents。

meanings_zh: v. 使用 | n. 使用；用途
definition_en: to do something with a tool or method | the act of using something
example1_en: Please use a pencil for the answer sheet.
example2_en: Farmers who use less water per kilo of rice help cities downstream keep their rivers flowing.
example2_zh: 每公斤稻谷用水更少的农民，能帮助下游城市维持河流不断流。
collocations: use up｜用完 ; make use of｜利用 ; used to｜过去常常
tip_zh: use 是动词；名词“用途”同形，名词常读 /juːs/，动词读 /juːz/。

definition_en: a group of twelve, or a lot
example1_en: We need a dozen chairs.
example2_en: A dozen notices on one board are harder to read than one clear sheet.
example2_zh: 板上十几张通知，比一张写清楚的纸更难读。
collocations: dozens of｜许多 ; a dozen｜一打
tip_zh: a dozen 后直接接复数名词，不加 of，除非有 the、these 等。表里这一行的音标是 downward，本库不用。

definition_en: a person in the same group
example1_en: Her fellow students helped her carry the books.
example2_en: A fellow passenger who offers a seat can matter more than a printed notice.
example2_zh: 主动让座的同车乘客，可能比一张印刷的通知更有用。
collocations: fellow students｜同学
tip_zh: fellow 常放在名词前：fellow workers。单独用时偏口语。

definition_en: sixty seconds, or a short time
example1_en: The bus leaves in five minutes.
example2_en: A minute of shade at a hot stop can matter when the temperature is already high.
example2_zh: 气温已经很高时，车站上一分钟的荫凉也会有用。
collocations: in a minute｜马上 ; wait a minute｜等一下
tip_zh: minute 作形容词“微小的”时读 /maɪˈnjuːt/，和“分钟”不同。

definition_en: a device that makes a ringing sound
example1_en: The bell rings at eight.
example2_en: A bell that cannot be heard at the far end of the yard is not a safety plan.
example2_zh: 院子远端听不见的铃，不是安全方案。
collocations: ring the bell｜按铃
tip_zh: bell 可数。give somebody a bell 在英式口语里是打个电话。

definition_en: fair treatment, or the legal system
example1_en: The story is about justice for the village.
example1_zh: 这个故事讲的是村子得到公正。
example2_en: Justice is slow if a simple case takes years while a family waits for a decision.
example2_zh: 如果一件简单案件要花数年、而家庭一直在等决定，司法就是缓慢的。
collocations: sense of justice｜正义感
tip_zh: justice 通常不可数。

definition_en: growth, or a new event
example1_en: The development of the town has been fast.
example2_en: Rapid development along a river can bring jobs and also destroy the wetland that holds flood water.
example2_zh: 河边的快速发展能带来工作，也会毁掉蓄洪水的湿地。
collocations: economic development｜经济发展 ; with the development of｜随着……的发展
tip_zh: development 作“发展”时常不可数；一项新进展可数。

definition_en: a company, or a new project
example1_en: The enterprise trains local students.
example1_zh: 这家企业培训当地学生。
example2_en: A school enterprise that hides fees is harder to trust.
example2_zh: 隐瞒费用的学校企业更难信任。
collocations: a business enterprise｜企业
tip_zh: enterprise 可数。也可指事业心。

definition_en: a short account of the main points
example1_en: Write a summary in three lines.
example2_en: A summary of the bus plan should include the return time.
example2_zh: 公交计划的摘要应当包括返回时间。
collocations: a summary of｜……的摘要
tip_zh: summary 可数。in summary 表示总之。

definition_en: the work of managing an organisation
example1_en: The school administration posted the new timetable.
example1_zh: 学校行政部门贴出了新课表。
example2_en: Slow administration can delay a clinic that the town has already agreed to build.
example2_zh: 缓慢的行政可以拖延城镇已经同意修建的诊所。
collocations: school administration｜学校行政
tip_zh: administration 通常不可数。

definition_en: full of light, or clever
example1_en: The lab is bright in the morning.
example2_en: A bright student who never speaks still needs a turn.
example2_zh: 从不发言的聪明学生，仍然需要一轮机会。
collocations: bright idea｜好主意 ; bright future｜光明的前途
tip_zh: bright 可形容光，也可形容人聪明。

definition_en: relating to government or public affairs
example1_en: We read a political cartoon in class.
example1_zh: 我们在课上读了一幅政治漫画。
example2_en: Political promises about housing mean little until rents actually fall for ordinary workers.
example2_zh: 关于住房的政治承诺，在普通工人的房租真正下降之前没什么意义。
collocations: political party｜政党
tip_zh: politics 表示政治，谓语常用单数。

definition_en: a person in charge at work
example1_en: Her boss let her leave early for the match.
example1_zh: 老板让她提前离开去看比赛。
example2_en: A boss who explains the task once, in writing, saves a new worker from guessing.
example2_zh: 把任务用书面讲清楚一次的上司，能让新员工不用靠猜。
collocations: boss of｜……的老板
tip_zh: boss 偏口语。正式场合常用 manager 或 employer。

definition_en: a title for a doctor
example1_en: Dr. Wang will talk about sleep on Friday.
example2_en: Dr. is a short title, but a village still needs the person behind it to be within reach.
example2_zh: Dr. 是一个简短的称谓，但村子仍需要这个称谓背后的人在能够到达的范围内。
collocations: Dr. Smith｜史密斯医生
tip_zh: Dr. 后接姓。表示医生或博士都可能用这个缩写，要看语境。

definition_en: a person who acts for another
example1_en: The ticket agent found us two seats.
example1_zh: 售票员给我们找到了两个座位。
example2_en: A travel agent who explains the fee clearly is more useful than one who only shows photos.
example2_zh: 把费用讲清楚的旅行代理人，比只展示照片的更有用。
collocations: travel agent｜旅行代理人
tip_zh: agent 是办事的人，agency 是机构。

definition_en: a town or place where ships load and unload
example1_en: The port closes when the wind is too strong.
example2_en: A port brings jobs, and it also brings trucks through streets where children walk.
example2_zh: 港口带来工作，也把卡车带进孩子走路的街道。
collocations: at the port｜在港口
tip_zh: port 是港口。计算机里的端口也叫 port。

definition_en: better, or higher in rank
example1_en: The second map is superior because it names the clinic.
example1_zh: 第二张地图更好，因为它标出了诊所。
example2_en: A superior who never walks the route will not see the missing light.
example2_zh: 从不走路程的上级，看不见那盏缺了的灯。
collocations: superior to｜比……更好 ; be superior｜占优势
tip_zh: superior to，不用 than。作名词是上级。

definition_en: not polite
example1_en: It is rude to interrupt.
example2_en: A rude sign at the gate teaches less than a clear one.
example2_zh: 门口粗鲁的牌子比清楚的牌子教得少。
collocations: rude to sb｜对某人粗鲁
tip_zh: rude 可以形容行为。不要用来嘲笑同学。

definition_en: the act of stopping something for a time
example1_en: The suspension of the bus lasted one day.
example2_en: A suspension from school should be explained to the family in writing.
example2_zh: 停学应当书面告知家庭。
collocations: suspension of｜……的暂停
tip_zh: suspension 可数也可不可数。

definition_en: a test, or a court case
example1_en: The new timetable is on trial this month.
example2_en: A fair trial needs time and a record, not only a loud room and a quick decision.
example2_zh: 公平的审判需要时间和记录，而不只是一间嘈杂的屋子和一个仓促的决定。
collocations: on trial｜受审；在试用 ; trial and error｜反复试验
tip_zh: trial 可以是法庭审判，也可以是试用、试验。

meanings_zh: v. 切；削减 | n. 伤口；削减
definition_en: to divide with a knife, or to reduce | an opening, or a reduction
example1_en: Please cut the paper along the line.
example2_en: Cities that cut bus routes to save money often increase the number of cars the next year.
example2_zh: 为省钱削减公交线路的城市，往往在下一年增加汽车数量。
collocations: cut down｜削减；砍倒 ; cut off｜切断
tip_zh: cut 的过去式和过去分词都是 cut。

meanings_zh: adj. 完整的；完全的 | v. 完成
definition_en: having all its parts | to finish
example1_en: Please hand in a complete form.
example1_zh: 请交一份填完整的表格。
example2_en: A complete picture of school travel includes the walk, not only the bus.
example2_zh: 对上学出行的完整描述包括步行，而不只是公交。
collocations: complete with｜备有
tip_zh: complete 作动词是“完成”。

definition_en: having a condition that limits movement or activity
example1_en: The disabled entrance is on the left.
example2_en: A disabled student needs the entrance marked, not a speech about courage.
example2_zh: 残疾学生需要标出的入口，而不是一篇关于勇气的讲话。
collocations: disabled access｜无障碍通道
tip_zh: 用“残疾”，不用“残废”。也可说 a disabled person。说话时要尊重。

definition_en: to keep something in the mind, or to bring it back
example1_en: Remember to lock the lab door.
example2_en: Communities remember a flood longer than planners do if their homes were under water.
example2_zh: 如果自家被水淹过，社区对洪水的记忆会比规划者更久。
collocations: remember to do｜记得去做 ; remember doing｜记得做过
tip_zh: remember to do 是记得要做；remember doing 是记得做过。

meanings_zh: n. 供应；供给 | v. 供应
definition_en: an amount of something available to use | to provide something that is needed
example1_en: The water supply was cut for two hours.
example2_en: A steady supply of books matters more to a village school than one expensive set of posters.
example2_zh: 对乡村学校来说，稳定的图书供应比一套昂贵的海报更重要。
collocations: water supply｜供水 ; supply sb with｜向某人提供
tip_zh: supply 作动词时，说 supply somebody with something。

definition_en: to touch someone with the lips to show love or greeting | an act of kissing
