example1_en: She kissed her grandmother at the gate.
example2_en: A story can mention a kiss and still be about saying goodbye, not about a lesson in romance.
example2_zh: 故事可以提到一个吻，主题仍然是告别，而不是恋爱课。
collocations: kiss sb goodbye｜与某人吻别
tip_zh: kiss 也可作名词。本条用家庭告别的普通含义。

definition_en: the ending of a pregnancy
example1_en: The health class uses the word abortion as a medical term.
example1_zh: 健康课把 abortion 用作医学术语。
example2_en: A clinic should explain the word abortion without pressure or instructions.
example2_zh: 诊所应当解释这个词，而不施加压力，也不给做法。
collocations: abortion of｜……的中止
tip_zh: 本条是健康词汇。不写过程。说话时要尊重。

definition_en: to stop sleeping, or to make someone stop sleeping
example1_en: I wake at six on school days.
example2_en: Street noise can wake a child long before the alarm that was meant to do it.
example2_zh: 街上的噪音可能在闹钟之前就把孩子吵醒。
collocations: wake up｜醒来
tip_zh: wake 的过去式是 woke，过去分词是 woken。叫醒也常说 wake somebody up。

definition_en: the liquid from fruit or vegetables
example1_en: The juice is mostly sugar.
example2_en: Juice that hides the sugar should say so on the label.
example2_zh: 隐瞒含糖量的果汁应当在标签上写明。
collocations: orange juice｜橙汁 ; a glass of juice｜一杯果汁
tip_zh: juice 作物质名词通常不可数。

definition_en: an empty area, or the area beyond Earth
example1_en: There is no space left on the notice board.
example2_en: Cities that leave no space for trees make summer streets hotter for people who walk.
example2_zh: 不给树留空间的城市，会让步行的人觉得夏天的街道更热。
collocations: parking space｜停车位 ; outer space｜外层空间 ; in space｜在太空
tip_zh: space 表示空间时常不可数；一个空位用 a space。

definition_en: used to show surprise or understanding
example1_en: Oh, I left my pen in the lab.
example1_zh: 哦，我把笔落在实验室了。
example2_en: Oh is a small word, but in a dialogue it can show surprise, pain, or a sudden idea.
example2_zh: Oh 是个小词，但在对话里可以表示惊讶、疼痛或忽然想到。
collocations: oh no｜哦不 ; oh dear｜哎呀
tip_zh: oh 是感叹词，后面常用逗号。

definition_en: the spiritual part of a person, or a deep feeling
example1_en: The song seemed to come from the soul.
example2_en: Not a soul was in the library at dawn, but the lights had been left on.
example2_zh: 黎明时图书馆里一个人也没有，灯却还亮着。
collocations: not a soul｜一个人也没有
tip_zh: not a soul 表示一个人也没有。soul 在宗教和文学里很常见。

meanings_zh: n. 请求 | v. 请求
definition_en: an act of asking for something politely | to ask for something formally
example1_en: She made a request for a quieter room.
example1_zh: 她请求换一间更安静的房间。
example2_en: A written request is easier for a school office to track than a remark in the hallway.
example2_zh: 书面请求比走廊里的一句话更容易被学校办公室跟上。
collocations: at the request of｜应……的请求 ; request sb to do｜请求某人做
tip_zh: request 比 ask 正式。

definition_en: a formal meeting
example1_en: The teachers are at a conference today.
example2_en: A conference about rural schools should include a teacher who actually works in one.
example2_zh: 关于乡村学校的会议，应该包括一位真正在那里工作的老师。
collocations: press conference｜记者招待会 ; at a conference｜在开会
tip_zh: conference 通常比 meeting 更正式、规模更大。

definition_en: kilometre
example1_en: The farm is 2 km from school.
example2_en: A map that uses km without a scale still leaves the reader guessing.
example2_zh: 不用比例尺却用千米的地图，仍然让读者猜。
collocations: 2 km｜2 千米
tip_zh: km 是 kilometre 的缩写。数字和 km 之间通常留空格。表里没有单独一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

definition_en: a large natural stream of water
example1_en: The river behind the school rose after the rain.
example1_zh: 雨后学校后面的河上涨了。
example2_en: A clean river is a shared good; waste from one factory reaches every town downstream.
example2_zh: 干净的河是共同的好处；一家工厂的废物会到达下游每个城镇。
collocations: river bank｜河岸
tip_zh: river 是可数名词。

definition_en: a person admired for courage, or the main male character
example1_en: The hero of the story is a bus driver.
example1_zh: 故事的主人公是一位公交司机。
example2_en: Calling every winner a hero can hide the teammate who passed the ball.
example2_zh: 把每个获胜者都叫做英雄，可能掩盖那个把球传出来的队友。
collocations: hero of｜……的英雄
tip_zh: 复数是 heroes。女英雄常用 heroine。

definition_en: a large animal used for riding or farm work
example1_en: The horse stood still by the gate.
example2_en: A school that keeps a horse needs a plan for holidays, not only a photo on open day.
example2_zh: 养马的学校需要假期的方案，而不只是开放日的一张照片。
collocations: on horseback｜骑马
tip_zh: horse 可数。骑马常用 ride a horse。

definition_en: the meal in the middle of the day
example1_en: Lunch is at twelve in the hall.
example2_en: A free lunch helps the student who would otherwise skip the meal.
example2_zh: 免费午餐能帮助那些否则会不吃饭的学生。
collocations: have lunch｜吃午饭 ; lunch break｜午休
tip_zh: lunch 前通常不用 a，除非指一份具体的午餐。

meanings_zh: prep. 沿着 | adv. 向前；一同
definition_en: from one end towards the other | forward, or with someone
example1_en: We walked along the river after school.
example2_en: Shops along the road to school decide what students can buy on the way home.
example2_zh: 通往学校的路上的商店，决定了学生回家时能买到什么。
collocations: along with｜与……一起 ; get along｜相处
tip_zh: along 强调沿着一条线走；across 是从一边到另一边。

definition_en: of more than average height
example1_en: The shelf is too tall for the first row.
example1_zh: 架子对第一排来说太高了。
example2_en: A tall sign that nobody can read at night is not a safety plan.
example2_zh: 夜里没人读得清的高牌子，不是安全方案。
collocations: tall building｜高楼
tip_zh: 人的身高用 tall。high 多用于物。height 是本批的名词。

definition_en: the object form of who
example1_en: Whom did you ask for the key?
example2_en: In formal writing, whom follows a preposition: the teacher to whom I wrote.
example2_zh: 正式写作里，whom 跟在介词后，例如 the teacher to whom I wrote。
collocations: to whom｜向谁
tip_zh: 口语里多用 who。介词后面的正式文体仍用 whom。

definition_en: under, or in a lower position
example1_en: The key is beneath the book.
example2_en: Beneath the poster, the real time is written in pencil.
example2_zh: 海报下面，真实时间用铅笔写着。
collocations: beneath the surface｜在表面之下
tip_zh: beneath 比 under 更正式，也可作副词。

definition_en: a section of a book
example1_en: Read the next chapter before Friday.
example2_en: The last chapter of a report should say what the school will actually do.
example2_zh: 报告的最后一章应当写学校实际上会做什么。
collocations: a chapter of｜……的一章 ; chapter and verse｜详尽地
tip_zh: chapter 可数。书的章用 chapter，文章的段用 paragraph。

meanings_zh: n. 外套 | v. 涂上
definition_en: a piece of outdoor clothing | to cover with a layer
example1_en: Hang your coat on the hook.
example2_en: A spare coat at school matters when the morning rain soaks the first one.
example2_zh: 早晨的雨打湿第一件时，学校里的备用外套就有用。
collocations: a coat of paint｜一层漆
tip_zh: coat 也可指一层涂层。

meanings_zh: v. 忍受；承担 | n. 熊
definition_en: to accept something painful, or to carry a weight | a large heavy animal
example1_en: I cannot bear the noise in the hall.
example1_zh: 我受不了大厅里的噪音。
example2_en: The bridge can bear the weight of a bus, according to the sign.
example2_zh: 根据标牌，这座桥能承受一辆公交的重量。
collocations: bear in mind｜记住 ; can not bear｜无法忍受
tip_zh: 忍受的过去式是 bore，过去分词是 borne。出生用 be born。名词 bear 是熊。

meanings_zh: n. 黄金；金色 | adj. 金的
definition_en: a valuable yellow metal | made of gold
example1_en: The medal looks like gold.
example1_zh: 这块奖牌看起来像金子。
example2_en: A gold mine can bring wages and also leave a river too dirty to drink.
example2_zh: 金矿能带来工资，也会把河弄脏到不能喝。
collocations: gold medal｜金牌
tip_zh: gold 作定语常表示材料：a gold ring。golden 多表示金色或珍贵。

meanings_zh: v. 更新 | n. 更新
definition_en: to make something more modern or add new information | new information, or a newer version
example1_en: Please update the class list.
example2_en: Schools should update an emergency number on the wall the day it changes.
example2_zh: 紧急电话一变，学校就应当当天改墙上的号码。
collocations: update sb on｜向某人更新情况
tip_zh: update 也可作名词。表里没有这一条的音标，本库用 espeak-ng。

definition_en: practice to learn a skill
example1_en: The team has training on Wednesday.
example2_en: Training for village teachers fails if it takes them away from class for a whole month.
example2_zh: 如果乡村教师培训让他们离开课堂整整一个月，培训就会失败。
collocations: job training｜职业培训
tip_zh: training 通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 集中（注意力） | v. 集中；聚集 | n. 浓缩物；浓缩液
definition_en: to focus attention | To bring things together in one place or direct efforts there. | A substance made stronger by removing water or other material.
example1_en: It is hard to concentrate in a noisy room.
example1_zh: 在嘈杂的房间里很难集中注意力。
example2_en: Governments should concentrate resources on preventive healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals in the long term.
example2_zh: 政府应将资源集中于预防性医疗，以长期减轻医院的压力。
collocations: concentrate on a task｜专注于任务 ; concentrate resources on｜将资源集中于 ; fruit juice concentrate｜浓缩果汁
tip_zh: concentrate on后接名词或动名词，表示专注于。

definition_en: the food a person usually eats
example1_en: A balanced diet includes fruit.
example2_en: The canteen diet should be one a student can see and afford.
example2_zh: 食堂的饮食应当是学生看得见、也买得起的。
collocations: a balanced diet｜均衡饮食 ; on a diet｜在节食
tip_zh: diet 可数。on a diet 表示节食。表里这一行的音标是 die，本库不用。

meanings_zh: n. 平民 | adj. 平民的
definition_en: a person who is not in the armed forces | not military
example1_en: The report names civilians, not only soldiers.
example1_zh: 报道写出平民，而不只是士兵。
example2_en: A history text should say what happened to civilians.
example2_zh: 历史课文应当说平民遭遇了什么。
collocations: a civilian of｜一名平民
tip_zh: civilian 也可作形容词。本条是历史和社会词汇。

definition_en: a long hollow pipe
example1_en: The tube in the lab is labelled.
example1_zh: 实验室里的管子贴了标签。
example2_en: A tube without a label should not be used.
example2_zh: 没有标签的管子不应当使用。
collocations: a tube of｜一管
tip_zh: 英式 the Tube 可指伦敦地铁。本条以管子为主。

meanings_zh: adj. 快的 | adv. 快地
definition_en: moving or happening quickly | quickly
example1_en: The early bus is fast, but it is often full.
example1_zh: 早班车很快，但常常满员。
example2_en: A fast road into the city helps drivers and can make the walk to school more dangerous.
example2_zh: 进城的快速路方便司机，也可能让走路上学更危险。
collocations: fast food｜快餐
tip_zh: fast 既可作形容词也可作副词，不加 -ly。fast 作副词不是 fastly。

definition_en: a machine that carries people or goods
example1_en: No vehicle may enter the playground.
example1_zh: 任何车辆不得进入操场。
example2_en: An electric vehicle still needs a safe place to charge near the school.
example2_zh: 电动车仍然需要学校附近一个安全的充电处。
collocations: motor vehicle｜机动车
tip_zh: vehicle 是车辆的总称，包括汽车、公交和自行车在正式用语里有时也包括。

definition_en: a large organised group of soldiers
example1_en: The history book describes the army's long march.
example1_zh: 历史书写到军队的长途行军。
example2_en: An army can build a bridge quickly, but a town still needs people to maintain it.
example2_zh: 军队可以很快建起一座桥，但城镇仍需要人来维护它。
collocations: join the army｜参军
tip_zh: army 作整体时谓语可用单数。

definition_en: in pieces, or not working
example1_en: The broken window was repaired before class.
example1_zh: 破碎的窗户在上课前修好了。
example2_en: A broken lift in a station matters most to travellers who cannot use the stairs.
example2_zh: 车站里坏掉的电梯，对不能走楼梯的旅客影响最大。
collocations: broken English｜不流利的英语
tip_zh: broken 是 break 的过去分词，也可作形容词。

definition_en: work, especially physical work; American spelling
example1_en: The harvest needs extra labor in October.
example1_zh: 十月的收成需要额外的劳力。
example2_en: Fair labor rules matter when students take a weekend job to pay for books.
example2_zh: 学生周末打工买书时，公平的劳动规则就很重要。
collocations: manual labor｜体力劳动
tip_zh: labor 是美式拼写，labour 是英式。考纲里两种都有，本库两条都保留，意思相同。

definition_en: a large area of trees
example1_en: The path goes through a forest.
example1_zh: 这条小路穿过一片森林。
example2_en: A forest near a town cools the air and still needs a rule against leaving rubbish.
example2_zh: 城镇附近的森林能让空气变凉，也仍然需要禁止丢垃圾的规定。
collocations: in the forest｜在森林里 ; rain forest｜雨林
tip_zh: forest 比 wood 大。a forest，the forest 都可以。

definition_en: to become larger
example1_en: The library will expand the reading room.
example2_en: Cities expand bus routes when they count who is left at the stop.
example2_zh: 当城市数清还留在车站的人时，才会延长公交线路。
collocations: expand into｜扩展成
tip_zh: expand 可及物也可不及物。

definition_en: something people do, especially for a purpose
example1_en: The club plans one outdoor activity a month.
example1_zh: 社团每月安排一次户外活动。
example2_en: After-school activity should not depend only on families who can pay for extra lessons.
example2_zh: 课外活动不该只依靠付得起额外课程的家庭。
collocations: outdoor activity｜户外活动 ; take part in an activity｜参加活动
tip_zh: activity 表示具体活动时可数。不可数时指活跃或繁忙。

definition_en: not shaking, or continuing at the same rate
example1_en: Keep a steady pace.
example2_en: A steady bus is more useful than a poster of a new one.
example2_zh: 稳定的公交比一张新车海报更有用。
collocations: a steady job｜稳定的工作
tip_zh: steady 也可作动词“使稳定”。

definition_en: a duty to deal with something
example1_en: It is your responsibility to lock the lab.
example2_en: Responsibility for a flooded street is shared by the town, not only by the family on the ground floor.
example2_zh: 被淹街道的责任在城镇，而不只在一楼那户人家。
collocations: a sense of responsibility｜责任感 ; take responsibility for｜对……负责
tip_zh: 对某事负责：be responsible for。

definition_en: a place larger than a village and smaller than a city
example1_en: Our town has one public library.
example1_zh: 我们镇上有一座公共图书馆。
example2_en: A small town loses young people when the college, the jobs, and the buses are all in the city.
example2_zh: 当大学、工作和公交都在城里时，小镇会失去年轻人。
collocations: in town｜在城里 ; home town｜家乡
tip_zh: town 比 city 小。in town 常不加 the。

meanings_zh: adj. 野生的；荒凉的 | n. 荒野
definition_en: living naturally, or not controlled | a natural place far from towns
example1_en: Wild birds nest in the trees by the river.
example1_zh: 野鸟在河边的树上筑巢。
example2_en: A wild hillside above a town can become a park, or it can become the next row of houses.
example2_zh: 城镇上方的荒坡可以变成公园，也可以变成下一排房子。
collocations: wild animals｜野生动物 ; in the wild｜在野外
tip_zh: in the wild 表示在野外。wild 也可作名词“荒野”。

definition_en: the place you are going to
example1_en: The destination is on the ticket.
example2_en: A destination without a return time is not a plan.
example2_zh: 没有返回时间的目的地不是计划。
collocations: the destination of｜……的目的地
tip_zh: destination 可数。

definition_en: not having, or not doing
example1_en: He finished the paper without a single mistake.
example1_zh: 他交卷时一个错误都没有。
example2_en: A city cannot cut car use without giving people buses and pavements they can trust.
example2_zh: 如果没有可靠的公交和人行道，一座城市就无法减少私家车使用。
collocations: without doubt｜毫无疑问 ; do without｜没有……也行
tip_zh: without 后接名词或 doing，不接 to do。

definition_en: a father
example1_en: My dad picks me up on Fridays.
example2_en: A dad who works nights may never see the school play his child is in.
example2_zh: 上夜班的爸爸可能永远看不到孩子参加的学校演出。
collocations: dad and mum｜父母
tip_zh: dad 是口语；正式写作可用 father。

definition_en: related to society or to meeting people
example1_en: We did a social study on how neighbours share tools.
example1_zh: 我们做了一项关于邻居如何共用工具的社会调查。
example2_en: Social media can connect a class, but it can also spread a rumour in minutes.
example2_zh: 社交媒体能把一个班联系起来，也能在几分钟内传播谣言。
collocations: social media｜社交媒体 ; social life｜社交生活
tip_zh: social 是形容词；社会用 society。

definition_en: a single part, or a standard of measurement
example1_en: We finished unit three today.
example1_zh: 我们今天学完了第三单元。
example2_en: A small clinic is a useful unit of care when the hospital is an hour away.
example2_zh: 当医院在一小时之外时，小诊所是有用的医疗单位。
collocations: unit of｜……的单位
tip_zh: unit 是可数名词。

definition_en: having great power or effect
example1_en: The speech was short but powerful.
example1_zh: 这次发言很短，但很有力量。
example2_en: A powerful poster can change a habit only if the school also changes the choice in the canteen.
example2_zh: 有力的海报只有在学校同时改变食堂的选择时，才可能改变习惯。
collocations: a powerful speech｜有力的演讲
tip_zh: powerful 可形容人、机器、话语或效果。

definition_en: an opening or a hollow place
example1_en: There is a hole in the fence.
example2_en: A hole in the playground should be marked before the first class, not after someone falls.
example2_zh: 操场上的坑应当在第一节课之前标出来，而不是等有人摔倒之后。
collocations: a hole in｜……上的洞
tip_zh: hole 可数。in the hole 有时比喻亏空。

meanings_zh: v. 测量 | n. 措施；度量
definition_en: to find the size or amount | an action, or a unit of size
example1_en: Measure the table before you buy the cloth.
example2_en: Cities should measure the air near schools, not only in the park.
example2_zh: 城市应当测量学校附近的空气，而不只是公园里的。
collocations: measure sth｜测量 ; a measure of｜一种衡量
tip_zh: measure 作名词是措施或度量。take measures to do 表示采取措施。

definition_en: a drawing or photograph
example1_en: Draw a picture of your street.
example2_en: A picture of a clean river can hide the factory that still pours waste at night.
example2_zh: 一张干净河流的照片，可以藏起仍在夜里排污的工厂。
collocations: take a picture｜拍照 ; picture book｜图画书
tip_zh: picture 作动词是“想象”。

meanings_zh: n. 草稿 | v. 起草
definition_en: an early version of a piece of writing | to write an early version
example1_en: Hand in a draft before the final essay.
example1_zh: 交定稿前先交一份草稿。
example2_en: A draft budget lets parents see the numbers before they are locked.
example2_zh: 预算草案让家长在数字定死之前看见它们。
collocations: a first draft｜初稿 ; draft a plan｜起草计划
tip_zh: draft 作动词是起草。美式 draft 也可指征兵，本条以草稿为主。

definition_en: a result you aim at
example1_en: Our target is to finish the poster today.
example1_zh: 我们的目标是今天完成海报。
example2_en: A target that ignores poorer schools can make a city average look successful and still leave them behind.
example2_zh: 忽视较穷学校的目标，可以让城市平均数看起来成功，那些学校却仍被落下。
collocations: meet a target｜达到目标 ; target of｜……的目标
tip_zh: target 作动词是“以……为目标”。

definition_en: a young person
example1_en: Every child in the class has a reading book.
example1_zh: 班上每个孩子都有一本读物。
example2_en: A child who walks to school needs a pavement, not only a parent with a car.
example2_zh: 走路上学的孩子需要人行道，而不只是一位有车的家长。
collocations: child's｜孩子的
tip_zh: child 的复数是 children，不是 childs。

meanings_zh: n. 种类 | adj. 善良的
definition_en: a type or sort | friendly and helpful
example1_en: What kind of book do you like?
example2_en: The kind of food sold at a school gate shapes what students eat between lessons.
example2_zh: 校门口卖的食物种类，影响着学生课间吃什么。
collocations: a kind of｜一种 ; all kinds of｜各种各样 ; kind of｜有点儿
tip_zh: kind 作形容词是“善良的”：be kind to sb。

definition_en: of the sun, or using its energy
example1_en: The solar clock in the yard still works.
example1_zh: 院子里的太阳钟还能用。
example2_en: Solar power on a school roof helps only if someone can repair it.
example2_zh: 学校屋顶的太阳能只有在有人能修的时候才有帮助。
collocations: solar energy｜太阳能 ; the solar system｜太阳系
tip_zh: solar 是形容词。名词太阳是 the sun。

meanings_zh: n. 印章；海豹 | v. 密封
definition_en: a stamp used to close something, or a sea animal | to close something tightly
example1_en: The seal on the letter is broken.
example2_en: The nature book shows a seal, and the lab door has a different seal.
example2_zh: 自然课本里是海豹，实验室门上是另一种封条。
collocations: a seal of｜一枚……印章 ; seal up｜密封
tip_zh: 印章和海豹同音。作动词是密封。本条不写如何伤害动物。

meanings_zh: n. 通道；使用权 | n. 入口；通道 | v. 访问；获取；进入
definition_en: a way of entering or using | A way of reaching or entering a place. | Reach, enter, or obtain something, especially information on a computer.
example1_en: Students need access to the library.
example1_zh: 学生需要使用图书馆的权限。
example2_en: Affordable internet access enables rural students to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
example2_zh: 价格可负担的互联网接入能让农村学生受益于更丰富的教育资源。
collocations: access to education｜受教育的机会 ; internet access｜互联网接入 ; gain access to｜获得使用或进入的机会 ; access information｜获取信息
tip_zh: 名词后接to；动词直接接宾语，不加to。

meanings_zh: n. 潜力 | adj. 潜在的
definition_en: the possibility of becoming something | possible in the future
example1_en: The club helps students find their potential.
example1_zh: 社团帮助学生发现自己的潜力。
example2_en: The potential of an empty building is a clinic or a library, if the town chooses that use.
example2_zh: 一座空楼的潜力是诊所或图书馆，如果城镇选择那样使用。
collocations: potential for｜……的潜力
tip_zh: potential 也可作形容词“潜在的”。

definition_en: related to farming
example1_en: The agricultural show is in October.
example2_en: Agricultural work feeds the town, and the workers need the bus too.
example2_zh: 农活养活城镇，干活的人也需要公交。
collocations: agricultural land｜农田
tip_zh: 名词 agriculture 是本批的另一词。

definition_en: different from
example1_en: Unlike the morning bus, the later one stops here.
example1_zh: 和早班车不同，晚班车在这里停。
example2_en: Unlike a poster, a working clock tells you whether you are late.
example2_zh: 和海报不同，一块能走的钟会告诉你是否迟到了。
collocations: unlike sb｜与某人不同
tip_zh: unlike 是介词。形容词 unlike 表示不同的，较少用。

meanings_zh: n. 争论；论据 | n. 论点；论据
definition_en: a disagreement; a reason | A reason or set of reasons supporting an opinion.
example1_en: Their argument lasted for hours.
example1_zh: 他们的争论持续了几个小时。
example2_en: The strongest argument for public transport investment is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
example2_zh: 支持投资公共交通最有力的论据是，它有望减少城市空气污染。
collocations: have an argument｜发生争吵 ; a convincing argument｜有说服力的论据 ; an argument for｜支持……的论据 ; an argument against｜反对……的论据
tip_zh: 争吵常接with或about；支持某观点用argument for。

meanings_zh: n. 规则 | v. 统治
definition_en: an official instruction | to govern
example1_en: The lab rule is to wear glasses.
example1_zh: 实验室的规则是戴眼镜。
example2_en: A rule against litter works when bins are near and everyone can see it applied.
example2_zh: 当附近有垃圾桶、而且人人都看到规则被执行时，禁止乱扔的规则才有效。
collocations: break a rule｜违反规则 ; as a rule｜通常
tip_zh: rule 作动词是“统治”。

definition_en: a tool with hairs used for cleaning or painting | to clean or paint with a brush
example1_en: The brush is by the sink.
example2_en: A brush in the art room should be washed the same day.
example2_zh: 美术室的刷子应当当天洗。
collocations: a brush of｜一把刷子
tip_zh: brush 作动词是刷。

definition_en: feeling pleased about something you or others did
example1_en: Her parents are proud of her speech.
example1_zh: 她父母为她的演讲感到自豪。
example2_en: A school can be proud of a garden and still admit who did the watering.
example2_zh: 学校可以为花园自豪，同时承认是谁浇的水。
collocations: be proud of｜为……自豪 ; proud to do｜因做……而自豪
tip_zh: be proud of 后接名词或 doing。骄傲过头时 proud 含贬义，要看语境。

definition_en: money received from work or other sources
example1_en: Rent takes a large part of their income.
example1_zh: 房租占了他们收入的很大一部分。
example2_en: When food prices rise, low income leaves less money for books and clinic visits.
example2_zh: 食品涨价时，低收入会让书和看病的钱更少。
collocations: income tax｜所得税 ; low income｜低收入
tip_zh: income 可数或不可数都可以。

definition_en: easy to understand or do
example1_en: Please use simple words in the notice.
example2_en: The simple act of sorting rubbish fails if the bins are too far from the canteen.
example2_zh: 如果垃圾桶离食堂太远，垃圾分类这个简单的行为也会失败。
collocations: simple and clear｜简单明了
tip_zh: simple 的副词是 simply。

meanings_zh: n. 恩惠；帮助 | v. 赞成；偏爱
definition_en: British spelling of favor | to prefer or support
example1_en: Could you do me a favour and lock the door?
example1_zh: 请帮个忙，把门锁上好吗？
example2_en: A favour for one class should not hide the bus from the others.
example2_zh: 给一个班的帮助，不应当把公交瞒着其他班。
collocations: do sb a favour｜帮某人一个忙 ; in favour of｜赞成
tip_zh: favour 是英式，favor 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留。

definition_en: not anything
example1_en: There is nothing in the lost-and-found box.
example1_zh: 失物招领箱里什么都没有。
example2_en: Nothing improves a river if factories upstream are allowed to pour waste into it at night.
example2_zh: 如果允许上游工厂在夜里排污，什么办法也改善不了这条河。
collocations: nothing but｜只有 ; for nothing｜免费；徒劳
tip_zh: nothing 作主语时谓语用单数。形容词后置：nothing new。

definition_en: the story of a book or film
example1_en: The plot is simple and the ending is not.
example1_zh: 情节简单，结局并不简单。
example2_en: A plot about a flood should not hide who had to leave their house.
example2_zh: 关于洪水的情节不应当藏起谁不得不离开自己的家。
collocations: the plot of｜……的情节
tip_zh: plot 也可指小块土地，或密谋。作动词是密谋或绘制。本条以故事情节为主。

meanings_zh: adv. 还；已经 | conj. 然而
definition_en: until now, often in questions and negatives | but at the same time
example1_en: She has not finished the poster yet.
example2_en: The town has not yet decided where the new clinic will stand, though the old one is already unsafe.
example2_zh: 尽管旧诊所已经不安全，镇上还没有决定新诊所建在哪里。
collocations: not yet｜尚未 ; as yet｜到目前为止
tip_zh: yet 多用于否定和疑问；already 多用于肯定。yet 也可作连词“然而”。

definition_en: strong trust, or a religion
example1_en: She has faith in the team's hard work.
example2_en: Public rules should protect every faith without making one of them the school rule.
example2_zh: 公共规则应当保护每一种信仰，而不把其中一种变成校规。
collocations: have faith in｜信任 ; in good faith｜真诚地
tip_zh: faith 可指对人的信任，也可指宗教信仰。

definition_en: the amount produced, or what a machine sends out
example1_en: The output of the garden is tomatoes.
example1_zh: 这个园子的产出是西红柿。
example2_en: Output numbers without a source are not a report.
example2_zh: 没有来源的产量数字不是报告。
collocations: the output of｜……的产量
tip_zh: output 也可作动词“输出”。

meanings_zh: adj. 地下的 | n. 地铁
definition_en: below the ground | an underground railway
example1_en: The underground station is closed.
example2_en: An underground path still needs a light.
example2_zh: 地下通道仍然需要灯。
collocations: underground station｜地铁站 ; go underground｜转入地下
tip_zh: 英式 the underground 可指地铁。ground 已在本库。

definition_en: to say no
example1_en: She refused to hide the broken step.
example1_zh: 她拒绝把坏台阶藏起来。
example2_en: A school should refuse a drink ad that hides the sugar.
example2_zh: 学校应当拒绝隐瞒含糖量的饮料广告。
collocations: refuse to do｜拒绝做 ; refuse sb sth｜拒绝给某人
tip_zh: refuse to do。名词垃圾也拼作 refuse，读 /ˈrefjuːs/，本条是动词。

definition_en: unwilling to work
example1_en: A lazy afternoon is not the same as a tired student.
example1_zh: 懒散的下午不等于一个疲惫的学生。
example2_en: Calling a classmate lazy ignores the student who works at night.
example2_zh: 说同学懒，会忽略那个晚上还在干活的学生。
collocations: lazy about｜对……懒散
tip_zh: lazy 用在人身上会伤人。可以形容一段轻松的时间。

definition_en: a long metal weapon used in the past
example1_en: The sword is in the museum, behind glass.
example1_zh: 剑在博物馆的玻璃后面。
example2_en: A history chapter can show a sword and still not teach how to use one.
example2_zh: 历史课可以展示一把剑，同时仍然不教如何使用。
collocations: a sword of｜一把……剑
tip_zh: 本条只作历史词汇。不写使用方法。

definition_en: a part of a tree, or a local office
example1_en: A branch fell across the path.
example2_en: The library branch near the station stays open after the main one closes.
example2_zh: 车站附近的图书馆分馆，在总馆关门后还开着。
collocations: a branch of｜……的分支
tip_zh: branch 可指树枝、分公司、支部或学科分支。

meanings_zh: n. 伤口 | v. 使受伤
definition_en: an injury to the body | to injure someone
example1_en: The nurse cleaned the wound.
example2_en: A wound should be seen at the clinic, not hidden until Friday.
example2_zh: 伤口应当去医务室看，而不是藏到周五。
collocations: a wound in｜……上的伤口
tip_zh: 名词伤口读 /wuːnd/。wind 的过去式 wound 读 /waʊnd/。本条是伤口，不写如何造成伤害。

definition_en: a covering for the head
example1_en: Take off your hat in the hall.
example2_en: A hat in strong sun is a health tool, not only a fashion.
example2_zh: 烈日下的帽子是健康用具，而不只是打扮。
collocations: wear a hat｜戴帽子
tip_zh: hat 通常有边。cap 多指无边或只有前面有沿的帽子，本批另有词条。

definition_en: a person who works
example1_en: The worker locked the gate.
example2_en: A night worker needs the late bus as much as a student does.
example2_zh: 上夜班的人需要晚班车，和学生一样。
collocations: a factory worker｜工厂工人
tip_zh: worker 可数。work 已在本库。

definition_en: very great fear
example1_en: The story uses terror, then it returns to the classroom.
example1_zh: 故事用了恐惧，然后回到教室。
example2_en: Terror in a headline is not the same as a fact.
example2_zh: 标题里的恐惧不等于事实。
collocations: in terror｜惊恐地
tip_zh: terror 通常不可数。本条不写如何恐吓。

meanings_zh: v. 减少 | n. 减少；减少量
definition_en: to become smaller in amount | A reduction in the size, number, or amount of something.
example1_en: Pollution may decrease if we use less plastic.
example1_zh: 如果我们少用塑料，污染可能会减少。
example2_en: Improved public transport could decrease traffic congestion and reduce air pollution in densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通可以缓解人口密集城市的交通拥堵，并减少空气污染。
collocations: a decrease in demand｜需求下降 ; decrease significantly｜显著减少 ; decrease by half｜减少一半 ; a steady decrease｜持续下降
tip_zh: 动词重音在后，名词/ˈdiːkriːs/重音在前。

definition_en: in or to any place
example1_en: You may sit anywhere in the front two rows.
example2_en: A student who cannot find anywhere quiet will not finish the same essay as a classmate with a desk.
example2_zh: 找不到安静地方的学生，完成不了和有书桌的同学同样的作文。
collocations: anywhere else｜其他任何地方
tip_zh: anywhere 多用于疑问句和否定句；肯定句常用 somewhere。

definition_en: a piece of cloth used as a symbol
example1_en: The flag is raised at eight.
example2_en: A flag at the gate does not tell a new student where the clinic is.
example2_zh: 门口的旗告诉不了新生医务室在哪里。
collocations: national flag｜国旗
tip_zh: flag 作动词可以是标出或衰退。国旗前常用 the。

definition_en: to become someone's husband or wife
example1_en: They will marry in the spring.
example2_en: A form about who may marry should not shame the student who fills it in.
example2_zh: 关于谁可以结婚的表格，不应当让填写的学生感到羞耻。
collocations: marry sb｜与某人结婚 ; get married｜结婚
tip_zh: 名词 marriage 已在本库。不说 marry with。

definition_en: a wild animal, especially a large or dangerous one
example1_en: The story has a beast, not a pet.
example1_zh: 故事里有一只野兽，不是宠物。
example2_en: Calling a person a beast is not a joke the class should keep.
example2_zh: 把人叫做野兽，不是班级该保留的笑话。
collocations: a beast of｜一只……野兽
tip_zh: beast 可数。用在人身上会伤人。

meanings_zh: n. 评论 | v. 评论
definition_en: a spoken or written remark | to give an opinion
example1_en: She left a short comment under the article.
example1_zh: 她在文章下面留了一条短评。
example2_en: A rude comment online can follow a student longer than the lesson it interrupted.
example2_zh: 网上一句粗鲁的评论，可能比它打断的那节课跟学生更久。
collocations: make a comment｜发表评论 ; no comment｜无可奉告
tip_zh: comment 作动词时，说 comment on something。

definition_en: the top layer of earth in which plants grow
example1_en: The soil here is good for tomatoes.
example1_zh: 这里的土壤适合种西红柿。
example2_en: Soil on a school path becomes mud when the drain is blocked.
example2_zh: 排水口堵住时，学校小路上的土会变成泥。
collocations: rich soil｜肥沃的土壤
tip_zh: soil 通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 风险 | v. 冒……的风险
definition_en: the chance of something bad | to do something that may cause harm
example1_en: There is a risk of rain this afternoon.
example1_zh: 今天下午有下雨的风险。
example2_en: The risk of flooding rises when a town builds houses on the cheapest land beside a river.
example2_zh: 当城镇把房子建在河边最便宜的地上时，洪水风险会上升。
collocations: at risk｜处于危险中 ; take a risk｜冒险
tip_zh: risk doing 表示冒险做可能带来坏结果的事。

definition_en: the space between two lines, or a way of looking
example1_en: Measure the angle before you cut.
example2_en: From the student angle, the last bus is the whole plan.
example2_zh: 从学生的角度看，末班车就是整个计划。
collocations: at an angle｜成一个角度 ; angle of｜……的角度
tip_zh: angle 可数。

definition_en: existing in nature, or normal
example1_en: It is natural to feel nervous before a test.
example1_zh: 考试前感到紧张是自然的。
example2_en: Natural shade from trees costs less over time than machines that cool one classroom.
example2_zh: 树木的天然荫凉，长期来看比只冷却一间教室的机器更省。
collocations: natural gas｜天然气
tip_zh: natural 是形容词；nature 是名词。

meanings_zh: n. 日程；时间表 | v. 安排
definition_en: a plan of times | to plan a time for something
example1_en: The schedule is on the door.
example2_en: A schedule that ignores the last bus will look neat and still fail.
example2_zh: 不考虑末班车的日程看起来整齐，仍然会失败。
collocations: on schedule｜按时 ; ahead of schedule｜提前
tip_zh: 英式常读 /ˈʃedjuːl/，美式常读 /ˈskedʒuːl/。作动词是安排。

meanings_zh: n. 错误 | n. 误差
definition_en: a mistake | the difference between a measured value and the true value
example1_en: Check your work for any error.
example2_en: Researchers should check their calculations carefully, as a minor error can significantly affect the final conclusions.
example2_zh: 研究人员应仔细核查计算过程，因为一个小错误就可能显著影响最终结论。
collocations: make an error｜犯错 ; human error｜人为失误 ; a margin of error｜误差范围 ; trial and error｜反复试验
tip_zh: error比mistake正式，常用于技术、计算或判断。

definition_en: to stay in a state, or to continue to have
example1_en: Please keep the door closed.
example2_en: Cities that keep old trees during construction save shade that new saplings cannot provide for years.
example2_zh: 施工时保留老树的城市，留住了新树苗多年内无法提供的荫凉。
collocations: keep doing｜一直做 ; keep on｜继续 ; keep a diary｜写日记
tip_zh: keep doing 表示持续做；keep sb from doing 表示阻止某人做。

meanings_zh: adj. 左边的 | v. 离开；留下（leave 的过去式）
definition_en: on the side opposite the right | past form of leave
example1_en: Turn left after the school gate.
example2_en: The shops on the left bank of the river closed when the new road drew customers away.
example2_zh: 河左岸的商店在新路把顾客引走之后关门了。
collocations: on the left｜在左边 ; turn left｜向左转
tip_zh: left 也是 leave 的过去式和过去分词。看上下文才能区分“左边”和“离开”。

meanings_zh: n. 运送者；带菌者；货架
definition_en: a person or thing that carries something
example1_en: The carrier on the bicycle is loose.
example2_en: A carrier of an illness should be able to stay home without shame.
example2_zh: 带病的人应当能待在家里，而不被羞辱。
collocations: a carrier of｜……的携带者
tip_zh: carrier 可数。健康课里可指带菌者。本条不写传播的做法。

definition_en: a person who uses something
example1_en: The user guide is on the desk.
example2_en: A library user who cannot log in still needs a way to borrow a book.
example2_zh: 登不进去的图书馆用户，仍然需要一种借书的办法。
collocations: user name｜用户名 ; end user｜最终用户
tip_zh: user 可数。计算机和图书馆都可以用。

definition_en: words spoken to a god
example1_en: The visit included a moment of prayer for those who wanted it.
example1_zh: 参观包括片刻祈祷，给想参加的人。
example2_en: A school can explain prayer without telling every student to join.
example2_zh: 学校可以讲解祈祷，而不要求每个学生参加。
collocations: a prayer for｜为……的祈祷
tip_zh: 动词 pray 是本批的另一词。本条是词汇，不是劝人信教。

definition_en: the area around a place; American spelling
example1_en: The neighborhood shares one clinic.
example1_zh: 这个街区共用一家诊所。
example2_en: A quiet neighborhood can still be far from the last bus.
example2_zh: 安静的街区仍然可能离末班车很远。
collocations: in the neighborhood｜在附近
tip_zh: neighborhood 是美式。英式是 neighbourhood。本库用考纲里的 neighborhood。

definition_en: to move something into a place
example1_en: Put the bottles in the recycling box.
example2_en: If a city puts all new housing on the edge, workers spend hours travelling to jobs in the centre.
example2_zh: 如果一座城市把新住房都放在边缘，工人就要花数小时去市中心上班。
collocations: put off｜推迟 ; put on｜穿上 ; put up｜张贴；搭建
tip_zh: put 的过去式和过去分词都是 put，不是 putted。

meanings_zh: v. 登记；注册 | n. 登记簿；注册员
definition_en: to put a name on an official list | an official list, or a person who keeps it
example1_en: Please register before the first class.
example2_en: A school that can register a new student in one morning keeps that child in class the same day.
example2_zh: 能在一个上午给新生登记的学校，能让那个孩子当天就上课。
collocations: register for｜报名参加 ; cash register｜收银机
tip_zh: register 作名词是登记簿或注册员。

definition_en: to rescue, to avoid spending, or to keep
example1_en: Save your work before you close the computer.
example2_en: Towns that save old trees save shade that new saplings cannot give for years.
example2_zh: 保住老树的城镇，也保住了新树苗多年内给不了的荫凉。
collocations: save money｜省钱 ; save sb from｜从……中救出
tip_zh: save 表示拯救或节省，后面直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: v. 附上；贴上 | v. 赋予；认为具有
definition_en: to fasten or join | Consider something to have a particular value or importance
example1_en: Please attach your photo to the form.
example2_en: Many employers attach greater importance to practical experience than to academic qualifications when recruiting new staff.
example2_zh: 许多雇主招聘新员工时，更看重实际经验而非学历。
collocations: attach a file｜附上文件 ; attach something to something｜把某物固定到某物上 ; attach importance to｜重视
tip_zh: 常用attach A to B；邮件附件用attachment。

definition_en: used for a possibility that is not certain
example1_en: It might snow tonight, so take a coat.
example1_zh: 今晚可能会下雪，带件外套。
example2_en: A new subway line might help the centre while making outer villages feel even farther away.
example2_zh: 一条新地铁线可能方便市中心，同时让外围村庄感觉更远。
collocations: might have done｜可能已经
tip_zh: might 比 may 语气更不确定，两者后面都接动词原形。

meanings_zh: n. 尊敬；尊重 | v. 尊敬
definition_en: a high opinion, or regard for someone's rights | to admire and treat well
example1_en: Students show respect by listening.
example1_zh: 学生用倾听来表示尊重。
example2_en: Respect for local knowledge means asking residents where the flood actually reached.
example2_zh: 尊重本地知识，意味着询问居民洪水实际淹到了哪里。
collocations: show respect for｜对……表示尊重 ; in respect of｜关于
tip_zh: respect 作动词直接接宾语：respect sb。

meanings_zh: n. 基础；基地 | v. 以……为根据
definition_en: the bottom support, or a main place | to use something as the starting point
example1_en: Trust is the base of the club.
example1_zh: 信任是这个社团的基础。
example2_en: A flood plan with no local base of volunteers will be slow on the first wet night.
example2_zh: 没有本地志愿者基础的防汛计划，会在第一个雨夜行动迟缓。
collocations: base on｜以……为基础 ; military base｜军事基地
tip_zh: be based on 表示以……为基础。base 作动词是“以……为根据”。

meanings_zh: n. 塑料 | adj. 塑料的
definition_en: a light artificial material | made of plastic
example1_en: The bottle is plastic, not glass.
example1_zh: 这个瓶子是塑料的，不是玻璃的。
example2_en: Plastic that leaves the school bin can reach a river if nobody stops it.
example2_zh: 离开学校垃圾桶的塑料，如果没人拦住，可以一直到河里。
collocations: a plastic bag｜塑料袋
tip_zh: plastic 作材料时常不可数。作形容词是塑料的。

definition_en: in the direction of, or in relation to
example1_en: We walked towards the gate.
example2_en: Attitudes towards night buses change when people have to use them themselves.
example2_zh: 当人们不得不自己去坐夜班公交时，他们对它的态度会改变。
collocations: towards the end｜将近结束时
tip_zh: 英式常用 towards，美式常用 toward，意思相同。

definition_en: to keep safe from harm
example1_en: Trees protect the playground from the sun.
example1_zh: 树木保护操场不受日晒。
example2_en: Laws that protect a river also protect the drinking water of the next town.
example2_zh: 保护河流的法律，也保护下一个城镇的饮用水。
collocations: protect sb from｜保护某人免受
tip_zh: protect 后接宾语，再加 from 或 against。

definition_en: unusual, or not familiar
example1_en: The noise was strange for a Sunday.
example2_en: A strange result in one lab is a reason to measure again, not to hide the page.
example2_zh: 一次实验里奇怪的结果，是再测一次的理由，不是把那页藏起来。
collocations: strange to sb｜对某人陌生
tip_zh: stranger 是陌生人。feel strange 可表示不舒服。

definition_en: a long reptile with no legs
example1_en: The snake is in the nature book, not in the lab.
example1_zh: 蛇在自然课本里，不在实验室。
example2_en: A lesson about the snake should say where it lives, not how to harm it.
example2_zh: 关于蛇的课应当说它住在哪里，而不是如何伤害它。
collocations: a snake of｜一条蛇
tip_zh: snake 可数。表里这一行的音标少了词尾的 k，本库不用。

definition_en: a building where people pay to stay
example1_en: The hotel near the station is full.
example2_en: A big sports event can fill every hotel while ordinary rents rise for the rest of the year.
example2_zh: 大型体育赛事可以住满每家旅馆，同时让普通房租在这一年的其余时间上涨。
collocations: hotel room｜旅馆房间
tip_zh: hotel 是可数名词。

definition_en: serious pain or difficulty
example1_en: The novel does not describe the suffering in detail.
example1_zh: 小说没有详细描写那些痛苦。
example2_en: Flood suffering is reduced by a dry room, not only by a speech.
example2_zh: 洪水带来的苦难靠一间干房间来减轻，而不只是靠一篇讲话。
collocations: suffering from｜遭受
tip_zh: suffering 可数也可不可数。动词 suffer from 表示患有或遭受。

definition_en: something that is needed or demanded
example1_en: Sleep is a requirement, not a reward.
example2_en: A requirement that families cannot read is not one they can meet.
example2_zh: 家庭读不懂的要求，不是他们能达到的要求。
collocations: a requirement for｜对……的要求
tip_zh: 动词 require 已在本库。

definition_en: clever, or neat and fashionable
example1_en: That was a smart way to save time.
example1_zh: 那是个省时间的聪明办法。
example2_en: A smart uniform does not tell a teacher who prepared and who copied.
example2_zh: 整齐时髦的校服并不能告诉老师谁做了准备、谁抄了作业。
collocations: a smart idea｜好主意
tip_zh: smart 可指聪明，也可指衣着整齐时髦。美式口语里很常见。

definition_en: to try to find or get
example1_en: They seek advice before they change the rule.
example1_zh: 他们在改规则之前寻求建议。
example2_en: Students who seek help early avoid the week when the work is already late.
example2_zh: 早点求助的学生，能避开作业已经迟了的那一周。
collocations: seek for｜寻找 ; seek to do｜试图做
tip_zh: seek 的过去式和过去分词是 sought。比 look for 正式。

meanings_zh: v. 负担得起 | v. 提供；给予
definition_en: to have enough money or time for | to provide something useful or desirable
example1_en: We cannot afford to waste water.
example2_en: Without financial assistance, many students cannot afford to attend university despite having strong academic potential.
example2_zh: 如果没有经济援助，许多学生即使有很强的学术潜力，也无力负担大学费用。
collocations: can afford to do｜有能力负担做某事 ; cannot afford to lose｜承受不起失去 ; afford protection｜提供保护
tip_zh: 常用can afford sth或can afford to do，不接doing。

definition_en: an edge, a face, or one of two groups
example1_en: Please write notes on the side of the page.
example2_en: Both sides of a noisy road need a safe crossing if children walk to school there.
example2_zh: 如果孩子从那里走路上学，嘈杂马路的两边都需要安全的过街处。
collocations: side by side｜并排 ; on the other side｜在另一边 ; take sides｜站队
tip_zh: side 是名词；旁边用 beside 或 by the side of。

meanings_zh: n. 物体；目标；宾语 | v. 反对
definition_en: a thing you can see or touch, an aim, or a grammar object | to say that you disagree
example1_en: The object on the desk is a model.
example1_zh: 桌上的物体是一个模型。
example2_en: The object of the rule is safety, and the sign should say that.
example2_zh: 这条规则的目的是安全，牌子上应当写出来。
collocations: object to｜反对 ; the object of｜……的目的
tip_zh: 名词物体读 /ˈɒbdʒɪkt/。动词反对读 /əbˈdʒekt/，后接 to doing。

meanings_zh: adj. 漂亮的 | adv. 相当
definition_en: pleasant to look at | fairly
example1_en: The pretty garden is behind the hall.
example1_zh: 漂亮的花园在大厅后面。
example2_en: A pretty river view does not mean the water is clean enough for children to play in.
example2_zh: 河景漂亮并不意味着水干净到可以让孩子玩。
collocations: pretty good｜相当好
tip_zh: pretty 作副词表示“相当”，语气比 very 弱。

definition_en: to get to a place
example1_en: The bus arrives at four.
example2_en: Students who arrive after the gate closes still need a number to call.
example2_zh: 门关了之后才到的学生，仍然需要一个能打的电话。
collocations: arrive at｜到达 ; arrive in｜到达（大地方）
tip_zh: 小地点用 arrive at，城市和国家用 arrive in。名词 arrival 是本批的另一词。

meanings_zh: n. 压力；强调 | v. 强调
definition_en: worry caused by difficulty, or special importance | to give special importance
example1_en: Exam stress is common in May.
example2_en: Teachers who stress sleep as well as scores give students a fairer message.
example2_zh: 同时强调睡眠和分数的老师，给学生的信息更公平。
collocations: under stress｜在压力下 ; lay stress on｜强调
tip_zh: stress 作动词是强调。语音里的重读也叫 stress。

meanings_zh: adj. 清楚的；清晰的 | v. 清除；放晴
definition_en: easy to understand or see | to remove, or to become bright
example1_en: Please write a clear title.
example2_en: Clear signs at a junction matter more at night, when drivers and children share a narrow road.
example2_zh: 路口清楚的标志在夜里更重要，那时司机和孩子共用一条窄路。
collocations: make clear｜表明 ; clear up｜收拾；放晴
tip_zh: clear 作动词是“清除”或“放晴”。It is clear that...

definition_en: using numbers, or stored as computer data
example1_en: The digital clock in the hall is wrong.
example2_en: Digital notes are easy to share and easy to lose if nobody keeps a copy.
example2_zh: 数字笔记容易分享，如果没人留备份也容易丢失。
collocations: digital camera｜数码相机
tip_zh: digital 与 analogue 相对。不要和 traditional 的反义 modern 混用。

definition_en: a government department
example1_en: The ministry published the new school rule.
example1_zh: 该部公布了新的学校规定。
example2_en: A ministry that funds buses should also say which villages are left out.
example2_zh: 资助公交的部，也应当说明哪些村子被落下了。
collocations: the Ministry of｜……部
tip_zh: ministry 可数。部长是 minister，已在本库。

definition_en: a hard clear material, or a cup made of it
example1_en: There is a glass of water on the desk.
example2_en: Broken glass on a playground is a safety problem, not only a cleaning job.
example2_zh: 操场上的碎玻璃是安全问题，不只是打扫的事。
collocations: a glass of｜一杯 ; glasses｜眼镜
tip_zh: glass 作材料不可数。a glass 是一只杯子。眼镜用复数 glasses。

definition_en: the group of people who govern a country or city
example1_en: The government plans to repair the old bridge.
example1_zh: 政府计划修缮那座旧桥。
example2_en: A local government that publishes its spending makes it easier for citizens to ask useful questions.
example2_zh: 公开支出的地方政府，让公民更容易提出有用的问题。
collocations: local government｜地方政府 ; government official｜政府官员
tip_zh: government 作整体时谓语常用单数。

definition_en: necessary for life or success
example1_en: Sleep is vital before an exam.
example2_en: A vital notice should be on paper when the network fails.
example2_zh: 至关重要的通知，在网络断了时应当有纸质的。
collocations: vital to｜对……极其重要
tip_zh: It is vital to do。

meanings_zh: n. 治疗；疗法 | v. 治愈
definition_en: something that makes an illness better | to make an illness go away
example1_en: Rest is not a cure for every illness.
example1_zh: 休息不是每种病的疗法。
example2_en: A claim of a cure should name the source.
example2_zh: 声称能治愈，应当写明来源。
collocations: a cure for｜治疗……的方法
tip_zh: cure 作动词是治愈。本条不写药方。

definition_en: very unusual or surprising
example1_en: The result was extraordinary, so they measured again.
example1_zh: 结果很离奇，所以他们又测了一次。
example2_en: An extraordinary storm still needs the ordinary plan: who calls parents.
example2_zh: 一场异常的风暴仍然需要普通的方案：谁给家长打电话。
collocations: extraordinary meeting｜特别会议
tip_zh: ordinary 是本批的另一词。

meanings_zh: adv. 一次；曾经 | conj. 一旦
definition_en: one time, or at some time in the past | as soon as
example1_en: I have been to the museum only once.
example2_en: Once a wetland is filled in for housing, the birds do not return just because a sign says they are welcome.
example2_zh: 一旦湿地被填平用来建房，鸟儿不会因为一块欢迎的牌子就回来。
collocations: once more｜再一次 ; at once｜立刻 ; once upon a time｜从前
tip_zh: once 引导条件从句时表示“一旦”，主句常用将来或情态。

meanings_zh: adj. 公平的；相当好的 | n. 集市；义卖
definition_en: just, or reasonably good | an outdoor sale or exhibition
example1_en: The rule is fair if it applies to everyone.
example1_zh: 如果规则适用于所有人，它就是公平的。
example2_en: A fair chance to learn includes a quiet room, not only an equal test paper.
example2_zh: 公平的学习机会包括一间安静的房间，而不只是一份相同的试卷。
collocations: fair play｜公平竞争 ; to be fair｜公平地说
tip_zh: fair 作名词是“集市、义卖”。

definition_en: a holiday; especially American
example1_en: The vacation starts next Friday.
example2_en: A long vacation still needs someone to feed the school cat.
example2_zh: 长假仍然需要有人喂学校的猫。
collocations: on vacation｜在度假 ; summer vacation｜暑假
tip_zh: vacation 是美式。英式常用 holiday，已在本库。

meanings_zh: adj. 主要的；重大的 | n. 主修专业；该专业学生 | v. 主修
definition_en: important; large | a main university subject, or a student studying that subject | to study a particular subject as your main university subject
example1_en: Traffic is a major problem.
example2_en: Access to affordable childcare remains a major concern for parents who wish to return to work.
example2_zh: 对于希望重返职场的父母而言，能否获得负担得起的托育服务仍是一个主要顾虑。
collocations: major problem｜重大问题 ; major role｜重要作用 ; major in biology｜主修生物学 ; major breakthrough｜重大突破
tip_zh: 动词主修用major in；主要用于美式英语。

definition_en: a written message, or a sign in the alphabet
example1_en: I wrote a letter to my cousin.
example2_en: A letter to the council should name the street and the problem, not only the feeling.
example2_zh: 给市政会的信应该写明街道和问题，而不只是情绪。
collocations: capital letter｜大写字母 ; letter box｜信箱
tip_zh: letter 的两个常见义是信和字母。

definition_en: unpleasant, poor, or serious
example1_en: The weather was bad, so the match was delayed.
example2_en: Bad air on the walk to school can harm children even when their classrooms are clean.
example2_zh: 即使教室很干净，上学路上的糟糕空气仍可能伤害孩子。
collocations: be bad for｜对……有害 ; go bad｜变质
tip_zh: bad 的比较级是 worse，最高级是 worst，不是 more bad。

meanings_zh: v. 射门；拍摄 | n. 嫩芽；射击
definition_en: to kick or throw toward a goal, or to take a photograph | a new growth, or an act of firing
example1_en: She can shoot from the corner.
example2_en: Students may not shoot photos during an exam, even if the phone is already in their hand.
example2_zh: 即使手机已经拿在手里，考试时学生也不可以拍照。
collocations: shoot a film｜拍电影 ; shoot at goal｜射门
tip_zh: shoot 的过去式和过去分词是 shot。名词还可指嫩芽。射击是词典里的另一个意思；本库不写操作方法。

meanings_zh: v. 滑倒 | n. 疏忽；纸条
definition_en: to slide and lose your balance | a small mistake, or a small piece of paper
example1_en: You may slip on the wet path.
example1_zh: 你可能会在湿路上滑倒。
example2_en: A slip at the gate is a reason to dry the floor the same hour.
example2_zh: 门口滑一跤，是在同一小时把地擦干的理由。
collocations: slip on｜在……上滑倒
tip_zh: slip 作名词可以是纸片或疏忽。

meanings_zh: n. 命令 | v. 命令；指挥
definition_en: an order | to order, or to be in charge
example1_en: The captain gave a clear command.
example1_zh: 队长下了一道清楚的命令。
example2_en: A command that nobody understands is not safer than a short explanation.
example2_zh: 谁也听不懂的命令，并不比一句短说明更安全。
collocations: in command of｜指挥 ; at one command｜听某人的命令
tip_zh: command 作动词是命令。计算机里的指令也叫 command。

definition_en: familiar with something, or not new
example1_en: I am used to getting up early on school days.
example2_en: A used textbook can be as useful as a new one if the notes in the margin are clear.
example2_zh: 如果页边的笔记清楚，旧课本可以和新的一样有用。
collocations: be used to｜习惯于 ; used to do｜过去常常 ; be used to do｜被用来做
tip_zh: used to do 是过去常常；be used to doing 是习惯于。不要混用。

definition_en: something you use to do a job
example1_en: The tool is on the bench.
example2_en: A map is a tool, and so is the person who knows which stop is safe at night.
example2_zh: 地图是工具，知道哪个车站夜里安全的人也是。
collocations: a tool for｜用于……的工具
tip_zh: tool 可数。计算机里的工具也叫 tool。

definition_en: a particular published form of a book or paper
example1_en: We use the new edition of the textbook.
example1_zh: 我们用这本教材的新版。
example2_en: The evening edition of the paper corrected a name that the morning edition had wrong.
example2_zh: 晚报更正了早报写错的一个名字。
collocations: first edition｜初版 ; a revised edition｜修订版
tip_zh: edition 是一版出版物。软件或文本的另一种形式也可用 version。

meanings_zh: v. 挣扎；奋斗 | n. 斗争；费力
definition_en: to try hard to do something difficult | a hard effort
example1_en: He struggled to hear at the back.
example2_en: Students who struggle with one subject still belong in the lab.
example2_zh: 某一科吃力的学生，仍然应当进实验室。
collocations: struggle for｜为……奋斗 ; struggle with｜与……斗争；费力应对
tip_zh: struggle 也可作名词。后接 to do 表示费力地做。

definition_en: the making of goods, or a branch of business
example1_en: The town grew around the steel industry.
example1_zh: 这个城镇是围绕钢铁工业发展起来的。
example2_en: An industry beside a river should pay for the water it dirties, not only for the jobs it creates.
example2_zh: 河边的工业应该为它弄脏的水付费，而不只为它创造的工作。
collocations: heavy industry｜重工业 ; tourist industry｜旅游业
tip_zh: industry 的复数是 industries。

definition_en: and not, used after a negative
example1_en: He cannot swim, nor can his brother.
example1_zh: 他不会游泳，他弟弟也不会。
example2_en: The hall has neither a ramp nor a clear sign, so some parents never come in.
example2_zh: 礼堂既没有坡道，也没有清楚的标志，所以有些家长从不进来。
collocations: neither...nor｜既不……也不
tip_zh: neither...nor 连接并列成分。nor 放在句首时，后面的句子常用倒装。or 已在排除的虚词里，nor 作为考纲词头保留。

definition_en: a game played with small bats and a light ball
example1_en: Table tennis practice is at four.
example2_en: A table tennis room that locks before the last class leaves is not a plan for sport.
example2_zh: 在最后一节课离开之前就锁上的乒乓球室，不是体育方案。
collocations: play table tennis｜打乒乓球
tip_zh: play table tennis 不加 the。

definition_en: the part of the face used for breathing and smelling
example1_en: Cover your nose when you sneeze.
example2_en: A nosebleed in class is a reason to call the clinic, not to laugh.
example2_zh: 课上流鼻血是叫医务室的理由，不是嘲笑的理由。
collocations: blow one nose｜擤鼻涕
tip_zh: nose 可数。

definition_en: spoken, not written
example1_en: The oral test is on Thursday.
example2_en: An oral warning at the gate helps the student who cannot read the sign.
example2_zh: 门口的口头警告能帮助看不懂牌子的学生。
collocations: an oral exam｜口试
tip_zh: oral 与 aural（听觉的）拼写接近。

definition_en: a person who controls a business or team
example1_en: The shop manager checked the list.
example2_en: A hospital manager who walks the night ward sees problems a report can miss.
example2_zh: 走夜班病房的医院经理，能看到报告可能漏掉的问题。
collocations: general manager｜总经理
tip_zh: manager 是人；management 是管理这个工作。

meanings_zh: adj. 平行的 | n. 相似的事物；纬线
definition_en: running side by side and never meeting | a similar case, or a line of latitude
example1_en: The two paths are parallel.
example2_en: A parallel example from another town helps, if the numbers are real.
example2_zh: 另一个城镇的平行例子有帮助，如果数字是真的。
collocations: parallel to｜与……平行
tip_zh: parallel 作名词可以是相似的人或纬线。

meanings_zh: n. 头；负责人 | v. 前往；率领
definition_en: the top of the body, or the person in charge | to go towards, or to lead
example1_en: She nodded her head to show she understood.
example2_en: A club needs a head who listens, or the loudest member will decide everything.
example2_zh: 社团需要一个肯听意见的负责人，否则声音最大的人会决定一切。
collocations: head teacher｜校长 ; from head to foot｜从头到脚
tip_zh: head for 表示朝某地去。head 作动词是“前往”或“率领”。

meanings_zh: adv. 昨天 | n. 昨天
definition_en: on the day before today | the day before today
example1_en: Yesterday we practised the play in the hall.
example1_zh: 昨天我们在大厅里排戏。
example2_en: A storm yesterday closed two roads, so some students arrived after the first lesson.
example2_zh: 昨天的暴风雨封了两条路，所以有些学生第一节课后才到。
collocations: the day before yesterday｜前天
tip_zh: yesterday 前不用介词，不说 on yesterday。

definition_en: a large organization, especially for education or care
example1_en: The library is a public institution.
example1_zh: 图书馆是一个公共机构。
example2_en: An institution that hides its fees is harder for families to trust.
example2_zh: 隐瞒费用的机构更难让家庭信任。
collocations: a public institution｜公共机构
tip_zh: institute 已在本库，常指研究所或学院。institution 更泛，也可以是制度。

definition_en: a thing that is not named
example1_en: There is something wrong with the clock.
example2_en: Something as small as a leaked battery can pollute the soil around a school for years.
example2_zh: 一块泄漏的电池这样小的东西，也可能污染学校周围的土壤很多年。
collocations: something like｜有点像 ; something else｜别的东西
tip_zh: 形容词放在 something 后面：something important。

definition_en: an animal kept at home
example1_en: The office pet is a cat.
example1_zh: 办公室的宠物是一只猫。
example2_en: A school pet needs a named person for the holiday, not only a photo.
example2_zh: 学校的宠物在假期需要一个写明姓名的人，而不只是一张照片。
collocations: a pet cat｜宠物猫
tip_zh: pet 作动词是抚摸。

definition_en: without other people
example1_en: She walked home alone.
example2_en: A child should not wait alone for a late bus on a road without lights.
example2_zh: 孩子不该独自在没有灯的路上等晚点的公交。
collocations: leave sb alone｜别打扰某人
tip_zh: alone 强调独自；lonely 强调孤独的感觉。alone 不作定语放在名词前。

definition_en: to stop something from happening
example1_en: Wash your hands to prevent a cold from spreading.
example2_en: Street lights prevent some night accidents, and they do not replace a crossing.
example2_zh: 路灯能防止一些夜间事故，但不能代替斑马线。
collocations: prevent sb from doing｜阻止某人做
tip_zh: 固定搭配是 prevent somebody from doing something。

definition_en: angry, or mentally ill; also very keen
example1_en: She was mad at me for being late.
example2_en: Being mad about a subject is useful only when the student also sleeps.
example2_zh: 对一门学科着迷只有在学生也睡觉时才有用。
collocations: be mad at｜对……生气 ; be mad about｜迷恋
tip_zh: 英式口语 mad 常指发疯或着迷；美式常指生气。描述疾病时要用更尊重的说法。

meanings_zh: v. 停止；阻止 | n. 停止；车站
definition_en: to end an activity or prevent something | a halt, or a place where a bus stops
example1_en: Please stop talking when the bell rings.
example2_en: Cities that stop cars from idling outside schools cut the fumes children breathe at the gate.
example2_zh: 禁止汽车在校门外怠速的城市，减少了孩子在门口吸入的废气。
collocations: bus stop｜公交车站 ; stop sb from doing｜阻止某人做 ; stop doing｜停止做
tip_zh: stop doing 是停下正在做的事；stop to do 是停下来去做另一件事。

definition_en: meat from a cow
example1_en: The soup has beef in it.
example2_en: Beef on a menu should say so, for the student who does not eat it.
example2_zh: 菜单上的牛肉应当写明，给不吃牛肉的学生看。
collocations: beef soup｜牛肉汤
tip_zh: beef 作肉通常不可数。

definition_en: a day or period when you do not work or study
example1_en: The holiday starts next Friday.
example2_en: A long holiday still needs someone to feed the school cat and lock the lab.
example2_zh: 长假仍然需要有人喂学校的猫、锁实验室。
collocations: on holiday｜在休假 ; summer holiday｜暑假
tip_zh: 英式 holiday 常指假期。美式 vacation 更常见。on holiday 不加 the。

meanings_zh: n. 前面；正面 | adj. 前面的
definition_en: the side that faces forward | at the front
example1_en: Please come to the front if you cannot see.
example1_zh: 如果看不见，请到前面来。
example2_en: Shops in front of a school affect what students buy more than a poster inside the classroom does.
example2_zh: 学校前面的商店对学生买什么的影响，大于教室里的一张海报。
collocations: in front of｜在……前面 ; in the front of｜在……前部
tip_zh: in front of 在外部前面；in the front of 在内部的前部。

meanings_zh: adj. 熟悉的 | adj. 熟知的；了解的
definition_en: well known | having knowledge or experience of something
example1_en: This song sounds familiar.
example2_en: Students who are familiar with digital tools may adapt more easily to online learning environments.
example2_zh: 熟悉数字工具的学生可能更容易适应在线学习环境。
collocations: familiar with｜熟悉…… ; familiar to｜为……所熟悉 ; a familiar face｜熟悉的面孔 ; look familiar｜看起来眼熟
tip_zh: 人熟悉事物用with；事物为人熟悉用to。

definition_en: the dark part of the day
example1_en: I review new words at night.
example2_en: Bright signs at night may help shops, but they can also keep nearby residents awake.
example2_zh: 夜间明亮的招牌也许有助于商店，但也会让附近居民睡不着。
collocations: at night｜在夜里 ; last night｜昨晚 ; night and day｜日夜
tip_zh: at night 不加 the；on 加具体的某个夜晚，如 on Sunday night。

definition_en: to put a question, or to request
example1_en: Ask the teacher if you do not understand.
example2_en: Cities should ask residents where floods actually reach, not only where the map predicts them.
example2_zh: 城市应该询问居民洪水实际淹到哪里，而不只是看地图的预测。
collocations: ask for｜请求 ; ask sb to do｜请某人做
tip_zh: ask sb sth 或 ask sb to do。ask 后不接 sb doing。

meanings_zh: n. 诡计；把戏 | v. 欺骗
definition_en: a clever act to deceive, or a skill that entertains | to deceive
example1_en: The trick question hid the real date.
example1_zh: 这道陷阱题藏起了真正的日期。
example2_en: A magic trick is fine; a trick that takes a classmate money is not.
example2_zh: 魔术把戏可以，骗同学钱的诡计不行。
collocations: play a trick on｜捉弄
tip_zh: trick 作动词是欺骗。

definition_en: a short coat
example1_en: Hang the jacket on the hook.
example2_en: A spare jacket at school matters when the rain soaks the first one.
example2_zh: 雨打湿第一件时，学校里的备用夹克就有用。
collocations: a jacket of｜一件……夹克
tip_zh: jacket 可数。

definition_en: having good luck
example1_en: We were lucky to catch the last bus.
example1_zh: 我们运气好，赶上了末班车。
example2_en: A lucky guess on one question should not be treated as mastery of the chapter.
example2_zh: 一道题上的幸运猜测，不该被当成已经掌握了这一章。
collocations: lucky to do｜幸运地做了
tip_zh: 名词运气是 luck，已在本库。lucky 是形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 荣誉 | v. 尊敬；授予荣誉
definition_en: British spelling of honor | to show respect, or to give an award
example1_en: It was an honour to speak for the class.
example1_zh: 代表班级发言是一种荣誉。
example2_en: An honour roll that lists only scores misses the student who kept the library open.
example2_zh: 只列分数的光荣榜，会漏掉那个让图书馆一直开着的学生。
collocations: in honour of｜为纪念 ; have the honour of｜有幸
tip_zh: honour 是英式，honor 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留，搜索只匹配词头。

definition_en: a copy, a good example, or a design
example1_en: We built a model of the bridge.
example1_zh: 我们做了一个桥的模型。
example2_en: A role model in a textbook helps less than a neighbour who does the job the student hopes to learn.
example2_zh: 课本里的榜样，不如一个正在做学生想学的工作的邻居有用。
collocations: role model｜榜样 ; model plane｜飞机模型
tip_zh: model 作动词是“做模特”或“以……为榜样”。

definition_en: something that joins people, or a written promise to pay
example1_en: Sport can create a bond between classes.
example1_zh: 体育能在班级之间建立联系。
example2_en: A bond between a school and a clinic matters on the day a child is ill.
example2_zh: 学校和诊所之间的联系，在孩子生病的那天很重要。
collocations: a bond between｜……之间的纽带
tip_zh: bond 也可指债券。作动词是建立联系。

definition_en: the world, or a model of the earth
example1_en: The globe is on the desk.
example2_en: A globe in the classroom should show more than one ocean.
example2_zh: 教室里的地球仪应当显示不止一片海洋。
collocations: around the globe｜全世界
tip_zh: globe 可数。the globe 常指地球。

meanings_zh: n. 邮件；邮政 | v. 邮寄
definition_en: letters and parcels, or the system that sends them | to send by post
example1_en: The mail arrives after lunch.
example2_en: School mail that names a child should not sit open on a public desk.
example2_zh: 写有孩子姓名的学校邮件，不应当拆开摊在公共桌子上。
collocations: by mail｜通过邮寄 ; email｜电子邮件
tip_zh: 美式 mail 相当于英式 post。作动词是邮寄。email 是电子邮件。

meanings_zh: n. 火；火灾 | v. 开火；解雇
definition_en: burning, or a destructive burning | to shoot, or to dismiss from a job
example1_en: We had a fire drill on Monday.
example1_zh: 周一我们进行了消防演习。
example2_en: A hillside fire can reach a village faster than a warning if the road out is narrow.
example2_zh: 如果出去的路很窄，山火到达村庄的速度可以快过警报。
collocations: on fire｜着火 ; fire alarm｜火警 ; set fire to｜点燃
tip_zh: fire 作“火”时常不可数；一场火灾用 a fire。

definition_en: who a person is
example1_en: The form asks for identity, not a nickname.
example1_zh: 表格要的是身份，不是绰号。
example2_en: A student identity card should open the library, not only the front gate.
example2_zh: 学生证应当能打开图书馆，而不只是前门。
collocations: identity card｜身份证；学生证
tip_zh: identity 可数。证明身份用 prove your identity。

definition_en: a girl or woman with the same parents
example1_en: My sister walks home with me.
example1_zh: 我姐姐和我一起走回家。
example2_en: A sister who leaves for the city may still call home, but the daily help is gone.
example2_zh: 去城市的姐妹也许仍会打电话回家，但日常的帮忙没有了。
collocations: elder sister｜姐姐
tip_zh: sister 的复数是 sisters。

definition_en: what is actually true
example1_en: The film is fun, but it is not reality.
example1_zh: 这部电影好看，但它不是现实。
example2_en: Budget reality returns when a school must choose between a new lab and repairing the roof.
example2_zh: 当学校必须在新实验室和修屋顶之间选择时，预算的现实就回来了。
collocations: in reality｜实际上 ; face reality｜面对现实
tip_zh: reality 通常不可数。in reality 用来纠正一种看起来相反的印象。

definition_en: a judgement of the value or level of something
example1_en: The assessment is a short essay, not only a score.
example1_zh: 这次评价是一篇短文，而不只是一个分数。
example2_en: Fair assessment looks at the work, not at who arrived in a quiet car.
example2_zh: 公平的评价看的是作业，而不是谁坐着安静的车来的。
collocations: assessment of｜对……的评价
tip_zh: assessment 可数。

definition_en: not strong
example1_en: The tea is weak.
example2_en: A weak signal in the hall is a reason to print the notice, not only to post it online.
example2_zh: 大厅信号弱，是把通知印出来的理由，而不只是发到网上。
collocations: weak in｜在……方面弱
tip_zh: 人身体弱、味道淡、论据弱都可以用 weak。名词是 weakness。

definition_en: a speed, a proportion, or a price
example1_en: The heart rate rises when you run.
example2_en: A high absence rate may show a bus problem, not only a lack of interest.
example2_zh: 高缺勤率可能说明公交有问题，而不只是缺乏兴趣。
collocations: at a rate of｜以……的速度 ; birth rate｜出生率
tip_zh: rate 作动词是“评价”。

definition_en: the coldest season
example1_en: Winter here lasts from December to February.
example1_zh: 这里的冬天从十二月持续到二月。
example2_en: Schools in a long winter need heating plans that poor families can still afford.
example2_zh: 漫长冬天里的学校需要穷人家庭仍然负担得起的供暖方案。
collocations: in winter｜在冬天 ; winter holiday｜寒假
tip_zh: 季节前通常不用 the：in winter。特指某一年的冬天可以用 the winter of。

definition_en: a person who treats illness, or a holder of a doctorate
example1_en: The doctor asked him to rest for two days.
example2_en: A school doctor can notice a hearing problem early, before it affects every lesson.
example2_zh: 校医可以早发现听力问题，免得它影响到每一节课。
collocations: see a doctor｜看医生 ; doctorate｜博士学位
tip_zh: 称谓缩写是 Dr.，本库已有单独词条。博士和医生都可能用 doctor，要看语境。

definition_en: a building used for worship
example1_en: The old temple is quiet in the morning.
example2_en: A visit to a temple should explain whose festival it is, and who does not celebrate it.
example2_zh: 参观寺庙应当说明这是谁的节日，以及谁不过这个节。
collocations: a temple of｜一座……庙
tip_zh: temple 可数。参观时保持安静。

meanings_zh: v. 对待；治疗 | n. 款待
definition_en: to behave toward someone, or to give medical care | something special that you pay for
example1_en: Treat the equipment with care.
example2_en: Clinics that treat a cut the same day keep a small injury from stopping a week of school.
example2_zh: 当天处理伤口的诊所，能避免小伤耽误一周的课。
collocations: treat sb as｜把某人当作 ; treat sb to｜请客
tip_zh: treat 还可表示请客。治疗的名词是 treatment，已在本库。

definition_en: to be worthy of
example1_en: You deserve a rest after such hard work.
example1_zh: 这么辛苦之后你应得休息。
example2_en: Healthcare workers deserve greater recognition because their dedication contributes directly to the wellbeing of society.
example2_zh: 医护人员值得获得更多认可，因为他们的奉献直接促进了社会福祉。
collocations: deserve praise｜值得表扬 ; deserve attention｜值得关注 ; deserve to win｜理应获胜
tip_zh: 接名词或to do；不用deserve doing表示主动。

meanings_zh: adj. 精神的；心理的 | adj. 脑力的；在头脑中进行的
definition_en: of the mind | Using thought rather than physical action or written calculation.
example1_en: mental health matters as much as body health.
example1_zh: 心理健康与身体健康同样重要。
example2_en: Employers should give mental wellbeing the same priority as physical safety when designing workplace policies.
example2_zh: 雇主制定职场政策时，应将心理健康与人身安全放在同等重要的位置。
collocations: mental health｜心理健康 ; mental wellbeing｜心理幸福感 ; mental arithmetic｜心算 ; mental effort｜脑力付出
tip_zh: mental侧重心理或脑力；口语中形容人疯狂可能冒犯。

definition_en: a large sports ground with seats
example1_en: The match is in the city stadium.
example2_en: A stadium that is full on Saturday can be empty of buses on Sunday.
example2_zh: 周六满座的体育场，周日可能没有公交。
collocations: sports stadium｜体育场
tip_zh: stadium 可数。复数 stadiums 或 stadia。

definition_en: to say that something or someone is good or suitable
example1_en: The teacher recommended a short novel.
example1_zh: 老师推荐了一部短篇小说。
example2_en: Doctors recommend sleep before an exam more often than another late lesson.
example2_zh: 医生建议考前睡觉，这比再加一节晚课更常见。
collocations: recommend sb sth｜向某人推荐 ; recommend doing｜建议做
tip_zh: recommend 后接 doing 或 that 从句，不接 to do。比 suggest 更明确地表示这是好的选择。

meanings_zh: n. 押金；沉积 | v. 存放；沉积
definition_en: money paid in advance, or a layer left by water | to put money or a layer somewhere
example1_en: The deposit is returned in June.
example2_en: A deposit that is not written down is not a price a family can check.
example2_zh: 没写下来的押金，不是家庭能核对的价格。
collocations: a deposit of｜一笔押金 ; pay a deposit｜付押金
tip_zh: deposit 作动词是存放或沉积。

definition_en: two things of the same kind used together
example1_en: I need a new pair of shoes.
example2_en: A pair of students sharing one text still need two chances to speak.
example2_zh: 合用一本课文的两名学生，仍然需要两次发言的机会。
collocations: a pair of｜一双；一对
tip_zh: a pair of trousers 谓语用单数。两条裤子是 two pairs。

definition_en: a part of something
example1_en: Read the first section of the text.
example2_en: The sports section of a newspaper rarely explains who pays for the new stadium.
example2_zh: 报纸的体育版很少解释新体育场的钱是谁出的。
collocations: a section of｜……的一部分
tip_zh: section 可指文章的一部分，也可指机构的部门。

definition_en: a group of things kept together
example1_en: The library has a collection of old maps.
example1_zh: 图书馆收藏了一批旧地图。
example2_en: A collection of photos taken each spring can show how a river changes.
example2_zh: 每年春天拍摄的一组照片，可以展示一条河如何变化。
collocations: a collection of｜一批
tip_zh: collection 是可数名词。

definition_en: a person who studies
example1_en: Every student has a library card.
example2_en: A student who works nights to pay rent may still care deeply about the class.
example2_zh: 为付房租上夜班的学生，仍然可能非常在意这门课。
collocations: student card｜学生证
tip_zh: student 是可数名词。

definition_en: the reflexive form of you
example1_en: Please help yourself to the fruit.
example2_en: You should ask yourself who benefits before you share a story that sounds too perfect.
example2_zh: 在转发一个听起来过于完美的故事之前，你应该问问自己谁从中获益。
collocations: by yourself｜独自 ; help yourself｜请自便
tip_zh: 对多人用 yourselves。

definition_en: the amount of money something costs
example1_en: The price of the ticket is twenty yuan.
example2_en: A low ticket price means little if the bus never reaches the villages that need it.
example2_zh: 如果公交根本到不了需要它的村子，低票价也没什么意义。
collocations: at a price of｜以……的价格 ; price rise｜涨价
tip_zh: price 是卖方标出的价格；cost 常指买方付出的代价。

meanings_zh: n. 媒介；手段 | adj. 中等的
definition_en: a way of communicating or doing something | of middle size or degree
example1_en: Video is one medium for the notice.
example1_zh: 视频是发布通知的一种媒介。
example2_en: The medium of a message matters less than whether the last bus is named.
example2_zh: 信息用什么媒介，不如有没有写上末班车重要。
collocations: a medium of｜……的媒介
tip_zh: 复数是 media，已在本库。作形容词是中等的。

meanings_zh: v. 有益于 | v. 使受益；得益于 | n. 福利金；补助金
definition_en: to be good for | to help someone or receive help or an advantage | money provided by the government to people needing support
example1_en: Exercise can benefit both body and mind.
example2_en: Rural communities can benefit from improved internet access through greater opportunities for education and employment.
example2_zh: 更好的互联网接入能增加教育和就业机会，让农村社区受益。
collocations: health benefits｜健康益处 ; benefit from｜从……中受益 ; unemployment benefit｜失业救济金 ; mutual benefit｜互利
tip_zh: benefit sb指使某人受益；benefit from指得益于。

definition_en: a being believed to control nature or life
example1_en: In the story, the villagers thanked the god of the river.
example2_en: Ancient myths about a god of rain show how closely people once tied weather to survival.
example2_zh: 古代关于雨神的神话表明，人们曾经把天气和生存联系得多么紧密。
collocations: thank God｜谢天谢地
tip_zh: god 指神灵；God 大写时常特指基督教等宗教中的上帝。

definition_en: a place where legal cases are heard, or a sports ground
example1_en: The tennis court is behind the gym.
example2_en: A court that takes years to hear a simple case leaves families waiting for a decision.
example2_zh: 审理一件简单案件要花数年的法院，会让家庭一直等一个决定。
collocations: basketball court｜篮球场 ; go to court｜上法庭
tip_zh: court 既可指法庭也可指球场，要看搭配。

definition_en: done for only part of the usual working time
example1_en: She has a part-time job at the library.
example1_zh: 她在图书馆有一份兼职。
example2_en: Part-time jobs can teach responsibility, but they should not replace the sleep teenagers still need.
example2_zh: 兼职可以培养责任感，但不该取代青少年仍然需要的睡眠。
collocations: part-time job｜兼职工作 ; full-time｜全职的
tip_zh: part-time 作定语时通常加连字符；作状语有时写成 part time。

meanings_zh: adj. 最后的；最近的 | v. 持续
definition_en: coming after all others, or most recent | to continue for a period of time
example1_en: I sat in the last row during the talk.
example1_zh: 讲座时我坐在最后一排。
example2_en: Last year's flood still shapes where the town is willing to build new houses.
example2_zh: 去年的洪水仍然影响着这座城镇愿意在哪里建新房。
collocations: at last｜终于 ; last night｜昨晚 ; the last but not least｜最后但同样重要
tip_zh: last 作动词是“持续”。过去式和过去分词仍是 last。

definition_en: to pay attention to sound
example1_en: Listen to the recording twice.
example2_en: Planners who listen to night-shift workers hear problems a daytime meeting never raises.
example2_zh: 倾听夜班工人的规划者，会听到白天的会议从不提出的问题。
collocations: listen to｜听 ; listen for｜留心等着听
tip_zh: listen 是不及物动词，必须加 to 再接宾语。

definition_en: having little money, or not good
example1_en: The recording quality is poor.
example2_en: Poor families spend a larger share of their income on food when prices rise.
example2_zh: 物价上涨时，贫穷家庭把收入中更大的一份花在食物上。
collocations: the poor｜穷人 ; poor at｜不擅长
tip_zh: the poor 表示穷人这一类，谓语用复数。

definition_en: as much as is needed, or more
example1_en: There is plenty of time before the bell.
example2_en: Plenty of posters do not replace one working clock in the hall.
example2_zh: 再多海报也代替不了大厅里一块能走的钟。
collocations: plenty of｜大量的
tip_zh: plenty of 后接可数复数或不可数名词。表里这一行的音标是 pleased，本库不用。

definition_en: the state of being real
example1_en: The rule is in existence, but nobody reads it.
example2_en: The existence of a late bus matters only if students know the time.
example2_zh: 晚班车的存在，只有在学生知道时间时才有意义。
collocations: in existence｜现存的 ; come into existence｜开始存在
tip_zh: 动词 exist 已在本库。existence 通常不可数。

definition_en: a place for indoor sport
example1_en: The gym is open after four.
example2_en: A gym that locks before the last class leaves is not a plan for sport.
example2_zh: 在最后一节课离开之前就锁上的体育馆，不是体育方案。
collocations: gym class｜体育课
tip_zh: gym 是 gymnasium 的简称。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

definition_en: a number of different types
example1_en: The canteen offers a variety of fruit.
example1_zh: 食堂提供各种各样的水果。
example2_en: A variety of routes to school matters when one road floods.
example2_zh: 一条路被淹时，多种上学路线就很重要。
collocations: a variety of｜各种各样的
tip_zh: a variety of 后接复数名词时，谓语可用复数。

definition_en: the chance that someone will be hurt
example1_en: The sign says danger because the step is broken.
example1_zh: 牌子写着危险，是因为台阶坏了。
example2_en: Danger on the walk home is a planning problem, not a test of courage.
example2_zh: 回家路上的危险是规划问题，不是勇气测验。
collocations: in danger｜处于危险中 ; out of danger｜脱离危险
tip_zh: dangerous 形容事物，已在本库。人处于危险中用 in danger。

definition_en: the activity of reading
example1_en: Quiet reading starts at eight.
example2_en: Reading with an adult at home helps a child more than an extra worksheet.
example2_zh: 在家有成年人陪着阅读，比多一张练习纸更有帮助。
collocations: reading room｜阅览室
tip_zh: reading 作“阅读”时常不可数。

definition_en: a musical instrument with strings
example1_en: The guitar is in the music room.
example2_en: A guitar that students can borrow matters more than a poster of a concert.
example2_zh: 学生能借到的吉他，比一张音乐会海报更重要。
collocations: play the guitar｜弹吉他
tip_zh: 乐器前常用 the：play the guitar。

definition_en: the star that gives the earth light
example1_en: The sun was hot at noon.
example2_en: Shade from trees matters most when the sun is high and the walk to school is long.
example2_zh: 当太阳高、上学的路又长时，树荫最为重要。
collocations: in the sun｜在阳光下 ; under the sun｜天下
tip_zh: the sun 通常加 the。

meanings_zh: n. 基督徒 | adj. 基督教的
definition_en: a person who believes in Christianity | of Christianity
example1_en: The guide said this church is still used by local Christians.
example1_zh: 导游说这座教堂仍供当地基督徒使用。
example2_en: A history lesson about Christian festivals should also explain who does not celebrate them.
example2_zh: 关于基督教节日的历史课，也应当说明谁不过这些节日。
collocations: Christian name｜教名
tip_zh: Christian 作名词和形容词都要大写。

definition_en: the reason for doing something
example1_en: The purpose of the survey is to plan lunch.
example1_zh: 这次调查的目的是安排午餐。
example2_en: A rule without a clear purpose is hard to defend when students ask why it exists.
example2_zh: 没有明确目的的规定，在学生追问它为什么存在时很难辩护。
collocations: on purpose｜故意 ; for the purpose of｜为了
tip_zh: on purpose 是故意，反义是 by accident。

definition_en: in the middle, or most important
example1_en: The central library is near the station.
example1_zh: 中心图书馆在车站附近。
example2_en: Central heating in a school matters in a town where winter lasts five months.
example2_zh: 在冬天长达五个月的城镇，学校的集中供暖很重要。
collocations: central government｜中央政府
tip_zh: central 是形容词；centre / center 是名词。

definition_en: an official paper that allows something
example1_en: The driver showed a license.
example2_en: A license to run the canteen should say who checks the food.
example2_zh: 经营食堂的许可证应当写明谁检查食物。
collocations: a driving license｜驾驶执照
tip_zh: license 是美式拼写。英式名词常用 licence，动词常用 license。本库用考纲里的 license。

definition_en: a person who directs a film or an organisation
example1_en: The director of the club explained the plan.
example1_zh: 社团负责人解释了计划。
example2_en: A hospital director who never walks the night ward may miss what the staff already know.
example2_zh: 从不走夜班病房的医院主任，可能会错过员工已经知道的事。
collocations: film director｜电影导演
tip_zh: director 是人；direction 是方向或指导。

definition_en: a planned set of actions
example1_en: The school started a campaign to save water.
example2_en: A campaign against litter fails if the bins are farther away than the habit of dropping rubbish.
example2_zh: 如果垃圾桶比随手扔垃圾的习惯更远，反垃圾运动就会失败。
collocations: election campaign｜竞选运动
tip_zh: campaign 作动词是“参加运动”。

definition_en: all of space and everything in it
example1_en: The lesson starts with the universe and ends with the town.
example1_zh: 这课从宇宙讲起，讲到我们的城镇结束。
example2_en: A picture of the universe does not replace a working clock in the hall.
example2_zh: 一张宇宙的图代替不了大厅里一块能走的钟。
collocations: in the universe｜在宇宙中
tip_zh: universe 通常用 the universe。

definition_en: feeling or showing anger
example1_en: He was angry about the broken window.
example1_zh: 他对打碎的窗户很生气。
example2_en: An angry notice rarely explains the rule as clearly as a calm one.
example2_zh: 一张怒气冲冲的通知，很少能像一张平静的通知那样把规则讲清。
collocations: be angry with sb｜生某人的气 ; be angry about｜因……生气
tip_zh: 对人生气用 angry with，对事用 angry about。

definition_en: the centre of a city
example1_en: The library is downtown.
example2_en: A downtown school still needs a bus for students who live past the last stop.
example2_zh: 市中心的学校仍然需要公交，给住在末站以外的学生。
collocations: downtown area｜闹市区
tip_zh: downtown 是美式，也可作副词。英式常说 the city centre。

definition_en: the season after winter, a coil, or a source of water
example1_en: We plant flowers in spring.
example2_en: A spring of clean water can matter more to a village than a new sign at the roadside.
example2_zh: 一口干净的泉对村子的意义，可以大于路边一块新牌子。
collocations: in spring｜在春天 ; hot spring｜温泉
tip_zh: 季节前用 in spring，通常不加 the。spring 的三个义靠搭配区分。

meanings_zh: n. 背景 | n. 背景情况 | n. 背景；后景
definition_en: past experience or setting | Information or events needed to understand a situation | The part of a scene behind the main subject
example1_en: Her family background shaped her views.
example1_zh: 她的家庭背景塑造了她的观点。
example2_en: Universities should provide equal opportunities for applicants from different social backgrounds, regardless of their family income.
example2_zh: 大学应为来自不同社会背景的申请者提供平等机会，不论其家庭收入如何。
collocations: a professional background｜职业背景 ; background information｜背景资料 ; in the background｜在背景中 ; a disadvantaged background｜弱势家庭背景
tip_zh: 经历领域用background in；背景中用in the background。

meanings_zh: adj. 直接的 | v. 指导；指挥；导演 | v. 指路；将……指向
definition_en: straight; clear | To guide or control an activity, performance, or group. | To show the way or aim something towards a place.
example1_en: Take the direct route home.
example2_en: Improved public transport can have a direct impact on employment by connecting residents with more job opportunities.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通能让居民获得更多就业机会，从而对就业产生直接影响。
collocations: direct contact｜直接接触 ; a direct flight｜直达航班 ; direct a film｜导演电影 ; direct attention to｜将注意力转向
tip_zh: direct可作形容词或动词；常见读音也有/daɪˈrekt/。

definition_en: fighting between countries or groups
example1_en: The history class discussed the cost of war.
example1_zh: 历史课讨论了战争的代价。
example2_en: After a war, schools are often rebuilt later than roads, though children need them first.
example2_zh: 战争之后，学校的重建常常晚于道路，尽管孩子最先需要的是学校。
collocations: world war｜世界大战 ; at war｜处于战争中
tip_zh: war 前常用 in：in the war。

definition_en: the land along the edge of a sea or lake
example1_en: The path follows the shore.
example2_en: A lesson about the shore should say who fishes there.
example2_zh: 关于岸边的课应当说谁在那里捕鱼。
collocations: on the shore｜在岸上
tip_zh: shore 可数。

definition_en: teaching and learning
example1_en: Public education should not depend on a family's income.
example1_zh: 公共教育不该取决于一个家庭的收入。
example2_en: Education about floods is useful only when it includes the streets children actually use.
example2_zh: 关于洪水的教育，只有包含孩子真正走的那些街时才有用。
collocations: higher education｜高等教育 ; physical education｜体育
tip_zh: education 不可数。

definition_en: a group of musicians, or a strip
example1_en: The school band will play tonight.
example2_en: A band playing in the square should keep a volume that lets people talk.
example2_zh: 在广场演奏的乐队应该把音量保持在人们仍能交谈的程度。
collocations: rock band｜摇滚乐队
tip_zh: band 也可指橡皮筋或波段，要看搭配。

meanings_zh: n. 东；东方 | adj. 东方的
definition_en: the direction where the sun rises | in or towards the east
example1_en: The sun rises in the east.
example2_en: Towns in the east of the region share one hospital, so the road between them matters.
example2_zh: 该地区东部的城镇共用一家医院，所以它们之间的路很重要。
collocations: in the east｜在东方 ; east of｜在……以东
tip_zh: eastern 是形容词。

definition_en: a device for taking photographs or video
example1_en: Leave the camera in the bag during the test.
example1_zh: 考试时把相机留在包里。
example2_en: A camera at the school gate can make parents feel safer, and it also records ordinary children every day.
example2_zh: 校门口的摄像头能让家长更安心，它也会每天拍下普通的孩子。
collocations: digital camera｜数码相机
tip_zh: camera 重音在第一音节。

definition_en: mother; British informal
example1_en: Her mum will meet the bus.
example2_en: A form should accept mum, mom, or another adult name.
example2_zh: 表格应当接受 mum、mom 或其他成年人的名字。
collocations: mum and dad｜爸爸妈妈
tip_zh: mum 是英式口语。美式 mom 已在本库。两条都保留。表里这一格是 Mom 的读音，本库用英式 espeak。

definition_en: a list of food, or a list of choices on a screen
example1_en: The menu is on the wall.
example2_en: A menu that hides nuts is not a menu a student can trust.
example2_zh: 隐瞒坚果的菜单，不是学生能信任的菜单。
collocations: on the menu｜在菜单上
tip_zh: menu 也可指计算机菜单。表里这一行的音标是 mention，本库不用。

meanings_zh: v. 营救 | n. 营救
definition_en: to save someone from danger | an act of saving someone
example1_en: The team rescued the bags, not a person; nobody was hurt.
example1_zh: 队伍救回的是包，不是人；没有人受伤。
example2_en: Flood rescue starts with a dry room and a list of names.
example2_zh: 洪水救援从一间干房间和一份名单开始。
collocations: come to the rescue｜前来救援 ; rescue sb from｜把某人从……救出
tip_zh: rescue 也可作名词。本条不写危险操作步骤。

meanings_zh: adj. 光滑的；顺利的 | v. 使光滑
definition_en: even, without bumps, or without problems | to make something smooth
example1_en: The path is smooth after the repair.
