example2_en: A smooth timetable still fails if it hides the last bus.
example2_zh: 顺利的课表如果藏起末班车，仍然会失败。
collocations: a smooth surface｜光滑的表面
tip_zh: smooth 作动词是使光滑。表里这一行的音标是 smoking，本库不用。

meanings_zh: v. 禁止 | n. 禁令
definition_en: to say officially that something is not allowed | an official order that forbids something
example1_en: The school bans phones during the exam.
example1_zh: 学校禁止考试时使用手机。
example2_en: A ban on the late bus would punish the students who stay for the club.
example2_zh: 禁止晚班车会惩罚留下来参加社团的学生。
collocations: ban sb from doing｜禁止某人做 ; a ban on｜对……的禁令
tip_zh: ban 作名词是禁令。比 forbid 更正式，常用于法规。

definition_en: a female child
example1_en: The girl by the window is our monitor.
example1_zh: 窗边的女孩是我们的班长。
example2_en: A girl who wants to study engineering should see women doing that work, not only hear that it is possible.
example2_zh: 想学工程的女孩，应该看到有女性在做这份工作，而不只是听说这是可能的。
collocations: little girl｜小女孩
tip_zh: girl 的复数是 girls。

meanings_zh: n. 答案；回答 | v. 回答
definition_en: a reply, or a solution | to reply
example1_en: Write the answer on the line.
example2_en: An easy answer to traffic is another lane, but that often brings more cars.
example2_zh: 交通的简单答案是再加一条车道，但这常常带来更多汽车。
collocations: answer to｜……的答案 ; in answer to｜作为对……的回答
tip_zh: the answer to a question，介词用 to，不用 of。

meanings_zh: n. 水龙头 | v. 轻拍
definition_en: a device that controls the flow of water; British | to hit lightly
example1_en: Turn off the tap.
example2_en: A dripping tap wastes more water than a poster about conservation.
example2_zh: 滴水的水龙头比一张节约用水的海报更费水。
collocations: turn on the tap｜打开水龙头
tip_zh: tap 是英式。美式常用 faucet。作动词是轻拍。

definition_en: feeling that there is no hope, or wanting something very much
example1_en: She was desperate for a seat on the last bus.
example1_zh: 她极想要末班车上的一个座位。
example2_en: A desperate student still needs a person to talk to, not only a poster.
example2_zh: 绝望的学生仍然需要一个能说话的人，而不只是一张海报。
collocations: desperate for｜极想得到
tip_zh: desperate 形容人。本条不写伤害自己的做法。

definition_en: a row, a long mark, or a queue
example1_en: Please stand in line for the tickets.
example2_en: A new metro line helps the centre, but outer towns still need buses to reach the first station.
example2_zh: 新地铁线方便市中心，但外围城镇仍需要公交才能到第一站。
collocations: in line｜排队 ; on line｜在线上 ; wait in line｜排队等候
tip_zh: 排队英式常用 queue，美式常用 line。online 是一个词，表示“在线”。

definition_en: a person trying to be chosen, or taking an exam
example1_en: Each candidate spoke for two minutes.
example1_zh: 每位候选人讲了两分钟。
example2_en: A candidate for class monitor should say what they will do, not only their name.
example2_zh: 班长候选人应当说自己要做什么，而不只是报名字。
collocations: a candidate for｜……的候选人
tip_zh: candidate 可指求职、选举或考试的人。英式和美式重音相同，元音略有差别。

definition_en: the act of keeping someone or something safe
example1_en: The helmet is for your protection.
example2_en: Legal protection for a river fails if nobody checks the factories along it.
example2_zh: 如果没人检查沿河工厂，对河流的法律保护就会落空。
collocations: under the protection of｜在……的保护下
tip_zh: protection 通常不可数。具体的保护措施有时可用复数。

definition_en: the entrance to a room or building
example1_en: Please close the door quietly.
example2_en: A shop door that opens onto a pavement full of cars is hard for a child to use.
example2_zh: 开向停满汽车的人行道的店门，孩子很难使用。
collocations: next door｜隔壁 ; out of doors｜在户外
tip_zh: answer the door 表示去开门。

definition_en: unhappy because you are alone
example1_en: He felt lonely on the first day.
example2_en: A lonely student still needs a seat, not only a smile.
example2_zh: 孤独的学生仍然需要一个座位，而不只是一个微笑。
collocations: feel lonely｜感到孤独
tip_zh: alone 已在本库，只表示独自。lonely 带有寂寞。

definition_en: the act of making someone known, or the beginning of a book
example1_en: The introduction explains how to use the lab.
example1_zh: 引言说明如何使用实验室。
example2_en: An introduction of a new student should include a seat, not only a name.
example2_zh: 介绍新生应当包括一个座位，而不只是一个名字。
collocations: introduction to｜……的入门；对……的介绍
tip_zh: an introduction to 可指入门，也可指介绍。

definition_en: the opinion people have of someone or something
example1_en: The school has a reputation for music.
example2_en: A reputation for fairness matters more than a reputation for high scores alone.
example2_zh: 公平的名声比只有高分的名声更重要。
collocations: a reputation for｜以……闻名
tip_zh: reputation 可数也可不可数。have a reputation for doing。

definition_en: a title before a woman's surname, without saying if she is married
example1_en: Ms. Li teaches history this term.
example2_en: On a form, Ms. is useful when a woman does not want Mrs. or Miss.
example2_zh: 在表格上，如果女性不想用 Mrs. 或 Miss，Ms. 就很有用。
collocations: Ms. Smith｜史密斯女士
tip_zh: Ms. 后接姓，不表明婚否。Mr. 和 Mrs. 已在本库。读音是 /mɪz/，不是两个字母分开读。

definition_en: the quality of being correct
example1_en: Accuracy matters more than speed.
example2_en: The accuracy of a bus time is a written clock, not a guess.
example2_zh: 公交时间的准确是一块写下来的钟，不是猜测。
collocations: accuracy of｜……的准确性
tip_zh: accurate 已在本库。accuracy 通常不可数。

definition_en: in or of the east
example1_en: The eastern sky was already bright.
example2_en: Eastern provinces that share one river have to share the news of a flood as well.
example2_zh: 共用一条河的东部省份，也必须共享洪水的消息。
collocations: eastern coast｜东海岸
tip_zh: eastern 是形容词。名词用 east。

definition_en: a way of doing or making something
example1_en: Each student has a different writing style.
example1_zh: 每个学生的写作风格不同。
example2_en: A building style that ignores local rain will leak in the first storm.
example2_zh: 忽视本地雨水的建筑风格，会在第一场暴风雨里漏水。
collocations: in style｜流行 ; life style｜生活方式
tip_zh: lifestyle 常写作一个词。

meanings_zh: v. 微笑 | n. 微笑
definition_en: to turn up the corners of the mouth | an act of smiling
example1_en: She smiled at the new student.
example2_en: A smile at the gate costs nothing and tells a visitor they are welcome.
example2_zh: 门口的微笑不花钱，也能告诉来访者他们受欢迎。
collocations: smile at｜对……微笑
tip_zh: smile 也可作名词。不要和 smoke（烟）混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 味道；品味 | v. 品尝；有……味道
definition_en: the flavour of food, or a liking | to try food, or to have a flavour
example1_en: The soup has a sweet taste.
example2_en: Taste in music differs, so the hall should not play one song for the whole afternoon.
example2_zh: 音乐品味不同，所以礼堂不该整个下午只放一首歌。
collocations: a taste of｜尝一尝 ; taste for｜对……的爱好
tip_zh: taste 作动词是品尝，也可作连系动词：taste good。

definition_en: to push yourself off the ground | an act of jumping
example1_en: Do not jump off the wall.
example2_en: Prices can jump in a dry month, and the canteen needs a plan before that week.
example2_zh: 干旱的月份价格可能跳涨，食堂需要在那一周之前就有方案。
collocations: jump at｜欣然接受 ; jump to a conclusion｜匆匆下结论
tip_zh: jump 也可作名词。jump to a conclusion 是未经思考就下结论。

meanings_zh: v. 找到（find 的过去式） | v. 建立
definition_en: past tense of find | to start an organisation
example1_en: We found a quiet corner in the library.
example1_zh: 我们在图书馆找到一个安静的角落。
example2_en: Archaeologists found tools that show people cooked together long before cities existed.
example2_zh: 考古学家发现的工具表明，早在城市出现之前，人们就一起做饭了。
collocations: found out｜查明（过去式）
tip_zh: find 的过去式是 found。表示“建立”时 founded 才是过去式，不要混用。

meanings_zh: n. 记录；唱片 | v. 记录；录制
definition_en: stored information, or the best result so far | to write down or store sound
example1_en: Keep a record of the books you borrow.
example2_en: A temperature record means little if the sensor sits in the sun beside a car park.
example2_zh: 如果传感器放在停车场旁边的太阳下，气温记录就没什么意义。
collocations: break a record｜打破纪录 ; on record｜有记录的
tip_zh: record 作名词重音常在前；作动词“记录”时重音常在后。

definition_en: a group of things tied or growing together
example1_en: She brought a bunch of keys.
example2_en: A bunch of notices on one board is harder to read than one clear sheet.
example2_zh: 板上的一堆通知，比一张写清楚的纸更难读。
collocations: a bunch of｜一串；一些
tip_zh: a bunch of 后可接花、钥匙，口语里也可接人，略随便。

definition_en: a part of a building, or space for something
example1_en: The music room is on the second floor.
example2_en: There is little room for a safe pavement if cars are allowed to park on both sides.
example2_zh: 如果允许汽车停在两边，就几乎没有空间做安全的人行道。
collocations: make room for｜为……腾地方 ; reading room｜阅览室
tip_zh: room 表示空间时不可数：no room for。表示房间时可数。

definition_en: a person who helps
example1_en: The lab assistant checked the list.
example1_zh: 实验室助理核对了名单。
example2_en: An assistant who knows the building can help a new teacher more than a thick handbook.
example2_zh: 熟悉这栋楼的助手，比一本厚手册更能帮助新老师。
collocations: shop assistant｜店员
tip_zh: assistant 也可放在职称前：assistant teacher。

meanings_zh: n. 休息；剩余部分 | v. 休息
definition_en: a break, or what remains | to stop activity for a while
example1_en: We had a short rest after the run.
example1_zh: 跑完后我们休息了一小会儿。
example2_en: The rest of the class waited outside while two students helped the teacher carry the maps.
example2_zh: 其余同学在外面等，两名学生帮老师搬地图。
collocations: have a rest｜休息一下 ; the rest of｜其余的
tip_zh: the rest of 加复数名词时谓语常用复数。

definition_en: related to education and study
example1_en: The academic year starts in September.
example2_en: Academic success is easier to see than the student who keeps the lab tidy.
example2_zh: 学业成功比那个让实验室保持整洁的学生更容易被看见。
collocations: academic year｜学年
tip_zh: academic 作名词可指大学教师。academy 是学会或学院，本批另有词条。

meanings_zh: v. 擦亮 | n. 擦光剂
definition_en: to make something shine by rubbing | a substance used to polish
example1_en: Polish the notice board, then write the time.
example1_zh: 把布告栏擦亮，然后写下时间。
example2_en: Polish on a shoe does not fix a hole.
example2_zh: 鞋油补不了洞。
collocations: polish up｜改进；擦亮
tip_zh: 小写 polish 是擦亮。大写 Polish 是“波兰的”，读音不同。也可作名词“擦光剂”。

meanings_zh: v. 使困惑 | v. 混淆；认错
definition_en: to make unclear or mixed up | To wrongly think one person or thing is another.
example1_en: Too many choices may confuse buyers.
example1_zh: 选择太多可能让买家困惑。
example2_en: Public health messages can confuse audiences when experts use technical language without explaining its meaning.
example2_zh: 专家使用术语却不解释其含义时，公共卫生信息可能会让受众感到困惑。
collocations: confuse A with B｜把A与B混淆 ; confuse the issue｜把问题弄复杂 ; easily confused｜容易混淆的
tip_zh: confused形容人感到困惑；confusing形容事物令人困惑。

definition_en: a person
example1_en: Every human being needs clean water.
example1_zh: 每个人都需要干净的水。
example2_en: A human being waiting for a bus in the dark is not a traffic statistic; the street should be lit.
example2_zh: 在黑暗中等公交的人不是一个交通统计数字；街道应该有灯。
collocations: human beings｜人们
tip_zh: human being 比 human 更强调“人”这一完整说法，可数。

meanings_zh: n. 护士 | v. 护理
definition_en: a person trained to care for the sick | to care for a sick person
example1_en: The nurse is in the clinic.
example2_en: A nurse at school can notice an illness before it spreads.
example2_zh: 学校的护士能在疾病传播之前发现它。
collocations: a nurse at｜在……的护士
tip_zh: nurse 作动词是护理。

definition_en: attracted to people of the same sex; in older texts, cheerful
example1_en: In that old poem, gay means cheerful.
example1_zh: 在那首旧诗里，gay 的意思是快乐的。
example2_en: A school rule is fair only if gay students are treated with the same respect as everyone else.
example2_zh: 只有当同性恋学生和其他人得到同样的尊重时，校规才算公平。
collocations: gay and lesbian｜男女同性恋者
tip_zh: 现代英语里 gay 主要指同性恋。旧诗文里它还可以表示快乐，阅读时要看年代。

definition_en: a device that moves air, or an enthusiastic supporter
example1_en: The classroom needs a fan in June.
example1_zh: 六月教室需要一台风扇。
example2_en: A sports fan who travels to a match still needs a bus home after the last whistle.
example2_zh: 去看比赛的体育迷，终场哨响后仍然需要一趟回家的公交。
collocations: electric fan｜电扇
tip_zh: fan 的三个常见义是扇子、风扇和爱好者。

meanings_zh: adj. 经典的；典型的 | n. 经典作品
definition_en: of the highest quality, or very typical | a book or work of the highest quality
example1_en: We read a classic story in class.
example1_zh: 我们在课上读了一篇经典故事。
example2_en: A classic mistake in the lab is to skip the label on the bottle.
example2_zh: 实验室里一个典型错误是不看瓶子上的标签。
collocations: a classic example｜典型例子
tip_zh: classic 是经典或典型。classical 多指古典的，如 classical music。

meanings_zh: v. 观看；注视 | n. 手表
definition_en: to look at something for a time | a small clock worn on the wrist
example1_en: We watched the match in the hall.
example2_en: Residents watch a river rise long before an official warning reaches their phones.
example2_zh: 居民在官方警报到达手机之前很久，就看着河水上涨。
collocations: watch out｜当心 ; watch TV｜看电视
tip_zh: watch 强调持续看；see 强调看见的结果。

meanings_zh: adj. 好奇的 | adj. 奇怪的；不寻常的
definition_en: wanting to know more | Unusual or strange in a way that attracts attention.
example1_en: Children are curious about nature.
example2_en: Teachers can encourage curious students to explore scientific questions through practical experiments rather than memorisation alone.
example2_zh: 教师可以鼓励求知欲强的学生通过动手实验探索科学问题，而不只是死记硬背。
collocations: curious about｜对……好奇 ; curious to know｜很想知道 ; a curious mixture｜奇特的混合物
tip_zh: be curious about表示“对……好奇”。

definition_en: the continent south of Europe
example1_en: We read a news story from Africa.
example1_zh: 我们读了一则来自非洲的新闻。
example2_en: A drought in Africa can raise food prices in towns that never see the dry field.
example2_zh: 非洲的干旱可以提高那些从未见过旱地的城镇的食品价格。
collocations: in Africa｜在非洲
tip_zh: Africa 和 African 都要大写。

definition_en: on some occasions but not always
example1_en: I sometimes study in the library.
example2_en: Buses that sometimes skip a stop leave students guessing whether to wait or walk.
example2_zh: 有时甩站的公交，让学生猜测该等还是该走。
collocations: sometimes...sometimes｜有时……有时
tip_zh: sometimes 位置较灵活，可放句首、句中或句末。

definition_en: a printed set of news pages
example1_en: The newspaper is in the library.
example2_en: A school newspaper that corrects a name the next day is more useful than a perfect delay.
example2_zh: 第二天就改掉姓名的校报，比拖得很完美更有用。
collocations: a daily newspaper｜日报 ; in the newspaper｜在报上
tip_zh: newspaper 可数。表里这一行的音标是 news，本库不用。

meanings_zh: prep. 直到 | conj. 直到
definition_en: up to a time | up to the time when
example1_en: The shop is open till nine.
example2_en: Wait till the path is clear before you send the younger students home.
example2_zh: 等路通了再送低年级学生回家。
collocations: till now｜直到现在 ; not...till｜直到……才
tip_zh: till 与 until 同义。until 已在本库，两条都保留。till 更口语，句首正式文体多用 until。

meanings_zh: adj. 好的；细的；晴朗的 | n. 罚款
definition_en: good, thin, or bright and dry | money paid as a punishment
example1_en: The weather is fine, so we can have class outside.
example1_zh: 天气很好，我们可以在外面上课。
example2_en: A fine for dropping litter works only when bins are near and the rule is explained clearly.
example2_zh: 乱扔垃圾的罚款只有在附近有垃圾桶、而且规则讲清楚时才有效。
collocations: fine weather｜好天气 ; be fine｜身体好；没问题
tip_zh: fine 作名词是“罚款”，作动词是“处以前款”。

definition_en: a school period, a word, or a length of time
example1_en: This term we have a new science teacher.
example1_zh: 这学期我们有一位新的科学老师。
example2_en: A short term of office can stop a mayor from finishing a flood plan that needs several years.
example2_zh: 很短的任期会让市长完不成一个需要数年的防汛计划。
collocations: in the long term｜从长远看 ; school term｜学期
tip_zh: in terms of 表示“就……而言”。

definition_en: a small vehicle for travelling on water
example1_en: The boat leaves when the class is ready.
example2_en: A school boat on a river needs life jackets, not only a sunny photograph.
example2_zh: 河上的学校用船需要救生衣，而不只是一张晴天的照片。
collocations: by boat｜乘船 ; in the same boat｜处境相同
tip_zh: boat 通常比 ship 小。by boat 不加冠词。

definition_en: what a word or action expresses
example1_en: What is the meaning of this sign?
example2_en: A poem can have more than one meaning, and a class does not have to pick a single winner.
example2_zh: 一首诗可以有不止一个意思，班级也不必选出唯一正确答案。
collocations: the meaning of｜……的意思
tip_zh: meaning 是名词。动词“意思是”用 mean。

definition_en: a small piece of stiff paper
example1_en: Show your student card at the gate.
example2_en: A library card should be free, or the students who need books most may never borrow them.
example2_zh: 借书证应该免费，否则最需要书的学生可能永远借不到。
collocations: ID card｜身份证 ; credit card｜信用卡
tip_zh: card 是可数名词。

definition_en: frightened
example1_en: Do not be afraid to ask.
example2_en: Students who are afraid of a wrong answer will not test the idea the lesson depends on.
example2_zh: 害怕答错的学生，不会去检验这节课所依赖的想法。
collocations: be afraid of｜害怕 ; be afraid to do｜不敢做
tip_zh: afraid 只作表语。I am afraid 也可表示遗憾的委婉说法。

meanings_zh: v. 控制；管理 | n. 控制
definition_en: to have power over something | the power to decide
example1_en: We cannot control the weather, but we can plan for rain.
example1_zh: 我们控制不了天气，但可以为下雨做准备。
example2_en: Cities that control building near rivers reduce the damage when the water rises.
example2_zh: 控制河边建设的城市，能在水位上涨时减少损失。
collocations: under control｜处于控制中 ; out of control｜失控 ; control over｜对……的控制
tip_zh: control 的过去式仍是 control，过去分词加 -led：controlled。

definition_en: the Olympic Games
example1_en: The Olympics are on the poster, not on our timetable.
example1_zh: 奥运会在海报上，不在我们的课表上。
example2_en: Watching the Olympics does not replace a field the school can use on Tuesday.
example2_zh: 看奥运会代替不了学校周二能用的场地。
collocations: the Olympics｜奥运会
tip_zh: the Olympics 谓语用复数。形容词 Olympic 是本批的另一词。表里没有复数这一条的音标，本库用 espeak-ng。

meanings_zh: v. 开始；出发 | n. 开始
definition_en: to begin | the beginning of something
example1_en: We start the meeting at two.
example2_en: Cities that start rubbish sorting early avoid the higher cost of fixing mixed waste later.
example2_zh: 早点开始垃圾分类的城市，可以避免以后处理混合垃圾的更高成本。
collocations: start doing｜开始做 ; start with｜从……开始 ; from the start｜从一开始
tip_zh: start 和 begin 后接 to do 或 doing 通常都可以。

definition_en: a place where sick people are treated
example1_en: The hospital is an hour away by bus.
example2_en: A hospital on the far side of a flooded road cannot help the street that needs it most.
example2_zh: 洪水那边的医院，帮不了最需要它的那条街。
collocations: in hospital｜住院 ; go to hospital｜去医院
tip_zh: 英式 in hospital 表示住院，不加 the；美式常用 in the hospital。

definition_en: bad and important, or sincere
example1_en: This is a serious problem.
example2_en: A serious heatwave is a health event, not only a few hot days on the news.
example2_zh: 一场严重的热浪是健康事件，而不只是新闻里的几天高温。
collocations: be serious about｜对……认真
tip_zh: take sth seriously 表示认真对待。

definition_en: the state of being alive, or a way of living
example1_en: School life is busy but full of friends.
example1_zh: 学校生活忙碌，但有很多朋友。
example2_en: City life can be exciting, yet the noise and cost push some families back to smaller towns.
example2_zh: 城市生活可以很精彩，但噪音和花费也会把一些家庭推回小城镇。
collocations: way of life｜生活方式 ; all one's life｜一生 ; daily life｜日常生活
tip_zh: life 的复数是 lives。泛指生活时通常不可数。

definition_en: feeling physically at ease
example1_en: These chairs are comfortable for a long class.
example1_zh: 这些椅子上长课也舒服。
example2_en: A comfortable classroom still fails if the air does not move on a hot afternoon.
example2_zh: 炎热的下午如果空气不流通，舒服的教室也没用。
collocations: feel comfortable｜感到舒服 ; comfortable with｜对……自在
tip_zh: comfortable 形容感受或使人体感舒适的事物。

definition_en: protection, or the arguments for someone in court
example1_en: The wall is a defence against the flood.
example2_en: A defence of a late bus is simple: students can stay for the club and still get home.
example2_zh: 为晚班车辩护很简单：学生可以留下参加社团，并且还能回家。
collocations: in defence of｜为……辩护 ; defence against｜抵御
tip_zh: defence 是英式拼写，defense 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留，搜索只匹配词头。

definition_en: something built to remember people
example1_en: The memorial names the people, not only the date.
example1_zh: 纪念碑写着人的名字，而不只是日期。
example2_en: A memorial visit should leave time for silence.
example2_zh: 纪念参观应当留出沉默的时间。
collocations: a memorial to｜对……的纪念
tip_zh: memorial 也可作形容词“纪念的”。

definition_en: the middle; British spelling of center
example1_en: The sports centre is near the station.
example2_en: A health centre in the middle of town is useless if the buses stop before it opens.
example2_zh: 如果公交在开门前就停了，镇中心的卫生中心也没用。
collocations: city centre｜市中心 ; in the centre of｜在……中心
tip_zh: centre 是英式拼写，center 是美式。本库两条都保留，因为考纲里都出现。

definition_en: money paid for work, often by the week
example1_en: The wage is written on the form.
example2_en: A low wage near a school pushes workers farther from the bus.
example2_zh: 学校附近的低工资，把工人推得离公交更远。
collocations: a wage of｜……的工资 ; minimum wage｜最低工资
tip_zh: wage 常用复数 wages。salary 多指月薪，本批另有词条。

definition_en: older or higher in rank
example1_en: A senior student helped the new class.
example1_zh: 一名高年级学生帮助了新班级。
example2_en: Senior teachers who stay in a village school are hard to replace.
example2_zh: 留在乡村学校的资深教师很难被替代。
collocations: senior high｜高中 ; senior to｜比……年长或级别高
tip_zh: senior to 不用 than。

definition_en: a thin book with articles and pictures, sold regularly
example1_en: The magazine arrives at the library every month.
example1_zh: 这本杂志每月送到图书馆。
example2_en: A school magazine gives students a page, and it needs an editor who checks names.
example2_zh: 校刊给学生一个版面，也需要一位核对姓名的编辑。
collocations: a magazine article｜杂志文章
tip_zh: magazine 可数。报纸是 newspaper。

definition_en: a large town
example1_en: Our city has a new metro line.
example1_zh: 我们这座城市有一条新地铁线。
example2_en: A city that grows upward needs parks on the ground, or children will have nowhere to play.
example2_zh: 向上生长的城市需要地面上的公园，否则孩子将无处玩耍。
collocations: capital city｜首都 ; city centre｜市中心
tip_zh: city 的复数是 cities。in the city 表示在城里。

definition_en: to finish a school or college course
example1_en: She will graduate in June.
example2_en: Students who graduate still need a bus on the morning of the ceremony.
example2_zh: 毕业的学生在典礼那天早上仍然需要一班车。
collocations: graduate from｜从……毕业
tip_zh: 名词毕业生也是 graduate，读音重音常在前。动词毕业重音也常在前。

meanings_zh: n. 研究 | v. 研究
definition_en: careful study to find facts | to study something carefully
example1_en: Her research is about teenage sleep.
example1_zh: 她的研究是关于青少年睡眠的。
example2_en: Research that never leaves the lab may miss what families actually do at home.
example2_zh: 从不离开实验室的研究，可能会错过家庭在家里真正做的事。
collocations: do research｜做研究 ; research into｜对……的研究
tip_zh: research 作研究时通常不可数。作动词直接接宾语：research a topic。

definition_en: not interesting
example1_en: The speech was boring because it named no fact.
example1_zh: 这篇讲话很乏味，因为它没有一个事实。
example2_en: A boring timetable is still better than one that hides the last bus.
example2_zh: 乏味的课表仍然好过藏起末班车的课表。
collocations: a boring lesson｜乏味的一课
tip_zh: boring 形容事物。bored 形容人。

definition_en: a journey for pleasure, or a short visit around a place
example1_en: The class went on a tour of the museum.
example2_en: A tour of a clean park does not show the street where the rubbish was moved.
example2_zh: 游览一座干净的公园，看不到垃圾被运去的那条街。
collocations: go on a tour｜去旅行 ; tour guide｜导游
tip_zh: tour 作动词是“游览”。

definition_en: a place where a road turns
example1_en: Take the second turning on the left.
example2_en: A turning without a light is where the school should ask for a crossing.
example2_zh: 没有灯的转弯处，正是学校应当要求设斑马线的地方。
collocations: take a turning｜转弯 ; turning point｜转折点
tip_zh: turning point 是转折点。表里没有单独音标，本库用 espeak-ng。

definition_en: energy sent out as waves or particles
example1_en: The textbook explains radiation as energy.
example1_zh: 课本把辐射解释为能量。
example2_en: A lesson on radiation should include the warning sign, not a method.
example2_zh: 辐射课应当包括警告标志，而不是做法。
collocations: radiation from｜来自……的辐射
tip_zh: radiation 通常不可数。本条是科普词汇，不写如何制造或使用。

definition_en: to come to the end of something
example1_en: Please finish the form before you leave.
example2_en: Students who finish a long project in small steps are less likely to stay up the night before it is due.
example2_zh: 把长作业分成小步来完成的学生，不太会拖到交作业前一夜才熬通宵。
collocations: finish doing｜做完 ; from start to finish｜自始至终
tip_zh: finish 后接 doing，不接 to do。

definition_en: a set of rooms for living in
example1_en: They live in a small apartment near school.
example1_zh: 他们住在学校附近的一套小公寓里。
example2_en: An apartment above a shop can be cheap and still too noisy for sleep before an exam.
example2_zh: 商店楼上的公寓可以很便宜，考试前却仍然吵得睡不着。
collocations: an apartment block｜公寓楼
tip_zh: apartment 是美式。英式常用 flat，已在本库。

definition_en: rings joined together, or a series of shops
example1_en: The gate is held by a chain.
example2_en: A chain of small shops can feed a street if one of them stays open after school.
example2_zh: 如果其中一家放学后还开着，一串小店就能养活一条街。
collocations: a chain of｜一连串；连锁
tip_zh: chain 也可指连锁店。a chain of events 是一连串事件。

definition_en: a game played by two teams with a ball
example1_en: We play football after school.
example2_en: A football field that floods every spring shows that the drains, not the players, need attention.
example2_zh: 每年春天都积水的足球场说明需要关注的是排水，不是球员。
collocations: play football｜踢足球 ; football match｜足球赛
tip_zh: 球类运动前不加 the：play football。美式 football 常指橄榄球。

meanings_zh: n. 沙漠 | v. 遗弃
definition_en: a large dry area | to leave someone or something
example1_en: The map shows a desert in the west.
example1_zh: 地图显示西边有一片沙漠。
example2_en: A lesson about the desert should also say who lives there.
example2_zh: 关于沙漠的课也应当说谁住在那里。
collocations: in the desert｜在沙漠里
tip_zh: 名词沙漠重音在前。动词“遗弃”重音在后，读 /dɪˈzɜːt/。表里给的是动词读音，本库名词用 espeak-ng。

definition_en: in the middle of three or more
example1_en: She is the tallest among the three.
example2_en: Trust is low among residents when a new road is planned without a public meeting.
example2_zh: 如果新路的规划没有公开会议，居民之间的信任就会很低。
collocations: among other things｜除了别的以外
tip_zh: among 用于三者或更多；between 多用于两者。

definition_en: a connection, or a member of your family
example1_en: The relation between sleep and scores is not a slogan.
example1_zh: 睡眠和分数的关系不是一句口号。
example2_en: A form should leave space for a relation who is not a parent.
example2_zh: 表格应当给不是父母的亲属留出位置。
collocations: in relation to｜关于 ; a relation of｜……的亲属
tip_zh: 动词 relate 是本批的另一词。relation 可指关系，也可指亲戚。

definition_en: land for crops, an area of study, or a sports ground
example1_en: The football field is behind the gym.
example2_en: Experts in one field may miss a river problem that farmers in the next field see every week.
example2_zh: 一个领域的专家可能会错过隔壁田里的农民每周都看见的河流问题。
collocations: in the field of｜在……领域 ; field trip｜实地考察
tip_zh: field 既可指田野、运动场，也可指学术领域。

definition_en: a stop for trains or buses, or a broadcasting centre
example1_en: We met at the bus station.
example2_en: A station without a light is a poor place for students to wait after the last lesson.
example2_zh: 没有灯的车站，是学生在最后一节课后等候的糟糕地方。
collocations: bus station｜汽车站 ; police station｜警察局 ; radio station｜电台
tip_zh: station 的具体种类靠前面的词区分。

meanings_zh: adv. 明天 | n. 明天
definition_en: the day after today | the day after today
example1_en: The test is tomorrow.
example2_en: A decision made tomorrow about housing will shape who can live near the school.
example2_zh: 明天做出的住房决定，将影响谁能住在学校附近。
collocations: tomorrow morning｜明天早上
tip_zh: tomorrow 前面不加 on。

meanings_zh: adv. 今天 | n. 今天
definition_en: on this day | this day
example1_en: Today we will practise the listening section.
example1_zh: 今天我们练习听力部分。
example2_en: Decisions made today about housing will decide who can live near good schools in ten years.
example2_zh: 今天做出的住房决定，将决定十年后谁能住在好学校附近。
collocations: today's newspaper｜今天的报纸
tip_zh: today 可作副词或名词，前面不加介词 on。

definition_en: a group of teams or organisations
example1_en: Our team is top of the school league.
example1_zh: 我们队在校联赛中排名第一。
example2_en: A league of small towns can share one hospital when none of them can pay for it alone.
example2_zh: 小城镇组成的联盟可以共用一家医院，当它们谁也单独负担不起时。
collocations: in the league｜在联赛中
tip_zh: League 大写时常指特定组织，如 the League。

definition_en: as a result, or in this way
example1_en: The bus was late; thus we missed the bell.
example1_zh: 公交晚了，因此我们没赶上铃。
example2_en: The river flooded the road and thus cut the village off from the county hospital.
example2_zh: 河水淹没了路，因此村子和县医院断了联系。
collocations: thus far｜到目前为止
tip_zh: thus 偏书面。口语里更常说 so 或 therefore。

definition_en: an aircraft
example1_en: The plane leaves at noon.
example2_en: A town with no plane still needs a bus that meets the train.
example2_zh: 没有飞机的城镇仍然需要一辆能接上火车的公交。
collocations: by plane｜乘飞机
tip_zh: plane 也可指数学里的平面。by plane 不加冠词。

meanings_zh: prep. 自……以来 | conj. 自从；因为
definition_en: from a time in the past until now | from the time when, or because
example1_en: I have lived here since 2019.
example1_zh: 我从 2019 年起住在这里。
example2_en: Since the new bridge opened, fewer students have had to take two buses to reach school.
example2_zh: 自从新桥通车，需要换乘两趟公交才能到校的学生少了。
collocations: ever since｜从那时起一直 ; since then｜从那时起
tip_zh: since 接时间点，for 接时间段，常与现在完成时连用。

meanings_zh: adj. 镇静的；平静的 | v. 使平静
definition_en: quiet and not excited or angry | to make someone or something calm
example1_en: Stay calm and read the notice again.
example1_zh: 保持镇静，再读一遍通知。
example2_en: A calm explanation of a late bus helps more than a loud one.
example2_zh: 对公交晚点的平静说明，比大声的说明更有帮助。
collocations: keep calm｜保持镇静 ; calm down｜平静下来
tip_zh: calm 作动词是使平静。

definition_en: paid work, or a task
example1_en: She found a weekend job at a bookshop.
example1_zh: 她在书店找到一份周末工作。
example2_en: A first job teaches timekeeping, but it should not take the hours a student needs for sleep.
example2_zh: 第一份工作能培养守时，但不该占掉学生需要的睡眠时间。
collocations: job interview｜求职面试 ; out of a job｜失业 ; do a good job｜干得好
tip_zh: job 是可数名词，一份工作用 a job；work 表示工作通常不可数。

definition_en: a building for Christian worship
example1_en: The old church stands at the end of the street.
example2_en: A church hall can become a shelter on the night a flood reaches the lower street.
example2_zh: 当洪水到达低处的街道时，教堂大厅可以变成避难所。
collocations: go to church｜去做礼拜
tip_zh: go to church 泛指去做礼拜，常不加 the。

definition_en: a large grand house of a king, queen, or president
example1_en: The palace is open on Sunday.
example2_en: A chapter about a palace should also say who carried the water.
example2_zh: 写宫殿的一章也应当写是谁担的水。
collocations: a palace of｜一座……宫殿
tip_zh: palace 可数。the palace 常指某一座具体的宫殿。

meanings_zh: adj. 杰出的；明亮的 | adj. 才华出众的；聪颖的 | adj. 明亮的；灿烂的
definition_en: very clever or bright | Exceptionally intelligent or skilled. | Shining brightly or having a strong, vivid colour.
example1_en: She had a brilliant idea.
example2_en: Brilliant teachers can inspire students to explore difficult subjects with confidence and genuine curiosity.
example2_zh: 出色的教师能激励学生带着信心和真正的好奇心探索难学的科目。
collocations: brilliant idea｜绝妙的主意 ; brilliant scientist｜杰出的科学家 ; brilliant sunshine｜灿烂的阳光
tip_zh: 英式口语中常用 brilliant 表示“太棒了”。

definition_en: an object for making music, or a tool for careful work
example1_en: The instrument is a piano.
example2_en: An instrument in the lab should have a label.
example2_zh: 实验室里的器械应当有标签。
collocations: a musical instrument｜乐器
tip_zh: instrument 可数。

definition_en: the process of coming to live in another country
example1_en: The museum has a room about immigration.
example1_zh: 博物馆有一个关于移民的展室。
example2_en: A school form about immigration should not shame the student who fills it in.
example2_zh: 关于移民的学校表格，不应当让填写的学生感到羞耻。
collocations: immigration office｜移民局
tip_zh: immigration 通常不可数。immigrant 是移民者。

definition_en: a room where food is prepared
example1_en: The kitchen closes at two.
example2_en: A school kitchen that labels nuts protects the student who cannot see the cook.
example2_zh: 标明坚果的学校厨房，能保护看不见厨师的那名学生。
collocations: in the kitchen｜在厨房
tip_zh: kitchen 可数。厨具的总称不是 kitchen，是用具本身。

definition_en: a fast aircraft
example1_en: The jet is late.
example1_zh: 这架喷气式飞机晚点了。
example2_en: A jet on a poster does not replace the bus to the airport.
example2_zh: 海报上的飞机代替不了去机场的公交。
collocations: a jet of water｜一股水
tip_zh: jet 也可指喷射的一股。

definition_en: a structure that carries a road over water or a gap
example1_en: We cross the bridge on the way to school.
example2_en: A bridge that cannot take a bus cuts a village off from the county hospital.
example2_zh: 不能过公交的桥，会让村子和县医院断开。
collocations: a bridge over｜……上的桥
tip_zh: bridge 也可指桥牌。作动词是“弥合”。

meanings_zh: v. 碰撞；坠毁 | n. 碰撞；崩溃
definition_en: to hit something hard, or to fall and break | an accident, or a sudden failure
example1_en: The bus did not crash; it only stopped.
example1_zh: 公交没有撞车，只是停了。
example2_en: News of a crash should give the place and the time, not a guess about blame.
example2_zh: 撞车新闻应当给出地点和时间，而不是猜测责任。
collocations: a car crash｜车祸 ; crash into｜撞上
tip_zh: crash 也可作名词。计算机崩溃也叫 crash。

definition_en: happening every day
example1_en: Exercise is part of her daily routine.
example1_zh: 锻炼是她每日例行的一部分。

meanings_zh: v. 想要；想象 | adj. 花哨的 | n. 想象；爱好
definition_en: to want, or to imagine | decorative and not simple | imagination, or a liking
example1_en: I fancy a quiet seat, not a loud one.
example1_zh: 我想要一个安静的座位，不是吵的。
example2_en: Do not fancy that a poster will move the bus.
example2_zh: 不要以为一张海报就会让公交改线。
collocations: fancy doing｜想做
tip_zh: fancy 作形容词是花哨的。英式口语 I fancy 表示想要。

definition_en: help and advice
example1_en: The notice gives guidance, not only a slogan.
example1_zh: 通知给出指导，而不只是一句口号。
example2_en: Guidance about the late bus should be written where parents can see it.
example2_zh: 关于晚班车的指导应当写在家长能看见的地方。
collocations: guidance on｜关于……的指导
tip_zh: guide 已在本库。guidance 通常不可数。

definition_en: the middle, or a place for an activity
example1_en: The sports center is near the station.
example2_en: A health center in the middle of a town is useless if buses stop before it opens.
example2_zh: 如果公交在开门前就停运，镇中心的卫生中心也没用。
collocations: city center｜市中心 ; in the center of｜在……中心
tip_zh: 英式拼写是 centre，美式是 center。意思相同。

definition_en: father; informal, often used by children
example1_en: Her daddy will meet the bus.
example2_en: A form should accept daddy, dad, or another adult name.
example2_zh: 表格应当接受 daddy、dad 或其他成年人的名字。
collocations: daddy and mummy｜爸爸妈妈
tip_zh: daddy 是儿童口语。dad 已在本库。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

definition_en: a serious disease in which cells grow without control
example1_en: The talk was about how to reduce the risk of cancer.
example1_zh: 讲座讲的是如何降低患癌风险。
example2_en: Cleaner air and earlier checks can lower the cancer risk in a neighbourhood beside a busy road.
example2_zh: 更干净的空气和更早的检查，可以降低繁忙道路旁社区的癌症风险。
collocations: cancer risk｜癌症风险
tip_zh: cancer 作病名时常不可数；某种癌症有时用 a cancer。

definition_en: a pointed end, a piece of advice, or extra money for service
example1_en: The tip of the pencil is broken.
example2_en: A tip on the board should name the bus, not only say good luck.
example2_zh: 布告栏上的提示应当写上公交，而不只是说祝你好运。
collocations: the tip of｜……的尖端 ; give a tip｜给小费；给提示
tip_zh: tip 作动词可以是倾斜或给小费。本库词卡上的“提示”也是这个词。

meanings_zh: n. 北；北方 | adj. 北方的
definition_en: the direction opposite south | in or towards the north
example1_en: The wind is coming from the north.
example2_en: Towns in the north may need longer heating seasons, which raises the cost of keeping schools warm.
example2_zh: 北方城镇可能需要更长的供暖季，这会提高学校保暖的成本。
collocations: in the north｜在北方 ; north of｜在……以北
tip_zh: in the north of 在范围内部的北部；to the north of 在某地以北。

definition_en: expected, or owed
example1_en: The report is due on Friday.
example2_en: Floods are due in part to drains built for a smaller town than the one that exists now.
example2_zh: 洪水的部分原因是排水系统按比现在更小的城镇修建。
collocations: due to｜由于 ; be due to do｜预定做
tip_zh: due to 后接名词，表示原因；be due to do 表示预定要做。

definition_en: a sweet substance used in food
example1_en: There is too much sugar in the drink.
example2_en: A canteen that hides sugar in sauces makes a healthy choice harder to see.
example2_zh: 把糖藏在酱里的食堂，会让健康的选择更难看出来。
collocations: sugar cane｜甘蔗
tip_zh: sugar 作物质名词不可数。a sugar 在口语里可以指一块糖。

definition_en: scientific knowledge used in practical ways
example1_en: The lab has new technology for measuring air.
example1_zh: 实验室有测量空气的新技术。
example2_en: Technology that warns of a storm helps only people who can receive the message.
example2_zh: 风暴预警技术只帮助那些能收到信息的人。
collocations: information technology｜信息技术
tip_zh: technology 作总称时常不可数。

definition_en: a way for walking, or a course
example1_en: The path to the lake is muddy.
example2_en: A safe path to school can matter more than a faster road with no pavement.
example2_zh: 一条安全的上学小路，可能比没有人行道的更快的大路更重要。
collocations: on the path｜在小路上 ; path to｜通向
tip_zh: path 比 road 窄，多供人走。career path 是职业道路。

definition_en: a married man
example1_en: Her husband teaches music.
example2_en: A husband on a night shift may miss the school meeting and still care about the result.
example2_zh: 上夜班的丈夫可能错过学校的会，却仍然关心结果。
collocations: husband and wife｜夫妻
tip_zh: husband 是可数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 正确的 | v. 改正
definition_en: right, without mistakes | to make something right
example1_en: Is this answer correct?
example2_en: A correct total still needs a source, or the class cannot tell how it was made.
example2_zh: 正确的总数仍然需要来源，否则班级看不出它是怎么算出来的。
collocations: correct answer｜正确答案
tip_zh: correct 作动词是改正。

definition_en: a set of parts working together, or an organised method
example1_en: The school bell system was repaired yesterday.
example1_zh: 学校的铃声系统昨天修好了。
example2_en: A bus system that only serves the centre leaves outer neighbourhoods with long walks to the first stop.
example2_zh: 只服务市中心的公交系统，会让外围社区走到第一站就要很久。
collocations: public system｜公共系统 ; system of｜……的体系
tip_zh: system 是可数名词：a transport system。

definition_en: a living creature that is not a plant
example1_en: The zoo poster shows an animal from Africa.
example1_zh: 动物园海报上是一种来自非洲的动物。
example2_en: An animal that loses its path through a town needs a bridge, not only a warning sign.
example2_zh: 在城镇里失去通道的动物需要一座桥，而不只是一块警告牌。
collocations: wild animal｜野生动物
tip_zh: animal 通常不包括植物。科学上有时也不包括人，日常英语里要看语境。

definition_en: to need or trust someone or something
example1_en: Do not rely on a poster for the bus time.
example1_zh: 不要靠一张海报来记公交时间。
example2_en: Families rely on the late bus when work ends after the early one.
example2_zh: 下班晚于早班车时，家庭依靠晚班车。
collocations: rely on｜依靠
tip_zh: rely on somebody or something。形容词 reliable 是本批的另一词。

definition_en: a tool for writing with ink
example1_en: The pen is on the desk.
example2_en: A pen that works matters more than a new cover.
example2_zh: 一支能写的笔比一个新封面更重要。
collocations: pen and paper｜纸笔
tip_zh: pen 可数。

definition_en: to go away, or to let something stay
example1_en: We leave school at four on Fridays.
example2_en: If young people leave a town, the shops and clinics that depend on them leave too.
example2_zh: 如果年轻人离开城镇，依靠他们的商店和诊所也会离开。
collocations: leave for｜动身去 ; leave out｜遗漏 ; leave a message｜留口信
tip_zh: leave 的过去式和过去分词是 left。leave 也可表示“使处于某种状态”：leave the door open。

definition_en: to say sorry
example1_en: You should apologize for being late.
example2_en: Companies should apologize promptly for service failures and explain what steps they will take to prevent further problems.
example2_zh: 企业应及时为服务失误道歉，并说明将采取哪些措施来防止问题再次发生。
collocations: apologize to someone｜向某人道歉 ; apologize for doing something｜为做某事道歉 ; apologize sincerely｜真诚道歉
tip_zh: 向人道歉用to，为事情道歉用for；英式也写apologise。

definition_en: an opening in a wall that lets in light, or an area on a screen
example1_en: Please open the window for a minute.
example2_en: A window that does not open turns a hot classroom into a health problem.
example2_zh: 打不开的窗户会把炎热的教室变成健康问题。
collocations: out of the window｜向窗外 ; window seat｜靠窗座位
tip_zh: 电脑里的窗口也叫 window。

meanings_zh: v. 骑；乘坐 | n. 乘车；骑行
definition_en: to sit on and control a bicycle or horse, or to travel in a vehicle | a journey on a bike, horse or vehicle
example1_en: I ride my bike to school when it is dry.
example1_zh: 天气干燥时我骑自行车上学。
example2_en: A safe ride home matters as much as the lesson that ended at dusk.
example2_zh: 安全骑车回家，和黄昏结束的那节课一样重要。
collocations: ride a bike｜骑自行车 ; give sb a ride｜让某人搭车
tip_zh: ride 的过去式是 rode，过去分词是 ridden。

definition_en: a part of the body used for standing and walking
example1_en: Her left leg hurt after the match.
example2_en: A chair with a short leg makes the whole row unsafe.
example2_zh: 一条短腿的椅子会让整排都不安全。
collocations: on foot｜步行
tip_zh: 家具的腿也叫 leg。pull somebody leg 是开玩笑，不是拉腿。

definition_en: a machine that produces motion
example1_en: The motor of the fan is loud.
example2_en: An electric motor still needs a clean source of power.
example2_zh: 电动机仍然需要清洁的电力来源。
collocations: motor vehicle｜机动车
tip_zh: engine 已在本库，常指更大的发动机。motor 也常用于机动车。

meanings_zh: v. 试图；尝试 | n. 尝试
definition_en: to make an effort, or to test something | an attempt
example1_en: Try the second method if the first one fails.
example1_zh: 如果第一种方法不行，试试第二种。
example2_en: Cities should try small bus changes before they rebuild a whole road.
example2_zh: 城市在重建整条路之前，应该先尝试小的公交调整。
collocations: try to do｜努力做 ; try doing｜试着做 ; have a try｜试一试
tip_zh: try to do 强调努力要做成；try doing 强调试一试某种做法。

definition_en: the science of living things
example1_en: Biology is in the lab on Wednesday.
example2_en: Students learn the word and the warning sign, not a method for misuse.
example2_zh: 学生学的是这个词和警告标志，不是误用的做法。
collocations: biology lab｜生物实验室
tip_zh: biology 作学科时谓语用单数。本条不写实验步骤。

definition_en: a place where meals are sold
example1_en: The restaurant near the station is closed on Monday.
example1_zh: 车站附近的餐馆周一休息。
example2_en: A school trip to a restaurant should say what a student can order if the menu is expensive.
example2_zh: 学校去餐馆的活动应当说明，如果菜单很贵，学生可以点什么。
collocations: at a restaurant｜在餐馆
tip_zh: restaurant 重音在第一音节。英式和美式元音不同，表里两种都有。

definition_en: a large vehicle that carries passengers
example1_en: The school bus leaves at seven.
example2_en: A later bus helps students who stay for club, if the stop is still lit.
example2_zh: 如果车站还有灯，晚一班的公交能帮助留下参加社团的学生。
collocations: by bus｜乘公交 ; bus stop｜公交站
tip_zh: by bus 不加冠词。上车用 get on the bus。

definition_en: a male parent
example1_en: My father picks me up on Fridays.
example2_en: A father who works nights may never see the school play his child is in.
example2_zh: 上夜班的父亲可能永远看不到孩子参加的学校演出。
collocations: father and mother｜父母
tip_zh: father 是较正式的说法；dad 更口语。

definition_en: the part of the leg you stand on, or a unit of length
example1_en: My left foot hurts after the hike.
example2_en: A path that is only one foot wide is not a safe route for a class walking together.
example2_zh: 只有一英尺宽的小路，不适合全班一起走。
collocations: on foot｜步行 ; at the foot of｜在……脚下
tip_zh: foot 的复数是 feet。on foot 表示步行，不用冠词。

definition_en: using force to hurt, or very strong
example1_en: The school rule forbids violent behaviour.
example2_en: A violent storm is a reason to open the hall, not to send students into it.
example2_zh: 猛烈的风暴是开放礼堂的理由，不是把学生送进风暴里。
collocations: violent crime｜暴力犯罪
tip_zh: 名词 violence 已在本库。本条不写伤害方法。

definition_en: in every part, or during the whole time
example1_en: The rule applies throughout the school.
example2_en: Rain throughout the night can fill a street if the drain was built for a smaller town.
example2_zh: 如果排水管按更小的城镇修建，整夜的雨就能灌满一条街。
collocations: throughout the year｜全年
tip_zh: throughout 强调整段时间或全部范围。

definition_en: having a good result
example1_en: The book fair was successful.
example2_en: A bus line is successful when workers arrive on time, not when a photo looks full.
example2_zh: 公交线的成功是工人准时到达，不是照片看起来很挤。
collocations: be successful in｜在……上成功
tip_zh: successful 是形容词；succeed 是动词。

definition_en: one part of a larger thing
example1_en: Cost is one component of the plan.
example1_zh: 费用是计划的一个部分。
example2_en: A component that students cannot see should still be named.
example2_zh: 学生看不见的部分仍然应当写出来。
collocations: a component of｜……的组成部分
tip_zh: component 可数。

definition_en: an area of study, a topic, or the doer in a sentence
example1_en: History is her favourite subject.
example1_zh: 历史是她最喜欢的学科。
example2_en: The subject of a public meeting should be posted before people are asked to attend.
example2_zh: 公开会议的主题应该在请人参加之前公布。
collocations: school subject｜学校科目 ; change the subject｜换话题
tip_zh: subject 作形容词是“受制的”：be subject to。

definition_en: after noon
example1_en: The club meets at 4 p.m.
example2_en: A notice that says 4 p.m. and another that says 16:00 should mean the same bus.
example2_zh: 写着下午四点的通知和写着 16:00 的通知，应当指同一班车。
collocations: 4 p.m.｜下午四点
tip_zh: p.m. 表示中午到午夜。与 pm 是同一个缩写，本库只保留 p.m.，以便和已有的 a.m. 一致。数字和 p.m. 之间留空格。

meanings_zh: n. 蠢人 | v. 欺骗
definition_en: a person who acts unwisely | to trick someone
example1_en: It is unkind to call a classmate a fool.
example1_zh: 把同学叫做蠢人是不友善的。
example2_en: A fool in a story can be funny; a fool aimed at a student is not.
example2_zh: 故事里的傻瓜可以好笑；对着学生说的傻瓜则不是。
collocations: make a fool of｜愚弄
tip_zh: fool 用在人身上会伤人。作动词是欺骗。

definition_en: the first part
example1_en: Read the beginning of the story again.
example1_zh: 把故事的开头再读一遍。
example2_en: The beginning of a heatwave is the time to open cool public rooms, not the day after people collapse.
example2_zh: 热浪开始时就该开放凉爽的公共房间，而不是等人们倒下之后。
collocations: at the beginning of｜在……开始时 ; from the beginning｜从一开始
tip_zh: at the beginning of 后接名词。

definition_en: not clean
example1_en: Do not drink from a dirty cup.
example2_en: A dirty filter in the lab is a reason to stop, not to hurry.
example2_zh: 实验室里脏了的滤器是停下来的理由，不是赶工的理由。
collocations: dirty hands｜脏手
tip_zh: dirty 作动词是弄脏。

definition_en: the protection of nature or of something valuable
example1_en: Conservation of water starts with a closed tap.
example1_zh: 节约用水从关好水龙头开始。
example2_en: A conservation plan should name who waters the school garden in August.
example2_zh: 保护计划应当写明八月谁给学校园子浇水。
collocations: conservation of｜对……的保护
tip_zh: conservation 通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 适合 | n. 一套衣服
definition_en: to be right for someone or something | a set of clothes
example1_en: The early class does not suit everyone.
example2_en: A timetable that suits the bus also suits the students who cannot stay late.
example2_zh: 适合公交的课表，也适合不能留下来很晚的学生。
collocations: suit sb｜适合某人 ; be suited to｜适合于
tip_zh: suit 作名词是一套衣服。动词是适合。两种读音都常见。

definition_en: very foolish, or very enthusiastic
example1_en: It is crazy to cycle without a light at night.
example1_zh: 夜里骑车不带灯是很荒唐的。
example2_en: A crazy building boom can fill a town with flats nobody on a local wage can rent.
example2_zh: 疯狂的建设热潮会让城镇充满本地工资租不起的公寓。
collocations: be crazy about｜对……着迷
tip_zh: crazy 是口语词，正式写作可用 foolish 或 unwise。

definition_en: the sense of perceiving sound, or an official meeting to hear facts
example1_en: The test checks hearing, not only reading.
example1_zh: 这次测验检查听力，不只是阅读。
example2_en: A public hearing lets neighbours speak before a new road is drawn through their street.
example2_zh: 公开听证会让邻居在新路画过他们的街道之前发言。
collocations: hearing loss｜听力损失 ; hard of hearing｜听力不好
tip_zh: 动词 hear 已在本库。hearing 是名词，也可指听证会。

definition_en: two people, or a small number
example1_en: A couple of students stayed to tidy up.
example1_zh: 有几个学生留下来收拾。
example2_en: A young couple may leave a town when the only flats cost more than their wages.
example2_zh: 当仅有的公寓贵过工资时，年轻夫妇可能会离开城镇。
collocations: a couple of｜几个；一对
tip_zh: a couple of 在口语里常表示“几个”，不一定正好两个。

definition_en: a piece of paper that allows you to travel or enter
example1_en: Keep your ticket until you leave the station.
example2_en: A free ticket that the last bus cannot honour is not free for the student who must take a taxi.
example2_zh: 末班车用不了的免费票，对必须改乘出租车的学生并不免费。
collocations: a ticket for｜……的票 ; ticket office｜售票处
tip_zh: ticket 可数。交通罚单也叫 ticket。

definition_en: the process of growing
example1_en: The growth of the town has been fast.
example2_en: Rapid growth along a river can bring jobs and also destroy the wetland that holds flood water.
example2_zh: 河边的快速增长能带来工作，也会毁掉蓄洪水的湿地。
collocations: population growth｜人口增长 ; economic growth｜经济增长
tip_zh: growth 通常不可数。

definition_en: the ability to do something well
example1_en: Checking a source is a skill.
example2_en: A skill that only one student can practise is not yet a class skill.
example2_zh: 只有一个学生能练的技能，还不是全班的技能。
collocations: a skill in｜……方面的技能
tip_zh: skill 可数。表里这一行的音标是 ski，本库不用。

definition_en: something that is done
example1_en: We need action, not only a poster.
example1_zh: 我们需要行动，而不只是一张海报。
example2_en: Climate action in a city includes buses and buildings, not only speeches on a special day.
example2_zh: 一座城市的气候行动包括公交和建筑，而不只是特殊日子里的演讲。
collocations: take action｜采取行动 ; in action｜在运转
tip_zh: take action to do 表示采取行动做某事。

definition_en: a story, often an imagined one
example1_en: The tale is about a late bus.
example1_zh: 这个故事讲的是一趟晚班车。
example2_en: A tale can be fiction, and the bus time on the wall still has to be fact.
example2_zh: 故事可以是虚构的，墙上的公交时间却必须是事实。
collocations: a tale of｜一个……的故事
tip_zh: tale 与 tail（尾巴）同音。tail 已在本库。

meanings_zh: num. 第二；秒 | n. 秒；片刻
definition_en: the one after the first, or a unit of time | a very short time
example1_en: I sat in the second row.
example2_en: A delay of even a second at a busy junction can add up to long queues in the evening.
example2_zh: 繁忙路口哪怕一秒钟的延误，也会在傍晚累积成长队。
collocations: a second｜再一个 ; second-hand｜二手的
tip_zh: the second 表示顺序；a second 可以表示“又一”。

meanings_zh: v. 搜索；搜查 | n. 搜索
definition_en: to look carefully for something | an act of searching
example1_en: Search the website for the bus times.
example1_zh: 在网站上搜索公交时刻。
example2_en: Families search for a flat they can afford near a school, and often fail.
example2_zh: 家庭寻找学校附近租得起的公寓，却常常找不到。
collocations: search for｜寻找 ; in search of｜寻找
tip_zh: search 可直接接地点，search for 后接寻找的对象。

definition_en: something said to make people laugh
example1_en: The joke was kind, and everyone laughed.
example1_zh: 这个玩笑很善意，大家都笑了。
example2_en: A joke about a classmate's name is not funny when that student cannot leave the room.
example2_zh: 拿同学的名字开玩笑，当那个学生没法离开房间时，就不好笑了。
collocations: tell a joke｜讲笑话 ; play a joke on｜捉弄
tip_zh: joke 作动词是开玩笑。make a joke 或 tell a joke 都可以。

definition_en: coming before
example1_en: Look at the previous page.
example2_en: The previous flood should have changed the building rules, but the same land was sold again.
example2_zh: 上一次洪水本应改变建筑规则，但同一块地又被卖掉了。
collocations: previous to｜在……之前
tip_zh: previous 前面常用 the。

definition_en: a person you invite, or who stays at a hotel
example1_en: The guest spoke for ten minutes.
example2_en: A guest speaker needs a chair, a glass of water, and a way back to the station.
example2_zh: 嘉宾需要一把椅子、一杯水和回车站的办法。
collocations: a guest speaker｜嘉宾
tip_zh: guest 可数。主人是 host，已在本库。

definition_en: a person thought to be guilty
example1_en: The report does not name the suspect.
example1_zh: 报道没有写出嫌疑人的名字。
example2_en: Calling a student a suspect before the facts are written down is not fair.
example2_zh: 在事实写下来之前把学生叫做嫌疑人，是不公平的。
collocations: a suspect in｜……案的嫌疑人
tip_zh: 名词嫌疑人重音常在前。动词“怀疑”重音在后：/səˈspekt/。本条以名词为主，不写办案步骤。

definition_en: a flat surface that shows images
example1_en: The screen at the back of the lab is new.
example1_zh: 实验室后面的屏幕是新的。
example2_en: A bright screen late at night can delay sleep even when the homework on it is finished.
example2_zh: 即使屏幕上的作业已经写完，深夜亮着的屏幕仍会推迟睡眠。
collocations: on the screen｜在屏幕上 ; screen time｜屏幕时间
tip_zh: screen 也可指纱窗或屏风。看电影的幕布也叫 screen。

definition_en: a person you do an activity with
example1_en: My partner in the lab checked the numbers.
example1_zh: 我的实验搭档核对了数字。
example2_en: A business partner who hides costs can damage a small shop faster than a quiet week.
example2_zh: 隐瞒成本的生意伙伴，对小店的伤害可以超过一周冷清。
collocations: partner with｜与……合作
tip_zh: partner 可以是合作伙伴、舞伴或配偶，要看语境。

definition_en: an object that moves around a planet, or a machine that does so
example1_en: The satellite sends the weather map.
example2_en: A satellite picture of the flood still needs someone who can read it.
example2_zh: 洪水的卫星图片仍然需要有人能看懂。
collocations: a satellite of｜……的卫星
tip_zh: satellite 可数。

definition_en: no person
example1_en: Nobody was late today.
example2_en: Nobody should have to wait for a bus in the dark if the town can put up one light.
example2_zh: 如果城镇能装一盏灯，就不该有人在黑暗中等公交。
collocations: nobody else｜没有别人
tip_zh: nobody 作主语时谓语用单数。

definition_en: the land next to the sea
example1_en: We walked along the coast at sunset.
example1_zh: 日落时我们沿着海岸走。
example2_en: Towns on a low coast need a plan for storms before the sea wall fails.
example2_zh: 低海岸上的城镇需要在海堤失事之前就有风暴方案。
collocations: on the coast｜在海岸 ; the coast of｜……的海岸
tip_zh: coast 是较大的海岸地带。shore 更强调水边的岸。

definition_en: to go or come in
example1_en: Enter the lab only with a teacher.
example1_zh: 只有老师在场才能进入实验室。
example2_en: Students who enter a new school in the middle of the year need a map and a person, not only a form.
example2_zh: 学年中途入学的学生需要一张地图和一个人，而不只是一张表。
collocations: enter a room｜进入房间 ; enter for｜报名参加
tip_zh: 进入某处直接说 enter a room，一般不加 into。enter into 多用于“开始讨论”或“达成协议”。

definition_en: a careful examination
example1_en: The analysis of the water will take a week.
example2_en: An analysis of late arrivals should look at buses before it looks at character.
example2_zh: 对迟到的分析应该先看公交，再看品格。
collocations: analysis of｜对……的分析
tip_zh: analysis 的复数是 analyses。

definition_en: the surface of a room, or a level of a building
example1_en: Please pick up the paper on the floor.
example2_en: The library is on the second floor, which is hard to reach without a lift.
example2_zh: 图书馆在二楼，没有电梯很难到达。
collocations: on the floor｜在地板上 ; ground floor｜底层
tip_zh: 英式 ground floor 是一层；美式 first floor 常指一层。

definition_en: land used for growing food or raising animals
example1_en: Her uncle works on a farm outside the town.
example1_zh: 她叔叔在镇外的农场干活。
example2_en: A school that visits a farm should ask who owns the land and who does the work.
example2_zh: 学校参观农场时，应当问土地是谁的、活是谁干的。
collocations: on the farm｜在农场
tip_zh: farm 作动词是务农。

definition_en: not high
example1_en: The shelf is low enough for everyone to reach.
example1_zh: 架子低得每个人都够得着。
example2_en: Low pay in village schools makes it hard to keep teachers who could work in the city.
example2_zh: 乡村学校的低报酬，让那些可以去城市工作的老师很难留下来。
collocations: low price｜低价 ; at a low level｜处于低水平
tip_zh: low 的比较级是 lower。人的声音低用 a low voice。

definition_en: a sign, sound, or movement that sends a message
example1_en: The signal was too weak for the video.
example2_en: A green signal at the crossing matters more than a poster about safety.
example2_zh: 路口的绿灯比一张安全海报更重要。
collocations: a signal to｜……的信号 ; mobile signal｜手机信号
tip_zh: signal 作动词是发信号。

definition_en: a formal test, or a careful look
example1_en: The examination is in the hall.
example2_en: A medical examination should be explained before it starts.
example2_zh: 体检应当在开始前说明。
collocations: an examination of｜对……的检查
tip_zh: 简称 exam 是本批的另一词。表里没有 examination 这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。本条不写检查步骤。

definition_en: a large old building built for defence
example1_en: The castle is on the hill.
example2_en: A castle in a textbook should also say who carried the water.
example2_zh: 课本里的城堡也应当写是谁担的水。
collocations: a castle on｜……上的城堡
tip_zh: castle 可数。

definition_en: very bad
example1_en: The noise was awful during the drill.
example2_en: An awful score on one quiz is information, not a final judgement.
example2_zh: 一次小测的糟糕分数是信息，不是最终判决。
collocations: an awful mistake｜严重的错误
tip_zh: awful 程度很强。awfully 在口语里也可表示“非常”。

definition_en: a picture made with paint
example1_en: The painting hangs in the hall.
example2_en: A student painting of the river can teach the town what the bank looks like after rain.
example2_zh: 学生画的河，能让城镇看见雨后的河岸。
collocations: oil painting｜油画
tip_zh: painting 作一幅画时可数。作绘画这项活动时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 文本；课文 | v. 发短信
definition_en: written words | to send a written message by phone
example1_en: Read the text before you answer.
example2_en: A text message about a storm helps only if it arrives before the road is already under water.
example2_zh: 关于风暴的短信只有在路还没被水淹之前到达才有帮助。
collocations: text message｜短信 ; the text of｜……的文本
tip_zh: text 作动词是“发短信”。

definition_en: a drawing of an area
example1_en: The map shows the bus stops.
example2_en: A map of flood risk helps a town decide which school needs a higher floor.
example2_zh: 洪水风险地图帮助城镇决定哪所学校需要更高的楼层。
collocations: on the map｜在地图上 ; a map of｜……的地图
tip_zh: map 作动词是绘制或详细安排。

definition_en: using electronic devices
example1_en: The electronic clock in the hall is wrong.
example2_en: An electronic notice still needs a paper copy when the network fails.
example2_zh: 网络断了的时候，电子通知仍然需要一份纸质副本。
collocations: electronic mail｜电子邮件
tip_zh: electronic 强调电子设备。electric 已在本库，多指用电的。

meanings_zh: v. 移动；搬家；感动 | n. 行动；一步
definition_en: to change place, or to cause a feeling | an action
example1_en: Please move your bag off the seat.
example2_en: Families move away when rents rise faster than wages, and schools then lose students.
example2_zh: 当房租涨得比工资快时，家庭会搬走，学校随后失去学生。
collocations: move to｜搬到 ; move on｜继续前进 ; be moved｜被感动
tip_zh: move 可作及物或不及物。搬家用 move to a place。

definition_en: what happens because of something
example1_en: The result of the test will come out tomorrow.
example2_en: The result of cutting night buses is that workers walk home on dark roads.
example2_zh: 削减夜班公交的结果是，工人走在没有灯的路上回家。
collocations: as a result｜因此 ; result in｜导致 ; result from｜由……引起
tip_zh: result in 后接后果；result from 后接原因。

definition_en: to cause something to go somewhere
example1_en: Please send the form to the office.
example2_en: Schools that send warnings only by app miss families who have no signal at home.
example2_zh: 只用应用发送警报的学校，会漏掉家里没有信号的家庭。
collocations: send for｜派人去请 ; send out｜发出
tip_zh: send 的过去式和过去分词是 sent。

definition_en: something you do regularly
example1_en: Checking the source is a habit.
example2_en: A habit of writing the bus time saves the phone call.
example2_zh: 写下公交时间的习惯能省掉那通电话。
collocations: a habit of｜……的习惯 ; get into a habit｜养成习惯
tip_zh: habit 可数。

definition_en: about, but not exactly
example1_en: The hall holds approximately 200 people.
example2_en: Approximately right numbers are useful, and a budget still needs the exact figure.
example2_zh: 大约正确的数字有用，预算仍然需要确切的数。
collocations: approximately equal｜大约相等
tip_zh: approximately 比 about 正式。

definition_en: stone, or a kind of popular music
example1_en: We sat on a flat rock by the lake.
example1_zh: 我们坐在湖边一块平坦的岩石上。
example2_en: A rock concert in a small square needs a volume that still lets neighbours sleep.
example2_zh: 小广场上的摇滚音乐会需要一个仍让邻居能睡觉的音量。
collocations: rock music｜摇滚乐
tip_zh: rock 作动词是“摇动”。

definition_en: a strong elastic material, or a tool that removes pencil marks
example1_en: The rubber is on the desk.
example2_en: Rubber boots by the door matter when the path is wet.
example2_zh: 小路湿的时候，门边的胶靴就有用。
collocations: a rubber of｜一块橡皮 ; rubber boots｜胶靴
tip_zh: 英式 rubber 常指橡皮。美式 eraser 更常见。材料“橡胶”通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 混合 | n. 混合；混合物
definition_en: to combine different things | a combination
example1_en: Do not mix those two liquids.
example1_zh: 不要把那两种液体混在一起。
example2_en: Cities that mix housing and shops keep a street alive after the offices close.
example2_zh: 把住房和商店混在一起的城市，能让街道在办公室关门后仍然有人。
collocations: mix up｜混淆 ; mix with｜与……混合
tip_zh: mix up 是搞混。a mix of 是名词短语。

definition_en: the power used to make light and machines work
example1_en: The electricity failed during the storm.
example2_en: Electricity from the school roof still needs someone who can repair it.
example2_zh: 学校屋顶发的电，仍然需要有人能修。
collocations: electricity supply｜供电
tip_zh: electricity 不可数。electric 和 electrical 都已在或将在本库。

definition_en: something that is made or grown to be sold
example1_en: The label says where the product comes from.
example1_zh: 标签写明产品来自哪里。
example2_en: A cheap product that cannot be repaired becomes waste faster than a simple tool.
example2_zh: 无法修理的便宜产品，会比一件简单工具更快变成垃圾。
collocations: product of｜……的产品
tip_zh: product 是可数名词。

definition_en: a series of names or items
example1_en: Your name is not on the list.
example2_en: A waiting list for a clinic shows demand, but it does not treat the patient.
example2_zh: 诊所的等候名单显示需求，但并不治疗病人。
collocations: a list of｜一份……清单 ; make a list｜列清单
tip_zh: list 作动词是“列出”。

definition_en: material of threads with spaces, or a network
example1_en: The ball went into the net.
example2_en: A safety net under the gym equipment prevents one fall from becoming a serious injury.
example2_zh: 体操器械下的安全网，能避免一次跌落变成重伤。
collocations: the Net｜互联网 ; fishing net｜渔网
tip_zh: the Net 可指互联网，和 web 相近。本库已有 network。

definition_en: to come together, or to satisfy a need
example1_en: We will meet at the gate at seven.
example2_en: A bus timetable should meet the hour when school ends, not an office hour from another city.
example2_zh: 公交时刻应该配合放学的时间，而不是另一座城市的办公时间。
collocations: meet with｜会见 ; sports meet｜运动会
tip_zh: meet 的过去式和过去分词是 met。初次相识用 meet；重逢也用 meet。

definition_en: a laboratory
example1_en: The lab closes at five.
example2_en: A lab rule that requires goggles only works if the goggles are there.
example2_zh: 要求戴护目镜的实验室规定，只有护目镜真的在时才有效。
collocations: in the lab｜在实验室 ; lab coat｜实验服
tip_zh: lab 是 laboratory 的缩写。表里这一行的音标是 knowledge，本库不用。

definition_en: as far as you are concerned, or in person
example1_en: Personally, I prefer the early bus.
example1_zh: 就我个人而言，我更喜欢早班车。
example2_en: The head teacher personally checked the lock.
example2_zh: 校长亲自检查了锁。
collocations: personally speaking｜就个人来说
tip_zh: personal 已在本库，并提醒不要和 personnel 拼混。personally 是副词。

definition_en: to remain in a place or state
example1_en: Please stay in your seat until the bell.
example2_en: Young workers stay in a town only if housing and jobs appear together.
example2_zh: 只有住房和工作同时出现，年轻工人才会留在城镇。
collocations: stay up｜熬夜 ; stay away｜离开 ; stay healthy｜保持健康
tip_zh: stay 作连系动词后接形容词：stay calm。

definition_en: the passage in the neck for food and air
example1_en: Her throat hurt on Monday.
example2_en: A sore throat is a reason to see the clinic before the match.
example2_zh: 喉咙疼是比赛前去医务室的理由。
collocations: a sore throat｜喉咙疼
tip_zh: throat 可数。

definition_en: feeling pleasure
example1_en: I am happy to help with the posters.
example2_en: A happy photo of a new park hides the families who were moved to make space for it.
example2_zh: 新公园的快乐照片，藏起了为腾地方而被搬走的家庭。
collocations: be happy to do｜乐意做 ; happy with｜对……满意
tip_zh: happy 后接 to do 或 that 从句。

definition_en: to be brave enough to do something
example1_en: She dared to ask about the fee.
example2_en: Do not dare a classmate to do something unsafe.
example2_zh: 不要激同学去做不安全的事。
collocations: dare to do｜敢于做
tip_zh: How dare you 表示“你怎么敢”。本条不写冒险的做法。

meanings_zh: adj. 自信的 | adj. 确信的；有把握的
definition_en: sure of yourself | certain that something is true or will happen
example1_en: Speak in a confident voice.
example2_en: Students become more confident when teachers provide constructive feedback and opportunities to practise new skills.
example2_zh: 当教师提供建设性反馈和练习新技能的机会时，学生会变得更自信。
collocations: feel confident｜感到自信 ; confident about the future｜对未来有信心 ; confident that｜确信
tip_zh: confident是形容词；confidence是名词。

meanings_zh: n. 成绩；年级；等级 | v. 评分；分等
definition_en: a mark, a school year, or a level of quality | to give a mark or a level
example1_en: She got a high grade in history.
example2_en: A single grade should not decide whether a student may join the choir.
example2_zh: 一个分数不该决定学生能否参加合唱团。
collocations: in the same grade｜同一年级 ; grade A｜甲等
tip_zh: grade 可指分数、年级或品质等级。作动词是评分。

meanings_zh: v. 投；抛 | n. 演员阵容
definition_en: to throw | the actors in a play or film
example1_en: Cast the net carefully from the bank.
example2_en: The cast of the school play includes students who have never stood on a stage.
example2_zh: 校园剧的演员阵容里有从未上过台的学生。
collocations: cast a vote｜投票 ; cast light on｜阐明
tip_zh: cast 的过去式和过去分词仍是 cast。作名词是“演员阵容”。

meanings_zh: n. 滥用 | v. 滥用；虐待
definition_en: wrong or cruel use | to use wrongly, or to treat cruelly
example1_en: Drug abuse is discussed in health class without any instructions.
example1_zh: 健康课讨论药物滥用，但不提供任何做法。
example2_en: If you see abuse, tell a teacher. You do not have to handle it alone.
example2_zh: 如果你看到虐待，告诉老师。你不必独自处理。
collocations: drug abuse｜药物滥用 ; abuse of｜对……的滥用
tip_zh: 动词 abuse 末尾常读 /z/，名词常读 /s/。本条只作词汇，不写任何伤害别人的方法。

definition_en: things that people or animals eat
example1_en: The food in the canteen was simple but hot.
example1_zh: 食堂的食物简单但是热的。
example2_en: Wasted food in school kitchens is a loss of money and of the water used to grow it.
example2_zh: 学校厨房里浪费的食物，既是金钱的损失，也是种植它所用水的损失。
collocations: fast food｜快餐 ; food and drink｜饮食
tip_zh: food 通常不可数。一种食物可以说 a food，但较少用。

definition_en: sounds arranged in a way people enjoy
example1_en: There is music practice in the hall after school.
example1_zh: 放学后大厅里有音乐排练。
example2_en: Live music in a square can bring a neighbourhood together, but only if the volume lets people talk.
example2_zh: 广场上的现场音乐能把社区聚在一起，但前提是音量仍允许人们交谈。
collocations: pop music｜流行音乐 ; music lesson｜音乐课
tip_zh: music 不可数，不说 a music 或 musics。

definition_en: a person trained in the law who advises and speaks in court
example1_en: The lawyer explained the form in plain words.
example1_zh: 律师用平实的话解释了表格。
example2_en: A school does not need a lawyer for every rule, but it does need one clear written policy.
example2_zh: 学校不是每条规则都需要律师，但确实需要一份写清楚的制度。
collocations: a lawyer for｜……的律师
tip_zh: lawyer 可数。法律是 law，已在本库。

meanings_zh: n. 商店；贮存 | v. 储存
definition_en: a shop, or a supply kept for later | to keep something for future use
example1_en: The store on the corner sells notebooks.
example2_en: A village store that closes forces families to travel for food they used to buy next door.
example2_zh: 村里的商店关门后，家庭不得不为过去在隔壁就能买到的食物出远门。
collocations: department store｜百货商店 ; in store｜即将发生
tip_zh: store 作动词是“储存”。美式 store 常指商店。

definition_en: a round part that turns
example1_en: The wheel of the cart is loose.
example2_en: A wheelchair needs a path, not only a poster about welcome.
example2_zh: 轮椅需要一条路，而不只是一张欢迎海报。
collocations: behind the wheel｜在驾驶
tip_zh: wheel 可数。wheelchair 是轮椅。

definition_en: the money spent on something
example1_en: The expense is written on the form.
example2_en: An expense that families cannot see is not a fair price.
example2_zh: 家庭看不见的费用不是公平的价格。
collocations: at the expense of｜以牺牲……为代价
tip_zh: expense 可数也可不可数。

definition_en: a set of pages on the internet
example1_en: The bus times are on the school website.
example1_zh: 公交时刻在学校网站上。
example2_en: A website that hides who wrote a story makes it harder to trust the facts.
example2_zh: 隐瞒作者的网站，让人更难信任其中的事实。
collocations: visit a website｜访问网站
tip_zh: website 是一个词，也可写成 web site。

meanings_zh: n. 电话 | v. 打电话
definition_en: a phone | to speak to someone by phone
example1_en: The telephone is by the office door.
example2_en: A telephone number on the wall matters when the network fails.
example2_zh: 网络断了的时候，墙上的电话号码很重要。
collocations: by telephone｜通过电话 ; telephone number｜电话号码
tip_zh: phone 已在本库，更常用。表里这一行的音标是 telegraph，本库不用。

meanings_zh: n. 问题 | v. 质疑
definition_en: something you ask | to express doubt about
example1_en: May I ask a question about the homework?
example1_zh: 我可以问一个关于作业的问题吗？
example2_en: The right question about a new road is who will walk it, not only how many cars it will carry.
example2_zh: 关于一条新路，正确的问题是谁会在上面走，而不只是它能载多少车。
collocations: ask a question｜提问 ; out of the question｜不可能 ; in question｜讨论中的
tip_zh: out of the question 是“不可能”；out of question 现在很少用。

definition_en: despite the fact that
example1_en: Though the lab is small, the equipment is new.
example1_zh: 虽然实验室小，设备却是新的。
example2_en: Though a city plants trees, the streets stay hot if the trees are too young to give shade.
example2_zh: 尽管一座城市种了树，如果树还小、遮不成荫，街道依然炎热。
collocations: even though｜即使 ; as though｜好像
tip_zh: though 可放在句首或句末；although 多放在句首，一般不放句末。

definition_en: the force of pushing, or stress
example1_en: Exam pressure is common in the last month.
example1_zh: 最后一个月考试压力很常见。
example2_en: Pressure to publish quickly can make a newsroom skip the check that would catch a false photo.
example2_zh: 赶快发表的压力，会让编辑部跳过能发现假照片的核对。
collocations: under pressure｜在压力下 ; blood pressure｜血压
tip_zh: pressure 通常不可数。put pressure on sb 表示向某人施压。

definition_en: if, used when there are two possibilities
example1_en: I do not know whether the museum is open.
example1_zh: 我不知道博物馆是否开着。
example2_en: Whether a town keeps its clinic depends on buses as well as on doctors.
example2_zh: 一个城镇能否保住诊所，既取决于医生，也取决于公交。
collocations: whether...or｜是……还是 ; whether or not｜是否
tip_zh: whether 可接不定式：whether to go。if 一般不接不定式。介词后用 whether，不用 if。

definition_en: a very small town in the countryside
example1_en: Her grandparents live in a village.
example1_zh: 她的祖父母住在一个村子里。
example2_en: A village school with one teacher still has to cover every subject on the exam list.
example2_zh: 只有一位老师的乡村学校，仍然要覆盖考试清单上的每一科。
collocations: in the village｜在村里
tip_zh: village 比 town 小。乡村地区也可说 the village。

definition_en: extremely good
example1_en: The concert was fantastic.
example2_en: A fantastic score for one class does not show what the school did for the others.
example2_zh: 一个班的极好成绩，说明不了学校为其他班做了什么。
collocations: a fantastic idea｜极好的主意
tip_zh: fantastic 已经程度很高，口语里很常见。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

definition_en: a movable barrier, or the entrance to a school or airport
example1_en: Meet me at the school gate.
example2_en: A gate that locks before the last student leaves is not a safety plan.
example2_zh: 在最后一名学生离开之前就锁上的门，不是安全方案。
collocations: at the gate｜在门口 ; school gate｜校门
tip_zh: gate 可数。机场登机口也叫 gate。

definition_en: AIDS, a serious illness
example1_en: The health class explains AIDS as an illness.
example1_zh: 健康课把艾滋病作为一种疾病来讲。
example2_en: A poster about AIDS should give facts, not fear.
example2_zh: 关于艾滋病的海报应当给事实，而不是恐惧。
collocations: AIDS prevention｜艾滋病预防
tip_zh: 书写常用大写 AIDS。本条是健康词汇，不写传播或治疗的做法。

definition_en: new information about events
example1_en: The news about the match spread quickly.
example1_zh: 关于比赛的消息很快传开了。
example2_en: Good news reporting explains what is known and what is still uncertain.
example2_zh: 好的新闻报道会说明哪些是已知的，哪些仍不确定。
collocations: a piece of news｜一则新闻 ; news report｜新闻报道
tip_zh: news 不可数，不说 a news。一则新闻用 a piece of news。

definition_en: the name of a book or a person's rank
example1_en: Write a clear title for the poster.
example1_zh: 给海报写一个清楚的标题。
example2_en: The title of a report should say what was measured, not only what sounds impressive.
example2_zh: 报告的标题应该说明测量了什么，而不只是听起来动人。
collocations: job title｜职务名称
tip_zh: title 作动词是“给……加标题”。

definition_en: a raised flat surface, or a place to speak or build on
example1_en: The train leaves from platform two.
example2_en: A platform for student writing needs an editor, not only a website.
example2_zh: 学生写作的平台需要编辑，而不只是一个网站。
collocations: on the platform｜在站台上 ; platform for｜……的平台
tip_zh: 火车站台和演讲台、软件平台都可以用 platform。

definition_en: the act of leaving a vehicle, or space for it
example1_en: There is no parking at the gate.
example2_en: Parking for the bus matters more than parking for one car.
example2_zh: 给公交的停车位比给一辆小汽车的更重要。
collocations: no parking｜禁止停车 ; a parking lot｜停车场
tip_zh: 动词 park 已在本库。parking 通常不可数。

definition_en: to take the place of, or to put something back
example1_en: The new clock will replace the broken one.
example1_zh: 新钟将换掉坏的那一个。
example2_en: Screens do not replace a teacher who knows the student is lost.
example2_zh: 屏幕代替不了知道学生没跟上的老师。
collocations: replace sth with｜用……替换
tip_zh: replace A with B 是用 B 替换 A。

definition_en: a unit of language
example1_en: I wrote the new word in my notebook.
example1_zh: 我把生词写在笔记本里。
example2_en: A single word in a headline can change how readers judge a whole event.
example2_zh: 标题里的一个词就能改变读者对整件事的判断。
collocations: in other words｜换句话说 ; keep one's word｜守信 ; word for word｜逐字
tip_zh: have a word with sb 是和某人说句话；have words with 是争吵。

definition_en: an area next to a building, or a unit of length
example1_en: The class meets in the yard.
example2_en: A yard with no light is a poor place to wait for the last bus.
example2_zh: 没有灯的院子，是等末班车的糟糕地方。
collocations: in the yard｜在院子里 ; school yard｜校园
tip_zh: yard 作长度是码，约 0.91 米。美式 backyard 是后院。

meanings_zh: adj. 黑暗的 | n. 黑暗
definition_en: with little or no light | the absence of light
example1_en: The street is dark after eight.
example2_en: A dark walk from the bus stop to the school gate is a safety problem, not a small inconvenience.
example2_zh: 从车站走到校门的一段黑路是安全问题，不是小不便。
collocations: in the dark｜在黑暗中 ; after dark｜天黑以后
tip_zh: dark 也可作名词，前面常加 the。

definition_en: numbers that give information, or the study of them
example1_en: The statistics show who uses the late bus.
example1_zh: 统计数字显示谁在坐晚班车。
example2_en: Statistics without a source are just another opinion.
example2_zh: 没有来源的统计数字只是另一种意见。
collocations: statistics show｜统计显示
tip_zh: 作“统计学”时谓语常用单数。作“统计数字”时谓语用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 土地；陆地 | v. 着陆；登陆
definition_en: ground, or the solid part of the earth | to come down onto the ground
example1_en: The school sits on flat land near the river.
example1_zh: 学校坐落在河边的平地上。
example2_en: Cheap land beside a river looks useful until the first flood shows why it was empty.
example2_zh: 河边的廉价土地看起来有用，直到第一次洪水说明它为什么曾经空着。
collocations: on land｜在陆地上 ; land on｜降落在
tip_zh: land 作动词是“着陆”或“登陆”。

definition_en: the keeping of things until they are needed
example1_en: There is no storage for the extra chairs.
example1_zh: 没有地方存放多余的椅子。
example2_en: Cold storage for milk matters more than a new sign on the canteen door.
example2_zh: 牛奶的冷藏比食堂门上的新牌子更重要。
collocations: in storage｜存放着 ; storage space｜储存空间
tip_zh: storage 通常不可数。store 已在本库。

definition_en: how long something is
example1_en: Measure the length of the table first.
example2_en: The length of a school day changes how much daylight children still have for sport.
example2_zh: 上课日的长度会改变孩子放学后还剩多少日光可以运动。
collocations: in length｜长度为 ; at length｜详细地
tip_zh: 长度用 length。at length 是书面语，表示详尽地。

definition_en: pleased
example1_en: I am glad to see you back at school.
example1_zh: 看到你回学校我很高兴。
example2_en: Parents are glad when a late bus is explained, even if the delay itself cannot be avoided.
example2_zh: 即使晚点本身无法避免，只要有人解释，家长也会高兴一些。
collocations: glad to do｜乐意做 ; glad that｜为……高兴
tip_zh: glad 作表语，一般不说 a glad person。

meanings_zh: adj. 最高的；至高无上的
definition_en: highest in rank or greatest
example1_en: The supreme rule here is to lock the lab.
example1_zh: 这里的最高规定是锁好实验室。
example2_en: A supreme court decision can change what a textbook is allowed to say.
example2_zh: 最高法院的裁决可以改变课本被允许写的内容。
collocations: the Supreme Court｜最高法院
tip_zh: supreme 程度已经最高，一般不再加 most。

definition_en: to know someone or something again, or to accept that something is true
example1_en: I did not recognize her in the hat.
example1_zh: 她戴着帽子，我没认出她。
example2_en: A city should recognize a flood risk before the first street is under water.
example2_zh: 城市应当在第一条街被淹之前承认洪水风险。
collocations: recognize sb as｜承认某人是
tip_zh: recognize 是美式拼写。英式常作 recognise。意思相同。

meanings_zh: n. 震惊 | v. 使震惊
definition_en: a sudden strong surprise | to surprise and upset someone
example1_en: The result was a shock.
example2_en: The shock of a cancelled bus is smaller if the other route is already on the sheet.
example2_zh: 如果另一条路线已经写在纸上，公交取消带来的震惊就会小一些。
collocations: a shock to｜对……是震惊 ; in shock｜震惊中
tip_zh: shock 作动词是使震惊。electric shock 是电击，本条不写如何触电。

definition_en: probable
example1_en: Rain is likely today.

definition_en: going far down, or strong
example1_en: Do not swim where the river is deep.
example1_zh: 河水深的地方不要游泳。
example2_en: Deep floods reach streets that a shallow rain never touches.
example2_zh: 深的洪水会漫到浅雨从不到达的街道。
collocations: deep in｜埋头于 ; deep sleep｜熟睡
tip_zh: deep 可形容水、颜色、睡眠或感情。

definition_en: a play or film that is meant to be funny
example1_en: The comedy made the hall laugh.
example1_zh: 这部喜剧让礼堂里的人笑了。
example2_en: A comedy about a flood can still name who had to leave their house.
example2_zh: 关于洪水的喜剧仍然可以写出谁不得不离开自己的家。
collocations: a comedy about｜关于……的喜剧
tip_zh: comedy 可数。喜剧演员是 comedian。

meanings_zh: n. 间谍 | v. 暗中侦察
definition_en: a person who secretly collects information for a government or company | to watch secretly
example1_en: The novel has a spy, and then it returns to school.
example1_zh: 小说里有一个间谍，然后回到学校。
example2_en: A history text can name a spy without teaching a method.
example2_zh: 历史课文可以提到间谍，同时不教做法。
collocations: a spy for｜为……工作的间谍
tip_zh: spy 作动词是暗中侦察。本条只作词汇，不写做法。

definition_en: at once
example1_en: Please come to the office immediately.
example2_en: A leaking gas pipe should be reported immediately, not after the next lesson.
example2_zh: 煤气管道泄漏应该立刻报告，而不是等下一节课之后。
collocations: immediately after｜在……之后立刻
tip_zh: immediately 是副词；immediate 是形容词。

definition_en: a short piece of writing on a subject
example1_en: The essay is due on Friday.
example2_en: An essay about the bus should include the return time.
example2_zh: 写公交的短文应当包括返回时间。
collocations: an essay on｜关于……的短文
tip_zh: essay 可数。

definition_en: a place where adults buy drinks; British
example1_en: The bus stops near the pub.
example2_en: A pub on a map is a landmark, not an invitation.
example2_zh: 地图上的酒吧是地标，不是邀请。
collocations: at the pub｜在酒吧
tip_zh: pub 是英式。本条只作地点词汇。

definition_en: a child
example1_en: The kid by the gate is waiting for his sister.
example1_zh: 门口的小孩在等他姐姐。
example2_en: A kid walking home in the dark needs a light on the street, not only a lecture about safety.
example2_zh: 在黑暗中走回家的小孩需要街上的灯，而不只是关于安全的说教。
collocations: kids｜孩子们
tip_zh: kid 是口语。正式写作多用 child。

meanings_zh: n. 努力 | n. 尝试；有组织的行动
definition_en: hard work | an attempt or organised activity intended to achieve a goal
example1_en: Success needs continuous effort.
example2_en: Reducing household waste requires a joint effort from consumers, manufacturers and local authorities to change everyday practices.
example2_zh: 减少家庭垃圾需要消费者、制造商和地方政府共同努力，改变日常做法。
collocations: make an effort｜作出努力 ; put effort into｜投入精力于 ; a joint effort｜共同努力 ; considerable effort｜相当大的努力
tip_zh: 表示精力时不可数；表示一次尝试时可数。

definition_en: to be in charge, or to succeed in doing something difficult
example1_en: She managed to catch the last bus.
example2_en: Schools manage a flood better when the plan names a person, not only a building.
example2_zh: 当方案写明一个人而不只是一栋楼时，学校能更好地应对洪水。
collocations: manage to do｜设法做成 ; manage a team｜管理团队
tip_zh: manage to do 表示做成了难事。manager 已在本库。

definition_en: a device that supplies electricity
example1_en: The battery in the clock is dead.
example2_en: A spare battery for the school bus radio matters on a storm day.
example2_zh: 暴风雨那天，校车无线电的备用电池很重要。
collocations: a battery of｜一系列
tip_zh: battery 可数。复数 batteries。

definition_en: things for sale or transport
example1_en: The goods arrived before the shop opened.
example1_zh: 货物在商店开门前到了。
example2_en: Goods left in the rain outside a school shop are nobody's bargain.
example2_zh: 放在学校小卖部外淋雨的货物，谁买了都不划算。
collocations: goods train｜货车
tip_zh: goods 是复数，不说 a goods。表里这一行的音标是 good，本库不用。

definition_en: a frozen sweet food
example1_en: We had ice cream after the match.
example1_zh: 比赛后我们吃了冰淇淋。
example2_en: Ice cream left in the sun is not a treat; it is a mess and a risk.
example2_zh: 放在太阳下的冰淇淋不是款待，是一片狼藉，也是风险。
collocations: a bowl of ice cream｜一碗冰淇淋
tip_zh: cream 已在本库。ice cream 通常不可数。an ice cream 可指一份。

definition_en: in a short time
example1_en: The meeting will start soon.
example2_en: A leaking roof will soon damage books if a school waits for a perfect budget.
example2_zh: 如果学校一直等一份完美的预算，漏雨的屋顶很快会损坏书籍。
collocations: as soon as｜一……就 ; sooner or later｜迟早
tip_zh: as soon as 引导时间从句，主句将来时，从句用一般现在时。

definition_en: to give a document to someone in authority
example1_en: Submit the form before Friday.
example2_en: Students submit better work when the question is clear.
example2_zh: 问题清楚时，学生交上来的作业更好。
collocations: submit sth to｜把某物提交给
tip_zh: submit 比 hand in 正式。

definition_en: a piece of a whole, or a role
example1_en: This chapter is the hardest part of the book.
example1_zh: 这一章是书里最难的部分。
example2_en: Parents are only one part of a child's education; streets, screens, and friends shape habits too.
example2_zh: 父母只是孩子教育的一部分；街道、屏幕和朋友也会塑造习惯。
collocations: take part in｜参加 ; play a part｜起作用 ; part of｜……的一部分
tip_zh: take part in 表示参加活动，不要漏掉 in。

meanings_zh: v. 浪费 | n. 废物；浪费
definition_en: to use something carelessly | unwanted material, or careless use
example1_en: Do not waste paper on a second cover.
example1_zh: 不要为了再做一个封面浪费纸。
example2_en: Food waste from the canteen can feed a garden if someone sorts it the same day.
example2_zh: 如果有人当天分类，食堂的食物废料可以供给花园。
collocations: a waste of｜对……的浪费 ; waste time｜浪费时间
tip_zh: waste 作名词是废物或浪费。food waste 里 waste 可以是名词。

definition_en: the leader of a country, club, or some universities
example1_en: The club president will speak first.
example2_en: A student president who only repeats teachers ideas will not represent the class.
example2_zh: 只重复老师想法的学生主席，代表不了班级。
collocations: vice president｜副总统；副主席
tip_zh: president 在不同机构里可以是总统、主席或大学校长。

definition_en: to promise to do something, or to do something wrong
example1_en: Please commit to locking the lab.
example2_en: Do not commit the same error on the next form.
example2_zh: 不要在下一张表上再犯同样的错误。
collocations: commit to｜承诺 ; commit an error｜犯错误
tip_zh: 名词 commitment 已在本库。本条不写伤害自己或他人的做法。

definition_en: a person's own nature or identity
example1_en: The exercise asks you to describe your self in three words.
