example1_zh: 这个练习请你用三个词描述自己。
example2_en: A sense of self grows when students are trusted with real tasks, not only with tests.
example2_zh: 当学生被托付真正的任务而不只是考试时，自我意识会成长。
collocations: self-control｜自制 ; yourself｜你自己
tip_zh: self 常构成复合词，如 self-study。复数是 selves。

meanings_zh: prep. 围绕；大约 | adv. 周围；到处
definition_en: on all sides of, or about | in the surrounding area
example1_en: We walked around the lake after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后我们绕着湖走了走。
example2_en: Shops around a school gate affect what students buy between classes, from water to sweets.
example2_zh: 校门口的商店影响着学生课间买什么，从水到糖果都是。
collocations: around the world｜全世界 ; look around｜环顾
tip_zh: around 表示大约时与 about 接近：around 20 students。

definition_en: sleeping
example1_en: The baby was asleep on the bus.
example2_en: A student asleep in class may need sleep, not a punishment.
example2_zh: 课上睡着的学生可能需要的是睡眠，不是惩罚。
collocations: fall asleep｜入睡
tip_zh: asleep 只作表语。sleep 已在本库。

definition_en: a person who reports news
example1_en: The reporter checked the name.
example2_en: A reporter who names no source is harder to trust.
example2_zh: 不写来源的记者更难信任。
collocations: a reporter for｜……的记者
tip_zh: report 已在本库。journalist 是本批的另一词。

definition_en: a female ruler, or the wife of a king
example1_en: The queen visited the old harbour in the story.
example1_zh: 故事里女王参观了古老的港口。
example2_en: A history chapter about a queen should also say who cooked, farmed and paid the taxes.
example2_zh: 写女王的历史章节，也应当说谁在做饭、种地和纳税。
collocations: queen of｜……女王
tip_zh: queen 可以是女性君主，也可以是国王的妻子。

meanings_zh: n. 气味 | v. 闻；发出气味
definition_en: what you notice with your nose | to notice a smell, or to have one
example1_en: There is a smell of paint in the hall.
example2_en: A bad smell from the kitchen is a reason to stop lunch, not to hide it.
example2_zh: 厨房的异味是停下午饭的理由，不是把它藏起来。
collocations: the smell of｜……的气味 ; smell of｜有……的气味
tip_zh: smell 作动词的过去式是 smelt 或 smelled。smell 可作连系动词：smell good。

definition_en: work, especially physical work; British spelling
example1_en: Harvest labour starts before sunrise.
example1_zh: 收割的劳动在日出前就开始了。
example2_en: Child labour is illegal, and a weekend school job is not the same thing.
example2_zh: 童工是非法的，周末在学校打工不是一回事。
collocations: manual labour｜体力劳动
tip_zh: labour 是英式拼写，labor 是美式。考纲里两种都有，本库两条都保留，意思相同。

definition_en: kind and pleasant
example1_en: The staff were friendly to the new students.
example1_zh: 工作人员对新同学很友好。
example2_en: A friendly match still needs a referee and a way home.
example2_zh: 友谊赛仍然需要裁判和回家的办法。
collocations: be friendly to｜对……友好 ; a friendly match｜友谊赛
tip_zh: friendly 是形容词，不是副词。友好地用 in a friendly way。friend 已在本库。

definition_en: the science of matter and energy
example1_en: Physics is the first lesson on Tuesday.
example2_en: A physics problem about the bus is more useful than a number with no story.
example2_zh: 一道关于公交的物理题，比一个没有情境的数字更有用。
collocations: physics lab｜物理实验室
tip_zh: physics 作学科时谓语用单数。physical 已在本库。

definition_en: measuring a lot from side to side
example1_en: The new pavement is wide enough for two people.
example1_zh: 新的人行道宽得够两个人走。
example2_en: A wide road without a crossing is still a barrier for a child.
example2_zh: 没有过街处的宽路，对孩子仍然是障碍。
collocations: wide range｜广泛的范围
tip_zh: wide 强调横向的宽；broad 常强调幅面或抽象的广。

definition_en: something accepted as true
example1_en: Strong belief can give people hope.
example1_zh: 坚定的信念能给人希望。
example2_en: The belief that education improves social mobility influences government spending priorities in many countries.
example2_zh: 教育能促进社会流动的这一信念影响着许多国家的政府支出重点。
collocations: belief in someone｜对某人的信任 ; religious beliefs｜宗教信仰 ; a widely held belief｜普遍持有的看法 ; contrary to popular belief｜与普遍看法相反
tip_zh: belief in表示信任或信仰；belief that后接具体看法。

definition_en: to get ready
example1_en: Prepare the lab before the class arrives.
example1_zh: 班级到来之前把实验室准备好。
example2_en: Cities should prepare flood plans before the rainy season, not after the first street is under water.
example2_zh: 城市应当在雨季之前准备防汛方案，而不是等第一条街被淹之后。
collocations: prepare for｜为……做准备 ; prepare to do｜准备做
tip_zh: prepare for 后接所准备的事。prepare sth 是把某物准备好。

meanings_zh: v. 飞；飞行 | n. 苍蝇
definition_en: to move through the air | a small flying insect
example1_en: Birds fly over the sports field.
example2_en: A town that wants fewer cars cannot only tell people to fly; most journeys are short.
example2_zh: 想减少汽车的城镇不能只叫人坐飞机，大多数行程都很短。
collocations: fly a kite｜放风筝
tip_zh: fly 的过去式是 flew，过去分词是 flown。航班名词 flight 已在本库。

definition_en: what you plan to do
example1_en: Her intention is to return the book.
example2_en: A good intention still needs a written time.
example2_zh: 好意仍然需要一个写下来的时间。
collocations: intention to do｜做……的打算
tip_zh: intention 可数。

definition_en: damaged by use, or very tired
example1_en: The coat is worn at the elbows.
example2_en: A worn step should be repaired before someone falls.
example2_zh: 磨坏的台阶应当在有人摔倒之前修好。
collocations: worn out｜疲惫不堪；用坏
tip_zh: worn 是 wear 的过去分词。wear 已在本库。表里把 worm 的读音混了进来，本库不用。

definition_en: demanding that rules are obeyed
example1_en: The rule is strict about the lab door.
example1_zh: 这条规则对实验室的门很严格。
example2_en: A strict timetable still fails if it hides the last bus.
example2_zh: 严格的课表如果藏起末班车，仍然会失败。
collocations: strict with｜对……严格 ; strict about｜对……严格
tip_zh: strict 可形容人或规则。

definition_en: far from towns
example1_en: The village is remote, but the school is open.
example1_zh: 村子很偏远，但学校开着。
example2_en: A remote school still needs a bus, not only a website.
example2_zh: 偏远的学校仍然需要公交，而不只是一个网站。
collocations: a remote area｜偏远地区 ; remote control｜遥控器
tip_zh: remote control 是遥控器。

definition_en: a room where people wait
example1_en: Please stay in the waiting room until your name is called.
example1_zh: 请在候诊室等到叫你的名字。
example2_en: A crowded waiting room shows that a clinic needs more staff, not only more chairs.
example2_zh: 拥挤的候诊室说明诊所需要更多工作人员，而不只是更多椅子。
collocations: in the waiting room｜在等候室
tip_zh: waiting room 中间有空格。医院、车站都可以用。

meanings_zh: adj. 冷的 | n. 寒冷；感冒
definition_en: having a low temperature | low temperature, or a common illness
example1_en: It is cold in the classroom this morning.
example2_en: Cold classrooms in winter make it harder to learn, especially for children who walked a long way.
example2_zh: 冬天寒冷的教室让学习更难，尤其是走了很远路的孩子。
collocations: catch a cold｜感冒 ; cold water｜冷水
tip_zh: cold 作名词是“寒冷”或“感冒”。

definition_en: very small grains of rock, as on a beach
example1_en: The path is covered with sand.
example2_en: Sand in the playground drains rain better than bare soil.
example2_zh: 操场上的沙比光土更能排雨。
collocations: a grain of sand｜一粒沙
tip_zh: sand 通常不可数。

definition_en: a path, a rail, or marks left behind
example1_en: She runs on the track after school.
example2_en: Keeping track of bus delays shows which routes fail students most often.
example2_zh: 记录公交延误，能显示哪些线路最常让学生失望。
collocations: keep track of｜记录；跟踪 ; on track｜在正轨上
tip_zh: track 作动词是“跟踪”。

definition_en: in or of the north
example1_en: The northern wind made the field feel colder.
example2_en: Northern towns may need longer heating, which changes the winter school budget.
example2_zh: 北方城镇可能需要更长的供暖，这会改变冬季的学校预算。
collocations: northern China｜中国北方
tip_zh: northern 是形容词。名词“北方”用 north。

meanings_zh: adj. 保守的 | n. 保守的人
definition_en: not liking change | a person who does not like change
example1_en: The plan is conservative and keeps the old bus.
example1_zh: 这个方案很保守，保留了旧公交。
example2_en: A conservative estimate of the cost is safer than a hopeful one.
example2_zh: 对费用的保守估计，比乐观的估计更安全。
collocations: a conservative estimate｜保守估计
tip_zh: conservative 也可作名词“保守的人”。政治里的 Conservative 常大写。

definition_en: if not
example1_en: We will walk unless it rains.
example1_zh: 除非下雨，否则我们走路去。
example2_en: A river will not recover unless the factories upstream stop the night waste.
example2_zh: 除非上游工厂停止夜间排污，否则河不会恢复。
collocations: unless necessary｜除非必要
tip_zh: unless 等于 if not，本身已含否定，从句里一般不再加 not。

definition_en: very valuable
example1_en: Time before the exam is precious.
example2_en: A precious seat on the late bus should go to the student who cannot stand.
example2_zh: 晚班车上珍贵的座位应当给不能站着的学生。
collocations: precious to｜对……珍贵
tip_zh: precious 可形容时间、物品或人。用在人身上时要尊重。

meanings_zh: v. 生产；出示 | n. 农产品
definition_en: to make something, or to show it | food that is grown, especially in large amounts
example1_en: The factory produces parts for buses.
example1_zh: 这家工厂生产公交零件。
example2_en: Local farms that produce food for the school can shorten the road from field to canteen.
example2_zh: 为学校生产食物的本地农场，可以缩短从田地到食堂的路。
collocations: produce evidence｜出示证据
tip_zh: 动词重音在后。名词 produce 指农产品，重音在前。

definition_en: having a sour sharp taste, or containing acid | a chemical substance with a sour sharp quality
example1_en: The lab labels every bottle that is acid.
example1_zh: 实验室给每一瓶酸性的东西贴标签。
example2_en: Students learn the word acid and the warning sign, not a method for making it.
example2_zh: 学生学的是 acid 这个词和警告标志，不是制造它的方法。
collocations: acid rain｜酸雨
tip_zh: acid 作名词是酸。本条只作课堂词汇和安全提示，不写制备或使用方法。

definition_en: material burned to produce heat or power
example1_en: The bus runs on cleaner fuel this year.
example1_zh: 今年这辆公交使用更清洁的燃料。
example2_en: Cutting fuel use in old buildings can pay for itself if the windows actually close.
example2_zh: 如果窗户真的能关上，减少旧楼的燃料消耗可以收回成本。
collocations: fossil fuel｜化石燃料
tip_zh: fuel 作物质名词时常不可数。作动词是加燃料或激起。

definition_en: to keep in the hand, to organise, or to contain
example1_en: Please hold the door for the next person.
example2_en: A hall that cannot hold the whole school should not be the only place for a fire drill.
example2_zh: 容纳不下全校的礼堂，不该是消防演习的唯一地点。
collocations: hold on｜等一下；坚持 ; hold a meeting｜举行会议
tip_zh: hold 的过去式和过去分词是 held。

definition_en: the place where visitors are received, or a formal party
example1_en: The reception is by the front door.
example2_en: A reception for parents should not start after the last bus.
example2_zh: 家长招待会不应当在末班车之后才开始。
collocations: reception desk｜接待处
tip_zh: reception 可数。

definition_en: a hot drink made from coffee beans
example1_en: The teachers drink coffee in the office.
example1_zh: 老师们在办公室喝咖啡。
example2_en: A night of coffee before an exam keeps students awake, and it also makes the next morning harder.
example2_zh: 考前一夜咖啡能让学生醒着，也会让第二天早上更难熬。
collocations: a cup of coffee｜一杯咖啡 ; black coffee｜黑咖啡
tip_zh: coffee 作物质名词不可数。a coffee 可以指一杯咖啡。

definition_en: to some degree, not completely
example1_en: The delay was partly the storm.
example1_zh: 这次延误有一部分是因为暴风雨。
example2_en: A plan that only partly names the bus still leaves families guessing.
example2_zh: 只部分写出公交的计划，仍然让家庭在猜。
collocations: partly because｜部分是因为
tip_zh: partly 是副词。

definition_en: a covering for the foot
example1_en: The shoe is under the desk.
example2_en: A wet shoe at the gate is a reason to bring a spare pair.
example2_zh: 门口的湿鞋是再带一双的理由。
collocations: a pair of shoes｜一双鞋
tip_zh: 常用复数 shoes。

definition_en: from another country
example1_en: She is learning a foreign language.
example2_en: Foreign news is useful only when students also know how to check the source.
example2_zh: 只有当学生也知道如何核对来源时，外国新闻才有用。
collocations: foreign language｜外语 ; foreigner｜外国人
tip_zh: foreign 是形容词，不说 foreign country people，说 people from other countries 或 foreigners。

definition_en: the planet, or soil
example1_en: We live on the earth.
example2_en: Healthy earth near a river can hold flood water that concrete sends straight into the street.
example2_zh: 河边健康的土壤能蓄住洪水，而混凝土会把水直接送进街道。
collocations: on earth｜究竟；在地球上
tip_zh: the earth 指地球时常加 the。on earth 也可加强疑问语气。

definition_en: a bicycle
example1_en: I ride my bike when the path is dry.
example1_zh: 路干的时候我骑自行车。
example2_en: A place to lock a bike matters as much as a lesson about clean air.
example2_zh: 一个能锁自行车的地方，和一节关于清洁空气的课一样重要。
collocations: by bike｜骑自行车 ; bike lane｜自行车道
tip_zh: bike 是 bicycle 的口语。by bike 不加冠词。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

definition_en: the reflexive form of they
example1_en: The students organised the fair themselves.
example1_zh: 学生们自己组织了这次义卖。
example2_en: Communities can protect a river themselves, but they still need the law behind them.
example2_zh: 社区可以自己保护一条河，但他们仍然需要法律在背后支持。
collocations: by themselves｜独自
tip_zh: themselves 不能代替 they 作主语。

meanings_zh: adj. 小的；少的 | adv. 少
definition_en: small, or not much | not much
example1_en: There is little time before the bus leaves.
example1_zh: 汽车开走前时间不多了。
example2_en: A little shade on a playground can make summer sports safer for younger children.
example2_zh: 操场上一点点荫凉，就能让年幼的孩子在夏天运动时更安全。
collocations: a little｜一点 ; little by little｜逐渐
tip_zh: little 偏否定，表示几乎没有；a little 表示有一点。都修饰不可数名词。

definition_en: of Europe
example1_en: We read a European folk story.
example1_zh: 我们读了一个欧洲民间故事。
example2_en: European visitors bring money to a town, but they also raise rents if housing is already short.
example2_zh: 欧洲游客给城镇带来钱，但如果住房已经短缺，他们也会推高房租。
collocations: European Union｜欧洲联盟
tip_zh: European 和 Europe 都要大写。

meanings_zh: adj. 甜的；可爱的 | n. 糖果；甜食
definition_en: tasting of sugar, or pleasant | a piece of candy or a sweet dish
example1_en: This tea is too sweet for me.
example2_en: A sweet snack every afternoon can hide how much sugar a teenager drinks in a week.
example2_zh: 每天下午一块甜点，会掩盖青少年一周喝下多少糖。
collocations: sweet tooth｜爱吃甜食 ; a sweet voice｜甜美的嗓音
tip_zh: sweet 作名词时常指糖果，英式英语更常见。

definition_en: a feeling of hurt
example1_en: She felt a pain in her knee after the match.
example2_en: Tooth pain that waits a month for a clinic becomes a larger problem than it was on the first day.
example2_zh: 等了一个月才看上诊所的牙痛，会比第一天更严重。
collocations: in pain｜疼痛 ; a pain in｜……疼
tip_zh: pain 可数或不可数都可以。

definition_en: a long flat surface in a shop or bank
example1_en: Please pay at the counter.
example2_en: A counter that is too high hides the person who is serving a child.
example2_zh: 太高的柜台会挡住正在给孩子服务的那个人。
collocations: at the counter｜在柜台 ; counter to｜与……相反
tip_zh: counter 作动词是反驳。run counter to 表示与……相反。

definition_en: the early part of the day
example1_en: I review words every morning.
example2_en: A hot morning in a room without fans makes the first lesson harder than it needs to be.
example2_zh: 没有风扇的房间里炎热的早晨，会让第一节课难上加难。
collocations: in the morning｜在上午 ; morning exercise｜早操
tip_zh: 泛指上午用 in the morning；具体某一天上午用 on Monday morning。

definition_en: as the representative of someone
example1_en: She spoke on behalf of the class.
example2_en: A speech on behalf of students should come after someone has asked them.
example2_zh: 代表学生的讲话，应当在有人问过他们之后。
collocations: on behalf of｜代表
tip_zh: 几乎只用于 on behalf of 或 on somebody's behalf。

definition_en: a unit of distance
example1_en: The farm is two miles from school.
example2_en: A mile of pavement matters more to a walking student than a faster road with none.
example2_zh: 对步行的学生来说，一英里人行道比没有人行道的更快的路更重要。
collocations: miles away｜很远
tip_zh: 1 mile 约 1.6 公里。英里是 mile，米是 metre。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……外面 | adv. 在外面
definition_en: not inside | outdoors or not inside
example1_en: Please wait outside the office.
example2_en: Noise from outside a classroom can undo the quiet a teacher is trying to keep.
example2_zh: 教室外面的噪音可以毁掉老师试图保持的安静。
collocations: outside of｜在……外面
tip_zh: outside 可作介词或副词。

definition_en: in or to a place that is not named
example1_en: I left my bag somewhere in the hall.
example1_zh: 我把包落在大厅的某个地方了。
example2_en: Students need somewhere quiet to read when home has no spare room.
example2_zh: 家里没有空房间时，学生需要一个安静的地方读书。
collocations: somewhere else｜别的地方
tip_zh: somewhere 是副词，前面不加 in。表里这一行的音标是 sometimes，本库不用。

definition_en: what is true
example1_en: Please tell the truth about the broken window.
example1_zh: 请说出打破窗户的真相。
example2_en: The truth about a flood includes which streets were under water, not only the official speech.
example2_zh: 洪水的真相包括哪些街被水淹了，而不只是官方的讲话。
collocations: tell the truth｜说实话 ; in truth｜事实上
tip_zh: truth 通常不可数。

definition_en: the direction between north and west
example1_en: The wind is from the north-west.
example2_en: Villages in the north-west share one clinic, so the winter road between them must stay open.
example2_zh: 西北的村子共用一家诊所，所以它们之间的冬季道路必须保持通畅。
collocations: in the north-west｜在西北
tip_zh: north-west 也可写作 northwest。

meanings_zh: adj. 黑色的 | n. 黑色
definition_en: of the darkest colour | the colour black
example1_en: The black cat slept on the warm step.
example1_zh: 黑猫睡在温暖的台阶上。
example2_en: Black smoke from old buses is a daily health problem for students waiting at the stop.
example2_zh: 旧公交冒出的黑烟，是等车学生每天面对的健康问题。
collocations: black and white｜黑白的
tip_zh: black 也可作名词表示黑色。

definition_en: a game, or the ball used in it
example1_en: Basketball practice is at four.
example2_en: A basketball court that locks at dusk leaves the students who finish late outside.
example2_zh: 黄昏就锁上的篮球场，把下课晚的学生留在外面。
collocations: play basketball｜打篮球
tip_zh: 球类运动前通常不加 the：play basketball。

definition_en: a closed path, or a complete electrical path
example1_en: The bus runs a circuit of the town.
example2_en: The lab circuit is drawn on the board, and the switch stays off until the teacher checks it.
example2_zh: 实验室电路画在黑板上，在老师检查之前开关保持关闭。
collocations: a circuit of｜绕……一圈
tip_zh: circuit 可指路线或电路。本条不写如何接通危险电路。

meanings_zh: n. 终点站；终端 | adj. 末端的
definition_en: the end of a route, or a computer screen and keyboard | at the end
example1_en: The bus terminal is at the end of the avenue.
example1_zh: 公交终点站在大街尽头。
example2_en: A computer terminal in the library needs a working clock.
example2_zh: 图书馆的计算机终端需要一块能走的钟。
collocations: bus terminal｜公交终点站
tip_zh: terminal 作形容词可指晚期的。表里这一行的音标是 term，本库不用。

definition_en: the body that goes round the earth
example1_en: The moon was bright on the way home.
example2_en: A town that turns off some lights can still see the moon, and the owls can hunt.
example2_zh: 关掉一部分灯的城镇仍然看得见月亮，猫头鹰也能捕猎。
collocations: full moon｜满月
tip_zh: moon 前通常加 the。

definition_en: a large wild cat with stripes
example1_en: The tiger is in the nature book.
example2_en: A lesson about the tiger should say where it can live, not how to harm it.
example2_zh: 关于老虎的课应当说它能住在哪里，而不是如何伤害它。
collocations: a tiger of｜一只老虎
tip_zh: tiger 可数。

definition_en: the Christian festival on 25 December
example1_en: The shop is closed on Christmas Day.
example2_en: Christmas lights can make a street feel safe at night if they do not replace the ordinary lamps.
example2_zh: 圣诞灯可以让街道在夜里感觉安全，如果它们不是用来代替普通路灯的。
collocations: at Christmas｜在圣诞节 ; Christmas Eve｜平安夜
tip_zh: Christmas 要大写。

definition_en: a table for writing or working
example1_en: Leave the desk clear.
example2_en: A desk at home is not available to every student, which is why the library stays open.
example2_zh: 不是每个学生家里都有书桌，所以图书馆一直开着。
collocations: at the desk｜在书桌前
tip_zh: desk 可数。

definition_en: of the kind already mentioned
example1_en: I have never seen such a clear night sky.
example1_zh: 我从没见过这么晴朗的夜空。
example2_en: Such a small tax on plastic bags can change what millions of shoppers carry home.
example2_zh: 对塑料袋征收如此小的一笔费用，就能改变数百万人拎回家的东西。
collocations: such as｜例如 ; such...that｜如此……以至于
tip_zh: such a/an + 形容词 + 可数名词单数；so + 形容词。

definition_en: to defeat, or to hit repeatedly
example1_en: Our team beat Class Three.
example2_en: You cannot beat a flood with a speech if the drains are still too small.
example2_zh: 如果排水管仍然太小，你无法用一篇讲话打败洪水。
collocations: beat sb｜打败某人 ; heartbeat｜心跳
tip_zh: 打败某人用 beat sb；赢得比赛用 win a match。过去式是 beat，过去分词是 beaten。

definition_en: causing public disagreement
example1_en: The plan is controversial.
example2_en: A controversial fee should be written down before the meeting.
example2_zh: 有争议的费用应当在开会前写下来。
collocations: a controversial topic｜有争议的话题
tip_zh: controversial 形容事物。

definition_en: an act of performing, or how well someone does
example1_en: The music performance starts at seven.
example2_en: A student's performance on one test should not decide the whole story of a year.
example2_zh: 学生一次考试的表现，不该决定一整年的全部故事。
collocations: give a performance｜演出
tip_zh: performance 可指演出，也可指工作或学习表现。

definition_en: to give information to someone, or to recognise a difference
example1_en: Please tell me when the meeting starts.
example1_zh: 请告诉我会议什么时候开始。
example2_en: A label should tell shoppers where food comes from, not only how attractive the packet looks.
example2_zh: 标签应该告诉购物者食物来自哪里，而不只是包装有多好看。
collocations: tell sb to do｜叫某人做 ; tell...from｜把……与……区分 ; tell a story｜讲故事
tip_zh: tell 后面接人：tell sb sth。say 后面接说的内容，不直接接人。

definition_en: money paid regularly for work, often by the month
example1_en: The salary is paid on the first day.
example2_en: A salary that cannot pay the rent pushes workers away from the school.
example2_zh: 付不起租金的薪水，把工人推离学校。
collocations: a salary of｜……的薪水
tip_zh: salary 多指月薪。wage 是本批的另一词，常指周薪。

definition_en: the sound of speaking, or the right to speak
example1_en: She has a clear voice.
example2_en: Students need a voice in decisions about the hour their school day starts.
example2_zh: 关于上学时间的决定，学生需要有发言权。
collocations: in a low voice｜低声 ; raise one's voice｜提高嗓门
tip_zh: voice 多指人的嗓音；sound 是任何声音。

definition_en: a general direction of change
example1_en: The trend is toward later school starts.
example2_en: A trend in the numbers is not a plan until someone writes the next step.
example2_zh: 数字里的趋势在有人写下下一步之前还不是计划。
collocations: a trend toward｜朝……的趋势
tip_zh: trend 可数。

definition_en: a series of lessons, or the way something develops
example1_en: I chose a history course this term.
example1_zh: 这学期我选了一门历史课。
example2_en: Of course a new course needs books, but it also needs a teacher who has time to mark them.
example2_zh: 新课程当然需要书，但也需要有时间批改的老师。
collocations: of course｜当然 ; in the course of｜在……过程中
tip_zh: course 表示课程；of course 是固定短语“当然”。

definition_en: a male ruler
example1_en: The story is about a king who listened to farmers.
example1_zh: 故事讲的是一位倾听农民的国王。
example2_en: Even a king in an old tale needed roads and grain, which is still true of any government.
example2_zh: 即使是旧故事里的国王也需要道路和粮食，任何政府今天仍然如此。
collocations: king of｜……之王
tip_zh: king 是可数名词。

definition_en: the ability to learn and understand
example1_en: The quiz does not measure all of a student's intelligence.
example1_zh: 这次小测测不出一名学生的全部智力。
example2_en: Artificial intelligence can sort answers, and a teacher still has to notice who is lost.
example2_zh: 人工智能可以给答案分类，老师仍然得注意到谁没跟上。
collocations: artificial intelligence｜人工智能
tip_zh: intelligence 通常不可数。表示情报时多用于机构名称。

definition_en: low land between hills or mountains
example1_en: Fog stays in the valley in the morning.
example2_en: Schools in a valley share one road, so a flood closes more than one gate.
example2_zh: 山谷里的学校共用一条路，所以一场洪水会关上不止一扇校门。
collocations: in the valley｜在山谷里
tip_zh: valley 可数。河流经过的谷地也叫 valley。

definition_en: to make someone believe
example1_en: She tried to convince him to stay.
example2_en: Governments must convince residents that improved public transport offers a practical alternative to private cars.
example2_zh: 政府必须让居民相信，改善后的公共交通能够切实替代私家车出行。
collocations: convince someone of something｜使某人相信某事 ; convince someone that｜使某人确信 ; convince someone to do something｜说服某人做某事
tip_zh: convince sb of sth表示使某人相信某事。

definition_en: the shore beside the sea
example1_en: We walked on the beach after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后我们在海滩上走了走。
example2_en: A popular beach can damage the coast if plastic from one weekend is left in the sand.
example2_zh: 如果一个周末的塑料留在沙子里，受欢迎的海滩会破坏海岸。
collocations: on the beach｜在海滩上
tip_zh: beach 是可数名词。

definition_en: related to literature
example1_en: The literary club meets on Thursday.
example2_en: A literary text about a flood can start a discussion, and the bus time still has to be fact.
example2_zh: 写洪水的文学作品可以开启讨论，公交时间却必须是事实。
collocations: literary works｜文学作品
tip_zh: literature 已在本库。

definition_en: lower than
example1_en: The temperature fell below zero last night.
example1_zh: 昨夜气温降到了零度以下。
example2_en: Scores below the pass line still show effort, and they should not be the only story of a term.
example2_zh: 低于及格线的分数仍然说明有努力，而且不该成为一学期的唯一故事。
collocations: below zero｜零度以下 ; see below｜见下文
tip_zh: below 强调低于某个水平；under 多指在某物正下方。

meanings_zh: n. 荣誉 | v. 尊敬；授予荣誉
definition_en: great respect, or something that brings it | to show respect, or to give an award
example1_en: It was an honor to speak for the class.
example1_zh: 代表班级发言是一种荣誉。
example2_en: An honor roll that lists only scores misses the student who kept the library open.
example2_zh: 只列分数的光荣榜，会漏掉那个让图书馆一直开着的学生。
collocations: in honor of｜为纪念 ; have the honor of｜有幸
tip_zh: honor 是美式拼写，英式是 honour。作动词是尊敬或授予荣誉。

definition_en: a person's social or legal position
example1_en: The form asks for your student status.
example1_zh: 表格询问你的学生身份。
example2_en: Social status should not decide who may use the public library after school.
example2_zh: 社会地位不该决定谁可以在放学后使用公共图书馆。
collocations: social status｜社会地位 ; status quo｜现状
tip_zh: status 通常不可数。法律地位、社会地位都可以用。

definition_en: to make something less
example1_en: The school wants to reduce food waste.
example2_en: Cities can reduce traffic near schools by changing the bell, not only by adding lanes.
example2_zh: 城市可以靠调整铃声来减少学校附近的车流，而不只是加车道。
collocations: reduce sth to｜把……减少到 ; reduce by｜减少了
tip_zh: reduce 后接所减少的东西。表里的美式音标不完整，美式读音用 espeak-ng。

definition_en: a married woman
example1_en: His wife teaches at the primary school.
example2_en: A wife who works nights still needs a safe bus home after the last shift.
example2_zh: 上夜班的妻子在最后一班结束后，仍然需要一趟安全的回家公交。
collocations: husband and wife｜夫妻
tip_zh: wife 的复数是 wives。

definition_en: an idea of how something is
example1_en: The concept is easier with a picture.
example1_zh: 这个概念配上一张图就容易些。
example2_en: Students grasp a new concept faster when they can test it on a familiar problem.
example2_zh: 学生若能用熟悉的题目检验一个新概念，就会理解得更快。
collocations: the concept of｜……的概念
tip_zh: concept 比 idea 更偏学科里的概念。

meanings_zh: n. 恶习 | adj. 副的
definition_en: a bad habit or moral fault | next in rank
example1_en: The essay argues that waste is a public vice.
example1_zh: 文章认为浪费是一种公共恶习。
example2_en: The vice principal, not the principal, meets the bus company on Mondays.
example2_zh: 周一和公交公司见面的是副校长，不是校长。
collocations: vice president｜副总统；副校长
tip_zh: vice 作名词是恶习。放在职称前表示“副”：vice principal。两种意思不要混在一个句子里让人猜。

meanings_zh: v. 希望 | n. 希望
definition_en: to want something to happen | a feeling of wanting something good
example1_en: I hope to see you at the concert.
example1_zh: 我希望在音乐会上见到你。
example2_en: Families hope the new clinic will open before winter, when travel on icy roads is harder.
example2_zh: 家人希望新诊所在冬天前开业，因为结冰的路更难走。
collocations: hope to do｜希望做 ; hope for｜希望得到 ; in the hope of｜抱着……的希望
tip_zh: hope 后接 to do 或 that 从句，不说 hope sb to do。

meanings_zh: n. 向导；指南 | v. 引导
definition_en: a person or book that shows the way | to show someone the way
example1_en: The guide stopped at the old gate.
example2_en: A guide for new students works better with a map than with a speech alone.
example2_zh: 给新生的指南配上一张地图，比只有一篇讲话更有用。
collocations: guide to｜……指南
tip_zh: guide 作动词是引导。

definition_en: a hard shiny material such as iron or gold
example1_en: The gate is made of metal.
example2_en: Sorting metal from kitchen waste makes recycling possible and keeps the rest cleaner.
example2_zh: 把金属从厨余里分出来，回收才可能进行，其余垃圾也更干净。
collocations: a metal box｜金属盒
tip_zh: metal 作材料时常不可数。a metal 可指某一种金属。

meanings_zh: v. 驾驶；驱动 | n. 驱车旅行
definition_en: to control a vehicle, or to force something forward | a journey in a car
example1_en: My uncle drives to work.
example2_en: High rents drive workers out of the centre, and then the morning roads fill with cars.
example2_zh: 高房租把工人赶出市中心，然后早晨的路就挤满了汽车。
collocations: drive sb to｜开车送某人去 ; drive away｜赶走
tip_zh: drive 的过去式是 drove，过去分词是 driven。

meanings_zh: v. 要求 | n. 坚决要求 | v. 强烈要求；需要
definition_en: to ask for firmly | a strong request that someone expects to be obeyed | to insist on receiving something or require something essential
example1_en: Workers demand better pay and safety.
example1_zh: 工人们要求更好的薪酬和安全。
example2_en: Growing demand for affordable housing has encouraged local authorities to convert unused office buildings into residential accommodation.
example2_zh: 对可负担住房不断增长的需求促使地方政府将闲置办公楼改建为住宅。
collocations: demand for housing｜住房需求 ; meet demand｜满足需求 ; in high demand｜需求旺盛 ; demand an explanation｜要求解释
tip_zh: 要求做某事用demand to do，不用demand sb to do。

meanings_zh: n. 脸；面 | v. 面对
definition_en: the front of the head | to deal with a difficult situation
example1_en: She had a smile on her face.
example2_en: A city must face the fact that cheap housing and clean air are both necessary.
example2_zh: 一座城市必须面对这个事实：廉价住房和干净空气都是必需的。
collocations: face to face｜面对面 ; make a face｜做鬼脸 ; lose face｜丢脸
tip_zh: face 作动词表示面对：face a problem，不要说 face to a problem。

meanings_zh: adj. 当代的；同时代的 | n. 同代人
definition_en: modern, or living at the same time | a person living at the same time
example1_en: The gallery shows contemporary painting.
example2_en: A contemporary of the old poet still needed a bus to the library.
example2_zh: 那位老诗人的同时代人，去图书馆仍然需要一班车。
collocations: contemporary art｜当代艺术
tip_zh: contemporary 作名词是同代人。

definition_en: a round deep dish
example1_en: There is a bowl of rice on the table.
example2_en: A cracked bowl in the canteen should be thrown away the same day.
example2_zh: 食堂里裂了的碗应当当天扔掉。
collocations: a bowl of｜一碗
tip_zh: bowl 可数。a bowl of 后接所盛的东西。

definition_en: health and happiness, or help given by the public
example1_en: The club cares about student welfare.
example2_en: Welfare that never reaches the clinic is only a word.
example2_zh: 到不了诊所的福利只是一个词。
collocations: social welfare｜社会福利 ; welfare of｜……的福祉
tip_zh: welfare 通常不可数。

definition_en: a black rock burned for heat
example1_en: The old school once burned coal.
example2_en: A town that leaves coal behind still has to heat the classroom.
example2_zh: 不再用煤的城镇，仍然必须给教室供暖。
collocations: coal mine｜煤矿
tip_zh: coal 通常不可数。本条不写开采方法。

meanings_zh: v. 承认；准许进入 | v. 准许进入；接收
definition_en: to say something is true; to allow in | to allow someone to enter or join a place or institution
example1_en: He had to admit that he was wrong.
example1_zh: 他不得不承认自己错了。
example2_en: Governments should admit when policies have failed and use reliable evidence to develop more effective alternatives.
example2_zh: 政府应承认政策失败，并依据可靠证据制定更有效的替代方案。
collocations: admit a mistake｜承认错误 ; admit doing something｜承认做过某事 ; admit that｜承认…… ; be admitted to hospital｜被收治入院
tip_zh: 用admit doing，不用admit to do；过去式双写t。

definition_en: a person who teaches
example1_en: Our teacher returned the essays on Friday.
example2_en: A new teacher needs time to learn the names, and a class can help by sitting in the same places at first.
example2_zh: 新老师需要时间记名字，班级一开始坐在固定位置可以帮上忙。
collocations: class teacher｜班主任 ; teacher of｜……老师
tip_zh: 说 a teacher of English，或 an English teacher。

meanings_zh: n. 目击者；证人 | v. 目击；作证
definition_en: a person who sees an event, or who speaks in court | to see something happen, or to give evidence
example1_en: The witness wrote the time, not a guess.
example1_zh: 证人写下了时间，不是猜测。
example2_en: A witness at a school gate should be asked what they saw, not what they fear.
example2_zh: 校门口的目击者应当被问看见了什么，而不是害怕什么。
collocations: a witness to｜……的目击者 ; witness sth｜目击
tip_zh: witness 作动词是目击或作证。

definition_en: to give something that is needed
example1_en: The school provides lunch for students.
example2_en: Cities should provide lights on the road home, not only seats in the classroom.
example2_zh: 城市应该在回家的路上提供照明，而不只是教室里的座位。
collocations: provide sb with sth｜向某人提供 ; provide sth for sb｜为某人提供
tip_zh: provide 的两种搭配：provide sb with sth 或 provide sth for sb。

definition_en: to make known publicly
example1_en: The teacher will announce the exam date tomorrow.
example1_zh: 老师明天会宣布考试日期。
example2_en: Local authorities should announce major policy changes early so residents have enough time to prepare.
example2_zh: 地方政府应尽早公布重大政策调整，让居民有充足的准备时间。
collocations: announce plans｜宣布计划 ; announce a decision｜宣布决定 ; announce the results｜公布结果
tip_zh: 用announce sth或announce that，不用announce sb sth。

definition_en: people living together under shared rules
example1_en: Schools are part of society, not separate from it.
example1_zh: 学校是社会的一部分，不是与之分开的。
example2_en: A society that measures success only by test scores will miss students who help their families after class.
example2_zh: 只用考分衡量成功的社会，会忽略那些课后帮助家人的学生。
collocations: in society｜在社会中
tip_zh: society 可数。the society 有时指某个社团。

definition_en: a way for vehicles
example1_en: The road to the museum is closed today.
example1_zh: 去博物馆的路今天封闭。
example2_en: A wider road can invite more cars unless buses and bikes are given space too.
example2_zh: 更宽的路会招来更多汽车，除非公交和自行车也有空间。
collocations: on the road｜在路上 ; main road｜主干道
tip_zh: road 多指车辆道路；street 多指两边有建筑的街道。

definition_en: a short form of advertisement
example1_en: The ad on the board is for the book fair.
example1_zh: 布告栏上的广告是书展的。
example2_en: An ad aimed at teenagers should say who paid for it.
example2_zh: 面向青少年的广告应当说明是谁出的钱。
collocations: an ad for｜……的广告
tip_zh: ad 是 advertisement 的缩写。正式写作用全称。

definition_en: one part of a situation
example1_en: Cost is only one aspect of the plan.
example1_zh: 费用只是计划的一个方面。
example2_en: The safety aspect of the late bus matters as much as the fare.
example2_zh: 晚班车的安全方面和票价一样重要。
collocations: an aspect of｜……的一个方面
tip_zh: aspect 可数。

definition_en: a large room for meetings or events
example1_en: The concert is in the school hall.
example1_zh: 音乐会在学校礼堂举行。
example2_en: A town hall that opens in the evening gives working parents a place to hear the budget.
example2_zh: 晚上开放的市政厅，给上班的家长一个听预算说明的地方。
collocations: town hall｜市政厅 ; dining hall｜食堂
tip_zh: hall 可指礼堂、门厅或市政厅，要看搭配。

definition_en: having a high temperature
example1_en: The classroom was too hot to concentrate.
example1_zh: 教室热得无法集中注意力。
example2_en: Hot nights without fans make it harder for students to sleep before an exam.
example2_zh: 没有风扇的炎热夜晚，让学生更难在考试前入睡。
collocations: hot water｜热水 ; hot dog｜热狗
tip_zh: hot 的比较级是 hotter。

definition_en: a step, or the speed of an activity
example1_en: Walk at a steady pace.
example2_en: The pace of the lesson should leave time for the quiet student.
example2_zh: 课的节奏应当给安静的学生留出时间。
collocations: at a pace of｜以……的速度 ; keep pace with｜跟上
tip_zh: pace 作动词是来回走动。

definition_en: to choose, or to take fruit or flowers
example1_en: Pick a question you can explain.
example2_en: Families pick a school they can reach, not only the one with the highest scores.
example2_zh: 家庭会选择他们能够到达的学校，而不只是分数最高的那所。
collocations: pick up｜捡起；接人 ; pick out｜挑出
tip_zh: pick up sb 可以表示开车接人。

definition_en: a building where a car is kept
example1_en: The garage is behind the hall.
example2_en: A garage that blocks the path is not a place to leave a car.
example2_zh: 挡住小路的车库不是停车的地方。
collocations: a garage of｜一个车库
tip_zh: 英式 garage 有 /ˈɡærɑːʒ/ 和 /ˈɡærɪdʒ/ 两种读音。

definition_en: ideas and activities about government
example1_en: They discussed politics in the history club.
example1_zh: 他们在历史社里讨论政治。
example2_en: School politics is not only elections; it is also who gets to speak in a meeting.
example2_zh: 校园政治不只是选举，也包括谁能在会上发言。
collocations: in politics｜从政 ; politics of｜……的政治
tip_zh: politics 作学科时谓语常用单数：Politics is interesting。

definition_en: a person who writes news
example1_en: The journalist checked the time twice.
example1_zh: 记者把时间核对了两遍。
example2_en: A journalist who names no source is harder to trust.
example2_zh: 不写来源的记者更难信任。
collocations: a journalist for｜……的记者
tip_zh: reporter 是本批的另一词，意思相近。

meanings_zh: adj. 蓝色的 | n. 蓝色
definition_en: of the colour of a clear sky | the colour blue
example1_en: She wore a blue coat.
example2_en: Blue signs that nobody can read at night do not make a crossing safer.
example2_zh: 夜里没人看得清的蓝色标志，并不能让过街更安全。
collocations: blue sky｜蓝天
tip_zh: blue 也可作名词表示蓝色。

definition_en: on this night
example1_en: The concert is tonight.
example2_en: A storm warning for tonight helps only families who can still receive it.
example2_zh: 今晚的风暴警报只帮助仍能收到它的家庭。
collocations: tonight's｜今晚的
tip_zh: tonight 前面不加介词 on。

definition_en: help given to people, or a public system
example1_en: The bus service stops at ten.
example2_en: A health service that only works in the city centre leaves villages waiting for basic care.
example2_zh: 只在市中心运转的医疗服务，会让乡村等待基本的照料。
collocations: public service｜公共服务 ; service industry｜服务业
tip_zh: service 表示服务时常不可数；一项具体服务有时用 a service。

definition_en: the worldwide computer network
example1_en: I checked the bus times on the Internet.
example1_zh: 我在网上查了公交时刻。
example2_en: The Internet spreads a correction slowly if the false picture was more exciting.
example2_zh: 如果假图片更刺激，互联网传播更正就会很慢。
collocations: on the Internet｜在互联网上 ; surf the Internet｜上网
tip_zh: Internet 常大写，前面加 the。

meanings_zh: n. 化学品 | adj. 化学的
definition_en: a substance used in or produced by chemistry | related to chemistry
example1_en: The chemical is labelled and locked.
example1_zh: 这种化学品贴了标签并锁好了。
example2_en: A school lab should name every chemical and still not publish a method for misuse.
example2_zh: 学校实验室应当标明每一种化学品，同时仍然不公布误用的方法。
collocations: chemical reaction｜化学反应
tip_zh: chemical 作形容词是化学的。本条不写配制或滥用方法。

definition_en: certain to, or obliged to
example1_en: The bus is bound to be full at four.
example1_zh: 四点的公交肯定是满的。
example2_en: A school is bound to publish the fee before it asks families to pay.
example2_zh: 学校在要求家庭付款之前，有义务公布费用。
collocations: be bound to｜一定；有义务 ; bound for｜开往
tip_zh: be bound to do 表示很可能或有义务。bound 也可作动词 bind 的过去分词，或名词“跳跃”。

definition_en: an opinion, or a decision by a court
example1_en: The judgment was written down.
example2_en: Judgment of a student should use more than one score.
example2_zh: 对学生的判断应当用不止一个分数。
collocations: in one's judgment｜依某人看 ; make a judgment｜做出判断
tip_zh: 美式拼作 judgment，英式常拼 judgement。表里词头是 judgement，读音相同。judge 已在本库。

meanings_zh: n. 范围；一系列 | v. 范围涉及
definition_en: a set of different things, or the limits of something | to vary between limits
example1_en: The shop sells a wide range of pens.
example1_zh: 这家店卖各种各样的笔。
example2_en: A wide range of bus times helps workers whose shifts do not match a school day.
example2_zh: 多样的公交班次有助于那些班次和上学日对不上的工人。
collocations: a range of｜一系列 ; in the range of｜在……范围内
tip_zh: range from A to B 表示范围从 A 到 B。

definition_en: to be unable to find, or to be beaten
example1_en: Do not lose your student card.
example2_en: Towns lose young workers when housing, jobs, and buses are all somewhere else.
example2_zh: 当住房、工作和公交都在别处时，城镇会失去年轻工人。
collocations: lose interest｜失去兴趣 ; lose one's way｜迷路
tip_zh: lose 的过去式和过去分词是 lost。

definition_en: a light in the night sky, or a famous performer
example1_en: We could see one bright star above the hill.
example1_zh: 我们能看见山上空一颗明亮的星。
example2_en: A film star visiting a school for one hour does less than a teacher who stays all year.
example2_zh: 在学校停留一小时的电影明星，不如全年留下来的老师做得更多。
collocations: pop star｜流行明星 ; star in｜主演
tip_zh: star 作动词是“主演”。

meanings_zh: n. 舒适；安慰 | v. 安慰
definition_en: a state of ease, or kind words | to make someone feel less sad
example1_en: The chair is for comfort, not for show.
example1_zh: 这把椅子是为了舒服，不是为了好看。
example2_en: A word of comfort helps, and a seat on the bus helps more.
example2_zh: 一句安慰有用，公交上的一个座位更有用。
collocations: in comfort｜舒适地 ; comfort sb｜安慰某人
tip_zh: comfortable 已在本库。comfort 作动词是安慰。

definition_en: a way of doing something, or polite behaviour
example1_en: She explained the rule in a calm manner.
example1_zh: 她用平静的方式解释了规定。
example2_en: Good manners at the gate include holding the door, not only saying hello.
example2_zh: 门口的礼貌包括扶门，而不只是说你好。
collocations: in a ... manner｜以……方式 ; table manners｜餐桌礼仪
tip_zh: manner 表示方式。manners 复数常指礼貌。

definition_en: a person who acts in plays or films
example1_en: The actor visited the drama club.
example2_en: An actor who only reads the lines still needs the crew that built the set.
example2_zh: 只念台词的演员，仍然需要搭景的那组人。
collocations: actor in｜……里的演员
tip_zh: 现在 actor 也可泛指演员。actress 专指女演员。

meanings_zh: n. 联系；链接 | v. 连接
definition_en: a connection | to connect
example1_en: There is a link between sleep and attention.
example1_zh: 睡眠和注意力之间有联系。
example2_en: The bus link between the village and the clinic is as important as the clinic itself.
example2_zh: 村子和诊所之间的公交联系，和诊所本身一样重要。
collocations: link between｜……之间的联系 ; a link to｜通向……的链接
tip_zh: link 作动词是“连接”。

definition_en: the end of life
example1_en: The story ends with the death of the old tree.
example1_zh: 故事以那棵老树的死亡结束。
example2_en: Heat-related death is more common in neighbourhoods with little shade and few clinics.
example2_zh: 与高温有关的死亡，在少荫凉、少诊所的社区更常见。
collocations: the death of｜……的死亡
tip_zh: death 是名词；die 是动词；dead 是形容词。

definition_en: popular, especially in music
example1_en: The pop song was playing in the canteen.
example1_zh: 食堂里放着那首流行歌曲。
example2_en: Pop culture reaches students faster than a textbook, which is why the source still matters.
example2_zh: 流行文化比课本更快到达学生，所以来源仍然重要。
collocations: pop music｜流行音乐 ; pop star｜流行歌星
tip_zh: pop 是 popular 的口语缩略，多用于音乐和艺术。作动词可表示发出砰的一声。

meanings_zh: n. 主人；大师；硕士 | v. 掌握
definition_en: a person in control, an expert, or a graduate degree | to learn something thoroughly
example1_en: She is a master of the violin.
example2_en: Students master a word by using it, not only by seeing it once on a list.
example2_zh: 学生通过使用来掌握一个词，而不只是在词表上看一次。
collocations: master a skill｜掌握一项技能 ; master's degree｜硕士学位
tip_zh: master 作动词是“掌握”。

definition_en: the making of beautiful or expressive things
example1_en: There is an art show in the hall.
example2_en: Public art on a dull wall can make a walk to school feel shorter and safer.
example2_zh: 单调墙上的公共艺术，能让走路上学感觉更短、更安全。
collocations: work of art｜艺术品 ; art museum｜美术馆
tip_zh: art 泛指艺术时不可数。the arts 可指多种艺术。

definition_en: to draw liquid into the mouth
example1_en: The baby will suck the milk.
example2_en: Do not suck the juice through a dirty straw.
example2_zh: 不要用脏吸管吸果汁。
collocations: suck up｜吸起
tip_zh: suck 是普通动词。本条用进食的意思。

definition_en: an official paper or computer file
example1_en: Save the document before you close it.
example2_en: A document that names a child should not sit open on a public desk.
example2_zh: 写有孩子姓名的文件，不应当摊开在公共桌子上。
collocations: a document of｜一份……文件
tip_zh: document 也可作动词“记录”。

meanings_zh: v. 打破；违反；休息 | n. 休息；中断
definition_en: to separate into pieces, or to disobey | a short rest
example1_en: Do not break the lab rules.
example2_en: If a pipe breaks under a school, classes stop even when the building looks fine.
example2_zh: 如果学校底下的管子破裂，即使楼看起来没事，课也会停。
collocations: break down｜出故障 ; break out｜爆发 ; have a break｜休息
tip_zh: break 的过去式是 broke，过去分词是 broken。

definition_en: an oval object from a bird, used as food
example1_en: There is an egg in the fridge.
example2_en: An egg left out of the fridge all morning is not a safe lunch.
example2_zh: 放在冰箱外一上午的蛋不是安全的午饭。
collocations: a boiled egg｜煮蛋
tip_zh: egg 可数。

definition_en: the direction between south and east
example1_en: The wind turned to the south-east.
example2_en: Ports in the south-east depend on roads that stay open when the river rises.
example2_zh: 东南的港口依靠河水上涨时仍然通畅的道路。
collocations: in the south-east｜在东南
tip_zh: south-east 也可写作 southeast。

definition_en: firm and not likely to change or fall
example1_en: The table is stable.
example2_en: A stable bus time helps more than a new paint colour.
example2_zh: 稳定的公交时间比新的油漆颜色更有帮助。
collocations: a stable job｜稳定的工作
tip_zh: stable 作名词是马厩。本条以形容词为主。

definition_en: the act of dividing, a part of an organization, or dividing numbers
example1_en: The younger division of the club meets on Monday.
example1_zh: 社团的低年级小组周一见面。
example2_en: Fair division of practice time matters when one team shares a single court.
example2_zh: 当两支队共用一块场地时，公平分配练习时间就很重要。
collocations: division of｜……的划分 ; division sign｜除号
tip_zh: 除法是 division。公司或机构的部门也用 division。

definition_en: how good something is
example1_en: The quality of the recording is poor.
example2_en: Air quality outside a school matters as much as the quality of the books inside.
example2_zh: 学校外面的空气质量和里面的书的质量一样重要。
collocations: high quality｜高质量 ; quality of life｜生活质量
tip_zh: quality 表示质量时常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 免费的；空闲的；自由的
definition_en: costing nothing, or not busy, or not controlled
example1_en: Are you free after class today?
example2_en: Free entry to museums matters most to families who would not pay for a ticket.
example2_zh: 博物馆免费入场，对那些本来不会买票的家庭最为重要。
collocations: for free｜免费 ; free time｜空闲时间 ; set free｜释放
tip_zh: free 表示免费或有空；freely 才是副词“自由地”。

definition_en: something that happens, or a race in a sports meeting
example1_en: The sports event starts at nine.
example2_en: A public event in the square should leave a path so people can still reach the clinic.
example2_zh: 广场上的公共活动应该留出一条路，让人们仍能到达诊所。
collocations: sports event｜体育赛事 ; in the event of｜如果发生
tip_zh: event 是可数名词。

definition_en: a large farm bird, or its meat
example1_en: The picture shows a turkey, not a chicken.
example2_en: Turkey the country and turkey the bird are different words; only the country is capitalised.
example2_zh: 国家 Turkey 和火鸡 turkey 是不同的词；只有国名大写。
collocations: roast turkey｜烤火鸡
tip_zh: 本条指鸟。国名是 Turkey，要大写，不在这一词条里展开。

definition_en: used to contrast with what was just said
example1_en: The plan is costly. However, it may save water.
example1_zh: 这个计划花费很大。然而，它也许能节水。
example2_en: The museum is free. However, families who live an hour away still pay for the bus.
example2_zh: 博物馆是免费的。然而，住在一小时车程外的家庭仍然要付公交费。
collocations: however hard｜无论多么努力
tip_zh: however 是副词，前后常用句号或分号；but 是连词，连接两个分句。

definition_en: a building where important objects are kept and shown
example1_en: The class visits the museum on Thursday.
example2_en: A free museum still fails if the bus stops an hour before it opens.
example2_zh: 如果公交在开馆前一小时就停了，免费的博物馆仍然去不成。
collocations: at the museum｜在博物馆 ; museum of｜……博物馆
tip_zh: museum 重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: n. 商店 | v. 购物
definition_en: a place that sells goods | to buy things in shops
example1_en: The shop on the corner sells notebooks.
example2_en: A small shop near a school can feed a street, but only if the rent stays possible.
example2_zh: 学校附近的小店能养活一条街，但前提是租金仍然付得起。
collocations: go shopping｜去购物 ; shop assistant｜店员
tip_zh: shop 作动词是买东西。英式常用 shop，美式常用 store。

definition_en: Saturday and Sunday
example1_en: I review words at the weekend.
example2_en: A clinic that closes every weekend leaves Friday-night injuries waiting until Monday.
example2_zh: 每个周末都关门的诊所，会让周五夜里的伤等到星期一。
collocations: at the weekend｜在周末 ; on the weekend｜在周末
tip_zh: 英式常用 at the weekend；美式常用 on the weekend。

definition_en: following what is usual
example1_en: The conventional time is eight.
example2_en: A conventional answer is not always the fair one.
example2_zh: 常规答案不总是公平的那个。
collocations: conventional wisdom｜常规看法
tip_zh: conventional 与方便的 convenient 不是同一个词。

meanings_zh: adj. 在场的；目前的 | n. 礼物；现在 | v. 呈现；颁发
definition_en: here now, or existing at this time | a gift, or the time now | to show or give formally
example1_en: All the students were present.
example2_en: The present bus timetable ignores the hour when the factory shift ends.
example2_zh: 目前的公交时刻表忽略了工厂换班结束的时间。
collocations: at present｜目前 ; be present at｜出席
tip_zh: present 作名词“礼物”或动词“呈现”时重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: adj. 亚洲的 | n. 亚洲人
definition_en: of Asia | a person from Asia
example1_en: The map shows Asian rivers in blue.
example1_zh: 地图上亚洲的河流用蓝色标出。
example2_en: An Asian writer on the list gives the class a voice one textbook chapter may miss.
example2_zh: 书单上的亚洲作家能给班级一个课本里某一章可能错过的声音。
collocations: Asian country｜亚洲国家
tip_zh: Asian 作形容词和名词都要大写。

meanings_zh: n. 形状 | v. 塑造
definition_en: the form of something | to give something a form
example1_en: Draw the shape before you add colour.
example2_en: The shape of the school day shapes how tired students are at four.
example2_zh: 上学日的安排会决定学生四点钟有多累。
collocations: in the shape of｜呈……形状 ; out of shape｜变形；状态不好
tip_zh: shape 作动词是塑造。in good shape 可指身体或事物状态好。

definition_en: any person
example1_en: Anybody can borrow the map.
example1_zh: 任何人都可以借这张地图。
example2_en: Anybody who misses the bus should know the office number before the gate closes.
example2_zh: 误了公交的任何人，应当在关门前知道办公室电话。
collocations: anybody else｜其他任何人
tip_zh: anybody 与 anyone 同义，anyone 已在本库。疑问句和否定句里更常见。作主语时谓语用单数。

definition_en: a female parent
example1_en: My mother works at the hospital.
example2_en: A mother on a night shift needs the school to understand why her child sometimes arrives tired.
example2_zh: 上夜班的母亲需要学校理解她的孩子为什么有时疲惫地到校。
collocations: mother tongue｜母语
tip_zh: mother 较正式；mum 或 mom 更口语。

meanings_zh: n. 租金 | v. 租用；出租
definition_en: money paid to use a room or thing | to pay to use something, or to let someone use it
example1_en: The rent is due on the first day.
example1_zh: 租金在每月第一天到期。
example2_en: High rent near a school pushes workers farther from the bus they need.
example2_zh: 学校附近的高租金，把工人推得离他们需要的公交更远。
collocations: pay the rent｜付租金 ; for rent｜出租
tip_zh: rent 作动词是租用或出租。英式 let 也表示出租。

definition_en: needing rest
example1_en: I am too tired to revise tonight.
example2_en: Tired drivers on the school route are a reason to shorten shifts.
example2_zh: 校车路线上疲劳的司机，是缩短班次的理由。
collocations: be tired of｜厌倦 ; tired out｜筋疲力尽
tip_zh: tired 形容人。tiring 形容事物令人疲劳。be tired of 是厌倦，不是身体累。表里的中文把轮胎混了进来，释义按疲倦来写。

definition_en: a rate out of each hundred
example1_en: A high percentage of students walk.
example2_en: A percentage without the total number can hide how many students are left out.
example2_zh: 没有总数的百分比，会藏起有多少学生被落下。
collocations: a percentage of｜……的百分比
tip_zh: percent 已在本库。percentage 前常用 a。

definition_en: having done something wrong, or feeling that you have
example1_en: The court did not find him guilty.
example2_en: Feeling guilty about a low score is not the same as a plan to improve.
example2_zh: 为低分内疚，不等于有了改进的计划。
collocations: be guilty of｜犯有……罪 ; feel guilty｜感到内疚
tip_zh: be guilty of 后接罪名或过错。innocent 已在本库。

meanings_zh: v. 玩；演奏；参加比赛 | n. 戏剧；比赛
definition_en: to take part in a game, or to perform music | a piece of writing for the theatre, or a game
example1_en: We play basketball after school.
example2_en: Children who play outside learn to judge risk in a way that a screen cannot teach.
example2_zh: 在户外玩耍的孩子会学习判断风险，这是屏幕教不会的。
collocations: play a role｜起作用 ; play the piano｜弹钢琴 ; play with｜玩耍
tip_zh: 球类前不加 the：play football；乐器前加 the：play the violin。

meanings_zh: v. 出口 | n. 出口
definition_en: to send goods to another country | a product sent to another country
example1_en: The town exports tea.
example2_en: An export figure without a source is not a report.
example2_zh: 没有来源的出口数字不是报告。
collocations: export to｜出口到
tip_zh: 名词“出口”重音常在前，动词重音在后。表里是动词读音。

meanings_zh: v. 打架；斗争 | n. 打架；斗争
definition_en: to use force, or to try hard to stop something | a struggle
example1_en: We should not fight in the corridor.
example1_zh: 我们不该在走廊里打架。
example2_en: Communities fight flooding with drains and trees, not only with photos after the water has gone.
example2_zh: 社区用排水和树木对抗洪水，而不只是在水退后拍照。
collocations: fight against｜与……斗争 ; fight for｜为……而战
tip_zh: fight 的过去式和过去分词是 fought。

definition_en: a small area of water, often for swimming
example1_en: The pool is closed on Monday.
example2_en: A public pool that opens after school gives students a place to swim without a private club.
example2_zh: 放学后开放的公共泳池，让学生不用私人俱乐部也能游泳。
collocations: swimming pool｜游泳池
tip_zh: pool 也可指共用的一笔资源：a pool of bikes。作动词是合伙共用。

definition_en: extremely good
example1_en: We had a wonderful time at the concert.
example1_zh: 音乐会上我们玩得很开心。
example2_en: A wonderful score on one test is not a full picture of a difficult term.
example2_zh: 一次测验的好成绩，不是艰难一学期的全貌。
collocations: a wonderful time｜一段美好时光
tip_zh: wonderful 已经表示程度很高，一般不必再加 very。

definition_en: to take air in and out
example1_en: It is hard to breathe in heavy smoke.
example2_en: People living near busy roads often breathe polluted air, which can increase their risk of respiratory illness.
example2_zh: 住在繁忙道路附近的人经常吸入受污染的空气，这可能增加他们患呼吸系统疾病的风险。
collocations: breathe deeply｜深呼吸 ; breathe in｜吸气 ; breathe out｜呼气 ; breathe fresh air｜呼吸新鲜空气
tip_zh: breathe是动词，末音/ð/；breath是名词，末音/θ/。

meanings_zh: adj. 白色的 | n. 白色
definition_en: of the colour of snow | the colour white
example1_en: Write your name on the white card.
example1_zh: 把名字写在白色卡片上。
example2_en: White roofs can reflect summer heat and make classrooms easier to cool.
example2_zh: 白色屋顶能反射夏日热量，让教室更容易降温。
collocations: white hair｜白发
tip_zh: white 也可作名词，表示白色。

definition_en: big in size or amount
example1_en: We need a large table for the maps.
example1_zh: 我们需要一张大桌子放地图。
example2_en: A large school on the edge of town forces many children into long bus rides.
example2_zh: 城边的大学校会迫使许多孩子长时间乘公交。
collocations: a large number of｜许多 ; at large｜未被捕；普遍
tip_zh: large 比 big 更正式，常修饰数量和面积。

definition_en: sixty minutes
example1_en: The talk lasted one hour.
example2_en: An extra hour on the bus each day takes time away from sleep and homework.
example2_zh: 每天在公交上多一个小时，会占去睡眠和作业的时间。
collocations: half an hour｜半小时 ; an hour's walk｜步行一小时的路程
tip_zh: hour 前的 an 不省：an hour。

definition_en: containing as much as possible, or complete
example1_en: The bus was full, so we waited for the next one.
example1_zh: 公交车满了，所以我们等下一辆。
example2_en: A diary full of small observations can later explain how a neighbourhood changed year by year.
example2_zh: 记满细小观察的日记，日后可以解释一个社区如何逐年变化。
collocations: be full of｜充满 ; full name｜全名
tip_zh: be full of 表示充满；fill 是动词“装满”。

definition_en: drinks such as beer and wine, or the substance in them
example1_en: The school does not serve alcohol.
example2_en: Health class can name alcohol as a risk without telling anyone how to obtain it.
example2_zh: 健康课可以把酒说成一种风险，同时不告诉任何人如何得到它。
collocations: alcohol free｜不含酒精的
tip_zh: alcohol 通常不可数。beer 和 wine 已在本库。本条不写饮酒方法。

definition_en: medical care, or the way someone is treated
example1_en: The treatment for the cough was simple.
example2_en: Equal treatment in a classroom means the quiet student is heard as well as the loud one.
example2_zh: 课堂上的平等对待，意味着安静的学生和大声的学生一样被听到。
collocations: medical treatment｜治疗 ; treatment of｜对……的对待
tip_zh: treatment 可指医疗，也可指待人的方式。

definition_en: the continent east of the Atlantic
example1_en: She read a story set in Europe.
example1_zh: 她读了一个以欧洲为背景的故事。
example2_en: Visitors from Europe bring money to a town, but housing for local workers still has to come first.
example2_zh: 来自欧洲的游客给城镇带来钱，但本地工人的住房仍然必须优先。
collocations: in Europe｜在欧洲
tip_zh: Europe 和 European 都要大写。

definition_en: to take place
example1_en: What happened after the bell?
example2_en: Floods happen more often when drains were built for a smaller town.
example2_zh: 当排水系统按更小的城镇修建时，洪水会更常发生。
collocations: happen to do｜碰巧做 ; happen to sb｜发生在某人身上
tip_zh: happen 是不及物动词，没有被动语态。某事发生在某人身上用 happen to sb。

definition_en: the work of building
example1_en: Construction of the bridge will take a year.
example2_en: Construction beside a school should keep a safe path open for children every morning.
example2_zh: 学校旁边的建设应该每天早晨为孩子留一条安全的路。
collocations: under construction｜在建设中
tip_zh: construction 作“建设”时常不可数。

definition_en: connected with what is being discussed
example1_en: Please keep the comment relevant.
example2_en: A relevant example from the town teaches more than a distant one the class cannot picture.
example2_zh: 来自本镇的相关例子，比班级想象不出的远例子教得更多。
collocations: relevant to｜与……相关
tip_zh: relevant to something。反义是 irrelevant。

definition_en: unpleasant to look at
example1_en: The crack is ugly, and it is also unsafe.
example1_zh: 这条裂缝难看，而且也不安全。
example2_en: Calling a person ugly is not a joke the class should keep.
example2_zh: 说一个人难看，不是班级该保留的笑话。
collocations: an ugly scene｜难看的场面
tip_zh: ugly 可以形容事物。用在人身上会伤人，写作时要避免。

meanings_zh: adj. 诚实的 | adj. 坦率的；真诚的
definition_en: truthful | Expressing what you really think or feel.
example1_en: Be honest about your mistakes.
example2_en: Honest communication between teachers and parents can help schools address students' difficulties before they become serious.
example2_zh: 教师与家长之间坦诚的沟通能帮助学校在学生的问题变得严重之前加以解决。
collocations: an honest person｜诚实的人 ; an honest answer｜坦率的回答 ; to be honest｜说实话
tip_zh: h不发音，因此说an honest person。

definition_en: a good result
example1_en: The book fair was a success.
example2_en: Success for a bus line is not a full photo; it is whether workers arrive on time.
example2_zh: 一条公交线的成功不是一张挤满的照片，而是工人是否准时到达。
collocations: success in｜在……上的成功
tip_zh: success 作“成功”时常不可数；一次成功的事可用 a success。

definition_en: a figure, or a quantity
example1_en: Write your seat number in the corner.
example2_en: The number of cars has grown faster than the number of safe places for children to cross.
example2_zh: 汽车数量的增长，快过儿童安全过街地点的增长。
collocations: a number of｜许多 ; the number of｜……的数量 ; phone number｜电话号码
tip_zh: a number of 作主语时谓语常用复数；the number of 作主语时谓语用单数。

definition_en: to take pleasure in
example1_en: I enjoy reading by the window.
example2_en: People enjoy a riverside path more when the water does not smell of waste.
example2_zh: 当水没有废物的气味时，人们更喜欢河边的小路。
collocations: enjoy doing｜喜欢做 ; enjoy oneself｜过得愉快
tip_zh: enjoy 后接 doing，不接 to do。

definition_en: a person who is hurt by someone or something
example1_en: The report does not name the victim.
example1_zh: 报道没有写出受害者的名字。
example2_en: A victim of a flood needs a dry room before a speech about courage.
example2_zh: 洪水的受害者需要一间干的房间，这比一篇关于勇气的讲话更先。
collocations: a victim of｜……的受害者 ; fall victim to｜成为……的受害者
tip_zh: victim 可数。不要把受害者写成有过错的一方。

meanings_zh: v. 损害；毁坏 | v. 损坏；损害
definition_en: to harm | Harm something or make it less effective.
example1_en: Floods can damage houses and roads.
example1_zh: 洪水会毁坏房屋和道路。
example2_en: Uncontrolled tourism can damage fragile ecosystems and reduce the quality of life for local residents.
example2_zh: 不受控制的旅游活动可能破坏脆弱的生态系统，并降低当地居民的生活质量。
collocations: cause damage｜造成损害 ; damage to property｜财产损坏 ; environmental damage｜环境破坏 ; damage someone's reputation｜损害某人的声誉
tip_zh: 损害用不可数damage；damages指法律赔偿金。

definition_en: a length of time, a full stop, or a lesson
example1_en: We have a free period on Wednesday.
example2_en: A dry period of only one month can empty a village tank if nobody measured the water.
example2_zh: 如果没人计量用水，仅仅一个月的干旱也能抽干村里的水箱。
collocations: period of time｜一段时间 ; class period｜一节课
tip_zh: 美式英语里 period 也指句号。

definition_en: a flat piece of paper, or a covering for a bed
example1_en: Write both times on one sheet.
example1_zh: 把两个时间写在同一张纸上。
example2_en: A clean sheet on the clinic bed matters as much as the notice.
example2_zh: 诊所床上的干净床单和通知一样重要。
collocations: a sheet of｜一张
tip_zh: a sheet of paper 是一张纸。

meanings_zh: v. 逮捕 | n. 逮捕
definition_en: to take someone to a police station by law | an act of arresting
example1_en: The novel says the officer did not arrest the child.
example1_zh: 小说写警官没有逮捕那个孩子。
example2_en: News of an arrest should give the charge and the date, not a guess.
example2_zh: 逮捕的新闻应当给出罪名和日期，而不是猜测。
collocations: arrest sb for｜因……逮捕 ; under arrest｜被拘留
tip_zh: arrest 也可作名词。本条只作法律词汇，不写执法步骤。

definition_en: full of energy, or changing
example1_en: The club is dynamic, and it still writes the time.
example1_zh: 社团很有活力，并且仍然把时间写下来。
example2_en: A dynamic plan that changes every hour needs one person to update the notice.
example2_zh: 每小时都在变的计划，需要一个人去更新通知。
collocations: a dynamic person｜有活力的人
tip_zh: dynamic 也可作名词，表示动力或相互作用。

definition_en: thankful
example1_en: I am grateful for your help.
example2_en: Many students are grateful for scholarships that allow them to continue their education despite financial difficulties.
example2_zh: 许多学生感谢奖学金让他们即使经济困难也能继续学业。
collocations: grateful to someone｜感激某人 ; grateful for something｜感谢某事 ; deeply grateful｜深表感激
tip_zh: be grateful to某人 for某事；注意不是greatful。

definition_en: next to, or together with
example1_en: The path runs alongside the river.
example2_en: A clinic alongside the school saves the hour a bus would take.
example2_zh: 学校旁边的诊所省下乘公交要花的那一小时。
collocations: alongside sb｜与某人并肩
tip_zh: alongside 也可作副词。

meanings_zh: v. 躺；位于 | n. 谎言 | v. 说谎
definition_en: to be in a flat position, or to be in a place | a statement that is not true | to say something that is not true
example1_en: Lie down if you feel dizzy.
example2_en: The village lies beyond the hill, so the clinic bus has to leave before dark.
example2_zh: 村子在山的那一边，所以去诊所的班车必须在天黑前出发。
collocations: lie down｜躺下 ; tell a lie｜说谎
tip_zh: 躺的过去式是 lay，过去分词是 lain。说谎的过去式和过去分词是 lied。不要和及物动词 lay（放置）混淆。

definition_en: a tall narrow building or part of a building
example1_en: The clock tower is visible from the gate.
example2_en: A tower without a light does not help the student who arrives after dark.
example2_zh: 没有灯的塔帮不了天黑后才到的学生。
collocations: a clock tower｜钟楼
tip_zh: tower 可数。

definition_en: a person who creates art
example1_en: The artist talked about the poster design.
example2_en: An artist in residence can help a school see its own walls as more than empty space.
example2_zh: 驻校艺术家能帮助学校看到，墙壁不只是空白。
collocations: make-up artist｜化妆师
tip_zh: artist 不限于画家，也包括其他艺术创作者。

definition_en: very unwise
example1_en: It is stupid to cycle at night without a light.
example1_zh: 夜里骑车不带灯是愚蠢的。
example2_en: Calling a question stupid stops the student who most needs to ask it.
example2_zh: 把一个问题说成愚蠢，会阻止最需要提问的学生。
collocations: stupid mistake｜愚蠢的错误
tip_zh: stupid 语气很重，容易伤人。课堂上更适合说 unclear 或 I do not understand。

definition_en: at any time
example1_en: Have you ever visited the city museum?
example2_en: If a river has ever flooded the same street twice, planners should stop building basements there.
example2_zh: 如果一条河曾两次淹没同一条街，规划者就不该再在那里建地下室。
collocations: for ever｜永远 ; ever since｜自从
tip_zh: ever 常用于疑问句和否定句；肯定句里的“曾经”多用 once。

definition_en: the feeling of being happy
example1_en: The concert brought happiness to the hall.
example1_zh: 音乐会给礼堂带来了愉快。
example2_en: Happiness at a win should still leave room to thank the team.
example2_zh: 胜利的愉快仍然应当留出位置去谢谢队伍。
collocations: a sense of happiness｜幸福感
tip_zh: happiness 通常不可数。happy 已在本库。

definition_en: to get better after an illness or a loss
example1_en: She recovered after three days at home.
example2_en: A student who is recovering still needs the notes from class.
example2_zh: 正在恢复的学生仍然需要课堂笔记。
collocations: recover from｜从……中恢复
tip_zh: recover 也可指找回失物。

meanings_zh: v. 下降；谢绝 | n. 下降
definition_en: to become less, or to refuse politely | a decrease
example1_en: The number of late buses did not decline.
example1_zh: 晚班车的数量没有下降。
example2_en: She declined the prize and asked for books for the library instead.
example2_zh: 她谢绝了奖品，改为给图书馆要书。
collocations: decline to do｜婉拒做 ; a decline in｜……的下降
tip_zh: decline 比 refuse 更客气。也可作名词。

definition_en: a person travelling in a vehicle
example1_en: The passenger waited for the late bus.
example2_en: A passenger who cannot stand needs a seat, not only a slogan.
example2_zh: 不能站着的乘客需要一个座位，而不只是一句口号。
collocations: a passenger on｜……上的乘客
tip_zh: passenger 可数。

definition_en: a piece of writing, a thing, or a/an/the
example1_en: I read an article about school buses.
example1_zh: 我读了一篇关于校车的文章。
example2_en: An article without a named source is hard to trust, however smooth the sentences are.
example2_zh: 没有署名来源的文章很难信任，无论句子多么流畅。
collocations: an article of｜一件
tip_zh: article 也可指语法里的冠词 a、an、the。

definition_en: to be on one's feet, or to bear
example1_en: Please stand in line.
example2_en: A small shop cannot stand a year of road works that stop customers reaching the door.
example2_zh: 一家小店受不了一整年让顾客到不了门口的道路施工。
collocations: stand up｜起立 ; stand for｜代表
tip_zh: stand 的过去式和过去分词是 stood。

definition_en: one part in every hundred
example1_en: About twenty percent of the class walks to school.
example1_zh: 大约百分之二十的学生步行上学。
example2_en: A ten percent rise in rent can push a family farther from the school they chose.
example2_zh: 房租上涨百分之十，就能把一个家庭推得离他们选择的学校更远。
collocations: percent of｜……的百分之
tip_zh: percent 常与数字连用。英式也写作 per cent。

definition_en: a custom that has existed for a long time
example1_en: The dance is a school tradition.
example1_zh: 这个舞蹈是学校的传统。
example2_en: A tradition can change when the market no longer sells the old grain.
example2_zh: 当市场不再卖那种老谷物时，传统也可以变。
collocations: by tradition｜按照传统
tip_zh: 形容词 traditional 已在本库。

definition_en: in place of something else
example1_en: We walked instead of taking the bus.
example1_zh: 我们没有坐公交，而是走路。
example2_en: Planting trees instead of only widening roads can cool a street and slow the rain.
example2_zh: 种树而不是只拓宽道路，可以给街道降温，并减缓雨水。
collocations: instead of｜而不是
tip_zh: instead 可放句首或句末；instead of 后接名词或 doing。

definition_en: of the Atlantic Ocean
example1_en: The map colours the Atlantic in blue.
example1_zh: 地图把大西洋涂成蓝色。
example2_en: A lesson about the Atlantic should name the coasts, not only the water.
example2_zh: 关于大西洋的课应当写到海岸，而不只是水。
collocations: the Atlantic｜大西洋 ; the Atlantic Ocean｜大西洋
tip_zh: Atlantic 作海洋名要大写。

definition_en: used for obligation or a strong guess
example1_en: You must wear glasses in the lab.
example1_zh: 在实验室里你必须戴眼镜。
example2_en: A public promise must be followed by a date and a person responsible, or it is only a sentence.
example2_zh: 一项公开承诺必须跟上日期和负责人，否则就只是一句话。
collocations: must be｜一定是 ; must not｜禁止
tip_zh: must not 表示禁止；不必是 don't have to 或 needn't。

definition_en: the space above the earth
example1_en: The sky cleared after lunch.
example2_en: A dark sky at noon is a reason to send the team indoors, not to wait for rain on the pitch.
example2_zh: 正午的阴天是让队伍进室内的理由，而不是在场上等雨。
collocations: in the sky｜在空中
tip_zh: sky 通常用 the sky。文学里可用 skies。

definition_en: a person who owns something
example1_en: The owner of the shop knows every student.
example2_en: The owner of a rented room and the student who lives there may want different repairs.
example2_zh: 出租房的主人和住在里面的学生，想修的东西可能不一样。
collocations: shop owner｜店主
tip_zh: owner 是人。所有权是 ownership。

definition_en: physical power, or a good quality
example1_en: Reading is her strength in English.
example1_zh: 阅读是她英语上的强项。
example2_en: The strength of a team is not the fastest runner if nobody passes the ball.
example2_zh: 如果没人传球，队伍的力量就不是跑得最快的那个人。
collocations: strengths and weaknesses｜优缺点
tip_zh: strength 是 strong 的名词。优点常用复数 strengths。

definition_en: a drop of salty water from the eye
example1_en: A tear ran down her face, and then she asked for help.
example1_zh: 一滴眼泪从她脸上落下，然后她求了助。
example2_en: Do not tear the notice off the board before the class has read it.
example2_zh: 在班级读完之前，不要把通知从板上撕下来。
collocations: in tears｜哭着 ; tear up｜撕碎
tip_zh: 名词眼泪读 /tɪə/。动词“撕”读 /teə/。两个意思都常用。

definition_en: a country's military ships and the people who work on them
example1_en: The museum has a room about the navy.
example1_zh: 博物馆有一个关于海军的展室。
example2_en: A chapter on the navy should also say who built the ships.
example2_zh: 写海军的一章也应当说是谁造的船。
collocations: navy blue｜藏青色
tip_zh: navy 前常用 the。navy blue 是藏青色。本条不写军事操作。

meanings_zh: adj. 简短的 | v. 向……介绍情况 | n. 任务说明；工作要求
definition_en: short in time or words | To give someone essential information or instructions. | Instructions explaining what a task should achieve.
example1_en: Give a brief summary.
example2_en: Teachers should brief students on safety procedures before allowing them to conduct experiments independently.
example2_zh: 教师应先向学生介绍安全操作规程，再允许他们独立进行实验。
collocations: a brief summary｜简要总结 ; a brief pause｜短暂停顿 ; brief someone on｜向某人介绍……的情况 ; a design brief｜设计任务说明
tip_zh: brief指时间短或内容简洁，本身不表示草率。

definition_en: extra money or an extra good thing
example1_en: The shorter walk is a bonus, not the reason.
example1_zh: 路程变短是额外的好处，不是理由。
example2_en: A bonus for the canteen staff should not come from cutting the students' meal.
example2_zh: 给食堂职工的奖金，不应当来自削减学生的那一餐。
collocations: a bonus for｜给……的奖金
tip_zh: bonus 可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 慢的 | v. 放慢
definition_en: not fast | to become slower or make something slower
example1_en: The slow bus still gets us there before class.
example1_zh: 这趟慢车仍能在上课前把我们送到。
example2_en: A slow reader may understand a poem more deeply than a classmate who only finishes first.
example2_zh: 读得慢的人，可能比只求最先读完的同学更懂一首诗。
collocations: slow down｜减速
tip_zh: slow 作动词是使变慢。表里这一行的音标是 sleep，本库不用。

definition_en: a long thin piece of wood or metal
example1_en: The pole by the gate holds the light.
example2_en: A loose pole at the crossing should be reported the same day.
example2_zh: 路口松动的杆子应当当天报告。
collocations: a pole of｜一根杆
tip_zh: pole 也可指地极，如 the North Pole。

definition_en: the only one of its kind
example1_en: Each student has a unique way of taking notes.
example1_zh: 每个学生记笔记的方式都不一样。
example2_en: A unique old tree in the schoolyard cannot be replaced by ten young ones in a plan.
example2_zh: 校园里一棵独一无二的老树，不能用规划里的十棵小树代替。
collocations: unique to｜为……所独有
tip_zh: unique 已经表示“唯一”，一般不再用 very 修饰。

definition_en: a box or bag that has been wrapped
example1_en: The package arrived at the office.
example2_en: A package for a student should not be opened on a public desk.
example2_zh: 给学生的包裹不应当在公共桌子上拆开。
collocations: a package of｜一包
tip_zh: package 也可指一套方案。pack 是本批的动词。

definition_en: at the end, after some time
example1_en: We eventually found the key in the lab coat.
example1_zh: 我们终于在实验服里找到了钥匙。
example2_en: A town that plants trees eventually feels the shade, but the first class of students may not.
example2_zh: 种树的城镇最终会享受到树荫，但第一届学生可能等不到。
collocations: eventually succeed｜最终成功
tip_zh: eventually 强调经过一段时间之后，不表示“可能”。

definition_en: a mistake, or responsibility for something bad
example1_en: The fault was in the timetable, not in the class.
example2_en: Finding fault with a student is easier than fixing the broken step.
example2_zh: 挑学生的错，比修好破台阶容易。
collocations: find fault with｜挑剔 ; be at fault｜有过错
tip_zh: It is my fault 表示是我的错。fault 也可指地质断层。

definition_en: each one in a group, seen as a whole
example1_en: Every student has a chance to speak.
example1_zh: 每个学生都有发言的机会。
example2_en: Every extra degree of summer heat makes it harder to keep classrooms comfortable without more energy.
example2_zh: 夏天每升高一度，都让教室在不增加能耗的情况下更难保持舒适。
collocations: every day｜每天 ; every other day｜每隔一天
tip_zh: every 后接单数名词；every day 是短语，everyday 是形容词“日常的”。

definition_en: a short group of words
example1_en: The phrase is on the board.
example2_en: A phrase in an ad can hide the fee if nobody asks what it means.
example2_zh: 广告里的一个说法，如果没人追问，就能把费用藏起来。
collocations: a phrase of｜一个……短语
tip_zh: phrase 可数。

definition_en: to some degree, or completely
example1_en: The room is quite quiet after four.
example1_zh: 四点以后房间相当安静。
example2_en: A cycle lane that is quite short still helps if it crosses the most dangerous junction.
example2_zh: 一段相当短的自行车道，如果穿过最危险的路口，仍然有帮助。
collocations: quite a few｜不少 ; quite a lot｜相当多
tip_zh: quite a + 形容词 + 名词：quite a long walk。不说 a quite long walk。

meanings_zh: adj. 心烦的 | v. 使心烦；弄翻
definition_en: unhappy or worried | to make someone unhappy, or to knock something over
example1_en: He was upset about the broken window.
example1_zh: 他对打碎的窗户感到心烦。
example2_en: An upset parent needs a clear time, not only a closed office.
example2_zh: 心烦的家长需要一个明确的时间，而不只是一间关着的办公室。
collocations: be upset about｜为……不安
tip_zh: upset 作动词是使心烦或弄翻，过去式仍是 upset。形容词和动词重音常在后。

definition_en: with little noise
example1_en: The library is quiet after four.
example1_zh: 四点以后图书馆很安静。
example2_en: A quiet street is not safe if the crossing has no light.
example2_zh: 如果路口没有灯，安静的街道也不安全。
collocations: keep quiet｜保持安静
tip_zh: quiet 也可作动词“使安静”，名词“安静”。

definition_en: to put something with something else
example1_en: Add your name at the bottom.
example2_en: Cities that add lanes without adding buses often add cars as well.
example2_zh: 只加车道不加公交的城市，往往也增加了汽车。
collocations: add to｜增加 ; add up｜加起来
tip_zh: add A to B 表示把 A 加到 B 上。

definition_en: something that is known to be true
example1_en: In fact, the library opens at eight.
example1_zh: 事实上，图书馆八点开门。
example2_en: A fact about air pollution should be separated from an opinion about who is to blame.
example2_zh: 关于空气污染的事实，应该和谁该受责备的看法分开。
collocations: in fact｜事实上 ; as a matter of fact｜事实上
tip_zh: fact 是可数名词。the fact that 后接从句。

definition_en: the direction between north and east
example1_en: The wind came from the north-east.
example2_en: Schools in the north-east may need longer heating, which raises the winter cost.
example2_zh: 东北的学校可能需要更长的供暖，这会提高冬天的费用。
collocations: in the north-east｜在东北
tip_zh: north-east 也可写作 northeast。

definition_en: pleasant or kind
example1_en: It was nice of you to wait for me.
example2_en: A nice park on a map is not enough if the path to it is dark and unsafe at night.
example2_zh: 地图上一个好看的公园不够，如果去那里的路夜里又黑又不安全。
collocations: be nice to｜对……友好 ; nice and｜很
tip_zh: It is nice of sb to do 表扬某人的善意。

definition_en: official permission, or a good opinion
example1_en: The trip needs approval from the office.
example1_zh: 这次出行需要办公室批准。
example2_en: Approval that arrives after the bus has left helps nobody.
example2_zh: 公交已经开走之后才到的批准，谁也帮不了。
collocations: approval of｜对……的批准 ; give approval｜批准
tip_zh: approval 通常不可数。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

meanings_zh: n. 赞扬 | v. 表扬
definition_en: words that say someone did well | to say that someone did well
example1_en: Praise for the quiet student was public.
example1_zh: 对那位安静学生的赞扬是公开的。
example2_en: Praise that names only scores misses the student who kept the library open.
example2_zh: 只提分数的赞扬，会漏掉那个让图书馆一直开着的学生。
collocations: praise for｜对……的赞扬 ; praise sb for｜因……赞扬某人
tip_zh: praise 作动词是表扬。通常不可数。

definition_en: a feeling of happiness, or something that causes it
example1_en: It was a pleasure to meet the class.
example1_zh: 见到这个班是一件愉快的事。
example2_en: Pleasure in a win should still leave room to thank the person who passed the ball.
example2_zh: 胜利的愉快仍然应当留出位置，去谢谢那个传球的人。
collocations: with pleasure｜乐意 ; take pleasure in｜以……为乐
tip_zh: It is a pleasure 是客套。表里这一行的音标是 pleased，本库不用。

definition_en: a small bag sewn into clothes
example1_en: The key is in my pocket.
example2_en: A pocket dictionary helps on the bus, and it does not replace the library.
example2_zh: 袖珍词典在公交上有用，它代替不了图书馆。
collocations: pocket money｜零花钱 ; in one pocket｜在口袋里
tip_zh: pocket 作形容词可指袖珍的。

definition_en: soon
example1_en: The bus will leave shortly.
example2_en: Shortly after the rain, the same two classrooms flood.
example2_zh: 雨后不久，同样的两间教室进水。
collocations: shortly after｜在……之后不久
tip_zh: shortly 是副词。short 是形容词。

definition_en: the coloured part of a plant
example1_en: The flower by the gate is open.
example2_en: A flower on the desk does not replace watering the school garden.
example2_zh: 桌上的一朵花代替不了给学校园子浇水。
collocations: a bunch of flowers｜一束花
tip_zh: flower 可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 总的；完全的 | n. 总数 | v. 合计
definition_en: complete, or including everything | the whole amount | to add up to
example1_en: The total cost is eighty yuan.
example2_en: A total ban on cars near schools works only if buses can carry the same children.
example2_zh: 学校附近全面禁车，只有在公交能运送同样的孩子时才行得通。
collocations: in total｜总共 ; a total of｜总共
tip_zh: total 作动词是“合计”。

definition_en: a member of an army
example1_en: The museum shows a soldier's letter from 1940.
example1_zh: 博物馆展示一封 1940 年的士兵来信。
example2_en: A history of soldiers should also say who grew the food they ate.
example2_zh: 士兵的历史也应当写是谁种了他们吃的粮食。
collocations: a soldier in｜……的士兵
tip_zh: soldier 可数。本条不写作战方法。

definition_en: to show, or to throw back light
example1_en: The mirror reflects the clock.
example2_en: The timetable should reflect the last bus, not an old hope.
example2_zh: 课表应当反映末班车，而不是一个旧的希望。
collocations: reflect on｜思考
tip_zh: reflect on 表示思考。

definition_en: forward movement or improvement
example1_en: She has made progress in listening.
example2_en: Real progress in a weak subject is often slower than a single high mark suggests.
example2_zh: 薄弱科目上的真正进步，往往比一次高分所显示的更慢。
collocations: make progress｜取得进步 ; in progress｜在进行中
tip_zh: progress 作名词不可数，不说 a progress。动词重音常在后。

meanings_zh: adj. 官方的；正式的 | n. 官员
definition_en: approved by an authority | a person with a public position
example1_en: Wait for the official notice before you change the date.
example1_zh: 改日期之前请等官方通知。
example2_en: An official report that hides bad numbers does not help a town prepare for the next flood.
example2_zh: 隐瞒糟糕数字的官方报告，帮不了一个城镇为下一次洪水做准备。
collocations: official language｜官方语言
tip_zh: official 作名词是“官员”。

meanings_zh: adj. 非洲的 | n. 非洲人
definition_en: of Africa | a person from Africa
example1_en: The map shows African rivers in blue.
example1_zh: 地图上非洲的河用蓝色标出。
example2_en: An African writer on the reading list gives the class a voice that a single textbook chapter may miss.
example2_zh: 阅读清单上的非洲作家，能给班级一个课本里一章可能错过的声音。
collocations: African country｜非洲国家
tip_zh: African 作形容词和名词都要大写。名词指非洲人。

definition_en: before Christ, used with years
example1_en: The map marks the year 200 BC.
example1_zh: 地图标着公元前 200 年。
example2_en: A timeline that says 200 BC should also say how we know.
example2_zh: 写着公元前 200 年的时间线，也应当说明我们是怎么知道的。
collocations: 200 BC｜公元前 200 年
tip_zh: BC 表示公元前，放在年份后面。与 pc 不是同一个缩写。

definition_en: having a big effect or value
example1_en: It is important to write the date on the form.
example1_zh: 在表格上写日期很重要。
example2_en: Clean drinking water is more important to a growing town than another bright shopping sign.
example2_zh: 对一个发展中的城镇来说，干净的饮用水比又一块闪亮的商店招牌更重要。
collocations: be important to｜对……重要 ; more important｜更重要
tip_zh: It is important for sb to do，不要漏掉 for 或 to。

definition_en: a room or building where art is shown
example1_en: The gallery is free on Sunday.
example2_en: A gallery that closes before the last bus has already chosen its visitors.
example2_zh: 在末班车之前就关门的画廊，其实已经选定了它的观众。
collocations: an art gallery｜美术馆
tip_zh: gallery 也可指楼座。

definition_en: very unpleasant
example1_en: The smell from the bin was disgusting.
example2_en: Calling a person disgusting is not a joke the class should keep.
example2_zh: 说一个人令人厌恶，不是班级该保留的笑话。
collocations: a disgusting smell｜令人厌恶的气味
tip_zh: disgusting 可以形容事物。用在人身上会伤人。

meanings_zh: n. 脂肪 | adj. 胖的；肥的
definition_en: an oily substance in food and in the body | having a lot of flesh or oil
example1_en: This soup has less fat than the fried dish.
example1_zh: 这汤比那道油炸菜脂肪少。
example2_en: Health class should talk about fat in food without mocking how a classmate looks.
example2_zh: 健康课应当讨论食物里的脂肪，而不是嘲笑同学的样子。
collocations: body fat｜体脂 ; low in fat｜低脂
tip_zh: fat 作形容词是“胖的；肥的”。描述人时要注意礼貌。

meanings_zh: v. 行进；游行 | n. 行进；三月（March）
definition_en: to walk with regular steps, often in a group | a walk by a group, or the third month when capitalised
example1_en: The band will march onto the field.
example2_en: People march when a decision about their street is made without asking them.
example2_zh: 当关于他们街道的决定没有询问他们就做出时，人们会游行。
collocations: on the march｜在行进中
tip_zh: March 大写是三月；march 小写是行进。不要在句子里混用大小写。

definition_en: related to the spirit or to religion
example1_en: The song had a spiritual meaning for some students.
example1_zh: 这首歌对一些学生有精神上的意义。
example2_en: A school can discuss spiritual life without choosing one faith for everyone.
example2_zh: 学校可以讨论精神生活，而不为每个人选定一种信仰。
collocations: spiritual life｜精神生活
tip_zh: spirit 已在本库。spiritual 不是“含酒精的”，那是 spirits 的另一个意思，本条不用。

definition_en: the act of selling
example1_en: The book sale is on Friday.
example2_en: The sale of public land beside a school should not ignore the playground it replaces.
example2_zh: 出售学校旁边的公共土地，不该忽略它取代的操场。
collocations: for sale｜待售 ; on sale｜减价出售
tip_zh: for sale 是待售；on sale 常指降价。

definition_en: at any time, or every time
example1_en: Come whenever you are free.
example2_en: Whenever the river rises, the same two classrooms flood first.
example2_zh: 每当河水上涨，同样的两间教室最先进水。
collocations: whenever possible｜只要可能
tip_zh: whenever 引导时间从句。口语里也可表示“究竟什么时候”。

meanings_zh: v. 预订；保留 | n. 储备；保护区
definition_en: to keep something for a particular person or purpose | a supply kept back, or a protected area
example1_en: Please reserve two seats on the bus.
example1_zh: 请在公交上订两个座位。
example2_en: A library that can reserve a book for a student who lives far away is doing its job.
example2_zh: 能为住得远的学生留一本书的图书馆，是在做它的工作。
collocations: in reserve｜备用 ; nature reserve｜自然保护区
tip_zh: reserve 作名词是储备或保护区。预订的名词常用 reservation。

definition_en: the last part
example1_en: The ending of the story surprised us.
example1_zh: 故事的结局让我们吃惊。
example2_en: A happy ending in a film about a flood can hide the work that comes after the water leaves.
example2_zh: 洪水电影里的快乐结局，可能掩盖水退之后还要做的工作。
collocations: a happy ending｜快乐的结局 ; ending of｜……的结尾
tip_zh: ending 是名词。动词结束用 end。

meanings_zh: v. 支持；供养 | n. 支持
