definition_en: to agree with and help, or to provide what is needed | help or approval
example1_en: Our class supports the book-sharing plan.
example1_zh: 我们班支持图书共享计划。
example2_en: Parents cannot support a long school day if the buses stop before the last lesson ends.
example2_zh: 如果公交车在最后一节课结束前就停运，父母就无法支持过长的在校时间。
collocations: in support of｜支持 ; support sb in｜在某方面支持
tip_zh: support 是及物动词，后面直接接宾语，不加 to。

definition_en: a building where people live
example1_en: Their house is next to the post office.
example1_zh: 他们的房子在邮局旁边。
example2_en: A house built on cheap wetland may cost less at first and much more after the first flood.
example2_zh: 建在廉价湿地上的房子，起初可能更便宜，第一次洪水之后却贵得多。
collocations: housewife｜家庭主妇 ; in the house｜在房子里
tip_zh: house 是建筑物；home 是家的感觉或所在。

definition_en: an idea or feeling about something
example1_en: The first impression was the broken clock.
example2_en: An impression is not a measurement.
example2_zh: 印象不是测量。
collocations: first impression｜第一印象 ; make an impression｜留下印象
tip_zh: impression 可数。

definition_en: a polite word for a woman
example1_en: The lady at the desk helped us.
example1_zh: 柜台的女士帮助了我们。
example2_en: A lady who works the night shift still needs a safe way home.
example2_zh: 上夜班的女士仍然需要一条安全的回家路。
collocations: ladies and gentlemen｜女士们先生们
tip_zh: lady 的复数是 ladies。正式场合可用，但 woman 更中性。

definition_en: a large musical instrument with keys
example1_en: The piano is in the hall.
example2_en: A piano that nobody may touch teaches less than ten minutes of practice.
example2_zh: 谁也不许碰的钢琴，比十分钟练习教得少。
collocations: play the piano｜弹钢琴
tip_zh: play the piano 要加 the。

definition_en: a game played by two teams kicking a ball; American name
example1_en: Soccer practice is at four.
example2_en: In this atlas, soccer is the same game many students call football.
example2_zh: 在本库里，soccer 就是许多学生称为 football 的那场运动。
collocations: play soccer｜踢足球
tip_zh: 英式足球在美国常叫 soccer。football 已在本库。play soccer 不加 the。

definition_en: to decide after thinking; to end
example1_en: We can conclude that practice helps.
example1_zh: 我们可以得出结论：练习有帮助。

meanings_zh: v. 影响 | v. 使感动；使悲伤
definition_en: to have an influence on | to cause someone to feel a strong emotion
example1_en: Noise can affect your ability to sleep.
example1_zh: 噪音会影响你的睡眠能力。
example2_en: Rising food prices disproportionately affect poorer households, which spend a larger share of their income on essentials.
example2_zh: 食品价格上涨对较贫困家庭的影响尤为严重，因为必需品支出占其收入的比例更大。
collocations: affect health｜影响健康 ; adversely affect｜产生不利影响 ; deeply affect someone｜深深触动某人 ; affect performance｜影响表现
tip_zh: 表示“影响”时affect是动词，effect通常是名词。

meanings_zh: v. 响；打电话 | n. 铃声；戒指；环
definition_en: to make a bell sound, or to call by phone | a sound of a bell, or a circle of metal
example1_en: The bell will ring in two minutes.
example2_en: Please ring the office if the bus has not left by four.
example2_zh: 如果公交四点还没走，请给办公室打电话。
collocations: ring sb up｜给某人打电话 ; give sb a ring｜给某人打电话
tip_zh: ring 的过去式是 rang，过去分词是 rung。作名词还可指戒指或环形物。

definition_en: a place where people buy and sell
example1_en: We buy fruit at the morning market.
example2_en: A local market keeps money in the town, while a distant supermarket sends it away.
example2_zh: 本地市场把钱留在镇上，而远处的超市把钱送走。
collocations: on the market｜在出售 ; market price｜市场价格
tip_zh: market 作动词是“推销”。

meanings_zh: n. 优势；有利条件 | n. 好处；益处
definition_en: something that helps you | A useful or positive feature of something.
example1_en: Speaking two languages is an advantage.
example1_zh: 会说两种语言是一种优势。
example2_en: One major advantage of public transport is its ability to reduce traffic congestion in urban areas.
example2_zh: 公共交通的一大好处是能够缓解城市地区的交通拥堵。
collocations: competitive advantage｜竞争优势 ; have an advantage over｜比……有优势 ; take advantage of｜利用；占……便宜 ; a major advantage｜一大优势
tip_zh: take advantage of可指利用机会，也可指占人便宜。

meanings_zh: n. 烟 | v. 冒烟；吸烟
definition_en: the cloud produced by something burning | to produce smoke, or to breathe in smoke from a cigarette
example1_en: Smoke from the lab set off the alarm.
example1_zh: 实验室的烟触发了警报。
example2_en: The school rule says students must not smoke, and it also says where adults may stand.
example2_zh: 校规写明学生不得吸烟，也写明成年人可以站在哪里。
collocations: smoke alarm｜烟雾警报器
tip_zh: smoke 作动词是冒烟或吸烟。表里这一行的音标是 smile，本库不用。

definition_en: a group of things of the same type
example1_en: Put the books in the right category.
example2_en: A category called other often hides the students the form forgot.
example2_zh: 名为“其他”的类别，常常藏着表格忘掉的学生。
collocations: fall into a category｜属于一类
tip_zh: category 可数。复数 categories。

definition_en: a raised area of land, smaller than a mountain
example1_en: The path goes over a low hill.
example1_zh: 这条小路翻过一座矮山。
example2_en: Houses on a steep hill need a plan for rain before the path becomes a stream.
example2_zh: 陡坡上的房子需要在小路变成溪流之前就有下雨的方案。
collocations: up the hill｜上山
tip_zh: hill 比 mountain 小。山脚用 at the foot of the hill。

meanings_zh: v. 骑自行车 | n. 循环；自行车
definition_en: to ride a bicycle | a series that repeats, or a bicycle
example1_en: I cycle to school when it is dry.
example1_zh: 天气干的时候我骑自行车上学。
example2_en: A safe place to cycle matters as much as a lesson about the environment.
example2_zh: 一个能安全骑车的地方，和一节关于环境的课一样重要。
collocations: cycle to｜骑车去 ; cycle lane｜自行车道
tip_zh: cycle 作名词可以是自行车，也可以是循环。

meanings_zh: adj. 晚的；迟到的 | adv. 晚
definition_en: after the expected time | after the right time
example1_en: I was late because the bus did not come.
example1_zh: 我迟到了，因为公交没来。
example2_en: Late buses leave students waiting in the dark, which is a safety problem as well as a delay.
example2_zh: 晚点的公交让学生在黑暗中等待，这既是延误，也是安全问题。
collocations: be late for｜……迟到 ; later on｜后来
tip_zh: late 可作形容词或副词。lately 是“最近”，不是“迟到地”。

meanings_zh: n. 首都；大写字母；资本 | adj. 大写的；资本的
definition_en: the main city, a large letter, or money for business | of a large letter, or of money
example1_en: Beijing is the capital of China.
example2_en: Write the capital letter at the start of the sentence, and check the name of the city.
example2_zh: 句首要写大写字母，并核对城市的名字。
collocations: capital letter｜大写字母 ; capital city｜首都
tip_zh: capital 的三个常见义是首都、大写和资本，要看搭配。

meanings_zh: n. 负荷；一车货物 | v. 装载
definition_en: something heavy that is carried | to put a load onto something
example1_en: The load was too heavy for one person.
example2_en: A lighter load of homework before a match does not lower the standard of the term.
example2_zh: 比赛前少一点作业，并不会降低整个学期的标准。
collocations: a load of｜许多；一车 ; loads of｜大量
tip_zh: load 作动词是装载。workload 是工作量。

definition_en: how old someone is, or a period of history
example1_en: What is the age of the oldest student in the club?
example1_zh: 社团里年龄最大的学生几岁？
example2_en: In an age of cheap photos, it is harder to know which picture shows a real event.
example2_zh: 在照片便宜的时代，更难知道哪张照片展示的是真事。
collocations: at the age of｜在……岁时 ; for ages｜很久
tip_zh: at the age of 后接数字。同龄用 of the same age。

definition_en: a sweet baked food
example1_en: The cake is for the class, not for one person.
example1_zh: 蛋糕是给全班的，不是给一个人的。
example2_en: A cake at a school fair should list nuts on the label.
example2_zh: 学校义卖上的蛋糕应当在标签上写明坚果。
collocations: a piece of cake｜一块蛋糕；很容易的事
tip_zh: a piece of cake 也可比喻很容易。cake 作一块时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 照片 | v. 拍照
definition_en: a picture made with a camera | to take a photograph
example1_en: The photograph is on the wall.
example2_en: A photograph of a student should not be posted without permission.
example2_zh: 学生的照片不应当未经允许发布。
collocations: a photograph of｜一张……的照片
tip_zh: photographer 是本批的另一词。photograph 作动词是拍照。

definition_en: careful thought
example1_en: Cost is one consideration.
example2_en: Consideration for the night worker belongs in the bus plan.
example2_zh: 对夜班工人的考虑应当写进公交计划。
collocations: take into consideration｜考虑到 ; consideration for｜对……的体谅
tip_zh: 动词 consider 已在本库。

meanings_zh: n. 声音 | v. 听起来 | adj. 健康的；合理的
definition_en: something that can be heard | to seem when heard | in good condition, or sensible
example1_en: I heard a sound in the hall.
example2_en: The sound of night traffic keeps students awake even when the classroom itself is quiet.
example2_zh: 夜间交通的声音会让学生睡不着，即使教室本身很安静。
collocations: sound like｜听起来像 ; safe and sound｜安然无恙
tip_zh: sound 作连系动词后接形容词：sound good，不接 well 表示“听起来好”（身体好除外）。

definition_en: a unit of weight
example1_en: The truck carried a ton of rice.
example2_en: A ton on a poster is not a measurement until someone writes the method.
example2_zh: 海报上的“一吨”在有人写下方法之前还不是测量。
collocations: a ton of｜一吨；大量
tip_zh: a ton of 口语里也可表示大量。表里这一行的音标是 tomorrow，本库不用。

meanings_zh: n. 兴趣；利益 | v. 使感兴趣
definition_en: a wish to know more, or an advantage | to make someone want to know more
example1_en: She has an interest in local history.
example2_en: A company interest in cheap land is not the same as a town interest in clean water.
example2_zh: 公司对廉价土地的利益，不等于城镇对干净水的利益。
collocations: lose interest｜失去兴趣 ; in the interest of｜为了
tip_zh: interesting 修饰事物；interested 修饰人。

meanings_zh: v. 收费；充电；指控 | n. 费用；收费 | v. 给……充电
definition_en: to ask for money; to accuse | An amount of money requested for goods or services. | Put electrical energy into a battery or device.
example1_en: Hotels often charge extra for breakfast.
example1_zh: 酒店常对早餐额外收费。
example2_en: Museums that charge admission fees should offer discounts to ensure that students can still access cultural resources.
example2_zh: 收取门票的博物馆应提供优惠，以确保学生仍能享用文化资源。
collocations: charge a fee｜收取费用 ; free of charge｜免费 ; charge a battery｜给电池充电 ; in charge of｜负责；掌管
tip_zh: 向某人收取某项费用：charge someone for something。

definition_en: no longer alive
example1_en: The plant is dead because nobody watered it.
example1_zh: 这棵植物死了，因为没人浇水。
example2_en: A river that looks dead in summer may recover if factories stop pouring waste at night.
example2_zh: 夏天看起来死气沉沉的河，如果工厂停止夜里排污，仍可能恢复。
collocations: dead tired｜累极了
tip_zh: dead 是形容词；die 是动词；death 是名词。

meanings_zh: v. 意思是；意味着 | adj. 吝啬的；刻薄的
definition_en: to have a particular meaning, or to intend | not generous, or unkind
example1_en: What does this word mean in the passage?
example1_zh: 这个词在文章里是什么意思？
example2_en: A low score does not mean a student cannot learn; it may mean the test ignored what they can do.
example2_zh: 低分并不意味着学生学不会；它可能意味着考试忽略了他们会做的事。
collocations: mean to do｜打算做 ; mean doing｜意味着 ; I mean｜我的意思是
tip_zh: mean to do 是打算；mean doing 是意味着。

definition_en: images during sleep, or a strong hope
example1_en: Her dream is to study medicine.
example2_en: A school that only praises high scores can make a quieter dream look less serious than it is.
example2_zh: 只夸奖高分的学校，会让一个较安静的梦想显得不够重要。
collocations: dream of｜梦想 ; a dream come true｜梦想成真
tip_zh: dream 作动词是“做梦”或“梦想”，后常接 of doing。

definition_en: the smallest unit of a living thing, or a small room
example1_en: We drew a plant cell in biology.
example1_zh: 我们在生物课上画了植物细胞。
example2_en: A biology lesson on the cell is clearer when students can compare it with a room in a building.
example2_zh: 如果学生能把细胞和楼里的一个房间相比，这一课会更清楚。
collocations: cell phone｜手机 ; prison cell｜牢房
tip_zh: cell 在生物课是细胞，在监狱语境是单人牢房。手机是 cell phone。

definition_en: happening at even times, or usual
example1_en: She takes a regular bus at seven.
example1_zh: 她七点坐固定的一班公交。
example2_en: Regular sleep helps attention more than one long night of revision.
example2_zh: 规律的睡眠比考前熬一个长夜更有助于注意力。
collocations: on a regular basis｜定期 ; regular customer｜常客
tip_zh: regular 的副词是 regularly。

definition_en: of the Pacific Ocean
example1_en: The map colours the Pacific in blue.
example1_zh: 地图把太平洋涂成蓝色。
example2_en: A lesson about the Pacific should name the coasts, not only the water.
example2_zh: 关于太平洋的课应当写到海岸，而不只是水。
collocations: the Pacific｜太平洋 ; the Pacific Ocean｜太平洋
tip_zh: Pacific 作海洋名要大写。作形容词“和平的”时可以小写，本条用考纲里的太平洋义。

meanings_zh: v. 打开；开业 | adj. 开着的；公开的
definition_en: to make something not closed, or to start a business | not closed, or public
example1_en: Open the window if the room feels hot.
example1_zh: 如果房间闷，就把窗户打开。
example2_en: Shops that open late help workers who cannot buy food before their shift ends.
example2_zh: 营业到很晚的商店，帮助那些下班前买不到食物的工人。
collocations: open up｜打开；开创 ; in the open｜在户外
tip_zh: open 作形容词是“开着的”；be open 表示状态，不要说 be opened 表示日常开着。

definition_en: in or to another country
example1_en: Her uncle works abroad.
example2_en: News from abroad should still name the source.
example2_zh: 来自国外的新闻仍然应当写明来源。
collocations: go abroad｜出国 ; at home and abroad｜国内外
tip_zh: abroad 是副词，前面不加 in。

definition_en: in or of the south
example1_en: The southern gate is closer to the bus stop.
example2_en: Southern cities face long summers, so school timetables may start earlier in the day.
example2_zh: 南方城市夏天很长，所以课程表可能把课排得更早。
collocations: southern China｜中国南方
tip_zh: southern 是形容词。名词用 south。

meanings_zh: v. 获得；增加 | n. 收益；增加
definition_en: to get something wanted or useful | something gained
example1_en: She hopes to gain experience in the library.
example1_zh: 她希望在图书馆获得经验。
example2_en: A city can gain parks and still lose old trees if the plan only counts new ones.
example2_zh: 如果方案只计算新种的树，一座城市可以新增公园，同时失去老树。
collocations: gain experience｜获得经验
tip_zh: gain 强调经过努力得到。也可作名词“收益”。

definition_en: matching the facts
example1_en: Is it true that the museum is free today?
example1_zh: 博物馆今天免费，这是真的吗？
example2_en: A story can sound true and still leave out the people who were harmed.
example2_zh: 一个故事可以听起来真实，却仍然漏掉受到伤害的人。
collocations: come true｜实现 ; true to｜忠实于
tip_zh: come true 的主语是梦想或预言，不用被动。true 强调符合事实。

definition_en: a system or a set for watching broadcasts
example1_en: They watched the match on television.
example1_zh: 他们在电视上看了比赛。
example2_en: Television can show a distant classroom, and it still cannot ask the student a question.
example2_zh: 电视可以展示一间遥远的教室，它仍然不能向学生提问。
collocations: on television｜在电视上 ; television set｜电视机
tip_zh: television 是全称，TV 已在本库。表里这一行的音标是 telegraph，本库不用。

definition_en: an alcoholic drink made from grain
example1_en: The school fair does not sell beer.
example2_en: A town festival that offers beer should also offer a clear rule for students under age.
example2_zh: 提供啤酒的城镇节日，也应当给未成年学生一条清楚的规定。
collocations: a glass of beer｜一杯啤酒
tip_zh: beer 作种类时可数：a beer。学校场景里它是成人饮料，不是给学生的奖品。

definition_en: to be present at, or to look after
example1_en: All students attend the morning meeting.
example2_en: Students who cannot attend still need the notes the same day.
example2_zh: 不能出席的学生，当天仍然需要笔记。
collocations: attend a meeting｜出席会议 ; attend to｜处理；照料
tip_zh: attend 后直接接活动，不加 to 表示出席。attend to 才是处理或照料。

definition_en: related to the skills of a particular subject
example1_en: The manual is too technical for the first week.
example1_zh: 这份说明书对第一周来说太技术化了。
example2_en: A technical fault in the exam system should not be recorded as a student mistake.
example2_zh: 考试系统的技术故障不应当记成学生的错误。
collocations: technical problem｜技术问题
tip_zh: technical 是形容词。名词技术常用 technology 或 technique。

definition_en: a strong feeling of being angry
example1_en: His anger did not fix the clock.
example2_en: Anger at a late bus is fair, and a written time is more useful.
example2_zh: 对晚点公交的愤怒是合理的，写下来的时间更有用。
collocations: in anger｜愤怒地
tip_zh: angry 已在本库。anger 是名词，通常不可数。

definition_en: the act of sharing information
example1_en: Clear communication saved the trip.
example1_zh: 清楚的沟通救了这次出行。
example2_en: Communication between the school and the bus company should not depend on one phone.
example2_zh: 学校和公交公司之间的沟通不应当只靠一部电话。
collocations: means of communication｜通讯方式
tip_zh: communication 通常不可数。a communication 可指一封正式函件。

definition_en: a feeling that worry has gone, or help for people in trouble
example1_en: It was a relief when the bus arrived.
example1_zh: 公交到了，大家松了一口气。
example2_en: Flood relief should include a dry room, not only a speech.
example2_zh: 洪水救济应当包括一间干的房间，而不只是一篇讲话。
collocations: to one relief｜令某人欣慰的是 ; relief from｜从……中解脱
tip_zh: relief 通常不可数。a relief 表示一件令人宽慰的事。

definition_en: the state of being dark
example1_en: The path was in darkness.
example2_en: Darkness at the crossing is a reason to add a light.
example2_zh: 路口的黑暗是加一盏灯的理由。
collocations: in darkness｜在黑暗中
tip_zh: dark 已在本库。darkness 通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 交易；数量 | v. 处理；交易
definition_en: an agreement, or an amount | to handle, or to do business
example1_en: We made a deal to share the cleaning.
example2_en: A great deal of plastic leaves a school every day if the canteen still uses single-use boxes.
example2_zh: 如果食堂仍用一次性盒子，学校每天都会送出大量塑料。
collocations: a great deal of｜大量 ; deal with｜处理 ; a good deal｜相当多
tip_zh: a great deal of 后接不可数名词。deal with 表示处理。

definition_en: a sudden bright light, or a very short time
example1_en: A flash of light crossed the yard.
example2_en: In a flash the notice was wrong, and the class had already left.
example2_zh: 转眼通知就错了，班级却已经走了。
collocations: in a flash｜瞬间 ; a flash of｜一闪
tip_zh: flash 作动词是闪光。新闻里的 flash 也可指快讯。

definition_en: a way of doing something
example1_en: The bus is our only means of getting to the museum.
example1_zh: 公交是我们去博物馆的唯一办法。
example2_en: A means of checking news matters when a false photo can travel faster than a correction.
example2_zh: 当一张假照片比更正传得更快时，核对新闻的方法就很重要。
collocations: by means of｜凭借 ; by all means｜当然可以 ; by no means｜决不
tip_zh: means 单复数同形。a means 是一种方法，谓语用单数。

definition_en: sweet food made with sugar; especially American
example1_en: The candy is mostly sugar.
example2_en: Candy that hides nuts should say so on the label.
example2_zh: 藏着坚果的糖果应当在标签上写明。
collocations: a piece of candy｜一块糖
tip_zh: candy 是美式。英式常用 sweet，已在本库。作物质名词通常不可数。

definition_en: the act of going in, or one item in a list
example1_en: Entry is free for students.
example2_en: The last entry in the log should say who locked the lab.
example2_zh: 记录的最后一条应当写明谁锁了实验室。
collocations: entry to｜进入…… ; no entry｜禁止入内
tip_zh: 动词进入是 enter，已在本库。entry 也可指参赛作品或词典的词条。

meanings_zh: adj. 公共的；公开的 | n. 公众
definition_en: for everyone, or known to people in general | people in general
example1_en: The public library is open on Sundays.
example2_en: Public money should be easy to trace, from the tax office to the classroom it is meant to support.
example2_zh: 公共资金应该易于追踪，从税务部门一直到它本应支持的教室。
collocations: in public｜公开地 ; public transport｜公共交通 ; the public｜公众
tip_zh: the public 表示公众，谓语常用单数。

meanings_zh: adj. 灰色的 | n. 灰色
definition_en: American spelling of grey | the colour gray
example1_en: The sky is gray this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上天空是灰色的。
example2_en: A gray area in the rule should be written in one sentence.
example2_zh: 规定里的灰色地带应当用一句话写清。
collocations: gray hair｜灰白头发
tip_zh: gray 是美式，grey 是英式。考纲里两种都有，本库两条都保留。

meanings_zh: n. 复习；评论 | v. 复习；评论
definition_en: studying again, or a report judging something | to study again, or to judge
example1_en: We did a review of last week's words.
example1_zh: 我们复习了上周的单词。
example2_en: A review of a new road should include the people who walk it, not only the engineers.
example2_zh: 对新路的评议应该包括走这条路的人，而不只是工程师。
collocations: book review｜书评 ; review for｜为……复习
tip_zh: review 作动词是“复习”或“评论”。

definition_en: a main public road
example1_en: The highway does not pass the school.
example2_en: A highway without a crossing is a wall for the student who walks.
example2_zh: 没有斑马线的公路，对步行的学生来说是一堵墙。
collocations: a highway to｜通向……的公路
tip_zh: highway 可数。information highway 比喻信息通道。

definition_en: soldiers as a group
example1_en: The history text mentions troops only as part of the war.
example1_zh: 历史课文提到部队，只是把它当作战争的一部分。
example2_en: News about troops should name the place and the date, not invent a method.
example2_zh: 关于部队的新闻应当写地点和日期，而不是编造方法。
collocations: troops of｜大批
tip_zh: troops 是复数。单数一名士兵不用 troop 来指人，troop 常指一队。本条不写军事操作。

definition_en: to need, or to demand
example1_en: The form requires a parent signature.
example2_en: A lab rule that requires goggles protects eyes, and it only works if the goggles are actually there.
example2_zh: 要求戴护目镜的实验室规定能保护眼睛，但前提是护目镜真的在那儿。
collocations: require sb to do｜要求某人做
tip_zh: require 后接名词或 sb to do。不说 require to do。

definition_en: a large business company
example1_en: The corporation funds the school library.
example1_zh: 这家公司资助学校图书馆。
example2_en: A corporation that uses the school name in an ad should say so on the poster.
example2_zh: 在广告里使用校名的公司，应当在海报上写明。
collocations: a large corporation｜大公司
tip_zh: corporation 比 firm 更常指大公司。可数。

definition_en: a penalty for doing something wrong
example1_en: The punishment was extra work, not shame.
example1_zh: 惩罚是额外的作业，不是羞辱。
example2_en: A punishment that names a student in public teaches fear more than the rule.
example2_zh: 当众点名的惩罚，教给人的是害怕多于规则。
collocations: punishment for｜对……的惩罚
tip_zh: punishment 可数也可不可数。

definition_en: a way of thinking or feeling
example1_en: A positive attitude helps in hard times.
example1_zh: 积极态度有助于渡过难关。
example2_en: Schools can encourage a positive attitude towards learning by giving students constructive feedback rather than constant criticism.
example2_zh: 学校可以给予学生建设性的反馈，而非不断批评，以培养积极的学习态度。
collocations: positive attitude｜积极的态度 ; attitude towards｜对……的态度 ; change of attitude｜态度的转变 ; public attitudes｜公众态度
tip_zh: 对某事的态度常用attitude to或towards。

definition_en: to be likely to, or to look after
example1_en: Prices tend to rise in a dry month.
example1_zh: 干旱的月份价格往往会上涨。
example2_en: Nurses tend the clinic, and the school still needs a number on the wall.
example2_zh: 护士照料医务室，学校仍然需要把电话写在墙上。
collocations: tend to do｜往往会 ; tend to sb｜照料某人
tip_zh: tend to do 表示倾向。照料用 tend somebody 或 tend to somebody。

definition_en: 12 o'clock at night
example1_en: The bus does not run after midnight.
example1_zh: 午夜之后这路公交不开。
example2_en: A club that ends at midnight still needs a way home.
example2_zh: 午夜才结束的社团仍然需要回家的办法。
collocations: at midnight｜在午夜
tip_zh: night 已在本库。at midnight 不加 the。

definition_en: a place for drinks, or a long piece
example1_en: There is a bar of soap by the sink.
example2_en: A snack bar at the school gate shapes what students eat more than a poster does.
example2_zh: 校门口的小吃店对学生吃什么的影响，大于一张海报。
collocations: a bar of｜一条 ; coffee bar｜咖啡馆
tip_zh: bar 的意思靠搭配区分：酒吧、条状物或栏杆。

definition_en: the act of choosing, or what is chosen
example1_en: You have a choice of two questions.
example2_en: A real choice of school exists only when a family can reach it by bus or on foot.
example2_zh: 只有当家庭能乘公交或步行到达时，择校才是真正的选择。
collocations: have no choice｜别无选择 ; choice between｜在……之间选择
tip_zh: choice 是名词；choose 是动词。

meanings_zh: v. 返回；归还 | n. 返回；回报
definition_en: to come back, or to give something back | the act of coming back
example1_en: Please return the book by Friday.
example2_en: Young people return to a town when there is work, not only when they miss their family.
example2_zh: 年轻人回到城镇是因为有工作，而不只是因为想念家人。
collocations: return to｜回到 ; in return｜作为回报
tip_zh: return 本身含“回”，不要说 return back。

definition_en: any person
example1_en: Anyone can borrow books with a library card.
example1_zh: 任何人有借书证都可以借书。
example2_en: Anyone planning a new road should ask the people who will walk beside it every day.
example2_zh: 任何计划修新路的人，都应该问问每天要在路边走的人。
collocations: anyone else｜其他任何人
tip_zh: anyone 作主语时谓语用单数。疑问句和否定句比 someone 更常见。

definition_en: in a correct or suitable way
example1_en: Close the window properly.
example2_en: A notice is useful only if the time is written properly.
example2_zh: 只有时间写对了，通知才有用。
collocations: properly speaking｜严格说来
tip_zh: 形容词 proper 已在本库。properly 是它的副词。

definition_en: very pleasing to see or hear
example1_en: The lake looks beautiful in the morning.
example2_en: A beautiful old street can still be unsafe if cars park across the pavement.
example2_zh: 一条美丽的老街，如果汽车停满人行道，仍然可能不安全。
collocations: beautiful music｜美妙的音乐
tip_zh: beautiful 可形容人、景色或声音。

definition_en: a name that identifies a product
example1_en: The brand on the bag is not a reason to buy it.
example1_zh: 包上的品牌不是购买的理由。
example2_en: A famous brand can raise the price of a simple pencil far above its cost.
example2_zh: 名牌可以把一支普通铅笔的价格抬到成本之上很多。
collocations: brand name｜品牌名称
tip_zh: brand 是商业品牌。作动词可以是“打上烙印”。

definition_en: to rest and become less anxious
example1_en: Relax for ten minutes, then check the map.
example1_zh: 放松十分钟，然后核对地图。
example2_en: A room where students can relax still needs a clock.
example2_zh: 学生能放松的房间仍然需要一块钟。
collocations: relax for｜放松一段时间
tip_zh: relax 可及物也可不及物。

meanings_zh: n. 惊奇；意外 | v. 使惊奇
definition_en: a feeling of shock, or an unexpected event | to make someone feel surprise
example1_en: The result was a surprise to the whole class.
example1_zh: 这个结果让全班都感到意外。
example2_en: A pleasant surprise still needs a plan if it changes the bus home.
example2_zh: 如果一件惊喜会改变回家的公交，它仍然需要安排。
collocations: to one surprise｜令某人吃惊的是 ; a surprise party｜惊喜聚会
tip_zh: surprised 形容人，surprising 形容事物。

definition_en: a situation, a legal matter, or a container
example1_en: In this case, we should ask the teacher.
example1_zh: 在这种情况下，我们应该问老师。
example2_en: In the case of a city flood, the first question is which roads still lead to the hospital.
example2_zh: 如果城市内涝，第一个问题是哪些路仍然通向医院。
collocations: in case｜以防万一 ; in case of｜如果发生 ; in any case｜无论如何
tip_zh: in case 后接句子，表示以防万一；in case of 后接名词。

definition_en: the warmest season
example1_en: The sports meet is in early summer.
example2_en: A hotter summer makes classrooms without fans harder places to learn.
example2_zh: 更热的夏天让没有风扇的教室更难学习。
collocations: in summer｜在夏天 ; summer holiday｜暑假
tip_zh: 季节前常用 in，不加 the：in summer。

definition_en: a number of people or things together
example1_en: Our group will present first.
example2_en: A small group of volunteers can keep a community library open when the town budget is thin.
example2_zh: 当城镇预算紧张时，一小群志愿者也能维持社区图书馆开放。
collocations: a group of｜一群 ; group work｜小组活动
tip_zh: a group of 加复数名词时，谓语可随强调整体或成员而变化。

definition_en: a person who belongs to a group
example1_en: She is a member of the science club.
example2_en: Every member of a team should know who will speak if the plan fails.
example2_zh: 团队的每个成员都应该知道，如果计划失败由谁来说明。
collocations: a member of｜……的一员 ; family member｜家庭成员
tip_zh: member 后常用 of，不用 in。

definition_en: an idea that explains facts
example1_en: The theory is simple, but the test is not.
example1_zh: 理论很简单，但实验并不简单。
example2_en: A theory about climate is useful only when students can see the measurements behind it.
example2_zh: 关于气候的理论，只有当学生能看到背后的测量数据时才有用。
collocations: in theory｜理论上 ; theory of｜……理论
tip_zh: in theory 常和 in practice 对照。表里这一行的音标其实是 theoretical，本库改用 espeak。

definition_en: the soft part in the mouth used for tasting and speaking
example1_en: The doctor asked her to show her tongue.
example2_en: A sharp tongue in a meeting teaches fear, not the bus time.
example2_zh: 会上尖刻的话教给人的是害怕，不是公交时间。
collocations: mother tongue｜母语 ; tongue twister｜绕口令
tip_zh: mother tongue 是母语。a sharp tongue 比喻说话刻薄。

meanings_zh: n. 鱼；鱼肉 | v. 钓鱼
definition_en: an animal that lives in water | to try to catch fish
example1_en: The fish in this lake are protected.
example2_en: If a river has no fish, the birds that feed on them leave the town as well.
example2_zh: 如果河里没有鱼，以鱼为食的鸟也会离开这座城镇。
collocations: fish and chips｜炸鱼薯条
tip_zh: fish 单复数同形。表示一条鱼可用 a fish。

definition_en: a female child
example1_en: Her daughter studies at this school.
example1_zh: 她的女儿在这所学校上学。
example2_en: A daughter who wants to study engineering should see women doing that work.
example2_zh: 想学工程的女儿，应该看到有女性在做这份工作。
collocations: daughter of｜……的女儿
tip_zh: daughter 的复数是 daughters。

definition_en: ready to attack or to push hard
example1_en: Aggressive talk does not fix the clock.
example2_en: An aggressive ad for a drink should not hang in the canteen.
example2_zh: 强推饮料的广告不应当挂在食堂。
collocations: aggressive behaviour｜攻击性行为
tip_zh: aggressive 可以形容人或做法。不要用来嘲笑同学。

meanings_zh: conj. 当……时；而 | n. 一会儿
definition_en: during the time that, or whereas | a period of time
example1_en: I listened to the recording while I washed the dishes.
example2_en: Some cities invest in stadiums while their oldest school buildings still leak in the rain.
example2_zh: 一些城市投资体育场，而它们最老的校舍下雨时仍在漏水。
collocations: for a while｜一会儿 ; once in a while｜偶尔
tip_zh: while 可表示对比，相当于“而”；一段时间用 for a while。

definition_en: a place where children are educated
example1_en: Our school has a new science lab.
example1_zh: 我们学校有一间新的科学实验室。
example2_en: A school that stays open in the evening can give working parents a safe place for their children.
example2_zh: 晚上仍然开放的学校，可以为上班的父母提供一个孩子的安全去处。
collocations: at school｜在上学 ; go to school｜去上学 ; primary school｜小学
tip_zh: go to school 泛指上学，school 前通常不加 the。

meanings_zh: v. 冲；奔 | n. 匆忙；猛冲
definition_en: to move or act quickly | a sudden quick movement, or haste
example1_en: Do not rush onto a full bus.
example2_en: Students who rush a lab step spill more than they save.
example2_zh: 赶实验步骤的学生洒出来的比省下的多。
collocations: rush hour｜高峰时间 ; in a rush｜匆忙
tip_zh: rush hour 是交通高峰。

definition_en: to lift, to increase, or to care for a child
example1_en: Please raise your hand before you speak.
example2_en: Towns that raise bus fares should also say how students on free meals will travel.
example2_zh: 提高公交票价的城镇，也应当说明吃免费餐的学生怎么出行。
collocations: raise a question｜提出问题 ; raise money｜筹款
tip_zh: raise 是及物动词。不及物的“上升”用 rise，已在本库。

meanings_zh: v. 放置；设置；确立 | n. 一套；集合
definition_en: to put, arrange, or establish | a group of things that belong together
example1_en: Please set the chairs in a circle.
example2_en: If a school sets homework without time to sleep, the extra pages may lower the next day's attention.
example2_zh: 如果学校布置的作业挤掉了睡眠，多出来的页数可能会降低第二天的注意力。
collocations: set up｜建立 ; set off｜出发 ; a set of｜一套
tip_zh: set 的过去式和过去分词都是 set。a set of 后接复数名词。

definition_en: to give food
example1_en: Who will feed the cat during the holiday?
example2_en: A canteen that can feed every student still needs a quiet table for those who eat slowly.
example2_zh: 能让每个学生吃上饭的食堂，仍然需要一张给吃得慢的人的安静桌子。
collocations: feed on｜以……为食 ; feed sb sth｜给某人喂
tip_zh: feed 的过去式和过去分词是 fed。feed on 表示以……为食。

definition_en: school lessons in sport and exercise
example1_en: Physical education is on Tuesday afternoon.
example2_en: Physical education needs a safe yard, not only a mark on the report.
example2_zh: 体育需要一个安全的场地，而不只是成绩单上的一个分数。
collocations: physical education class｜体育课
tip_zh: 常缩写为 PE。形容词 physical 已在本库，本条保留全称，因为考纲里单独出现。

definition_en: clear and exact
example1_en: Please give a specific example.
example2_en: A specific date for opening the clinic matters more than a general promise.
example2_zh: 诊所开业的具体日期，比笼统的承诺更重要。
collocations: be specific about｜对……说具体
tip_zh: specific 强调明确；special 强调特别。

meanings_zh: v. 后悔；遗憾 | n. 遗憾
definition_en: to feel sorry about something | a feeling of being sorry
example1_en: I regret the delay.
example1_zh: 我对这次延误感到遗憾。
example2_en: The town will regret a plan that ignores the last bus.
example2_zh: 忽视末班车的计划，城镇以后会后悔。
collocations: regret doing｜后悔做了 ; regret to say｜遗憾地说
tip_zh: regret doing 是后悔做过。regret to say 是遗憾地告诉你。也可作名词。

definition_en: at all times
example1_en: She always checks her answers twice.
example1_zh: 她总是把答案检查两遍。
example2_en: Towns that always build on the cheapest land may later discover that the ground floods.
example2_zh: 总在最便宜的土地上建设的城镇，日后可能会发现那块地会积水。
collocations: always remember｜永远记得
tip_zh: always 放在实义动词前、be 动词后。

definition_en: the sky, or a place of complete happiness in some religions
example1_en: The poem looks up at heaven.
example2_en: Good heavens is an old phrase of surprise, not a fact about the sky.
example2_zh: Good heavens 是表示惊讶的旧说法，不是关于天空的事实。
collocations: good heavens｜天哪
tip_zh: heaven 在宗教里常指天堂。文学里也可指天空。

definition_en: past events, or the study of them
example1_en: We have a history test on Friday.
example2_en: Local history is easier to care about when students can visit the street the textbook describes.
example2_zh: 当学生能去教科书描写的那条街时，本地历史就更容易让人在意。
collocations: in history｜在历史上 ; history museum｜历史博物馆
tip_zh: history 作学科不可数。historical 是“历史的”；historic 常指有历史意义的。

definition_en: not including
example1_en: Everyone was present except Tom.
example2_en: The museum is free except on the one day when a special show raises the price.
example2_zh: 除了特别展览涨价的那一天，博物馆都是免费的。
collocations: except for｜除了 ; except that｜除了……之外
tip_zh: except 表示排除；besides 表示除此之外还有。

definition_en: not firmly fixed, or not tight
example1_en: The lock is loose.
example2_en: A loose wheel on the cart is a reason to stop before the hill.
example2_zh: 手推车轮子松了，是在上坡前停下来的理由。
collocations: loose change｜零钱
tip_zh: 不要和 lose（丢失）混淆。tight 已在本库。

definition_en: newly made or picked, or clean and new
example1_en: The canteen has fresh fruit on Monday.
example2_en: Fresh air in a classroom depends on windows that actually open, not only on a poster.
example2_zh: 教室里的新鲜空气取决于窗户真的能开，而不只是一张海报。
collocations: fresh air｜新鲜空气 ; fresh water｜淡水
tip_zh: fresh water 是淡水，不是“刚接的水”这一个意思。

definition_en: a workers' organisation, or a joining together
example1_en: The union asked for safer night buses.
example1_zh: 工会要求更安全的夜班公交。
example2_en: A union of small shops can buy together and keep a market alive.
example2_zh: 小店的联合可以一起进货，并让市场继续活着。
collocations: trade union｜工会 ; students' union｜学生会
tip_zh: the European Union 是欧洲联盟。

definition_en: to clean with water | an act of washing
example1_en: Wash your hands before lunch.
example2_en: A place to wash near the canteen prevents more illness than a poster.
example2_zh: 食堂附近一个能洗手的地方，比一张海报更能减少疾病。
collocations: wash up｜洗餐具；洗脸 ; do the washing｜洗衣服
tip_zh: wash 作名词是洗。表里这一行的音标是 warning，本库不用。

definition_en: a ceremony for a person who has died
example1_en: The class sent a letter after the funeral.
example1_zh: 葬礼之后班级送了一封信。
example2_en: A school should leave time for a funeral without asking the student to explain it in public.
example2_zh: 学校应当为葬礼留出时间，而不要求学生当众解释。
collocations: a funeral of｜……的葬礼
tip_zh: funeral 可数。说话时要尊重。

definition_en: a team game played with an oval ball
example1_en: Rugby practice is on the field.
example2_en: Rugby needs a safe surface, not only a poster of a cup.
example2_zh: 橄榄球需要安全的场地，而不只是一张奖杯海报。
collocations: play rugby｜打橄榄球
tip_zh: play rugby 不加 the。

definition_en: great honour and praise
example1_en: The glory belongs to the whole team.
example2_en: Glory on a poster does not name who locked the door.
example2_zh: 海报上的光荣不会写出是谁锁的门。
collocations: glory of｜……的光荣
tip_zh: glory 通常不可数。

definition_en: without being affected by something
example1_en: The bus left regardless of the rain.
example1_zh: 尽管下雨，公交还是开了。
example2_en: Every student may use the library regardless of the score.
example2_zh: 不论分数，每个学生都可以用图书馆。
collocations: regardless of｜不管
tip_zh: 固定搭配 regardless of。表里把它标成形容词，本库按副词用。

definition_en: whether a person is male or female
example1_en: The form asks for your name and sex.
example1_zh: 表格要填写姓名和性别。
example2_en: A school sports rule based only on sex can be unfair if it ignores what each student can actually do.
example2_zh: 只按性别制定的学校体育规则，如果忽略每个学生实际能做什么，就可能不公平。
collocations: both sexes｜男女
tip_zh: sex 在考纲里主要作“性别”，填写表格时用。

definition_en: a very small cause of disease, or a harmful computer program
example1_en: The clinic explained the virus without a scare.
example1_zh: 医务室解释了这种病毒，没有制造恐慌。
example2_en: A computer virus is a reason to keep a paper copy of the class list.
example2_zh: 计算机病毒是给班级名单留一份纸质副本的理由。
collocations: a virus infection｜病毒感染
tip_zh: virus 可数。本条不写如何制造或传播病毒。

meanings_zh: adj. 普通的；清楚的 | n. 平原
definition_en: simple, or easy to see | a large area of flat land
example1_en: The notice is in plain words.
example2_en: A plain meal that students can afford is better than a picture of a feast.
example2_zh: 学生买得起的普通一餐，好过一张盛宴的图片。
collocations: plain English｜简明英语 ; the plain｜平原
tip_zh: plain 作名词是平原。

meanings_zh: adj. 天主教的 | n. 天主教徒
definition_en: of the Roman Catholic Church | a member of the Roman Catholic Church
example1_en: The old church in the story is Catholic.
example1_zh: 故事里的老教堂是天主教的。
example2_en: A history class can explain a Catholic festival without telling students to join it.
example2_zh: 历史课可以讲解一个天主教节日，而不要求学生加入。
collocations: the Catholic Church｜天主教会
tip_zh: Catholic 作宗教名要大写。本条是词汇，不是劝人信教。

meanings_zh: n. 影响；效果 | v. 实现；使发生
definition_en: a result | To bring about a change or result.
example1_en: Sleep has a strong effect on mood.
example1_zh: 睡眠对情绪有强烈影响。
example2_en: Higher parking charges may have little effect on traffic unless reliable public transport is also available.
example2_zh: 如果没有可靠的公共交通，提高停车费对交通状况的影响可能很小。
collocations: have an effect on｜对……有影响 ; side effect｜副作用 ; take effect｜生效；起作用 ; effect change｜促成变革
tip_zh: effect常作名词；affect常作动词，意为影响。

definition_en: a senior university teacher
example1_en: The professor answered questions after the talk.
example1_zh: 教授在讲座后回答了问题。
example2_en: A visiting professor can show students how research looks outside their own textbook.
example2_zh: 客座教授能让学生看到研究在自己课本之外是什么样。
collocations: a professor of｜……教授
tip_zh: professor 是大学里的高级职称，中学老师一般称 teacher。

definition_en: holding one's attention
example1_en: The talk was interesting.
example2_en: An interesting museum is still out of reach if the bus fare is too high.
example2_zh: 如果公交票价太高，有趣的博物馆仍然到不了。
collocations: be interesting to｜对……来说有趣
tip_zh: interesting 修饰事物；interested 修饰人。

definition_en: very great, or very far in one direction
example1_en: The extreme heat closed the afternoon sport.
example1_zh: 极端高温让下午的体育停了。
example2_en: Extreme views in a debate still have to answer the same question: what happens to the bus?
example2_zh: 辩论里的极端观点，仍然必须回答同一个问题：公交怎么办？
collocations: extreme weather｜极端天气
tip_zh: extreme 作名词可指极端。go to extremes 是走极端。

definition_en: a grain, or the food made from it
example1_en: There is rice in the bowl.
example2_en: Rice left out all morning is not a safe lunch.
example2_zh: 放了一上午的米饭不是安全的午饭。
collocations: a bowl of rice｜一碗米饭
tip_zh: rice 通常不可数。不说 a rice。

meanings_zh: n. 援助；辅助 | v. 援助
definition_en: help | to help
example1_en: The clinic keeps a first-aid box by the door.
example1_zh: 医务室在门边放着急救箱。
example2_en: Food aid after a flood helps for a week; repairing the road helps for years.
example2_zh: 洪水后的食品援助能帮上一周，修路则能帮上很多年。
collocations: first aid｜急救 ; in aid of｜为了帮助
tip_zh: aid 作动词是帮助，比 help 正式。

definition_en: a part of a place, or the size of a surface
example1_en: This area of the library is for quiet study.
example1_zh: 图书馆这一区是安静学习用的。
example2_en: Industrial areas beside rivers need stricter rules, because waste travels farther than the factory gate.
example2_zh: 河边的工业区需要更严的规定，因为废物会流到比厂门更远的地方。
collocations: in the area｜在该地区 ; area of｜……的面积
tip_zh: area 可指地区或面积，面积不可数时仍说 an area of。

definition_en: to become better or make something better
example1_en: Reading aloud can improve your pronunciation.
example2_en: Towns improve a bus line by counting who is left at the stop, not only who is already on board.
example2_zh: 城镇改进公交线路，要数还留在车站的人，而不只是已经上车的人。
collocations: improve on｜改进
tip_zh: improve 可及物也可不及物：improve English；English improves。

definition_en: a piece of writing in verse
example1_en: The poem is on the wall.
example2_en: A poem about a flood can start a discussion, and the bus time still has to be fact.
example2_zh: 写洪水的诗可以开启讨论，公交时间却必须是事实。
collocations: a poem about｜关于……的诗
tip_zh: poem 可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 固体的；结实的 | n. 固体
definition_en: firm and hard, or reliable | a substance that is not a liquid or a gas
example1_en: Ice is solid water.
example2_en: A solid plan names who locks the door, not only what the poster says.
example2_zh: 扎实的计划会写明谁锁门，而不只是海报上的话。
collocations: solid food｜固体食物
tip_zh: solid 作名词是固体。

meanings_zh: n. 棉花 | adj. 棉的
definition_en: a soft white material from a plant | made of cotton
example1_en: The shirt is cotton.
example2_en: Cotton dries faster than a coat left in a pile.
example2_zh: 棉布比堆着的外套干得快。
collocations: cotton shirt｜棉衬衫
tip_zh: cotton 作材料通常不可数。也可作形容词。

meanings_zh: v. 申请；应用 | v. 应用；适用 | v. 涂；敷
definition_en: to ask formally; to use | To use something practically, or be relevant to a situation | To spread a substance onto a surface
example1_en: She will apply for a scholarship.
example2_en: Universities should encourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for scholarships that cover tuition and living expenses.
example2_zh: 大学应鼓励家庭条件困难的学生申请涵盖学费和生活费的奖学金。
collocations: apply for a job｜申请工作 ; apply to a university｜向大学提出申请 ; apply knowledge｜应用知识 ; apply sunscreen｜涂防晒霜
tip_zh: apply for接申请事项；apply to接机构或适用对象。

meanings_zh: adj. 干净的 | v. 打扫
definition_en: not dirty | to make something not dirty
example1_en: The lab must be clean before we leave.
example1_zh: 离开前实验室必须干净。
example2_en: Clean drinking water is a public duty, not a luxury for one neighbourhood.
example2_zh: 干净的饮用水是公共责任，不是一个社区的奢侈。
collocations: clean up｜打扫干净
tip_zh: clean 作动词是“打扫”。

meanings_zh: v. 咬；叮 | n. 一口；咬伤
definition_en: to cut with the teeth, or to sting | a small mouthful, or a wound from a bite
example1_en: The dog did not bite.
example2_en: A bite from an insect is a reason to see the clinic.
example2_zh: 被虫子叮了是去医务室的理由。
collocations: bite into｜咬进
tip_zh: 过去式 bit，过去分词 bitten。本条不写如何伤害。

meanings_zh: adj. 立即的 | adj. 速溶的；即食的 | n. 瞬间；片刻
definition_en: happening at once | prepared very quickly, usually by adding hot water | an extremely short period of time
example1_en: She got an instant reply.
example2_en: Digital platforms provide instant access to educational resources, although reliable internet connections remain essential.
example2_zh: 数字平台让人们即时获取教育资源，但稳定的网络连接仍然必不可少。
collocations: instant access｜即时获取 ; instant results｜即时结果 ; instant coffee｜速溶咖啡 ; in an instant｜转眼间
tip_zh: instant作形容词表示即时的；in an instant表示转眼间。

meanings_zh: n. 结论；结尾 | n. 结尾；结束
definition_en: a final decision or end | the final part or ending of something
example1_en: The conclusion of the report is clear.
example2_en: Researchers should consider alternative explanations before drawing a conclusion from a relatively small sample.
example2_zh: 研究人员根据较小的样本得出结论之前，应考虑其他可能的解释。
collocations: reach a conclusion｜得出结论 ; draw a conclusion｜作出推断 ; jump to conclusions｜贸然下结论 ; in conclusion｜总而言之
tip_zh: “得出结论”用reach或draw a conclusion，不用make。

definition_en: trade, a company, or a matter to deal with
example1_en: Her aunt runs a small business near the station.
example1_zh: 她阿姨在车站附近做小生意。
example2_en: A business that ignores its waste may save money this year and lose the trust of the town next year.
example2_zh: 忽视废弃物的企业今年也许省了钱，明年却可能失去城镇的信任。
collocations: on business｜出差 ; do business｜做生意 ; none of one's business｜不关某人的事
tip_zh: business 表示生意时可不可数；表示一家企业时可数。

definition_en: the way people or things are connected
example1_en: The relationship between the two clubs is friendly.
example1_zh: 两个社团的关系很友好。
example2_en: The relationship between rent and bus fares decides whether a worker can live near a job.
example2_zh: 房租和公交费之间的关系，决定工人能否住在工作附近。
collocations: relationship between｜……之间的关系 ; relationship with｜与……的关系
tip_zh: relationship 比 relation 更常指人与人的关系。

definition_en: extremely large
example1_en: The map shows a vast forest.
example1_zh: 地图上是一片广阔的森林。
example2_en: A vast budget that never names the roof is still a leak.
example2_zh: 从不写屋顶的庞大预算，漏的仍然是雨。
collocations: a vast area｜广大地区
tip_zh: vast 比 big 更强调范围大。

definition_en: added to
example1_en: Two plus three is five.
example2_en: A low fare plus a late bus is still a poor service for students.
example2_zh: 低票价加上晚点的公交，对学生来说仍是糟糕的服务。
collocations: plus the cost｜加上费用
tip_zh: plus 可作介词或名词。A plus B。

definition_en: a kind of music with a strong rhythm
example1_en: Jazz is on the radio at noon.
example2_en: A jazz concert that starts after the last bus has already chosen who can come.
example2_zh: 在末班车之后才开始的爵士音乐会，其实已经选定了谁能来。
collocations: jazz music｜爵士乐
tip_zh: jazz 通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 打包 | n. 包；一群
definition_en: to put things into a bag or box | a bag, or a group
example1_en: Pack your bag the night before the trip.
example2_en: Students who pack only what the list says leave room for a coat.
example2_zh: 只按清单打包的学生，还能给外套留出地方。
collocations: pack up｜收拾 ; a pack of｜一包；一群
tip_zh: pack 作名词是包，或一群。a pack of 后可接物或动物。

definition_en: very bad weather with wind and rain
example1_en: The storm started after lunch.
example2_en: A storm plan should say who calls parents if the buses stop.
example2_zh: 风暴方案应当写明公交停运时谁给家长打电话。
collocations: a storm of｜一阵
tip_zh: storm 可数。a storm of protest 比喻一阵抗议。

meanings_zh: n. 名字；名称 | v. 命名；说出名字
definition_en: what a person or thing is called | to give a name, or to say a name
example1_en: Please write your name in capital letters.
example1_zh: 请用大写字母写你的名字。
example2_en: A place can lose its old name when new maps care more about roads than about the people who named it.
example2_zh: 当新地图更在意道路而不是命名的人时，一个地方可能失去旧名。
collocations: family name｜姓 ; first name｜名 ; by name｜按名字
tip_zh: name 作动词是“命名”：name the baby。

definition_en: a place where aircraft land and take off
example1_en: The airport bus leaves every half hour.
example1_zh: 机场大巴每半小时一班。
example2_en: An airport far from the city helps flights, and it also makes the last bus home matter.
example2_zh: 远离城区的机场方便航班，也让末班回家的车变得重要。
collocations: at the airport｜在机场
tip_zh: airport 是一个词，不要拆开写。

definition_en: a part of the coast where the land curves in
example1_en: The town sits on a quiet bay.
example1_zh: 小镇坐落在一个安静的海湾边。
example2_en: A bay that looks calm can still be a poor place for a school boat on a windy day.
example2_zh: 看起来平静的海湾，在有风的日子仍可能不适合学校的小船。
collocations: on the bay｜在海湾
tip_zh: bay 是海湾，比 gulf 小。

definition_en: many times
example1_en: I often review new words on the bus.
example1_zh: 我经常在公交上复习生词。
example2_en: Streets that often flood need a better drain, not only a warning after the rain starts.
example2_zh: 经常积水的街道需要更好的排水，而不只是雨开始后的警报。
collocations: how often｜多久一次
tip_zh: often 放在实义动词前、be 动词后。

meanings_zh: n. 共产主义者 | adj. 共产主义的
definition_en: a person who supports communism | related to communism
example1_en: The history chapter uses the word communist.
example1_zh: 历史课用了 communist 这个词。
example2_en: Students can read the word communist without being told what to believe.
example2_zh: 学生可以读到这个词，同时不被要求信什么。
collocations: a communist party｜共产党
tip_zh: 也可作形容词。本条是历史词汇，不是要求学生表态。

definition_en: a country with an elected head, not a king
example1_en: The text compares a republic with a kingdom.
example1_zh: 课文把共和国和王国作了比较。
example2_en: A republic still has to decide who may vote and who may go to school.
example2_zh: 共和国仍然必须决定谁可以投票、谁可以上学。
collocations: the People's Republic of China｜中华人民共和国
tip_zh: republic 可数。People's Republic 要大写。

definition_en: a curved piece of metal for hanging things
example1_en: Hang the coat on the hook.
example2_en: A hook by the door keeps wet coats off the floor.
example2_zh: 门边的钩子让湿外套不堆在地上。
collocations: hook on｜挂上
tip_zh: hook 作动词是钩住。

definition_en: not smooth, or not exact
example1_en: The path is rough after the rain.
example2_en: A rough estimate is useful, and the budget still needs the exact figure.
example2_zh: 粗略估计有用，预算仍然需要确切数字。
collocations: rough paper｜草稿纸 ; a rough idea｜大致想法
tip_zh: rough 也可表示风浪大或粗暴。粗暴义不要用来形容同学。

definition_en: at the same time
example1_en: The bus was late; meanwhile the class waited.
example1_zh: 公交晚了，与此同时班级在等。
example2_en: Meanwhile the clinic stayed open, which mattered more than the speech.
example2_zh: 与此同时诊所还开着，这比那篇讲话更重要。
collocations: meanwhile｜同时
tip_zh: meanwhile 是副词，可放在句首。也可作名词，较少用。

definition_en: a person who leads a meeting or an organization
example1_en: The chairman asked each class to speak once.
example1_zh: 主席请每个班发言一次。
example2_en: A chairman who keeps the clock also keeps the last speaker from being pushed out.
example2_zh: 守时的主席也能避免最后一位发言人被挤掉。
collocations: chairman of｜……的主席
tip_zh: 复数是 chairmen。现在也常用 chair 或 chairperson 表示同一职务。

definition_en: the unit of money in the US and some other countries
example1_en: The book costs ten dollars.
example2_en: A dollar sign on a school poster should not be the only way a family learns the real cost.
example2_zh: 学校海报上的美元符号，不应当是家庭得知真实费用的唯一方式。
collocations: US dollar｜美元
tip_zh: 符号是 $。100 cents 等于 1 dollar。cent 已在本库。

definition_en: a place where people live, or an agreement
example1_en: The old settlement is now a town.
example1_zh: 旧定居点现在是一座城镇。
example2_en: A settlement of the bus argument should be written down.
example2_zh: 公交争论的解决办法应当写下来。
collocations: reach a settlement｜达成解决
tip_zh: settlement 可指村落，也可指协议。

meanings_zh: n. 目标；目的 | v. 力求；旨在 | v. 瞄准；对准
definition_en: a purpose or goal | to intend or try to achieve something | to point something towards a particular target
example1_en: Our aim is to finish on time.
example1_zh: 我们的目标是按时完成。
example2_en: The programme aims to reduce youth unemployment by providing practical training and opportunities to gain workplace experience.
example2_zh: 该项目旨在通过提供实践培训和获取职场经验的机会，降低青年失业率。
collocations: the main aim｜主要目标 ; aim to do something｜力求做某事 ; with the aim of｜以……为目的 ; aim at a target｜瞄准目标
tip_zh: aim to do表打算做；aim at doing表力求实现。

definition_en: not thick, or not having much fat
example1_en: The ice is too thin to walk on.
example2_en: A thin coat in this wind is a reason to open the lost-property box.
example2_zh: 这种风里一件薄外套，是打开失物箱的理由。
collocations: thin ice｜薄冰
tip_zh: 说人瘦时要注意礼貌。thin 也可作动词“变薄”。

definition_en: British spelling of realize
example1_en: She realised the clock was wrong.
example2_en: Cities realise a bus plan only after they write the time.
example2_zh: 城市在写下时间之后，公交计划才算实现。
collocations: realise that｜意识到
tip_zh: realise 是英式，realize 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留。

definition_en: the people who work for an organisation
example1_en: The staff meeting is at four.
example2_en: Hospital staff on the night shift need a bus after the regular service has stopped.
example2_zh: 夜班的医院职工需要一趟在常规班次停运之后的公交。
collocations: teaching staff｜全体教师 ; staff member｜职员
tip_zh: staff 是集体名词，谓语常用复数。

definition_en: a very young child
example1_en: The baby slept through the whole meeting.
example1_zh: 婴儿在整个会议期间都睡着。
example2_en: A baby clinic once a month is not enough for a village that is two hours from the hospital.
example2_zh: 对离医院两小时的村子来说，每月一次的婴儿诊所是不够的。
collocations: baby boy｜男婴
tip_zh: baby 的复数是 babies。

meanings_zh: v. 印刷；打印 | n. 印刷；印迹
definition_en: to produce words or pictures on paper | letters produced by printing, or a mark
example1_en: Print the notice before the network fails.
example1_zh: 在网络断掉之前把通知打印出来。
example2_en: A school that can print one page for a student without a phone is still fair.
example2_zh: 能为没有手机的学生打印一页的学校，仍然是公平的。
collocations: in print｜已出版 ; print out｜打印出来
tip_zh: print 也可作名词“印刷品”。

definition_en: large and impressive, or important
example1_en: The grand hall can hold the whole school.
example1_zh: 这个宏伟的大厅能容纳全校。
example2_en: A grand opening means little if the new library still has no books for the lower grades.
example2_zh: 如果新图书馆仍然没有适合低年级的书，盛大的开幕就意义不大。
collocations: a grand hall｜宏伟大厅 ; grand opening｜盛大开幕
tip_zh: grand 也可放在称呼里，如 grandfather。

definition_en: the right to do something, given by someone
example1_en: You need permission to use the lab.
example2_en: Permission to leave early should be written, so the gate and the parent agree.
example2_zh: 提前离开的许可应当写下来，这样门口和家长才一致。
collocations: ask for permission｜请求允许 ; without permission｜未经允许
tip_zh: permission 通常不可数。

definition_en: the clear liquid we drink | to pour water on plants
example1_en: Please bring your own water to the sports meet.
example2_en: When a city wastes water in dry months, farms downstream have less for the next planting season.
example2_zh: 城市在干旱月份浪费水，下游农场下一季可种的水就更少。
collocations: drinking water｜饮用水 ; a glass of water｜一杯水
tip_zh: water 通常不可数，不说 a water。

definition_en: an organized store of information on a computer
example1_en: The database lists every bus time.
example1_zh: 数据库列出每一班车的时间。
example2_en: A database without a paper copy fails when the network fails.
example2_zh: 没有纸质副本的数据库，在断网时就会失效。
collocations: a database of｜……的数据库
tip_zh: data 已在本库。

meanings_zh: n. 一半 | det. 一半的
definition_en: one of two equal parts | equal to one of two parts
example1_en: Half of the class walks to school.
example1_zh: 班上一半的人步行上学。
example2_en: Cutting a journey by half still leaves some students on the bus for more than an hour.
example2_zh: 把路程缩短一半，仍有一些学生要在公交上坐一个多小时。
collocations: half an hour｜半小时 ; in half｜成两半
tip_zh: half of 加复数名词时谓语常用复数；half an hour 中间有 an。

definition_en: American spelling of colour
example1_en: What color is your bag?
example2_en: The color of flood water does not tell you whether it is safe to touch.
example2_zh: 洪水的颜色并不能告诉你它是否可以安全触碰。
collocations: color of｜……的颜色
tip_zh: color 是美式拼写；英式是 colour。考纲里两种都可能出现。

definition_en: ill, or about to vomit
example1_en: He stayed home because he felt sick.
example1_zh: 他觉得不舒服，所以待在家里。
example2_en: A sick child sent to school can pass an illness through a whole class by noon.
example2_zh: 带病上学的孩子，到中午就可能把病传给全班。
collocations: be sick of｜厌倦 ; feel sick｜感到恶心
tip_zh: be sick of 表示厌烦，不是生病。英式 feel sick 常指恶心。

definition_en: to experience something bad
example1_en: The village suffered from the flood.
example2_en: Students should not suffer in silence when the bus stops coming.
example2_zh: 公交不再来时，学生不应当默默忍受。
collocations: suffer from｜遭受；患有
tip_zh: 名词 suffering 已在本库。suffer from 后接疾病或困难。

definition_en: a thin piece of metal, or a cable
example1_en: Do not touch the loose wire.
example2_en: A loose wire in the lab is a reason to switch the power off and call an adult.
example2_zh: 实验室里松了的电线，是关掉电源并叫成年人的理由。
collocations: a piece of wire｜一根金属丝
tip_zh: 本条只作安全词汇。不写如何接线。

definition_en: a person who hunts, or who searches
example1_en: The history text mentions a hunter, not a method.
example1_zh: 历史课文提到猎人，不是方法。
example2_en: A job hunter needs a clear form more than a long speech.
example2_zh: 找工作的人需要一张清楚的表，而不是一篇长讲话。
collocations: a hunter of｜……的搜寻者
tip_zh: 动词 hunt 已在本库。本条不写狩猎操作。

definition_en: a tool with a blade for cutting
example1_en: The knife stays in the kitchen drawer.
example2_en: A knife in a school kitchen is a tool for food, and it is locked when the cook leaves.
example2_zh: 学校厨房里的刀是做饭的工具，厨师离开时要锁上。
collocations: a knife and fork｜一副刀叉
tip_zh: 复数是 knives。本条不写如何伤人。

definition_en: able to harm you
example1_en: The icy steps are dangerous.
example2_en: A dangerous crossing near a school is a planning problem, not only a warning to children.
example2_zh: 学校附近危险的路口是规划问题，而不只是对孩子的一句警告。
collocations: dangerous to｜对……危险
tip_zh: dangerous 形容事物。处于危险中的人用 in danger。

meanings_zh: adj. 直的 | adv. 直接地；一直
definition_en: not bent or curved | directly
example1_en: Draw a straight line under the title.
example2_en: A straight road through a wetland may be faster for cars and worse for the water.
example2_zh: 穿过湿地的直路对汽车可能更快，对水却更糟。
collocations: straight away｜立刻 ; go straight｜一直走
tip_zh: straight 可作形容词或副词，不要写成 straightly。

meanings_zh: v. 前进；推进 | n. 进展；预付款
definition_en: to move forward, or to help something develop | progress, or money paid before the work
example1_en: The line will advance when the gate opens.
example2_en: Science can advance and still leave a village without clean water.
example2_zh: 科学可以进步，村子却仍然可能没有干净的水。
collocations: in advance｜提前 ; advance notice｜预先通知
tip_zh: in advance 表示事先。advance 作名词是进展或预付。

definition_en: the state of being free from control
example1_en: The country marks independence in October.
example1_zh: 这个国家在十月纪念独立。
example2_en: Independence in study means a student can start without waiting to be told every step.
example2_zh: 学习上的独立，是指学生不必每一步都被吩咐也能开始。
collocations: independence from｜脱离……而独立
tip_zh: 形容词 independent 已在本库。Independence Day 要大写。

meanings_zh: n. 贸易；行业 | v. 交易
definition_en: buying and selling, or a kind of work | to buy and sell
example1_en: The town lives by trade with the city.
example1_zh: 这个城镇靠与城市的贸易过活。
example2_en: Fair trade in food means the farmer, not only the shop, receives a living wage.
example2_zh: 公平的食品贸易意味着农民而不只是商店获得足以生活的工资。
collocations: foreign trade｜对外贸易 ; trade with｜与……贸易
tip_zh: trade 作动词是“交易”。

meanings_zh: adj. 本地的；本土的 | n. 本地人
definition_en: belonging to the place where you were born | a person born in a place
example1_en: She is a native speaker of the local dialect.
example2_en: Native plants along the path need less water than a lawn that must stay green.
example2_zh: 路边的本地植物比必须保持翠绿的草坪更省水。
collocations: native language｜母语 ; native speaker｜母语使用者
tip_zh: native 作名词是本地人。用在人身上时要注意礼貌，不要带轻视。

definition_en: a piece of information sent to someone
example1_en: I left a message on her desk.
example2_en: A text message about a storm helps only if it arrives before the road is under water.
example2_zh: 关于风暴的短信只有在路被水淹之前到达才有帮助。
collocations: leave a message｜留口信 ; text message｜短信
tip_zh: message 是可数名词。

definition_en: the salt water covering much of the earth
example1_en: We could smell the sea from the hill.
example1_zh: 我们在山上能闻到海的气味。
example2_en: Plastic that reaches the sea started as packaging someone dropped in a town.
example2_zh: 进入大海的塑料，起初是有人在城镇里丢掉的包装。
collocations: by sea｜由海路 ; at sea｜在海上
tip_zh: by sea 表示经海路，不加 the。go to the sea 常指去海边。

definition_en: a building where people are kept as a legal punishment
example1_en: The history text describes the old prison.
example1_zh: 历史课文描述了那座旧监狱。
example2_en: A town that builds a prison still has to decide what happens to a person on the day they leave.
example2_zh: 建造监狱的城镇，仍要决定一个人出狱那天会发生什么。
collocations: in prison｜在狱中 ; go to prison｜入狱
tip_zh: in prison 表示服刑，通常不加 the。

definition_en: a play in which most of the words are sung
example1_en: The opera starts at seven.
example2_en: An opera that starts after the last bus has already chosen who can come.
example2_zh: 在末班车之后才开演的歌剧，其实已经选定了谁能来。
collocations: an opera of｜一部……歌剧
tip_zh: opera 可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 复杂的 | n. 综合建筑群
definition_en: having many parts | A group of buildings used for related activities.
example1_en: The problem is more complex than it looks.
example2_en: Urban poverty is a complex issue that requires cooperation between governments, businesses and local communities.
example2_zh: 城市贫困是一个复杂问题，需要政府、企业和当地社区共同合作。
collocations: complex issue｜复杂问题 ; complex system｜复杂系统 ; sports complex｜综合体育场馆
tip_zh: 作形容词指复杂；作名词可指综合建筑群。

definition_en: a common food made from flour
example1_en: There is bread in the kitchen.
example2_en: Bread left out all day is not a safe breakfast.
example2_zh: 放了一整天的面包不是安全的早饭。
collocations: a piece of bread｜一片面包
tip_zh: bread 通常不可数。不说 a bread。

definition_en: how hot or cold something is
example1_en: The temperature in the lab is too high.
example2_en: A city that records temperature near schools can see which classrooms need shade.
example2_zh: 记录学校附近温度的城市，能看出哪些教室需要遮阴。
collocations: take one temperature｜量体温 ; body temperature｜体温
tip_zh: temperature 可数。have a temperature 常指发烧。

definition_en: a person or group that hates or fights another
example1_en: The story has no simple enemy.
example1_zh: 这个故事里没有一个简单的敌人。
example2_en: Treating a rival school as an enemy teaches the wrong lesson before a friendly match.
example2_zh: 在友谊赛前把对手学校当成敌人，教给学生的是错误的一课。
collocations: make an enemy of｜与……为敌
tip_zh: enemy 可数。the enemy 作军队时谓语可用单数或复数。

definition_en: in the space or time separating two things
example1_en: The lab is between the library and the hall.
example1_zh: 实验室在图书馆和大厅之间。
example2_en: The difference between knowing a word and using it shows up when students write under time pressure.
example2_zh: 认识一个词和会用一个词的差别，会在学生限时写作时显现出来。
collocations: between...and｜在……和……之间 ; in between｜在中间
tip_zh: between 多用于两者；among 用于三者或更多。

definition_en: at or to a great distance | distant
example1_en: The station is not far from our school.
example2_en: Families who live far from a hospital wait longer when a child is suddenly ill.
example2_zh: 住得离医院远的家庭，孩子突然生病时要等更久。
collocations: far from｜远离 ; so far｜到目前为止 ; as far as｜就……而言
tip_zh: far 的比较级是 farther 或 further；further 还可表示“进一步的”。

definition_en: a well-known statement, or something said
example1_en: There is an old saying about practice.
example1_zh: 有一句关于练习的老话。
example2_en: A saying about saving water means little unless the school itself fixes a leaking tap.
example2_zh: 如果学校自己不修漏水的水龙头，一句关于节水的谚语就没什么意义。
collocations: as the saying goes｜俗话说
tip_zh: saying 也可是 say 的 -ing 形式。作名词“谚语”是可数的。

meanings_zh: n. 要点；点；分数 | v. 指；指向
definition_en: the main idea, a dot, or a score | to show direction with a finger
example1_en: The point of the story is to check your sources.
example1_zh: 这个故事的要点是要核对来源。
example2_en: There is little point in collecting data if nobody is responsible for acting on it.
example2_zh: 如果没有人负责根据数据采取行动，收集数据就没什么意义。
collocations: the point is｜重点是 ; point of view｜观点 ; to the point｜切题
tip_zh: point 作动词是“指”：point at / point to。There is no point in doing 表示做某事没有意义。

definition_en: a business, or the state of being with someone
example1_en: Her mother works for a bus company.
example1_zh: 她母亲在一家公交公司工作。
example2_en: A company that moves its factory should also say what will happen to the workers who stay behind.
example2_zh: 搬迁工厂的公司，也应该说明留下来的工人会怎样。
collocations: keep sb company｜陪伴某人 ; company policy｜公司政策
tip_zh: company 表示陪伴时不可数：for company。表示公司时可数。

definition_en: not one, or not any
example1_en: None of the answers is correct.
example1_zh: 这些答案没有一个是对的。
example2_en: None of the night buses reach the village, so the clinic might as well be closed after dark.
example2_zh: 夜班公交没有一趟到村子，所以诊所天黑后等于关了。
collocations: none of｜……中没有一个
tip_zh: none of 加复数时谓语可用单数或复数；强调“一个也没有”时常用单数。

definition_en: a very large sea
example1_en: The river ends in the ocean.
example2_en: Plastic that leaves a school bin can reach the ocean if nobody stops it on the way.
example2_zh: 如果沿途没人拦住，离开学校垃圾桶的塑料可以一直到海洋。
collocations: across the ocean｜远渡重洋
tip_zh: ocean 比 sea 大。the ocean 常指海洋整体。

meanings_zh: n. 秋千；摆动 | v. 摆动
definition_en: a seat that swings, or a swinging movement | to move backwards and forwards
example1_en: The swing in the yard is for the younger class.
example1_zh: 院子里的秋千是给低年级的。
example2_en: A swing with a loose chain should be closed the same day.
example2_zh: 链子松了的秋千应当当天停用。
collocations: in full swing｜在全力进行
tip_zh: swing 作动词是摆动，过去式是 swung。

definition_en: a room with a bath or toilet
example1_en: The bathroom on this floor is closed.
example2_en: A bathroom that students can reach matters more than a new poster about health.
example2_zh: 学生能够到的卫生间，比一张关于健康的新海报更重要。
collocations: in the bathroom｜在卫生间
tip_zh: 美式 bathroom 常指卫生间。英式有时只指有浴缸的房间。

definition_en: to appear to be
example1_en: The question seems easy at first.
example1_zh: 这道题起初似乎很容易。
example2_en: A street can seem safe in daylight and still be dark for the walk home at night.
example2_zh: 一条街在白天可以看起来安全，夜里回家时仍然很黑。
collocations: seem to do｜似乎做 ; it seems that｜似乎
tip_zh: seem 后接形容词、to do 或 that 从句。

definition_en: related to the nucleus of an atom
example1_en: The chapter explains nuclear energy in simple words.
example1_zh: 这一章用简单的话解释核能。
example2_en: A town that discusses nuclear power should also publish the emergency plan.
example2_zh: 讨论核电的城镇，也应当公布应急方案。
collocations: nuclear energy｜核能 ; nuclear family｜核心家庭
tip_zh: nuclear family 指父母和子女组成的家庭，不是核能。本条不提供任何制造或使用危险材料的方法。

definition_en: about science, or done in a careful tested way
example1_en: The scientific report includes the measurements.
example1_zh: 这份科学报告包含测量数据。
example2_en: A scientific claim about sleep should show how the numbers were collected.
example2_zh: 关于睡眠的科学主张应当说明数字是怎么收集的。
collocations: scientific method｜科学方法
tip_zh: scientific 是形容词。名词科学是 science，已在本库。

definition_en: an official rule
example1_en: The regulation is on the lab door.
example2_en: A regulation that students can hardly read is not one they can follow.
example2_zh: 学生几乎读不懂的规章，不是他们能遵守的规章。
collocations: safety regulations｜安全规章
tip_zh: regulation 可数。

definition_en: the act of getting ready
example1_en: Preparation for the exam includes sleep.
example2_en: Preparation that never names the return bus will fail the trip.
example2_zh: 从不写回程公交的准备会让这次出行失败。
collocations: in preparation for｜为……做准备
tip_zh: 动词 prepare 已在本库。preparation 可数也可不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 警报；闹钟 | v. 使惊慌
definition_en: a warning signal, or a clock that wakes you | to make someone afraid
example1_en: The alarm rang at seven.
example2_en: An alarm that nobody can hear is not a fire plan.
example2_zh: 没人听得见的警报不是消防方案。
collocations: alarm clock｜闹钟 ; set the alarm｜设闹钟
tip_zh: alarm 作动词是使惊恐。本条不写如何制造危险。

definition_en: an official paper that proves something
example1_en: The certificate is in the office.
example2_en: A certificate that families cannot read should also have plain words.
example2_zh: 家庭读不懂的证书，也应当配上明白的话。
collocations: a certificate of｜……的证书
tip_zh: certificate 可数。

definition_en: in spite of that, or in any case
example1_en: It was raining, but we walked anyway.
example1_zh: 当时在下雨，但我们还是走了。
example2_en: The poster looks fine. Anyway, the real question is whether the bus arrives.
example2_zh: 海报看起来不错。无论如何，真正的问题是公交是否到达。
collocations: anyway｜反正
tip_zh: anyway 多用于口语，常放在句首或句末。

definition_en: related to electricity
example1_en: The electrical fault closed the lab.
example1_zh: 电气故障让实验室关了门。
example2_en: An electrical repair needs an adult, not a student with a loose wire.
example2_zh: 电气维修需要成年人，而不是拿着松脱电线的学生。
collocations: electrical equipment｜电气设备
tip_zh: 电动设备多用 electric；电气系统多用 electrical。本条不写如何修电路。

definition_en: clothes in general
example1_en: Wet clothing dries slowly in this room.
example1_zh: 湿衣服在这个房间里干得很慢。
example2_en: Spare clothing at school matters when the morning rain soaks the first set.
example2_zh: 早晨的雨打湿第一套衣服时，学校里的备用衣服就有用。
collocations: an item of clothing｜一件衣服
tip_zh: clothing 是总称，不可数。一件用 an item of clothing。clothes 已在本库，是复数。

meanings_zh: n. 解释 | n. 原因；解释理由
definition_en: words that make something clear | a reason given for why something happened
example1_en: Her explanation helped us understand.
example1_zh: 她的解释帮助我们理解。
example2_en: One possible explanation for declining car ownership is the growing availability of reliable public transport.
example2_zh: 汽车拥有率下降的一个可能原因，是可靠的公共交通越来越普及。
collocations: clear explanation｜清楚的解释 ; give an explanation｜作出解释 ; explanation for｜对……的原因解释 ; explanation of｜对……的说明
tip_zh: explanation of多说明内容，for多解释原因。

definition_en: how high something is
example1_en: The height of the shelf is on the label.
example1_zh: 架子的高度写在标签上。
example2_en: The height of a flood mark tells the next class what the last storm did.
example2_zh: 洪水痕迹的高度告诉下一届学生上次风暴做了什么。
collocations: in height｜高度为 ; at the height of｜在……的顶点
tip_zh: 形容词 high 已在本库。问身高用 How tall，不用 How high 指人时要小心；身高也常用 height。

definition_en: sad because something was not as good as hoped
example1_en: She was disappointed with the score, not with the effort.
example1_zh: 她对分数失望，不是对努力失望。
example2_en: Parents are disappointed when the bus time changes and nobody writes it down.
example2_zh: 公交时间变了却没人写下来时，家长会失望。
collocations: be disappointed with｜对……失望 ; disappointed to do｜因做……而失望
tip_zh: disappointed 形容人。disappointing 形容事物。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

definition_en: whole
example1_en: The entire class passed the test.
example1_zh: 整个班级都通过了考试。

definition_en: almost
example1_en: It is nearly eight.
example2_en: A clinic that is nearly an hour away is too far for a child who cannot breathe well.
example2_zh: 将近一小时路程的诊所，对呼吸困难的孩子来说太远了。
collocations: nearly all｜几乎全部
tip_zh: nearly 和 almost 常可互换；almost 更能修饰 no 和 never。

meanings_zh: v. 跳舞 | n. 舞蹈；舞会
definition_en: to move to music | a set of movements, or a social event
example1_en: They dance in the hall on Fridays.
example2_en: A school dance can bring a class together if the cost does not keep some students out.
example2_zh: 如果费用不把一些学生挡在外面，学校舞会可以把一个班聚在一起。
collocations: dance to｜随着……跳舞
tip_zh: dance 也可作名词“舞蹈”。

definition_en: liked more than others
example1_en: Blue is her favorite colour.
example1_zh: 蓝色是她最喜欢的颜色。
example2_en: A student's favorite reading place may be a shared table, not a quiet room of their own.
example2_zh: 学生最喜欢的阅读地点可能是一张共用的桌子，而不是自己的安静房间。
collocations: favorite book｜最喜欢的书
tip_zh: favorite 是美式拼写；英式是 favourite。意思相同。

definition_en: further than, or outside the range of
example1_en: The village is beyond the hill.
example2_en: The cost of dirty air goes beyond the hospital bill and into lost days at school.
example2_zh: 脏空气的代价超出医院账单，还包括在学校损失的天数。
collocations: beyond doubt｜毫无疑问
tip_zh: beyond 是介词，后接名词。

definition_en: a hot drink made from leaves
example1_en: The teachers drink tea in the office.
example2_en: Afternoon tea in some families is a meal, not only a cup.
example2_zh: 在有些家庭，下午茶是一餐，而不只是一杯饮料。
collocations: a cup of tea｜一杯茶 ; make tea｜泡茶
tip_zh: tea 作物质名词不可数。a tea 可以指一杯茶。

meanings_zh: v. 改变；更换 | n. 变化；零钱
definition_en: to become different, or to replace | a difference, or coins returned
example1_en: We changed the time of the meeting.
example2_en: Cities that change bus routes without warning leave workers late and children waiting in the dark.
example2_zh: 不预先通知就更改公交线路的城市，会让工人迟到，让孩子在黑暗中等候。
collocations: change into｜变成 ; change one's mind｜改变主意
tip_zh: change 可作及物或不及物动词。

meanings_zh: v. 竞争 | v. 参加比赛
definition_en: to try to win against others | Take part in a sporting event or other contest.
example1_en: Many teams compete for the prize.
example1_zh: 许多队伍竞争这个奖项。
example2_en: Small businesses often struggle to compete with larger companies that can offer lower prices.
example2_zh: 小企业往往难以与能够提供更低价格的大公司竞争。
collocations: compete with｜与……竞争 ; compete for｜争夺 ; compete in a tournament｜参加锦标赛
tip_zh: compete with/against对手；for奖项；in赛事。

definition_en: fair and sensible
example1_en: The price is reasonable.
example2_en: A reasonable timetable leaves time to eat, not only time to score.
example2_zh: 合理的课表留出吃饭的时间，而不只是得分的时间。
collocations: a reasonable price｜公道的价格
tip_zh: reasonable 来自 reason。It is reasonable to do。

definition_en: a period of one hundred years
example1_en: The bridge was built in the last century.
example2_en: A town that grew in one century can lose its river in a single decade of careless building.
example2_zh: 一个世纪里成长起来的城镇，可能在十年粗心的建设中失去它的河。
collocations: the 21st century｜21世纪
tip_zh: in the twentieth century 表示在二十世纪。

definition_en: prepared
example1_en: Are you ready for the listening test?
example1_zh: 听力测试你准备好了吗？
example2_en: A town is not ready for a flood if the only high road is already full of parked cars.
example2_zh: 如果唯一的高路已经停满车，一个城镇就还没有为洪水做好准备。
collocations: be ready to do｜准备好做 ; get ready｜做准备
tip_zh: be ready for 后接名词；be ready to do 后接动词。

definition_en: a complete change in government or in a way of doing something
example1_en: The chapter describes the revolution in simple words.
example1_zh: 这一章用简单的话描述那场革命。
example2_en: A revolution in bus routes still needs a map the next morning.
example2_zh: 公交线路的大变革，第二天早上仍然需要一张地图。
collocations: industrial revolution｜工业革命
tip_zh: revolution 可数。也可指旋转一周。

meanings_zh: n. 得分；分数 | v. 得分
definition_en: the points in a game or test | to get a point or a mark
example1_en: The final score was two to one.
example2_en: A low score on a listening test may show noise in the room, not only a weak ear.
example2_zh: 听力测验分数低，可能说明房间吵，而不只是耳朵不行。
collocations: score a goal｜进球 ; full score｜满分
tip_zh: score 作动词是得分。比分的说法是 two to one。

meanings_zh: adj. 独立的 | adj. 不受控制的；独立的 | adj. 无关联的；互不影响的
definition_en: not needing others' control | not controlled by another person, organisation, or country | not connected with or affected by something else
example1_en: She became more independent at college.
example2_en: Independent research can help governments assess whether new environmental policies are achieving their intended goals.
example2_zh: 独立研究可以帮助政府评估新的环境政策是否正在实现预期目标。
collocations: financially independent｜经济独立的 ; independent research｜独立研究 ; independent of｜不依赖；不受影响 ; independent judgement｜独立判断
tip_zh: 常搭配of：independent of意为不依赖或不受影响。

definition_en: on
example1_en: The decision depends upon the bus timetable.
example1_zh: 这个决定取决于公交时刻表。
example2_en: Once upon a time is a story opening, but real towns still depend upon roads and water.
example2_zh: Once upon a time 是故事的开头，但真实的城镇仍然依靠道路和水。
collocations: once upon a time｜从前 ; depend upon｜依靠
tip_zh: upon 比 on 更正式，意思常常相同。

definition_en: to stay, or to be left
example1_en: Please remain in your seats until the bell.
example2_en: The questions that remain after a lesson are often the ones worth writing down.
example2_zh: 一节课结束后仍留下的问题，往往值得写下来。
collocations: remain silent｜保持沉默 ; it remains to be seen｜尚待分晓
tip_zh: remain 是连系动词，后接形容词：remain calm。不能说 remain to do 表示“仍然要做”时要小心，剩下要做的常用 it remains to do。

definition_en: a thought or plan
example1_en: That is a good idea for the poster.
example1_zh: 对海报来说那是个好主意。
example2_en: An idea for a new park fails if nobody asks who will water the trees after the opening day.
example2_zh: 如果没人问开放日之后谁来给树浇水，建新公园的想法就会失败。
collocations: have no idea｜不知道 ; the idea of｜……的想法
tip_zh: idea 是可数名词：an idea。

definition_en: one side of a sheet in a book
example1_en: The answer is on page twelve.
example2_en: A torn page in a shared textbook matters when the school cannot buy a new copy.
example2_zh: 当学校买不起新书时，共用课本上撕掉的一页就很要紧。
collocations: on page｜在第……页 ; front page｜头版
tip_zh: page 前用 on：on page 5。

definition_en: to make a picture, or to pull
example1_en: Draw the map before you write the paragraph.
example1_zh: 写段落之前先把地图画出来。
example2_en: Cities draw young workers when housing and night buses exist, not only when the posters are bright.
example2_zh: 当住房和夜班公交都存在时，城市才会吸引年轻工人，而不只是海报鲜亮的时候。
collocations: draw a conclusion｜得出结论 ; draw up｜起草
tip_zh: draw 的过去式是 drew，过去分词是 drawn。draw 也可表示吸引。

meanings_zh: v. 行动；表演 | n. 行为；法令
definition_en: to do something, or to perform | something done, or a law
example1_en: We must act before the river rises again.
example1_zh: 我们必须在河水再次上涨前行动。
example2_en: Schools that act on student suggestions show that those suggestions were not only a form to fill.
example2_zh: 根据学生建议采取行动的学校，表明那些建议不只是一张要填的表。
collocations: act as｜充当 ; act on｜按照……行动
tip_zh: act 强调行动；action 是名词。

definition_en: one of the four parts of the year, or a sports period
example1_en: Autumn is my favourite season.
example1_zh: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节。
example2_en: A long dry season can empty village wells before the next rain arrives.
example2_zh: 漫长的旱季会在下一场雨到来前抽干村里的水井。
collocations: rainy season｜雨季 ; in season｜当令
tip_zh: 季节前常用 in：in summer。

definition_en: towards a lower place
example1_en: Please sit down and open your books.
example2_en: When a factory closes down, the town has to find new work for the people who stayed.
example2_zh: 当一家工厂倒闭时，城镇必须为留下来的人找到新的工作。
collocations: sit down｜坐下 ; write down｜写下 ; up and down｜上上下下
tip_zh: down 可作副词或介词：walk down the street。

meanings_zh: v. 猜测 | n. 猜测
definition_en: to give an answer without being sure | an answer given without proof
example1_en: Can you guess the last word?
example1_zh: 你能猜出最后一个词吗？
example2_en: Planners should not guess where floods reach when residents can show them the marks on the wall.
example2_zh: 当居民能指出墙上的水痕时，规划者不该猜测洪水淹到哪里。
collocations: guess at｜猜测 ; I guess｜我想
tip_zh: guess 后可直接接从句。

definition_en: to speak to a god, or to hope strongly
example1_en: Some students pray before the meal.
example2_en: A school can leave time to pray without making it a rule for everyone.
example2_zh: 学校可以留出祈祷的时间，而不把它变成每个人的规定。
collocations: pray for｜为……祈祷
tip_zh: 名词 prayer 是本批的另一词。本条不是劝人信教。

definition_en: a conversation, or the words spoken in a story
example1_en: The dialogue is on page two.
example2_en: A dialogue about the bus should include the quiet student.
example2_zh: 关于公交的对话应当包括那位安静的学生。
collocations: a dialogue between｜……之间的对话
tip_zh: dialogue 是英式。美式常拼 dialog，目前本库是 dialogue。

definition_en: a plant smaller than a tree
example1_en: The bush by the gate needs cutting.
example2_en: A bush that hides the crossing sign is not decoration; move it.
example2_zh: 挡住路口标志的灌木不是装饰，把它移开。
collocations: a rose bush｜玫瑰丛
tip_zh: bush 可数。the bush 在有的国家指荒野。

definition_en: happening quickly and unexpectedly
example1_en: The sudden rain closed the match.
example2_en: A sudden change in the bus time should be written the same hour.
example2_zh: 公交时间的突然改变，应当在同一小时写出来。
collocations: all of a sudden｜突然
tip_zh: suddenly 是副词。

definition_en: a piece of equipment that does work
example1_en: This machine copies the notice for every class.
example1_zh: 这台机器给每个班复印通知。
example2_en: A washing machine saves time, but a school still has to teach students how to share one.
example2_zh: 洗衣机能省时间，但学校仍要教学生如何共用一台。
collocations: washing machine｜洗衣机
tip_zh: machine 是可数名词。统称机器设备常用 machinery，不可数。

definition_en: having the power or skill to do something
example1_en: She is able to explain the diagram clearly.
example2_en: Students are more able to concentrate when the classroom is quiet and the air is fresh.
example2_zh: 当教室安静、空气新鲜时，学生更能集中注意力。
collocations: be able to｜能够 ; able student｜有能力的学生
tip_zh: can 多指一般能力；be able to 可用于各种时态，并强调做成。

meanings_zh: n. 格式 | v. 编排
definition_en: the way something is arranged | to arrange in a format
example1_en: Keep the same format for every notice.
example2_en: A clear format names the time before the welcome.
example2_zh: 清楚的格式先写时间，再写欢迎。
collocations: in this format｜以这种格式
tip_zh: format 作动词是编排，计算机里也可指格式化。本条不写破坏数据的操作。

meanings_zh: n. 焦点；重点 | n. 重点；关注中心 | n. 清晰度；焦点
definition_en: the center of attention | the main subject receiving attention or effort | image sharpness, or the point where light rays meet
example1_en: Keep your focus on the task.
example1_zh: 把注意力集中在任务上。
example2_en: Governments should focus on affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
example2_zh: 政府应重点发展价格合理的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善就业机会的可达性。
collocations: focus on｜集中于 ; the main focus｜主要关注点 ; in focus｜影像清晰 ; out of focus｜影像模糊
tip_zh: focus on后接名词或动名词；不要说focus in。

meanings_zh: adj. 红色的 | n. 红色
definition_en: of the colour of blood | the colour red
example1_en: The red bag on the chair is mine.
example2_en: Red warnings on a river app help only if people who live nearby can actually receive them.
example2_zh: 河流应用上的红色警报只有在附近居民真能收到时才有用。
collocations: red light｜红灯
tip_zh: red 也可作名词表示红色。

definition_en: goodbye
example1_en: She said bye at the gate.
example2_en: A bye on the phone is not a record of the bus time.
example2_zh: 电话里一声再见不是公交时间的记录。
collocations: bye for now｜回头见
tip_zh: bye 是 goodbye 的口语。

definition_en: the main meal of the day
example1_en: Dinner is at six in our hall.
example2_en: A free dinner at school can matter more than a speech about healthy food.
example2_zh: 学校的一顿免费晚餐，可能比一场关于健康饮食的演讲更重要。
collocations: have dinner｜吃晚饭 ; dinner party｜宴会
tip_zh: dinner 在不同地方可以指午餐或晚餐，都是一天的正餐。

definition_en: the act of arriving
example1_en: The arrival of the bus was late.
example2_en: The arrival time should be on the same sheet as the return time.
example2_zh: 到达时间应当和返回时间写在同一张纸上。
collocations: on arrival｜到达时 ; the arrival of｜……的到达
tip_zh: 动词 arrive 是本批的另一词。arrival 通常不可数，一次到达可以说 an arrival。

definition_en: personal computer
example1_en: The lab has one PC for two students.
example1_zh: 实验室里两名学生共用一台个人电脑。
example2_en: A PC at home does not replace a quiet place to read.
example2_zh: 家里的个人电脑代替不了一个安静的阅读角落。
collocations: a school PC｜学校的个人电脑
tip_zh: PC 与 p.c. 是同一个缩写，本库只保留 PC。personal computer 已在本库。

definition_en: to carry something towards the speaker
example1_en: Please bring your student card tomorrow.
example2_en: New jobs bring people to a town only if there is also a place for them to live.
example2_zh: 只有同时有地方住，新工作才会把人带到一个城镇。
collocations: bring about｜引起 ; bring up｜抚养；提出
tip_zh: bring 是带来（朝说话人）；take 是带走。过去式是 brought。

definition_en: of several different kinds
example1_en: The library has various maps of the town.
example1_zh: 图书馆有各种各样的城镇地图。
example2_en: Various reasons, from rent to bus times, push young workers out of a small town.
example2_zh: 从房租到公交时间，各种各样的原因把年轻工人推出小镇。
collocations: various kinds of｜各种各样的
tip_zh: various 后接复数名词。

definition_en: why something happens
example1_en: The reason for the delay was the rain.
example2_en: The reason a street floods is often an old drain, not only a heavy cloud.
example2_zh: 街道积水的原因常常是旧排水管，而不只是厚云。
collocations: the reason for｜……的原因 ; the reason why｜……的原因
tip_zh: the reason 后用 why 或 that，不要再用 because 重复原因。

definition_en: material made from animal skin
example1_en: The bag is leather.
example2_en: Leather shoes still need a dry place after the rain.
example2_zh: 皮鞋在雨后仍然需要一个干的地方。
collocations: leather shoes｜皮鞋
tip_zh: leather 作材料通常不可数。

definition_en: the largest continent
example1_en: Asia appears on the first map in the book.
example1_zh: 亚洲出现在书里的第一张地图上。
example2_en: A chapter about Asia should not treat the whole continent as one climate.
example2_zh: 写亚洲的一章不应当把整块大陆当成同一种气候。
