collocations: in Asia｜在亚洲
tip_zh: Asia 要大写。形容词 Asian 已在本库。

meanings_zh: n. 颜色 | v. 给……着色
definition_en: British spelling of color | to add colour
example1_en: What colour is the new notice?
example2_en: The colour of flood water does not tell you whether it is safe.
example2_zh: 洪水的颜色并不能告诉你它是否安全。
collocations: colour of｜……的颜色
tip_zh: colour 是英式，color 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留，因为考纲里都有，搜索只匹配词头。

definition_en: the organ of sight
example1_en: She has brown eyes.
example2_en: Too little light in a classroom tires the eye before the lesson is over.
example2_zh: 教室光线太暗，课还没结束眼睛就累了。
collocations: keep an eye on｜照看 ; in the eyes of｜在……看来
tip_zh: eye 的复数是 eyes。

meanings_zh: adj. 频繁的 | v. 常去；常到访
definition_en: happening often | Visit a particular place regularly
example1_en: frequent rain delayed the flight.
example1_zh: 频繁的降雨延误了航班。
example2_en: Frequent changes in education policy can make it difficult for teachers to plan effective lessons.
example2_zh: 教育政策频繁变化，可能使教师难以规划有效的课堂教学。
collocations: frequent visits｜频繁到访 ; frequent delays｜频繁延误 ; a frequent visitor｜常客 ; frequent changes｜频繁变化
tip_zh: 形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

definition_en: the time from noon until evening
example1_en: The match is on Friday afternoon.
example2_en: A hot afternoon in a room with shut windows is a health problem, not a character test.
example2_zh: 窗户关着的炎热下午是健康问题，不是对性格的考验。
collocations: in the afternoon｜在下午 ; tomorrow afternoon｜明天下午
tip_zh: 泛指下午用 in the afternoon。具体某一天用 on Friday afternoon。

definition_en: a shirt with short sleeves and no collar
example1_en: He wore a clean T-shirt to the photo.
example1_zh: 他穿着干净的 T 恤去拍照。
example2_en: A T-shirt rule that costs too much keeps some students out of the team photo.
example2_zh: 花费过高的 T 恤规定，会让一些学生进不了集体照。
collocations: a cotton T-shirt｜棉 T 恤
tip_zh: T-shirt 也可写成 tee shirt。shirt 是本批的另一词，通常有领。

definition_en: mathematics; American short form
example1_en: Math is the first lesson on Monday.
example2_en: A math problem about the bus is more useful than a number with no story.
example2_zh: 一道关于公交的数学题，比一个没有情境的数字更有用。
collocations: math class｜数学课
tip_zh: math 是美式简称。英式常用 maths。本库用考纲里的 math。学科前通常不加 the，但可以说 the math lesson。

definition_en: a large vehicle for carrying goods
example1_en: The truck blocked the school gate.
example2_en: A truck route that avoids the gate is safer than a sign that says slow.
example2_zh: 避开校门的卡车路线，比一块写着慢行的牌子更安全。
collocations: a truck of｜一卡车
tip_zh: truck 是美式。英式常用 lorry。

definition_en: happening a short time ago
example1_en: A recent photo shows the new bridge.
example2_en: Recent floods should change where the town allows new houses, not only this year's repairs.
example2_zh: 最近的洪水应该改变城镇允许建新房的位置，而不只是今年的修补。
collocations: in recent years｜近年来
tip_zh: recent 是形容词；recently 是副词。

meanings_zh: n. 结尾；末端 | v. 结束
definition_en: the last part of something | to finish
example1_en: Please write your name at the end of the page.
example2_en: The end of a holiday is a good time to ask which local shops actually benefited from the visitors.
example2_zh: 假期结束时，适合问问哪些本地店铺真正从游客那里获益。
collocations: in the end｜最后 ; at the end of｜在……末尾 ; end up｜最终成为
tip_zh: in the end 表示最终；at the end of 后面要接具体的时间或事物。

definition_en: a contract that pays if something bad happens
example1_en: Health insurance helped the family pay the bill.
example1_zh: 健康保险帮助这个家庭付了账单。
example2_en: Insurance does not replace a clinic that is close enough to reach at night.
example2_zh: 保险替代不了一家夜里能够到达的诊所。
collocations: health insurance｜健康保险
tip_zh: insurance 通常不可数。

definition_en: easily affected, or understanding feelings
example1_en: The topic is sensitive, so the names stay off the board.
example1_zh: 这个话题很敏感，所以名字不写在板上。
example2_en: A sensitive teacher notices who has no coat before the speech about weather.
example2_zh: 体贴的老师在关于天气的讲话之前，就会注意到谁没有外套。
collocations: be sensitive to｜对……敏感
tip_zh: sensitive 可指容易受影响，也可指善解人意。不要和 sensible（明智的）混淆。

definition_en: very pleasant to taste
example1_en: The soup was delicious.
example2_en: Delicious food that hides nuts should say so on the label.
example2_zh: 藏着坚果的美食应当在标签上写明。
collocations: delicious meal｜美味的一餐
tip_zh: delicious 形容食物。

definition_en: to make something full, or to write information
example1_en: Fill the form before you leave.
example2_en: Bottles that fill the recycling bin by noon show the canteen what it sells.
example2_zh: 中午就把回收桶装满的瓶子，告诉食堂它在卖什么。
collocations: fill in｜填写 ; fill with｜用……装满
tip_zh: 填表英式常用 fill in，美式常用 fill out。

definition_en: unable to see, or not based on reason
example1_en: The sign is in large print for students who are not fully blind but cannot read small type.
example1_zh: 牌子用大字，给那些并非全盲但看不清小字的学生。
example2_en: A blind rule that ignores the last bus will fail the students who need it.
example2_zh: 无视末班车的盲目规定，会让需要它的学生吃亏。
collocations: turn a blind eye｜视而不见
tip_zh: 说视力时要尊重对方。blind 也可比喻盲目。用 the blind 指一类人时要谨慎。

definition_en: a building where goods are made
example1_en: The factory is outside the town.
example2_en: A factory near a school should publish what it releases into the air.
example2_zh: 学校附近的工厂应当公布它排到空气里的东西。
collocations: a factory worker｜工厂工人
tip_zh: factory 可数。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

meanings_zh: v. 希望；祝愿 | n. 愿望
definition_en: to want something that may not be real | a desire
example1_en: I wish you a good journey.
example2_en: Residents wish the clinic were closer, but wishes do not move a building.
example2_zh: 居民希望诊所更近，但愿望搬不走一座楼。
collocations: wish to do｜希望做 ; wish sb sth｜祝愿某人
tip_zh: wish 后接虚拟语气，表示与事实相反；hope 后接真实的希望。

definition_en: relaxed, or not formal
example1_en: The meeting is casual, but the time is fixed.
example1_zh: 见面很随意，但时间是定好的。
example2_en: Casual clothes still need a name on the lost-property form.
example2_zh: 便装在失物表格上仍然需要一个名字。
collocations: casual clothes｜便装
tip_zh: casual 也可表示偶然的。

definition_en: tables, chairs, and similar objects
example1_en: The furniture is old but safe.
example2_en: Furniture that blocks the exit is not a design.
example2_zh: 挡住出口的家具不是设计。
collocations: a piece of furniture｜一件家具
tip_zh: furniture 不可数。一件用 a piece of furniture。

definition_en: a flower with a sweet smell and thorns
example1_en: She put a rose on the teacher's desk.
example1_zh: 她在老师桌上放了一朵玫瑰。
example2_en: A rose in the school garden needs water in August, when most students are away.
example2_zh: 学校花园里的玫瑰在八月需要浇水，而那时大多数学生不在。
collocations: a red rose｜红玫瑰
tip_zh: rose 也是 rise（上升）的过去式。作花名时是名词。

meanings_zh: n. 纽扣；按钮 | v. 扣上
definition_en: a small disc on clothes, or a control you press | to fasten with buttons
example1_en: The button on the coat is loose.
example2_en: A button that calls the office should be where a student can reach it.
example2_zh: 呼叫办公室的按钮应当装在学生够得着的地方。
collocations: press a button｜按按钮
tip_zh: button 作动词是扣上。

definition_en: to begin to be
example1_en: The room will become quiet when the talk starts.
example1_zh: 讲座开始时房间会安静下来。
example2_en: A neighbourhood can become unsafe for walking if shops close and the street lights fail.
example2_zh: 如果商店关门、路灯不亮，一个社区会变得不适合步行。
collocations: become of｜发生……情况
tip_zh: become 后接形容词或名词，不加 to be。过去分词仍是 become。

definition_en: land with water all around it
example1_en: We read a story about a small island.
example1_zh: 我们读了一个关于小岛的故事。
example2_en: An island school depends on the boat timetable as much as on its teachers.
example2_zh: 岛上的学校对船的时刻表的依赖，不亚于对老师的依赖。
collocations: on an island｜在岛上
tip_zh: island 前的元音用 an：an island。

definition_en: the thick part of milk
example1_en: The cake has too much cream.
example2_en: Cream left in the sun is not a treat; it is a risk.
example2_zh: 放在太阳下的奶油不是款待，是风险。
collocations: ice cream｜冰淇淋
tip_zh: cream 通常不可数。ice cream 是冰淇淋。

definition_en: chance, especially good chance
example1_en: Good luck on the oral test tomorrow.
example1_zh: 祝你明天口语考试好运。
example2_en: Luck may open a door, but a student still has to walk through it with preparation.
example2_zh: 运气也许能打开一扇门，但学生仍要靠准备自己走进去。
collocations: good luck｜好运 ; a stroke of luck｜一次走运
tip_zh: luck 不可数。祝愿用 Good luck，不要说 a good luck。

definition_en: the earth, or a particular area of activity
example1_en: Students from three countries joined the world map project.
example1_zh: 来自三个国家的学生参加了世界地图项目。
example2_en: The online world gives teenagers a voice, but it also spreads rumours faster than a classroom can correct them.
example2_zh: 网络世界给了青少年发言的机会，但谣言传播的速度也快过课堂能够纠正的速度。
collocations: all over the world｜全世界 ; in the world｜在世界上
tip_zh: in the world 常与最高级连用，加强语气。

definition_en: anxious
example1_en: Parents were worried about the late bus.
example2_en: A worried note from a student is information, not a nuisance.
example2_zh: 学生写来的担心是信息，不是麻烦。
collocations: be worried about｜担心
tip_zh: worried 形容人。worry 已在本库。worrying 形容令人担心的事物。

meanings_zh: n. 离婚 | v. 离婚
definition_en: the legal end of a marriage | to legally end a marriage
example1_en: The form does not ask about divorce in public.
example1_zh: 表格不在公开场合询问离婚。
example2_en: A school should not shame a student because of a divorce at home.
example2_zh: 学校不应当因为家里的离婚而让学生感到羞耻。
collocations: divorce from｜与……离婚
tip_zh: divorce 作动词是离婚。说话时要尊重家庭。

definition_en: a senior priest in some Christian churches
example1_en: The history text mentions a bishop, not a rule for today.
example1_zh: 历史课文提到一位主教，不是今天的规定。
example2_en: A visit to a church can name the bishop and still not tell students what to believe.
example2_zh: 参观教堂可以提到主教，同时仍然不告诉学生该信什么。
collocations: a bishop of｜……的主教
tip_zh: bishop 是称谓。本条是词汇，不是劝人信教。

definition_en: to act as if something is true when it is not
example1_en: Do not pretend the late bus arrived.
example1_zh: 不要假装晚班车已经到了。
example2_en: A student should not have to pretend that a broken step is safe.
example2_zh: 不应当让学生假装坏台阶是安全的。
collocations: pretend to do｜假装做
tip_zh: 表里这一行的音标是 pressure，本库不用。

definition_en: to take liquid into the mouth | a liquid for drinking
example1_en: Drink some water before the run.
example2_en: Towns that drink from the same river have to agree on what factories may pour into it.
example2_zh: 共用一条河取水的城镇，必须约定工厂可以向河里排什么。
collocations: drink water｜喝水 ; soft drink｜软饮料
tip_zh: drink 的过去式是 drank，过去分词是 drunk。

definition_en: a group with a purpose, or the act of arranging
example1_en: The organization collected books for the village school.
example1_zh: 这个组织为乡村学校收集了书。
example2_en: Good organization of a fire drill matters more than a long speech about safety.
example2_zh: 消防演习的良好组织，比关于安全的长篇讲话更重要。
collocations: international organization｜国际组织
tip_zh: organization 是美式拼写；英式常用 organisation。

definition_en: not true or not real
example1_en: The rumour was false.
example2_en: A false alarm still needs a check, or the next real one will be ignored.
example2_zh: 假警报仍然需要核查，否则下一次真的会被忽视。
collocations: false alarm｜假警报
tip_zh: false 是形容词。名词错误用 mistake 或 error。

definition_en: not usual
example1_en: An empty bus at four is unusual.
example2_en: An unusual result in the lab is a reason to measure again.
example2_zh: 实验室里不寻常的结果，是再测一次的理由。
collocations: unusual for｜对……来说不寻常
tip_zh: usual 已在本库。unusual 是反义。

meanings_zh: adj. 灰色的 | n. 灰色
definition_en: of the colour between black and white; British spelling | the colour grey
example1_en: The sky is grey this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上天空是灰色的。
example2_en: A grey area in the rule should be written in one sentence.
example2_zh: 规定里的灰色地带应当用一句话写清。
collocations: grey hair｜灰白头发
tip_zh: grey 是英式，gray 是美式。考纲里两种都有，本库两条都保留，搜索只匹配词头。

definition_en: fine dry powder
example1_en: Dust covered the map.
example2_en: Dust in the lab is a reason to cover the bottles.
example2_zh: 实验室里的灰尘是把瓶子盖上的理由。
collocations: a cloud of dust｜一片尘土
tip_zh: dust 通常不可数。作动词是掸灰。

definition_en: the business of providing holidays
example1_en: Tourism brings money, and also crowds.
example1_zh: 旅游业带来钱，也带来人群。
example2_en: Tourism that closes the local bus for visitors is not a gift to the town.
example2_zh: 为游客停掉本地公交的旅游业，不是给城镇的礼物。
collocations: tourism industry｜旅游业
tip_zh: tourism 通常不可数。

definition_en: an act of travelling from one place to another
example1_en: The journey takes two hours by bus.
example1_zh: 这段路程乘公交要两小时。
example2_en: A journey to a museum teaches more when the return time is written on the same sheet.
example2_zh: 如果回程时间写在同一张纸上，去博物馆的旅程会更有收获。
collocations: a journey to｜去……的旅行
tip_zh: journey 常比 trip 更长或更正式。动词旅行用 travel。

definition_en: very silly or unreasonable
example1_en: The rumour is ridiculous.
example2_en: It is ridiculous to blame a student for a bus the town cancelled.
example2_zh: 因为城镇取消的公交去责备学生，是荒谬的。
collocations: a ridiculous idea｜荒谬的想法
tip_zh: ridiculous 程度很强。不要用来嘲笑同学的外表。

definition_en: to gain knowledge or skill
example1_en: We learn new words by using them.
example1_zh: 我们通过使用来学会生词。
example2_en: Children learn road safety by walking with an adult, not only by reading a poster.
example2_zh: 孩子通过和成年人一起走路来学习交通安全，而不只是读海报。
collocations: learn to do｜学做 ; learn from｜向……学习
tip_zh: learn 强调学会；study 强调学习的过程。

definition_en: protection, or the argument for someone
example1_en: The town's defense against floods is still a low wall.
example1_zh: 城镇的防洪仍然只是一堵矮墙。
example2_en: A strong defense of a plan should include the people who disagree with it.
example2_zh: 对一个计划的有力辩护，应该包括不同意它的人。
collocations: in defense of｜为……辩护
tip_zh: defense 是美式拼写；英式是 defence。

definition_en: wide
example1_en: The path is broad enough for two people.
example1_zh: 这条路宽得能过两个人。
example2_en: A broad rule that says nothing clear is harder to follow than a short one.
example2_zh: 一条宽泛却什么也没说清的规定，比一条短的更难遵守。
collocations: a broad smile｜满面笑容
tip_zh: broad 与 wide 相近。broad 更常用于比喻：a broad range。

definition_en: to take something from a person or place by force
example1_en: The novel says the shop was robbed, and then it stops.
example1_zh: 小说写商店被抢，然后就停住了。
example2_en: News of a robbery should give the place and the date, not a method.
example2_zh: 抢劫新闻应当给出地点和日期，而不是方法。
collocations: rob sb of｜抢劫某人的
tip_zh: rob 的宾语是人或地方，不是被抢走的东西。steal 的宾语才是东西。本条不写作案方法。

meanings_zh: n. 南；南方 | adj. 南方的
definition_en: the direction opposite north | in or towards the south
example1_en: The library is to the south of the stadium.
example2_en: Towns in the south may face longer summers, which changes when schools can hold sports outdoors.
example2_zh: 南方的城镇可能面临更长的夏天，这会改变学校何时能在户外运动。
collocations: in the south｜在南方 ; South Africa｜南非
tip_zh: in the south of 表示在某范围的南部；to the south of 表示在某地以南。

definition_en: to speak or act for someone, or to be a sign of something
example1_en: She will represent the class at the meeting.
example2_en: One photo does not represent every family that uses the school.
example2_zh: 一张照片代表不了使用这所学校的每一个家庭。
collocations: represent sb｜代表某人
tip_zh: 名词 representative 是本批的另一词，指代表或典型的。

definition_en: of great weight, or severe
example1_en: The box is too heavy for one person.
example1_zh: 这个箱子一个人搬太重。
example2_en: Heavy rain on a street with small drains becomes a flood within an hour.
example2_zh: 排水管很小的街道上的大雨，会在一小时内变成洪水。
collocations: heavy rain｜大雨 ; heavy traffic｜交通拥堵
tip_zh: heavy 的比较级是 heavier。

definition_en: to be real
example1_en: The problem still exists after the meeting.
example2_en: A rule that exists only on paper does not protect the student who needs it.
example2_zh: 只存在于纸上的规定，保护不了需要它的学生。
collocations: exist in｜存在于
tip_zh: exist 是不及物动词，没有被动式。there exist 是较正式的 there be。

definition_en: fairly, or preferably
example1_en: The question is rather difficult.
example2_en: Many students would rather walk than take a bus that arrives after the gate has closed.
example2_zh: 许多学生宁愿走路，也不愿坐一辆校门关上后才到的公交。
collocations: rather than｜而不是 ; would rather｜宁愿
tip_zh: would rather do than do 表示宁愿……而不愿。rather than 后常接不带 to 的动词。

meanings_zh: n. 聊天 | v. 聊天
definition_en: a friendly informal talk | to talk in a friendly way
example1_en: We had a chat after class.
example2_en: A chat in the hallway is not a record; write the decision down.
example2_zh: 走廊里的聊天不是记录，把决定写下来。
collocations: have a chat｜聊天 ; chat with｜与……聊天
tip_zh: chat 作动词同义。比 discussion 随意。

meanings_zh: v. 提到 | n. 提及
definition_en: to speak or write about something briefly | a short remark
example1_en: She did not mention the test date.
example2_en: Reports that mention a river but not the villages along it miss half the story.
example2_zh: 只提到河、不提沿岸村子的报道，漏掉了一半内容。
collocations: mention sth to sb｜向某人提到 ; not to mention｜更不必说
tip_zh: mention 后直接接内容，不说 mention about。

definition_en: to cause pain, or to feel pain
example1_en: My knee hurts after the match.
example2_en: Words can hurt, and a false story about a classmate can last longer than the speaker expects.
example2_zh: 话能伤人，关于同学的假故事可能比说话的人预计的更长久。
collocations: hurt oneself｜伤到自己 ; get hurt｜受伤
tip_zh: hurt 的过去式和过去分词仍是 hurt。

definition_en: a narrow line of light
example1_en: A ray of sun reached the back row.
example2_en: One ray of light in a stairwell can stop a fall that a speech about safety will not.
example2_zh: 楼梯间的一束光能防止摔倒，而一篇关于安全的讲话做不到。
collocations: a ray of｜一缕 ; X-ray｜X 射线
tip_zh: a ray of hope 表示一线希望。

definition_en: concerned with real use, not only ideas
example1_en: The plan is practical: it names the bus.
example1_zh: 这个计划是实际的：它写了公交。
example2_en: Practical help is a seat and a time, not only a kind sentence.
example2_zh: 实际的帮助是一个座位和一个时间，而不只是一句善意的话。
collocations: practical advice｜实用建议
tip_zh: practice 已在本库。practical 是形容词。

meanings_zh: v. 滚动 | n. 卷；小面包；名册
definition_en: to move by turning over and over | something rolled, a small loaf, or a list
example1_en: The ball rolled under the desk.
example2_en: Teachers roll a new plan out slowly when the old timetable still has to finish the term.
example2_zh: 旧课表还要撑完这个学期时，老师会慢慢推出新方案。
collocations: roll out｜推出 ; call the roll｜点名
tip_zh: roll 作名词可以是小圆面包、名册或卷。

definition_en: one of four equal parts, or fifteen minutes
example1_en: It is a quarter past eight.
example2_en: A quarter of the class walking is still a crowd if the pavement is one person wide.
example2_zh: 如果人行道只有一个人宽，即使只有四分之一的班级步行，也仍是拥挤。
collocations: a quarter of｜四分之一 ; a quarter past｜……点过一刻
tip_zh: 一刻钟是 fifteen minutes，口语常用 a quarter。美式 quarter 也可指 25 美分。

definition_en: a piece of work to be done
example1_en: The first task is to count the chairs.
example2_en: A task without a name on it becomes everybody's job and nobody's job.
example2_zh: 没有写上名字的任务，会变成每个人的事，也变成没有人的事。
collocations: a task for｜给……的任务
tip_zh: task 可数。比 work 更具体。

definition_en: a wash under falling water, or a short fall of rain
example1_en: There is a shower on the second floor.
example2_en: A shower of rain at the gate is a reason to open the hall, not to cancel the bus.
example2_zh: 门口的一阵雨是开放礼堂的理由，不是取消公交。
collocations: take a shower｜淋浴 ; a shower of｜一阵
tip_zh: 淋浴和阵雨是同一个词。

definition_en: a room where scientific tests are done
example1_en: The laboratory closes at five.
example2_en: A laboratory rule that requires goggles only works if the goggles are there.
example2_zh: 要求戴护目镜的规定，只有护目镜真的在时才有效。
collocations: in the laboratory｜在实验室
tip_zh: lab 已在本库，是简称。表里没有 laboratory 这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。本条不写实验步骤。

definition_en: belonging to me | a place where minerals are dug
example1_en: This bag is mine.
example2_en: A river is not mine or yours alone; the town downstream drinks from it too.
example2_zh: 一条河不是我的或你一个人的；下游的城镇也从中取水。
collocations: a friend of mine｜我的一个朋友
tip_zh: 名词性物主代词 mine 后面不再加名词。mine 作名词是“矿”。

definition_en: if not, or in a different way
example1_en: Hurry up; otherwise we will miss the bus.
example1_zh: 快点，否则我们会错过公交。
example2_en: Write the source down; otherwise a later reader cannot tell a fact from a guess.
example2_zh: 把来源写下来，否则后来的读者分不清事实和猜测。
collocations: or otherwise｜或相反
tip_zh: otherwise 可单独作“否则”。和 or 连用时不要再堆一个 else。

definition_en: a tall plant with a trunk and branches
example1_en: The old tree by the gate gives shade.
example2_en: One tree in a schoolyard does not cool a city, but a row of them can change a street.
example2_zh: 校园里的一棵树凉不了一座城，但一排树可以改变一条街。
collocations: family tree｜家谱 ; climb a tree｜爬树
tip_zh: tree 可数。木头作为材料用 wood，不是 tree。

definition_en: to make something by putting parts together
example1_en: They plan to build a bridge over the river.
example1_zh: 他们计划在河上建一座桥。
example2_en: Towns that build only roads forget that children also need a pavement.
example2_zh: 只修路的城镇忘了孩子也需要人行道。
collocations: build up｜增强 ; build on｜在……上建造
tip_zh: build 的过去式和过去分词是 built。

definition_en: the head of a government
example1_en: The premier visited the new library.
example2_en: A speech by the premier does not replace the bus the town was promised.
example2_zh: 总理的讲话代替不了城镇被承诺的那路公交。
collocations: the premier of｜……的总理
tip_zh: premier 与 prime minister 相近。作形容词是首要的，较少用。

definition_en: to give someone confidence or hope
example1_en: Teachers encourage students to ask.
example2_en: Cities encourage walking when the path is lit, not only when the poster says so.
example2_zh: 当小路有灯而不只是海报这么说时，城市才是在鼓励步行。
collocations: encourage sb to do｜鼓励某人做
tip_zh: encourage somebody to do。

definition_en: knowing about something
example1_en: Be aware of the risks.

definition_en: happening once a year
example1_en: The annual sports meet is in May.
example1_zh: 一年一度的运动会在五月。
example2_en: An annual check of the school roof costs less than the damage after one storm.
example2_zh: 每年检查一次校舍屋顶，比一场暴风雨之后的损坏更省。
collocations: annual meeting｜年会
tip_zh: annual 是形容词；annually 是副词。

definition_en: a sign that stands for something
example1_en: The symbol on the door means the clinic.
example1_zh: 门上的符号表示医务室。
example2_en: A symbol without words fails the parent who does not know it.
example2_zh: 没有文字的符号会让不认识它的家长看不懂。
collocations: a symbol of｜……的象征
tip_zh: symbol 可数。

meanings_zh: v. 选择 | adj. 精选的
definition_en: to choose | chosen as the best
example1_en: Select one route before you print the notice.
example1_zh: 打印通知前先选定一条路线。
example2_en: A school should not select only the already confident students for the lab.
example2_zh: 学校不应当只挑选已经自信的学生进实验室。
collocations: select sb to do｜挑选某人做
tip_zh: select 比 choose 更正式。也可作形容词“精选的”。

definition_en: a relationship or a join
example1_en: The internet connection failed during the quiz.
example2_en: The connection between sleep and memory is a reason to protect the hour before bed.
example2_zh: 睡眠和记忆的联系，是保护睡前那一小时的理由。
collocations: internet connection｜网络连接 ; in connection with｜与……有关
tip_zh: connection 可指具体的连接，也可指抽象联系。

meanings_zh: n. 制服 | adj. 一致的
definition_en: a set of clothes worn by members of a group | the same in all cases
example1_en: The uniform is blue.
example2_en: A uniform rule should say what a family does if they cannot buy one.
example2_zh: 校服规定应当写明买不起时家庭怎么办。
collocations: in uniform｜穿着制服
tip_zh: uniform 作形容词是一致的。

meanings_zh: v. 结合；联合 | n. 联合收割机
definition_en: to join together | A farm machine that harvests grain and separates the seeds.
example1_en: Good teachers combine hard work with creativity.
example1_zh: 好老师把努力与创造力结合起来。
example2_en: Cities can combine improved public transport with safer cycling routes to reduce dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 城市可以将公共交通改善与更安全的骑行路线建设相结合，减少对私家车的依赖。
collocations: combine A with B｜把A与B结合 ; combine efforts｜合力 ; combine theory and practice｜理论与实践相结合
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；收割机名词读/ˈkɒmbaɪn/。

meanings_zh: n. 替代选择 | adj. 可供替代的
definition_en: something you can choose instead | that can be used instead
example1_en: Walking is an alternative to the crowded bus.
example1_zh: 步行是拥挤公交之外的一种选择。
example2_en: An alternative date for the exam helps students who are ill on the first day.
example2_zh: 考试的备用日期能帮助第一天生病的学生。
collocations: an alternative to｜……的替代
tip_zh: alternative 作形容词是“可供替代的”。后接 to，不接 of。

meanings_zh: v. 下载 | n. 下载
definition_en: to copy data from a larger system onto your device | a file you have copied onto your device
example1_en: Download the form before Friday.
example1_zh: 周五前把表格下载下来。
example2_en: Students who cannot download a large file at home need a copy at school.
example2_zh: 在家下载不了大文件的学生，需要学校里有一份副本。
collocations: download a file｜下载文件
tip_zh: download 也可作名词。反义常是 upload。

definition_en: an adult male, or humans in general
example1_en: A man from the bookshop helped us find the map.
example1_zh: 书店里的一位男士帮我们找到了那张地图。
example2_en: For most of history, man changed the land slowly; the last century has been different.
example2_zh: 在历史上的大部分时间里，人类改变土地的速度很慢；上一个世纪则不同。
collocations: man-made｜人造的
tip_zh: man 泛指人类时较少用于新的正式写作，更常见的是 humans 或 people。

definition_en: the reflexive form of it
example1_en: The door closed by itself.
example2_en: A warning system that fails itself is worse than no system, because people trust it.
example2_zh: 自己失灵的警报系统比没有系统更糟，因为人们信任它。
collocations: by itself｜独自；自动
tip_zh: itself 指事物或动物，不指人。

definition_en: before the usual time | before the expected time
example1_en: I caught the early bus.
example2_en: Early support in reading costs less than trying to repair years of failure later.
example2_zh: 早期的阅读帮助，比日后修补多年的失败更省。
collocations: early morning｜清晨 ; as early as｜早在
tip_zh: early 既可作形容词也可作副词：arrive early。

definition_en: the ability to remember, or something remembered
example1_en: The song brings back a memory of primary school.
example1_zh: 这首歌唤起一段小学的回忆。
example2_en: Public memory of a flood fades unless the photos stay in the library.
example2_zh: 除非照片留在图书馆，否则公众对一场洪水的记忆会消退。
collocations: in memory of｜为纪念 ; a good memory｜好记性
tip_zh: memory 表示记性时多不可数；表示一段回忆时可数。电脑内存也叫 memory。

definition_en: a computer set of instructions, a show, or a plan
example1_en: The program helps students check new words.
example1_zh: 这个程序帮助学生检查生词。
example2_en: A training program for village teachers fails if it requires them to leave their classes for a month.
example2_zh: 如果乡村教师培训计划要求他们离开课堂一个月，这个计划就会失败。
collocations: computer program｜计算机程序 ; TV program｜电视节目
tip_zh: 英式拼写 programme 常指节目或计划；计算机程序英美都常用 program。

meanings_zh: n. 预算 | v. 编制预算
definition_en: a plan of how money will be spent | to plan how to spend money
example1_en: The club budget cannot pay for two trips.
example1_zh: 社团预算付不起两次出行。
example2_en: A school budget that forgets heating discovers the mistake in the first cold week.
example2_zh: 忘了供暖的学校预算，会在第一个寒冷的星期发现错误。
collocations: on a budget｜预算有限 ; family budget｜家庭预算
tip_zh: budget 作动词是编制预算。

definition_en: for each
example1_en: The room costs twenty yuan per hour.
example1_zh: 这间房间每小时二十元。
example2_en: Cities that measure water use per person can see which habits waste the most.
example2_zh: 按每人用水量统计的城市，能看出哪些习惯最浪费。
collocations: per cent｜百分之 ; per person｜每人
tip_zh: per 多用于书面；口语里常用 a 或 every，如 twenty yuan an hour。

definition_en: the science of substances and how they change
example1_en: Chemistry is in the lab on Wednesday.
example2_en: Students learn the word and the warning sign, not a method for misuse.
example2_zh: 学生学的是这个词和警告标志，不是误用的方法。
collocations: chemistry lab｜化学实验室
tip_zh: chemistry 作学科时谓语用单数。chemical 已在本库。本条不写实验配方。

definition_en: a dry substance in the form of very small grains
example1_en: The powder on the shelf is labelled.
example1_zh: 架子上的粉末贴了标签。
example2_en: A powder without a label in the lab should not be used.
example2_zh: 实验室里没有标签的粉末不应当使用。
collocations: a powder of｜一种粉末
tip_zh: powder 作物质名词通常不可数。本条指贴了标签的粉末，不写配方或用途。

meanings_zh: adj. 最喜爱的 | n. 最喜爱的人（或物）
definition_en: liked more than others; British spelling | a person or thing you like best
example1_en: This is her favourite seat by the window.
example1_zh: 这是她最喜欢的靠窗座位。
example2_en: A favourite book in the library should have more than one copy.
example2_zh: 图书馆里最受欢迎的书，应当不止一本。
collocations: favourite of｜最喜欢的
tip_zh: favourite 是英式，favorite 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留，因为考纲里都出现，搜索也只匹配词头。

definition_en: to fix something at the top so the lower part is free
example1_en: Hang the map where everyone can see it.
example1_zh: 把地图挂在大家都能看见的地方。
example2_en: Wet coats that hang in the hallway dry faster than coats left in a pile.
example2_zh: 挂在走廊里的湿外套，比堆成一堆的干得快。
collocations: hang up｜挂断；悬挂 ; hang on｜等一下；坚持
tip_zh: 悬挂的过去式和过去分词是 hung。绞死的过去式是 hanged，本库不展开这个意思。

definition_en: more than usual, or in particular
example1_en: The library is busy, especially before exams.
example1_zh: 图书馆很忙，尤其是考试前。
example2_en: Night buses matter especially for workers who finish after the regular service has stopped.
example2_zh: 夜班公交对那些在常规班次停运后才下班的工人尤其重要。
collocations: especially important｜尤其重要
tip_zh: especially 强调“尤其”；specially 强调“专门地”。

definition_en: a piece of metal given as a prize
example1_en: The medal is for the whole team.
example2_en: A medal in a cabinet teaches less than the practice that won it.
example2_zh: 柜子里的奖牌比赢得它的那次练习教得少。
collocations: a gold medal｜金牌
tip_zh: medal 可数。

definition_en: a fully grown person
example1_en: An adult must sign the trip form.
example1_zh: 出行表必须由成年人签字。
example2_en: Evening classes give adults a second chance without asking them to leave work.
example2_zh: 夜校给成年人第二次机会，又不必让他们辞去工作。
collocations: adult education｜成人教育
tip_zh: adult 也可作形容词“成年的”。

definition_en: to show that something is true
example1_en: The experiment did not prove the idea.
example1_zh: 实验没有证明这个想法。
example2_en: One story cannot prove that a whole teaching method works for every school.
example2_zh: 一个故事证明不了一种教学法在每所学校都有效。
collocations: prove that｜证明 ; prove to be｜结果是
tip_zh: 过去式 proved，过去分词 proved 或 proven。prove 后可接形容词：prove useful。

definition_en: a hole, a start, or a job that is free
example1_en: The opening of the clinic is next month.
example2_en: An opening for a village teacher stays empty if the housing is an hour from the school.
example2_zh: 如果住房离学校一小时，乡村教师的空缺就会一直空着。
collocations: job opening｜职位空缺 ; opening hours｜营业时间
tip_zh: opening 是可数名词。

definition_en: the condition of the body or mind
example1_en: Sleep is part of health, not a reward after study.
example1_zh: 睡眠是健康的一部分，不是学完之后的奖赏。
example2_en: Poor air quality is a public health problem, not only a matter of personal choice.
example2_zh: 糟糕的空气质量是公共健康问题，不只是个人选择。
collocations: in good health｜身体健康 ; mental health｜心理健康
tip_zh: health 不可数。healthy 是形容词。

definition_en: a device that shows the time
example1_en: The clock in the hall is five minutes fast.
example2_en: A working clock tells you whether you are late; a poster does not.
example2_zh: 能走的钟告诉你是否迟到；海报不会。
collocations: around the clock｜昼夜不停
tip_zh: clock 通常挂在墙上或放在桌上。戴在手上的是 watch。

meanings_zh: n. 电子邮件 | v. 给……发电子邮件
definition_en: a message sent by computer | to send an e-mail
example1_en: Send the form by e-mail.
example2_en: An e-mail to the whole school should say who wrote it and how to reply.
example2_zh: 发给全校的电子邮件应当写明是谁写的、如何回复。
collocations: by e-mail｜通过电子邮件 ; e-mail address｜电子邮件地址
tip_zh: e-mail 与 email 同义。mail 已在本库，范围更广，也包括纸质邮件。

meanings_zh: n. 业余爱好者 | adj. 业余的
definition_en: a person who does something for pleasure, not as a job | done for pleasure, not as a job
example1_en: The amateur asked the photographer before taking a picture.
example1_zh: 这位业余爱好者拍照前问过摄影师。
example2_en: An amateur concert still needs a bus home.
example2_zh: 业余音乐会仍然需要回家的公交。
collocations: an amateur of｜……的业余爱好者
tip_zh: amateur 也可作形容词。

definition_en: able to be moved
example1_en: The clinic uses a mobile screen in the hallway.
example1_zh: 诊所在走廊里用一块可移动的屏。
example2_en: A mobile phone in class is useful for a timetable and harmful when it replaces the lesson.
example2_zh: 课堂上的手机对查看课表有用，如果它取代了课本身就有害。
collocations: mobile phone｜手机
tip_zh: mobile phone 是手机。美式也说 cell phone。形容词 mobile 表示可移动。

definition_en: facts about something
example1_en: The website gives information about bus times.
example1_zh: 网站提供公交时刻的信息。
example2_en: Personal information collected by a school app should not be sold to other companies.
example2_zh: 学校应用收集的个人信息，不该卖给其他公司。
collocations: a piece of information｜一条信息 ; information technology｜信息技术
tip_zh: information 不可数，不说 an information。

definition_en: something that happens, especially something unusual
example1_en: The incident was written in the log.
example2_en: An incident at the gate should name the time, not a guess about who started it.
example2_zh: 门口的事件应当写明时间，而不是猜测谁先动手。
collocations: an incident of｜一次……事件
tip_zh: incident 可数。比 accident 更中性，不一定是事故。

definition_en: extremely good
example1_en: We had a super time at the fair.
example1_zh: 我们在义卖上玩得非常开心。
example2_en: A super stadium does not help a town whose school roof still leaks.
example2_zh: 一座超级体育场帮不了校舍屋顶仍在漏雨的城镇。
collocations: super star｜超级明星
tip_zh: super 多用于口语。supermarket 是“超市”。

definition_en: to take in; to hold one's attention
example1_en: Plants absorb water through their roots.
example1_zh: 植物通过根部吸收水分。

definition_en: to be connected, or to tell
example1_en: The chart relates sleep to scores.
example1_zh: 图表把睡眠和分数联系起来。
example2_en: Relate the bus story, then give the source.
example2_zh: 讲公交的事，然后给出来源。
collocations: relate to｜与……有关
tip_zh: 名词 relation 是本批的另一词。relate to something。

definition_en: against the law
example1_en: It is illegal to drive through the playground.
example1_zh: 开车穿过操场是违法的。
example2_en: An illegal dump behind the school is a town problem, not only a bad smell.
example2_zh: 学校后面的非法倾倒是城镇的问题，而不只是一股臭味。
collocations: illegal to do｜做……是非法的
tip_zh: illegal 是形容词。名词是 illegality，不常用。

definition_en: said aloud, not written
example1_en: Spoken English is practised in pairs.
example1_zh: 英语口语两人一组练习。
example2_en: A spoken warning at the gate helps the student who cannot read the sign.
example2_zh: 门口的口头警告能帮助看不懂牌子的学生。
collocations: spoken language｜口语
tip_zh: speak 的过去分词是 spoken。动词 speak 已在本库。

definition_en: a social gathering, or a political group
example1_en: Our class will have a party on Friday evening.
example1_zh: 我们班周五晚上有聚会。
example2_en: A political party that never meets voters outside election season soon loses their trust.
example2_zh: 只在选举季见选民的政党，很快会失去他们的信任。
collocations: birthday party｜生日聚会 ; party member｜党员
tip_zh: party 表示聚会或党派，看语境区分。

definition_en: an occasion when you eat, or the food itself
example1_en: Breakfast is the first meal.
example2_en: A hot meal at school can matter more than a speech about diet.
example2_zh: 学校的一顿热饭，可能比一篇关于饮食的讲话更重要。
collocations: a meal of｜一餐 ; cook a meal｜做一顿饭
tip_zh: meal 可数。breakfast、lunch 是具体的餐。

definition_en: the relationship between friends
example1_en: Their friendship began in the library.
example1_zh: 他们的友谊从图书馆开始。
example2_en: Friendship across two classes still needs a seat on the same bus.
example2_zh: 两个班之间的友谊，仍然需要同一班车上的座位。
collocations: a friendship with｜与……的友谊
tip_zh: friend 已在本库。friendship 可数也可不可数。

definition_en: a seat for one person
example1_en: Please put the chair back.
example2_en: A chair with arms helps some students stand, and it takes more space in a crowded room.
example2_zh: 有扶手的椅子能帮助一些学生站起来，在拥挤的房间里也更占地方。
collocations: in the chair｜担任主席
tip_zh: chair 也可指会议主席。chairman 已在本库。

meanings_zh: n. 热；高温 | v. 加热
definition_en: the quality of being hot | to make something hot
example1_en: The heat in the lab made everyone thirsty.
example1_zh: 实验室里的高温让每个人都口渴。
example2_en: Cities store heat in roads and roofs, so a park can be cooler than the street beside it.
example2_zh: 城市把热存在路面和屋顶里，所以公园可以比旁边的街道凉快。
collocations: heat wave｜热浪 ; heat up｜加热
tip_zh: heat 作名词通常不可数。作动词是加热。

meanings_zh: n. 外貌；出现 | n. 出现；露面
definition_en: how someone looks; the act of showing up | an occasion when someone or something becomes visible or present
example1_en: First appearance can be misleading.
example1_zh: 第一印象可能具有误导性。
example2_en: Employers should assess candidates on their skills and experience rather than judging them by their appearance.
example2_zh: 雇主应根据应聘者的技能和经验进行评估，而不是以貌取人。
collocations: physical appearance｜外貌 ; make an appearance｜露面 ; outward appearance｜外表 ; improve the appearance of｜改善……的外观
tip_zh: 外貌与露面都可用appearance；露面常用make an appearance。

meanings_zh: n. 中间 | adj. 中间的
definition_en: the centre | in the centre
example1_en: Stand in the middle of the line.
example2_en: Shops in the middle of a town keep daily life there when a mall opens on the edge.
example2_zh: 当商场开在城边时，镇中心的商店仍维持着那里的日常生活。
collocations: in the middle of｜在……中间
tip_zh: middle 作形容词是“中间的”：middle school。

definition_en: fairly cold, or calm
example1_en: The room is cool in the morning.
example2_en: Cool shade from old trees can matter as much as an air conditioner a school cannot afford.
example2_zh: 老树的凉荫，可以和学校买不起的空调一样重要。
collocations: keep cool｜保持冷静
tip_zh: cool 比 cold 程度轻。口语里也可表示“酷”。

definition_en: the leader of a team or a ship
example1_en: She is captain of the school basketball team.
example2_en: A captain who listens before the match can stop a small argument from becoming a lost game.
example2_zh: 开赛前肯听人说话的队长，能避免小争执变成一场输掉的比赛。
collocations: team captain｜队长 ; captain of the ship｜船长
tip_zh: captain 也可指海军上校或机长，要看语境。

definition_en: a person or team that wins
example1_en: The winner of the race is in Class 2.
example2_en: Naming only one winner can hide a class project that several students built together.
example2_zh: 只点出一个获胜者，可能掩盖几个学生一起完成的课堂项目。
collocations: winner of｜……的获胜者
tip_zh: winner 是人。奖品用 prize 或 award。

definition_en: a large region of a country
example1_en: The province shares one exam timetable.
example1_zh: 这个省共用一份考试时间表。
example2_en: Two provinces that share a river have to share the news of a flood.
example2_zh: 共用一条河的两个省，也必须共享洪水的消息。
collocations: in the province｜在省内
tip_zh: province 可数。

definition_en: not difficult
example1_en: The first question is easy.
example2_en: It is easy to blame students for being late when the bus itself never arrives on time.
example2_zh: 当公交本身从不准时，责备学生迟到是容易的。
collocations: take it easy｜别紧张 ; easy to do｜容易做
tip_zh: It is easy for sb to do。

definition_en: suitable, or real and correct
example1_en: Please use the proper bin for paper.
example2_en: A proper lunch is more than a packet eaten while walking to the next class.
example2_zh: 一顿像样的午饭不只是走向下一节课时吃掉的一包东西。
collocations: proper noun｜专有名词
tip_zh: proper 放在名词前。properly 是副词。

definition_en: an object, fact, or action
example1_en: The first thing I do is open the windows.
example1_zh: 我做的第一件事是开窗。
example2_en: The hardest thing about changing a habit is not the first day but the quiet week that follows.
example2_zh: 改变一个习惯最难的不是第一天，而是之后安静的那一周。
collocations: the thing is｜问题是 ; for one thing｜首先
tip_zh: thing 很宽泛；写作里能用更具体的名词时尽量换掉。

meanings_zh: n. 害怕；恐惧 | v. 害怕
definition_en: the feeling of being afraid | to be afraid of
example1_en: Her fear of the dark road is reasonable.
example1_zh: 她对那条黑路的害怕是合理的。
example2_en: Fear of a late bus should lead a town to change the timetable, not to blame the student.
example2_zh: 对晚点公交的担忧应该促使城镇改时刻表，而不是责备学生。
collocations: for fear of｜生怕 ; in fear｜害怕地
tip_zh: fear 作动词是“害怕”：fear that。

definition_en: to like one thing more than another
example1_en: I prefer tea to coffee.
example2_en: Students who prefer a quiet seat should not have to arrive first to get one.
example2_zh: 更喜欢安静座位的学生，不应当必须最先到才能得到。
collocations: prefer A to B｜喜欢 A 胜过 B ; prefer to do｜更愿意做
tip_zh: prefer A to B，不用 than。prefer to do rather than do 也可以。

definition_en: lasting for a long time or forever
example1_en: The mark on the wall is not permanent.
example1_zh: 墙上的痕迹不是永久的。
example2_en: A permanent bus stop is more useful than a promise that changes every term.
example2_zh: 一个固定的公交站，比每个学期都变的承诺更有用。
collocations: permanent job｜固定工作
tip_zh: permanent 的反义是 temporary。

meanings_zh: n. 主人；主持人 | v. 主办；招待
definition_en: a person who receives guests, or who presents a show | to organize an event or receive guests
example1_en: Our host showed us where to sit.
example2_en: A host city for a school games meeting needs beds as well as a stadium.
example2_zh: 承办校际运动会的城市需要床位，而不只是一座体育场。
collocations: host city｜主办城市
tip_zh: host 作动词是主办或招待。a host of 表示许多。

meanings_zh: adj. 备用的；空闲的 | v. 抽出；饶过
definition_en: extra, or available | to give time, or to not harm
example1_en: There is a spare key in the office.
example1_zh: 办公室有一把备用钥匙。
example2_en: A spare coat at school matters when the rain soaks the first one.
example2_zh: 雨打湿第一件时，学校里的备用外套就有用。
collocations: spare time｜空闲时间 ; a spare key｜备用钥匙
tip_zh: spare 作动词是抽出（时间）或使免于。

definition_en: the quality of being beautiful
example1_en: The beauty of the lake is in the morning light.
example2_en: A city can protect the beauty of an old street and still make the pavement safe.
example2_zh: 一座城市可以保护老街的美，同时把人行道修安全。
collocations: natural beauty｜自然美 ; beauty of｜……之美
tip_zh: beauty 通常不可数。a beauty 可指美丽的人或物，要看语境。

definition_en: the opening in the face used for eating and speaking
example1_en: Cover your mouth when you cough.
example2_en: The mouth of the river is where the town's waste becomes the sea's problem.
example2_zh: 河口是城镇的废物变成海洋问题的地方。
collocations: mouth of a river｜河口
tip_zh: mouth 可指嘴，也可指河口或容器口。

definition_en: not far away
example1_en: There is a nearby shop that sells notebooks.
example1_zh: 附近有一家卖笔记本的店。
example2_en: A nearby clinic is useful only if it is open after school.
example2_zh: 附近的诊所只有在放学后还开着时才有用。
collocations: nearby school｜附近的学校
tip_zh: nearby 也可作副词，放在动词后：live nearby。

meanings_zh: n. 基础；根据 | n. 方式；频率
definition_en: the main support or reason | The arrangement or frequency according to which something happens.
example1_en: Trust is the basis of friendship.
example2_en: Reliable evidence should provide the basis for government decisions about public health and environmental protection.
example2_zh: 可靠的证据应成为政府作出公共卫生和环境保护决策的依据。
collocations: on a daily basis｜每天 ; on the basis of｜根据 ; form the basis of｜构成……的基础 ; a sound basis｜坚实的基础
tip_zh: 复数为bases；on a daily basis意为每天。

meanings_zh: v. 学习；研究 | n. 学习；研究
definition_en: to spend time learning | the activity of studying
example1_en: I study English for twenty minutes a day.
example1_zh: 我每天学二十分钟英语。
example2_en: Students study better in a room that is quiet than in one filled with traffic noise.
example2_zh: 学生在安静的房间里比在充满交通噪音的房间里学得更好。
collocations: study for｜为……学习 ; study hard｜努力学习
tip_zh: study 强调系统学习；learn 强调学会。

meanings_zh: n. 费用；代价 | v. 花费
definition_en: the money or effort needed | to have a price
example1_en: The cost of the trip is fifty yuan.
example1_zh: 这次出行的费用是五十元。
example2_en: The cost of dirty air does not appear on a shop receipt, but it appears in hospital visits.
example2_zh: 脏空气的代价不会出现在购物小票上，但会出现在医院就诊里。
collocations: at the cost of｜以……为代价 ; living cost｜生活费用
tip_zh: cost 作动词的过去式仍是 cost。sth costs sb money。

definition_en: any thing at all
example1_en: Is there anything I can do to help?
example2_en: If a report hides anything important, the public cannot judge whether a project deserves support.
example2_zh: 如果一份报告隐瞒了重要内容，公众就无法判断一个项目是否值得支持。
collocations: anything else｜其他任何事 ; anything but｜根本不
tip_zh: anything 常用于疑问句和否定句；肯定句中的“某事”用 something。

definition_en: a hot sausage in a long piece of bread
example1_en: He bought a hot dog after the match.
example1_zh: 比赛结束后他买了一个热狗。
example2_en: A hot dog at a school fair is a small sale, and the queue still needs a clear price.
example2_zh: 学校义卖上的热狗是小买卖，队伍前面仍然需要标明清价格。
collocations: hot dog stand｜热狗摊
tip_zh: hot dog 是食物，不是狗。两个词都要写。

definition_en: a sweet brown food
example1_en: The chocolate is for the whole class.
example2_en: Chocolate that hides nuts should say so on the label.
example2_zh: 藏着坚果的巧克力应当在标签上写明。
collocations: a bar of chocolate｜一条巧克力
tip_zh: chocolate 作物质名词通常不可数。

definition_en: how big something is
example1_en: What size are these shoes?
example2_en: The size of a class changes what one teacher can notice during a lesson.
example2_zh: 班级的大小会改变一位老师在课上能注意到什么。
collocations: size of｜……的大小 ; in size｜在尺寸上
tip_zh: size 前常用 what 提问尺码。

definition_en: of whom or of which
example1_en: Whose bag is this?
example2_en: A town whose only clinic closes will send every night emergency onto a dark road.
example2_zh: 唯一诊所关闭的城镇，会把每个夜间急诊都送到一条黑暗的路上。
collocations: whose book｜谁的书
tip_zh: whose 可指人也可指物，用来表示所属。

definition_en: the ability to see, or something you see
example1_en: The test checks sight, not only reading.
example1_zh: 这次检查的是视力，不只是阅读。
example2_en: The sight of a late bus is a relief only if it still stops here.
example2_zh: 看见晚班车令人宽慰，前提是它仍然在这里停。
collocations: catch sight of｜看见 ; at first sight｜乍一看
tip_zh: in sight 表示看得见。表里这一行的音标是 sigh，本库不用。

definition_en: not large
example1_en: We need a small room for the group discussion.
example1_zh: 小组讨论我们需要一间小房间。
example2_en: A small change in bus times can decide whether a student arrives before the first lesson.
example2_zh: 公交时间的一个小改动，就能决定学生是否赶得上第一节课。
collocations: small talk｜闲聊
tip_zh: small 强调尺寸不大；little 常带感情色彩。

meanings_zh: n. 代表 | adj. 有代表性的
definition_en: a person who speaks for a group | typical of a group
example1_en: Each class sent one representative.
example2_en: A representative who never asks the class is only a name on a list.
example2_zh: 从不询问班级的代表，只是名单上的一个名字。
collocations: a representative of｜……的代表
tip_zh: represent 是本批的动词。representative 作形容词是有代表性的。

definition_en: physical games and exercise
example1_en: Sport is part of the timetable on Friday.
example2_en: School sport should include students who are not trying to win a cup.
example2_zh: 学校体育应当包括那些并不想去夺杯的学生。
collocations: sports meeting｜运动会 ; do sport｜做运动
tip_zh: sport 作总称时常不可数。具体项目可用 a sport。英式运动会常用 sports。

definition_en: an examination
example1_en: The exam is on Friday.
example2_en: An exam room needs a clock that works.
example2_zh: 考场需要一块能走的钟。
collocations: an exam in｜……的考试
tip_zh: exam 是 examination 的缩写，examination 是本批的另一词。表里这一行的音标是整个 examination，本库不用。

definition_en: the organ of thought
example1_en: Sleep helps the brain keep new words.
example1_zh: 睡眠帮助大脑记住生词。
example2_en: A tired brain makes careless mistakes, which is why a late bus is also a learning problem.
example2_zh: 疲惫的大脑会犯粗心错误，所以晚点的公交也是学习问题。
collocations: brain work｜脑力劳动
tip_zh: brain 是可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 伤害 | v. 伤害
definition_en: damage or injury | to hurt
example1_en: The smoke did no lasting harm.
example1_zh: 这烟没有造成持久的伤害。
example2_en: Harm from a rumour can last longer than the speaker expects.
example2_zh: 谣言造成的伤害可能比说话的人预计的更久。
collocations: do harm to｜对……有害 ; there is no harm in｜……没有坏处
tip_zh: harm 作动词是伤害。通常不可数。

definition_en: a round object used in games, or a formal dance
example1_en: The ball went over the fence.
example2_en: A lost ball is a small cost; a playground with no space to play is a larger one.
example2_zh: 丢一个球是小代价；没有地方玩的操场是更大的代价。
collocations: play ball｜开始合作；打球
tip_zh: ball 表示球是可数名词。

meanings_zh: v. 承诺；答应 | n. 承诺
definition_en: to say you will certainly do something | a statement that you will do something
example1_en: I promise to return the book on Monday.
example2_en: A city should not promise a new library until it has named the building and the staff.
example2_zh: 在确定房子和人员之前，城市不应当承诺一座新图书馆。
collocations: promise to do｜答应做 ; make a promise｜作出承诺
tip_zh: promise 后接 to do 或 that。名词也是 promise。

meanings_zh: adj. 一致的；始终如一的
definition_en: not changing, or in agreement
example1_en: The two notices are not consistent.
example2_en: A consistent bus time is more useful than a new colour on the sign.
example2_zh: 稳定的公交时间比牌子上的新颜色更有用。
collocations: be consistent with｜与……一致
tip_zh: consistent with something。

definition_en: special, or one certain thing
example1_en: Is there a particular bus you take?
example1_zh: 你坐某一路特定的公交吗？
example2_en: A particular street may flood every year while the official map still calls the area safe.
example2_zh: 某一条街可能每年都积水，而官方地图仍称该地区安全。
collocations: in particular｜尤其
tip_zh: particular 强调某一个；special 强调与众不同。

meanings_zh: v. 寻找；狩猎 | n. 搜寻；狩猎
definition_en: to search carefully, or to chase wild animals | a search, or the chasing of animals
example1_en: We hunted for the key for ten minutes.
example2_en: The history text mentions a hunt only as a custom, not as a method.
example2_zh: 历史课文提到狩猎，只把它当作一种习俗，而不是方法。
collocations: hunt for｜寻找
tip_zh: hunt for 是寻找。狩猎义本条不写操作。

meanings_zh: n. 事情；问题 | v. 要紧
definition_en: a subject or situation | to be important
example1_en: This is a serious matter.
example2_en: Housing is not a private matter when high rents push workers far from the jobs a city needs.
example2_zh: 当高房租把工人推离城市需要的工作时，住房就不是私事。
collocations: as a matter of fact｜事实上 ; no matter｜无论 ; What's the matter?｜怎么了？
tip_zh: matter 作动词是“要紧”：It matters。no matter 后接 who、what、how。

definition_en: an organization that provides a service
example1_en: The travel agency changed our train tickets.
example1_zh: 旅行社改了我们的火车票。
example2_en: A housing agency that hides fees makes it harder for young workers to compare real costs.
example2_zh: 隐瞒费用的房屋中介，会让年轻工人更难比较真实成本。
collocations: travel agency｜旅行社 ; news agency｜通讯社
tip_zh: agency 是机构，agent 是里面办事的人或代理人。

meanings_zh: v. 带领；导致 | n. 领先；铅
definition_en: to guide, or to cause a result | a leading position, or a soft metal
example1_en: The monitor will lead us to the hall.
example2_en: Poor bus links can lead families to buy cars they can hardly afford.
example2_zh: 糟糕的公交连接会促使家庭去买他们几乎负担不起的汽车。
collocations: lead to｜导致 ; lead a life｜过生活
tip_zh: lead 的过去式和过去分词是 led，不是 leaded。作名词“铅”或“领先”时读音不同。

definition_en: an organised group, or a connection
example1_en: The parents' association paid for the new books.
example1_zh: 家长协会付了新书的钱。
example2_en: The association between night noise and poor sleep is clear in streets beside a main road.
example2_zh: 夜间噪音和睡眠差之间的联系，在主干道旁的街道上很清楚。
collocations: in association with｜与……联合
tip_zh: association 可指组织，也可指事物之间的关联。

definition_en: to start
example1_en: The meeting will begin at eight.
example2_en: Cities should begin flood practice before the rainy season, not after the first street is under water.
example2_zh: 城市应当在雨季之前开始防汛演练，而不是等第一条街被淹之后。
collocations: begin to do｜开始做 ; begin with｜以……开始
tip_zh: begin 的过去式是 began，过去分词是 begun。to begin with 表示首先。

definition_en: to pay no attention to
example1_en: Do not ignore the broken step.
example2_en: Cities that ignore the last bus will hear about it from parents.
example2_zh: 忽视末班车的城市，会从家长那里听到这件事。
collocations: ignore sb｜不理睬某人
tip_zh: ignore 后直接接宾语，不说 ignore about。

definition_en: as much or as many as needed
example1_en: There is enough paper for everyone.
example2_en: It is not enough to build a cycle lane if it ends at the busiest crossing without a light.
example2_zh: 如果自行车道在最繁忙的路口没有信号灯就中断，仅仅修建它是不够的。
collocations: enough to do｜足够做 ; more than enough｜绰绰有余
tip_zh: enough 放在形容词和副词后面：old enough；放在名词前面：enough time。

definition_en: only
example1_en: The notice merely says the time.
example2_en: A poster that merely says welcome does not name the bus.
example2_zh: 只写欢迎的海报没有写出公交。
collocations: not merely｜不仅仅
tip_zh: merely 放在所限制的词前。比 only 更正式。

definition_en: a person who designs or builds machines or structures
example1_en: An engineer checked the roof.
example1_zh: 一位工程师检查了屋顶。
example2_en: The engineer who designs the crossing should walk it at the hour students leave.
example2_zh: 设计路口的工程师应当在学生离校的那个钟点走一遍。
collocations: an engineer of｜……工程师
tip_zh: engine 已在本库。engineer 是设计或修建的人。

definition_en: a group of students, a lesson, or a social group
example1_en: Our class meets in Room 12.
example2_en: A class of forty is hard to teach well if one teacher has no assistant.
example2_zh: 如果一位老师没有助手，四十人的班很难教好。
collocations: in class｜在课堂上 ; after class｜课后 ; class teacher｜班主任
tip_zh: class 表示课堂时 in class 不加 the。

definition_en: a part in a play, or a function
example1_en: She played the role of the teacher in the play.
example2_en: Buses play a role in school life that a wider road cannot replace.
example2_zh: 公交在学校生活中的作用，是更宽的马路替代不了的。
collocations: play a role in｜在……中起作用
tip_zh: play a role in 后接名词或 doing。

definition_en: to continue to live or exist
example1_en: The plant survived the frost.
example1_zh: 这棵植物在霜冻后活了下来。
example2_en: A small shop survives when the rent stays possible, not only when the poster is bright.
example2_zh: 小店能留下来，是因为租金仍然付得起，而不只是因为海报鲜亮。
collocations: survive on｜靠……生存
tip_zh: survive 可及物：survive a flood。也可不及物。

definition_en: not many
example1_en: Few students finished the last question.
example1_zh: 很少有学生做完最后一题。
example2_en: A few trees on a hot street help, but they cannot replace a park.
example2_zh: 炎热街道上的几棵树有帮助，但替代不了一座公园。
collocations: a few｜一些 ; quite a few｜不少 ; few of｜……中很少
tip_zh: few 偏否定，几乎没有；a few 表示有一些。都用于可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 平衡 | v. 使平衡；权衡
definition_en: a state in which weight or importance is equal | to keep something steady, or to weigh options
example1_en: Try to keep a balance between study and sleep.
example1_zh: 尽量在学习和睡眠之间保持平衡。
example2_en: A city budget is a balance between a new road and the clinic that already needs repairs.
example2_zh: 城市预算是在新路和已经需要维修的诊所之间做平衡。
collocations: keep a balance｜保持平衡 ; balance between｜……之间的平衡
tip_zh: balance 作动词是权衡或使平衡。

definition_en: a nation, or land outside towns
example1_en: Students from five countries joined the online class.
example1_zh: 来自五个国家的学生参加了网课。
example2_en: People leave the country for the city when schools and clinics there are too far apart.
example2_zh: 当乡村的学校和诊所彼此离得太远时，人们会离开乡村去城市。
collocations: in the country｜在乡下 ; developing country｜发展中国家
tip_zh: country 表示国家时可数；the country 常指乡村。

definition_en: to know the meaning of something
example1_en: I understand the question now.
example2_en: Planners understand a neighbourhood better when they walk it at the hour children leave school.
example2_zh: 规划者如果在孩子放学的时刻走过一个社区，会理解得更好。
collocations: make oneself understood｜让别人听懂
tip_zh: understand 的过去式仍是 understand，不是 understanded。

definition_en: a title used before a man's surname
example1_en: Mr. Li starts the lesson at eight.
example2_en: A letter that begins with the wrong title, such as Mr. for a woman, can undo an otherwise polite request.
example2_zh: 一封信如果称谓用错，比如对女性用 Mr.，再礼貌的请求也会被削弱。
collocations: Mr. Smith｜史密斯先生
tip_zh: Mr. 后接姓，不接名。书写时通常作 Mr.。

definition_en: the act of leaving
example1_en: The departure is at four.
example2_en: The departure time should be on the same sheet as the return time.
example2_zh: 出发时间应当和返回时间写在同一张纸上。
collocations: departure from｜从……出发
tip_zh: 名词 arrival 已在本库。departure 可数。

definition_en: pleasing, or able to draw interest
example1_en: The poster is attractive, but the time is wrong.
example1_zh: 海报好看，但时间写错了。
example2_en: An attractive fare is useless if the last bus does not stop here.
example2_zh: 如果末班车不在这里停，好看的票价也没用。
collocations: attractive to｜对……有吸引力
tip_zh: attract 已在本库。attractive 不要只用在外貌上。

meanings_zh: adj. 高尚的；贵族的 | n. 贵族
definition_en: morally good, or belonging to a high social rank | a person of high social rank
example1_en: A noble aim still needs a written time.
example1_zh: 高尚的目标仍然需要一个写下来的时间。
example2_en: The history text uses noble for a rank, not for a compliment.
example2_zh: 历史课文里的 noble 是一种等级，不是一句夸奖。
collocations: a noble aim｜高尚的目标
tip_zh: noble 作名词是贵族。

definition_en: safety, or the people who guard a place
example1_en: The school improved security at the gate.
example1_zh: 学校加强了校门的安保。
example2_en: Food security means a town can still eat when one road is closed by a flood.
example2_zh: 粮食安全意味着一条路被洪水封闭时，城镇仍然吃得上饭。
collocations: security check｜安全检查 ; a sense of security｜安全感
tip_zh: security 通常不可数。

definition_en: unfair treatment of a person or group
example1_en: Discrimination by race is not a school rule.
example2_en: A form should not be a tool for discrimination.
example2_zh: 表格不应当成为歧视的工具。
collocations: discrimination against｜对……的歧视
tip_zh: discrimination 通常不可数。说话时要尊重。

meanings_zh: n. 文化 | n. 文化艺术活动 | n. 培养物
definition_en: shared customs and arts | activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work | cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions
example1_en: Food is part of local culture.
example1_zh: 食物是当地文化的一部分。
example2_en: Preserving local culture can strengthen community identity while allowing residents to benefit from international exchange.
example2_zh: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。
collocations: local culture｜本土文化 ; cultural exchange｜文化交流 ; popular culture｜流行文化 ; bacterial culture｜细菌培养物
tip_zh: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。

meanings_zh: n. 看法；景色 | v. 观看；视为
definition_en: an opinion, or what can be seen | to look at, or to consider
example1_en: What is your view on the new timetable?
example1_zh: 你对新课表有什么看法？
example2_en: A fine view of the river does not show whether the water is safe to drink.
example2_zh: 好看的河景并不能说明水是否可以安全饮用。
collocations: point of view｜观点 ; in view of｜鉴于
tip_zh: view 作动词是“观看”或“视为”。

definition_en: to stop living
example1_en: The flowers die if nobody waters them.
example1_zh: 如果没人浇水，花就会死。
example2_en: Fish die in a river long before the colour of the water warns the town.
example2_zh: 鱼会在水色警告城镇之前很久就死在河里。
collocations: die of｜死于 ; die out｜灭绝
tip_zh: die 是不及物动词，不能说 die sb。过去式是 died。

meanings_zh: v. 击败 | n. 失败
definition_en: to win against someone | a loss
example1_en: The team did not defeat anyone; the match was cancelled.
example1_zh: 队伍没有击败任何人，比赛取消了。
example2_en: A defeat on the field should not decide who may use the library.
example2_zh: 场上的失败不应当决定谁可以使用图书馆。
collocations: defeat sb｜击败某人 ; suffer a defeat｜遭遇失败
tip_zh: defeat 作名词是失败。比 fail 更常用于比赛或战争。

definition_en: a photograph, a kick or throw at a goal, or an injection
example1_en: She took a shot of the old bridge.
example1_zh: 她给那座旧桥拍了一张照片。
example2_en: A last-minute shot can win a match, but a team still needs a plan for the whole game.
example2_zh: 最后一秒的投篮可以赢得比赛，但球队仍需要整场比赛的计划。
collocations: take a shot｜拍摄；尝试 ; a shot at｜一次尝试
tip_zh: shot 也是 shoot 的过去式和过去分词。

meanings_zh: n. 借口 | v. 原谅
definition_en: a reason you give to explain a fault | to forgive
example1_en: Tiredness is not an excuse for a locked fire door.
example1_zh: 疲劳不是锁上防火门的借口。
example2_en: Please excuse the delay; the bus was late and the notice said so.
example2_zh: 请原谅这次耽误；公交晚了，通知里也写了。
collocations: an excuse for｜……的借口 ; excuse sb for｜原谅某人
tip_zh: 名词借口常读 /ɪkˈskjuːs/，动词原谅常读 /ɪkˈskjuːz/。表里给的是动词读音。

definition_en: not thin, or not flowing easily
example1_en: The coat is thick enough for this wind.
example1_zh: 这件外套够厚，能挡这种风。
example2_en: Thick smoke in a hallway is a reason to leave, not to look for a bag.
example2_zh: 走廊里的浓烟是离开的理由，不是找包的理由。
collocations: thick coat｜厚外套
tip_zh: thick 可形容物体、液体或烟雾。

definition_en: acceptable
example1_en: Is it okay if I borrow your ruler?
example2_en: An okay-looking timetable still fails students if the last bus leaves before school ends.
example2_zh: 看起来没问题的时刻表，如果末班车在放学前离开，仍然会让学生失望。
collocations: be okay｜没问题
tip_zh: okay 与 O.K. 是同一个词。本库只保留 okay。正式写作可用 all right。

definition_en: a disease or a period of being ill
example1_en: The illness kept her at home for three days.
example1_zh: 这场病让她在家待了三天。
example2_en: An illness reported early is easier to treat than one hidden until Friday.
example2_zh: 早报告的病比拖到周五才说的更容易处理。
collocations: a serious illness｜重病
tip_zh: ill 已在本库。illness 可数也可不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 较年幼的；初级的 | adj. 青少年的；年少的 | n. 低年级学生；较年幼者
definition_en: younger or lower in rank | Intended for younger people or involving them | A younger person, or a student below the final year
example1_en: He is a junior member of the team.
example2_en: Companies should provide junior employees with structured training and regular opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues.
example2_zh: 公司应为初级员工提供系统培训，并定期安排他们向经验丰富的同事学习。
collocations: junior staff｜初级员工 ; junior position｜初级职位 ; junior championship｜青少年锦标赛
tip_zh: 职位或年龄比较用junior to，不用junior than。

definition_en: in a true way, or sincerely
example1_en: I am truly sorry for the delay.
example1_zh: 这次耽误我真的很抱歉。
example2_en: A programme is truly open only when students without a laptop can still take part.
example2_zh: 只有没有笔记本电脑的学生也能参加时，一个项目才真正开放。
collocations: yours truly｜敬上
tip_zh: 信末 Yours truly 是客套结尾。truly 强调真实，不只是程度很高。

definition_en: a flat dish, or a flat piece
example1_en: Put the plate in the sink.
example2_en: A cracked plate in the canteen should be thrown away the same day.
example2_zh: 食堂里裂了的盘子应当当天扔掉。
collocations: a plate of｜一盘
tip_zh: plate 也可指金属板或车牌。

definition_en: with each other
example1_en: We cleaned the classroom together.
example2_en: Neighbours who cook together waste less food than families who each buy too much.
example2_zh: 一起做饭的邻居，比各自买得太多的家庭浪费的食物更少。
collocations: together with｜和……一起 ; get together｜聚会
tip_zh: together 是副词，不单独作动词。

definition_en: the process of making things, or the amount made
example1_en: Food production fell after the dry month.
example1_zh: 干旱的一个月之后，食品产量下降了。
example2_en: Higher production of plastic does not help if the town has nowhere to put the waste.
example2_zh: 如果城镇没有地方放置废物，更高的塑料产量也没有帮助。
collocations: in production｜在生产中
tip_zh: production 通常不可数。

definition_en: a place, a job, or an opinion
example1_en: Write your position in the team on the form.
example1_zh: 在表格上写你在队里的位置。
example2_en: A city's position on housing decides who can live near work and who must travel for hours.
example2_zh: 一座城市在住房上的立场，决定谁能住在工作附近，谁必须赶几小时的路。
collocations: in a position to｜能够 ; take a position｜采取立场
tip_zh: in a position to do 表示有条件做某事。

definition_en: something you own, or the state of owning it
example1_en: The bag is her possession.
example2_en: A list of possessions helps a lost bag return.
example2_zh: 一份物品清单能帮助遗失的包回到主人手里。
collocations: in possession of｜拥有 ; personal possessions｜个人物品
tip_zh: possessions 复数常指财物。

definition_en: not in any place
example1_en: The key was nowhere in the lab.
example1_zh: 钥匙在实验室里哪儿都没有。
example2_en: A plan that leads nowhere should be rewritten before the trip.
example2_zh: 哪儿也到不了的计划，应当在出行前改写。
collocations: nowhere else｜没有别的地方
tip_zh: nowhere 已含否定。放在句首时句子常倒装。

meanings_zh: adj. 棕色的 | n. 棕色
definition_en: of the colour of earth or coffee | the colour brown
example1_en: He carried a brown bag.
example2_en: Brown flood water in a street is a warning, not a picture to share without context.
example2_zh: 街上的棕色洪水是警报，不是可以不说明背景就转发的照片。
collocations: brown eyes｜棕色眼睛
tip_zh: brown 也可作名词表示棕色。

definition_en: of the Olympic Games
example1_en: The Olympic story is on the wall.
example1_zh: 奥林匹克的故事在墙上。
example2_en: An Olympic poster does not replace a field the school can actually use.
example2_zh: 一张奥林匹克海报代替不了学校真正能用的场地。
collocations: the Olympic Games｜奥林匹克运动会
tip_zh: Olympic 要大写。Olympics 是本批的另一词，指奥运会。

definition_en: to use money or time
example1_en: I spend twenty minutes on new words.
example2_en: Families spend a larger share of their income on food when prices rise.
example2_zh: 物价上涨时，家庭把收入中更大的一份花在食物上。
collocations: spend time doing｜花时间做 ; spend money on｜在……上花钱
tip_zh: spend 的主语是人。It takes time 的主语是事物。过去式是 spent。

definition_en: a repeated design, or a regular way something happens
example1_en: The pattern on the cloth is simple.
example2_en: A pattern of late buses is a fact, not one unlucky day.
example2_zh: 公交一再晚点是一个事实，不是倒霉的一天。
collocations: a pattern of｜……的模式
tip_zh: pattern 可数。作动词是仿造。

meanings_zh: n. 液体 | adj. 液体的
definition_en: a substance that flows, like water | in the form of a liquid
example1_en: Do not mix the two liquids.
example1_zh: 不要把这两种液体混在一起。
example2_en: A liquid without a label in the lab should not be used.
example2_zh: 实验室里没有标签的液体不应当使用。
collocations: liquid food｜流质食物
tip_zh: liquid 也可作形容词。本条不写如何混合危险液体。

definition_en: the season between summer and winter; British
example1_en: School starts in autumn.
example2_en: An autumn storm still needs the ordinary plan: who calls parents.
example2_zh: 一场秋日暴风雨仍然需要普通的方案：谁给家长打电话。
collocations: in autumn｜在秋天
tip_zh: autumn 是英式。美式秋季常用 fall。本库已有 fall，含义更多。

meanings_zh: v. 帮助 | n. 帮助
definition_en: to make it easier for someone to do something | the act of helping
example1_en: Could you help me move this desk?
example1_zh: 你能帮我搬这张桌子吗？
example2_en: Older students can help younger ones settle in, which also builds leadership in the older group.
example2_zh: 高年级学生可以帮助新生适应，这也能培养他们的领导能力。
collocations: help sb with｜在某方面帮助 ; with the help of｜在……帮助下 ; can't help doing｜忍不住
tip_zh: help sb (to) do 中的 to 可以省略。

meanings_zh: n. 曲调 | v. 调音
definition_en: a series of musical notes | to adjust a musical instrument
example1_en: The tune is simple.
example2_en: A tune without words still needs a time if the concert has a bus.
example2_zh: 如果音乐会要坐公交，没有歌词的曲子仍然需要一个时间。
collocations: in tune｜合调 ; a tune of｜一首……曲子
tip_zh: tune 作动词是调音。

definition_en: the one belonging to you
example1_en: This seat is yours if you want it.
example1_zh: 如果你要，这个座位是你的。
example2_en: Yours sincerely is a safe ending when you know the name but not the person well.
example2_zh: 知道对方姓名但并不熟时，Yours sincerely 是稳妥的信末用语。
collocations: yours sincerely｜谨上
tip_zh: 名词性物主代词，后面不再接名词。your 是限定词，本库未单列。

definition_en: tall, or great in amount or level
example1_en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
example2_en: High housing costs near good schools can shut out the families those schools were meant to serve.
example2_zh: 好学校附近的高房价，可能把学校本应服务的家庭挡在外面。
collocations: high school｜中学 ; at a high speed｜高速
tip_zh: 人的个子用 tall；山、价格、水平用 high。

definition_en: a person who does office work or keeps records
example1_en: The club secretary wrote the minutes.
example1_zh: 社团秘书写了会议记录。
example2_en: A school secretary often knows which families cannot be reached by phone.
example2_zh: 学校秘书常常知道哪些家庭用电话联系不上。
collocations: secretary of｜……的秘书
tip_zh: secretary 的复数是 secretaries。

definition_en: to a position on
example1_en: The cat jumped onto the desk.
example2_en: A ramp onto the platform lets a student with a wheelchair board the same train.
example2_zh: 通向站台的坡道，让坐轮椅的学生能上同一列火车。
collocations: onto the bus｜到公交车上
tip_zh: onto 强调移动到表面之上。已经在上面用 on。

definition_en: the small part from which a plant grows
example1_en: The seed is in the soil.
example2_en: A seed in the school garden needs water in August, when most students are away.
example2_zh: 学校园子里的种子在八月需要水，而那时大多数学生不在。
collocations: a seed of｜一粒种子；……的萌芽
tip_zh: seed 可数。

definition_en: a date remembered each year
example1_en: The school anniversary is in October.
example2_en: An anniversary speech should name who keeps the building open, not only who founded it.
example2_zh: 周年讲话应当点出是谁让这栋楼一直开着，而不只是谁创办了它。
collocations: the anniversary of｜……的周年
tip_zh: anniversary 可数。

definition_en: something given to a winner
example1_en: The prize was a book, not money.
example2_en: A prize for attendance can hide the student who was ill and still caught up.
example2_zh: 出勤奖可能掩盖那个生过病却仍然补上进度的学生。
collocations: win a prize｜获奖 ; first prize｜一等奖
tip_zh: prize 是奖品。award 已在本库，更常指正式授予的奖。

definition_en: how fast something moves
example1_en: The car was travelling at a high speed.
example2_en: Lower speed near a school protects children more than a wider road does.
example2_zh: 学校附近降低速度，比把路修得更宽更能保护孩子。
collocations: at a speed of｜以……的速度 ; speed up｜加速
tip_zh: speed 作动词是“加速”，过去式可以是 sped。

definition_en: a formal public event
example1_en: The ceremony starts at ten.
example2_en: A ceremony still needs a seat for the parent who comes from work.
example2_zh: 典礼仍然要给下班赶来的家长留一个座位。
collocations: opening ceremony｜开幕式 ; graduation ceremony｜毕业典礼
tip_zh: ceremony 可数。

meanings_zh: n. 平均数；一般水平 | n. 平均数；平均水平 | v. 平均为
definition_en: the usual level or mean | A value calculated by dividing a total by the item count. | Have a particular amount as the usual or calculated middle value.
example1_en: His scores are above the average.
example1_zh: 他的分数高于平均水平。
example2_en: Average household spending on energy may fall as better insulation reduces the need for heating.
example2_zh: 随着更好的隔热措施减少供暖需求，家庭能源支出的平均水平可能下降。
collocations: on average｜平均而言 ; above average｜高于平均水平 ; average income｜平均收入 ; average temperature｜平均气温
tip_zh: on average表示“平均而言”，不用in average。

definition_en: to put something where it cannot be seen, or to go where you cannot be seen
example1_en: Do not hide the broken step behind a sign.
example1_zh: 不要用一块牌子把坏台阶遮住。
example2_en: Students who hide a worry until the exam give the school no time to help.
example2_zh: 把担心藏到考试的学生，没给学校留下帮忙的时间。
collocations: hide sth from sb｜对某人隐瞒
tip_zh: hide 的过去式是 hid，过去分词是 hidden。

definition_en: a sound, especially a loud or unpleasant one
example1_en: The noise from the road enters the classroom.
example2_en: Noise at a school gate is a design problem if the pavement is too narrow.
example2_zh: 如果人行道太窄，校门口的噪声就是设计问题。
collocations: make a noise｜发出声音
tip_zh: noise 可数也可不可数。a noise 是一阵声音。

meanings_zh: n. 棍；枝条 | v. 粘住；坚持
definition_en: a thin piece of wood | to attach, or to continue with
example1_en: The dog brought back a stick.
example1_zh: 狗把一根棍子叼了回来。
example2_en: A walking stick at the school gate is a tool, not something to joke about.
example2_zh: 校门口的拐杖是工具，不是拿来开玩笑的东西。
collocations: stick to｜坚持 ; walking stick｜拐杖
tip_zh: 动词 stick 的过去式和过去分词是 stuck。stick to 表示坚持。

definition_en: to decide which one you want
example1_en: Choose a question you can explain.
example2_en: Families choose a school they can reach, not only the one with the highest scores.
example2_zh: 家庭选择他们能够到达的学校，而不只是分数最高的那所。
collocations: choose to do｜选择做 ; choose between｜在……之间选择
tip_zh: choose 的过去式是 chose，过去分词是 chosen。

definition_en: to remove something written or stored
example1_en: Delete the old time before you write the new one.
example1_zh: 写下新时间之前，先删掉旧时间。
example2_en: Do not delete the only copy of the class list.
example2_zh: 不要删掉班级名单的唯一副本。
collocations: delete sth from｜从……删除
tip_zh: delete 比 remove 更常用于文字和文件。

meanings_zh: prep. 除……以外（还有） | adv. 而且
definition_en: in addition to | in addition
example1_en: Besides English, she studies history.
example2_en: Besides the fare, the later bus matters because students can stay for the club.
example2_zh: 除了票价，晚班车重要是因为学生可以留下参加社团。
collocations: besides that｜除此之外
tip_zh: besides 表示包括在内的“还有”。except 是排除。作副词是“而且”。

definition_en: a film
example1_en: We saw a movie about a small town.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部关于小镇的电影。
example2_en: A movie can show a problem, but the town still has to decide what to do on Monday.
example2_zh: 电影可以展示一个问题，但城镇仍要决定星期一做什么。
collocations: go to the movies｜去看电影 ; movie star｜电影明星
tip_zh: movie 是美式常用词；英式更常说 film。

meanings_zh: n. 泵 | v. 用泵抽
definition_en: a machine that moves liquid or air | to move liquid or air with a pump
example1_en: The pump is off.
example2_en: A pump that fails in August leaves the garden dry.
example2_zh: 八月坏掉的泵会让园子变干。
collocations: water pump｜水泵
tip_zh: pump 作动词是用泵抽。本条不写危险操作。

definition_en: happening often, or shared
example1_en: Colds are common in winter.
example2_en: A common timetable for buses and schools would stop students waiting in the dark.
example2_zh: 公交和学校共用的时刻表，能避免学生在黑暗中等候。
collocations: in common｜共同的 ; common sense｜常识
tip_zh: common 强调经常发生或共有；ordinary 强调平凡、不特别。

definition_en: to divide into parts
example1_en: Split the class into two groups.
example2_en: Cities that split one bus into two short routes can help students who live past the old stop.
example2_zh: 把一路公交拆成两条短线的城市，能帮助住在旧站以外的学生。
collocations: split up｜分手；分开 ; split into｜分成
tip_zh: split 的过去式和过去分词仍是 split。

definition_en: to think that something is true
example1_en: I believe we can finish the project tonight.
example1_zh: 我相信我们今晚能做完这个项目。
example2_en: Students should not believe a chart until they know who collected the numbers and why.
example2_zh: 学生在弄清数字是谁收集的、为什么收集之前，不该轻信一张图表。
collocations: believe in｜信任；信仰 ; believe it or not｜信不信由你
tip_zh: believe 后接 that 从句或 sb；believe in 表示信任或信仰。

meanings_zh: n. 火车 | v. 训练
definition_en: a railway vehicle | to teach a skill
example1_en: The train leaves at seven.
example2_en: A late train can make a student miss the first lesson even when the school itself starts on time.
example2_zh: 晚点的火车会让学生错过第一节课，即使学校本身准时开始。
collocations: by train｜乘火车 ; train station｜火车站
tip_zh: train 作动词是“训练”。

definition_en: thin material for writing, or a newspaper
example1_en: Write your name on the paper.
example2_en: A paper exam in a hot room measures heat as well as knowledge.
example2_zh: 炎热房间里的纸笔考试，测量的不只是知识，还有热。
collocations: a piece of paper｜一张纸 ; on paper｜在纸面上
tip_zh: paper 表示纸张时不可数。a paper 可以是一份报纸或一篇论文。

meanings_zh: adj. 对面的；相反的 | n. 对立面 | prep. 在……对面
definition_en: facing, or completely different | a person or thing that is completely different | across from
example1_en: The shop is opposite the school.
example2_en: The opposite choice, a later bus, helps the students who stay for sport.
example2_zh: 相反的选择，也就是晚一班车，能帮助留下来运动的学生。
collocations: opposite to｜与……相反 ; the opposite of｜……的反面
tip_zh: opposite 作介词也可表示在对面。名词是“相反的事物”。

definition_en: large in size or importance
example1_en: We need a bigger table for the group work.
example1_zh: 小组活动我们需要一张更大的桌子。
example2_en: A big sports event can fill hotels while leaving ordinary residents with higher rents.
example2_zh: 一场大型体育赛事可以住满酒店，同时让普通居民面对更高的房租。
collocations: a big deal｜一件大事
tip_zh: big 多用于口语；large 更中性，great 强调程度或情感。

definition_en: not able
example1_en: She was unable to attend the first class.
example2_en: A student unable to climb the stairs still needs a way into the lab.
example2_zh: 上不了楼梯的学生，仍然需要一条进实验室的路。
collocations: unable to do｜不能做
tip_zh: unable 后接 to do。able 已在本库。表里这一行的音标不对，本库用 espeak-ng。

definition_en: the part of the body at the end of the arm | to pass something to someone
example1_en: Please raise your hand before you speak.
example2_en: A helping hand from an older student can matter more than another printed worksheet.
example2_zh: 高年级学生伸来的一只援手，可能比又一张打印的练习纸更重要。
collocations: by hand｜用手 ; on the one hand｜一方面 ; give sb a hand｜帮忙
tip_zh: hand in 是上交。hand 作动词是“递”。

definition_en: a period of ten years
example1_en: The school is a decade old.
example2_en: A decade of the same broken step is a choice, not an accident.
example2_zh: 同一个坏台阶过了十年，是一种选择，不是意外。
collocations: for a decade｜十年之久 ; the last decade｜过去十年
tip_zh: decade 可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 女的；雌的 | n. 女性；雌性
definition_en: of the sex that can produce young | a female person or animal
example1_en: The form has a box for male or female.
example1_zh: 表格上有男或女的一栏。
example2_en: A female engineer visiting the class shows a possible job, not only a word in a textbook.
example2_zh: 一位女工程师来到班上，展示的是一种可能的工作，而不只是课本里的一个词。
collocations: female student｜女学生
tip_zh: female 可作形容词或名词。填写表格时表示性别。

definition_en: farming
example1_en: Agriculture still feeds the town.
example1_zh: 农业仍然养活这座城镇。
example2_en: A lesson on agriculture should name who does the work.
example2_zh: 农业课应当写出是谁在干活。
collocations: agriculture of｜……的农业
tip_zh: 形容词 agricultural 是本批的另一词。agriculture 通常不可数。

definition_en: a large amount, or ordinary people as a group
example1_en: A mass of leaves blocked the drain.
example1_zh: 一大堆叶子堵住了排水口。
example2_en: The masses use the early bus, so a fare rise hits them before it hits anyone with a car.
example2_zh: 普通大众坐早班车，所以票价上涨先打击他们，而不是有车的人。
collocations: a mass of｜大量 ; the masses｜群众
tip_zh: a mass of 后可接可数或不可数名词。the masses 指广大民众。

meanings_zh: adj. 黄色的 | n. 黄色
definition_en: of the colour of a lemon or the sun | the colour yellow
example1_en: The yellow bus is ours.
example1_zh: 那辆黄色的车是我们的。
example2_en: Yellow lines on the road mean more when students know why they are there.
example2_zh: 当学生知道黄线为什么在那里时，路上的黄线才更有意义。
collocations: yellow line｜黄线
tip_zh: yellow 也可作名词“黄色”。

definition_en: to form a picture in the mind
example1_en: Imagine a street where children can walk safely.
example1_zh: 想象一条孩子可以安全走路的街。
example2_en: It is hard to imagine a later school start unless the buses change too.
example2_zh: 除非公交也改时间，否则很难想象推迟上学。
collocations: imagine doing｜想象做
tip_zh: imagine 后接名词、doing 或 that 从句。

definition_en: a set of papers or computer data about one subject
example1_en: Please save the file before you close it.
example2_en: A paper file and a computer file of the same student should not disagree.
example2_zh: 同一名学生的纸质档案和电脑档案不应当互相矛盾。
collocations: a file of｜一份……档案 ; on file｜存档
tip_zh: file 也可作动词“把……归档”。计算机里的文档也叫 file。

definition_en: having a lot of money, or full of something
example1_en: The soil here is rich and good for vegetables.
example1_zh: 这里的土壤肥沃，适合种菜。
example2_en: A rich city can still have neighbourhoods where children share one small room.
example2_zh: 富裕的城市里，仍可能有孩子合住一间小屋的社区。
collocations: rich in｜富含 ; the rich｜富人
tip_zh: the rich 表示一类人。rich in 后接所富含的东西。

meanings_zh: n. 影响 | v. 影响
definition_en: the power to change someone or something | to change how someone thinks or acts
example1_en: His teacher had a strong influence on him.
example2_en: Peer influence can push a student toward a club or away from one.
example2_zh: 同伴的影响可以把学生推向一个社团，也可以把他们推开。
collocations: have an influence on｜对……有影响 ; under the influence of｜在……影响下
tip_zh: influence 后接 on。作动词时直接接宾语：influence somebody。

definition_en: what something is made of, or information for a piece of work
example1_en: The bag is made of recycled material.
example1_zh: 这个包是用回收材料做的。
example2_en: Teaching material about floods should include the streets children actually use.
example2_zh: 关于洪水的教材应该包括孩子真正走的那些街。
collocations: raw material｜原材料 ; reading material｜阅读材料
tip_zh: material 作“材料”时可数或不可数。作形容词是“物质的”。

definition_en: a student with a class duty, or a screen
example1_en: The monitor locked the lab.
example2_en: A monitor on the wall does not replace a person who knows the students.
example2_zh: 墙上的监视器代替不了认识学生的人。
collocations: class monitor｜班长
tip_zh: monitor 也可作动词“监视”。班长是中国课堂里的常用义。

definition_en: an idea that someone offers
example1_en: The suggestion is on the board.
example2_en: A suggestion about the bus should include the return time.
example2_zh: 关于公交的建议应当包括返回时间。
collocations: a suggestion for｜对……的建议
tip_zh: 动词 suggest 已在本库。suggestion 可数。

meanings_zh: n. 堂（表）兄弟；堂（表）姐妹
definition_en: the child of your aunt or uncle
example1_en: Her cousin will share the book.
example1_zh: 她的表姐会和她合用这本书。
example2_en: A form that says cousin should still leave space for another name.
example2_zh: 写着表亲的表格，仍然应当给另一个名字留出位置。
collocations: a cousin of｜……的表亲
tip_zh: cousin 可指表兄弟或表姐妹，不标明性别。

definition_en: the reflexive form of we
example1_en: We cleaned the lab ourselves.
example1_zh: 实验室是我们自己打扫的。
example2_en: We cannot blame the timetable if we wrote it ourselves and left out the last bus.
example2_zh: 如果课表是我们自己写的，又漏了末班车，就不能怪课表。
collocations: by ourselves｜我们独自
tip_zh: ourselves 是反身代词。by ourselves 表示独自。

meanings_zh: v. 提供；出价 | n. 提供；出价
definition_en: to say you will give or do something | a proposal to give or pay
example1_en: The library offers a quiet room after school.
example1_zh: 图书馆放学后提供一间安静的房间。
example2_en: Towns that offer night buses help workers who finish after the regular service stops.
example2_zh: 提供夜班公交的城镇，帮助那些在常规班次停运后才下班的工人。
collocations: offer to do｜主动提出做 ; offer sb sth｜向某人提供
tip_zh: offer 后可接 to do 或双宾语。

meanings_zh: v. 居住；生活 | adj. 现场的；活的
definition_en: to have one's home, or to be alive | happening now, or alive
example1_en: We live near the old market.
example2_en: People who live beside a busy road pay a health cost that does not appear on the rent receipt.
example2_zh: 住在繁忙道路旁的人承担着健康代价，而这不会出现在房租收据上。
collocations: live on｜以……为生 ; live up to｜不辜负
tip_zh: live 作动词读 /lɪv/；作形容词“现场的”读 /laɪv/。

definition_en: fitting closely, or firmly fixed
example1_en: The lid is too tight.
example2_en: A tight budget can still buy the lock if the lab door does not close.
example2_zh: 如果实验室的门关不上，紧的预算也仍然应当先买锁。
collocations: tight schedule｜紧凑的日程
tip_zh: tight 可形容衣服、时间或预算。

meanings_zh: n. 种类 | v. 分类
definition_en: a type | to arrange into groups
example1_en: What sort of book do you want?
example2_en: The sort of food sold at the gate shapes what students eat between lessons.
example2_zh: 门口卖的食物种类，影响着学生课间吃什么。
collocations: sort of｜有点儿；某种 ; all sorts of｜各种各样
tip_zh: sort 作动词是“分类”。

definition_en: a planned piece of work
example1_en: Our project is about the river behind the school.
example1_zh: 我们的课题是关于学校后面的河。
example2_en: A project that never asks local people can solve the wrong problem.
example2_zh: 从不询问当地人的项目，可能会解决一个错误的问题。
collocations: project work｜课题作业
tip_zh: project 作名词重音常在前；作动词“投射、预计”时重音常在后。

definition_en: kindness shown when you could punish
example1_en: The story ends with mercy, not with shame.
example1_zh: 故事以怜悯结束，不是以羞辱结束。
example2_en: Mercy for a late form is fair when the bus never came.
example2_zh: 公交根本没来时，原谅迟交的表格是公平的。
collocations: show mercy｜表示怜悯 ; at the mercy of｜受……支配
tip_zh: mercy 通常不可数。

definition_en: a woman who acts in plays or films
example1_en: The actress visited the drama club.
example1_zh: 这位女演员来了戏剧社。
example2_en: An actress who only reads the lines still needs the crew that built the set.
example2_zh: 只念台词的女演员，仍然需要搭景的那组人。
collocations: an actress in｜……里的女演员
tip_zh: actor 已在本库，现在也可泛指演员。actress 专指女演员。

definition_en: liked by many people
example1_en: The reading club is popular this term.
example1_zh: 读书社团这学期很受欢迎。
example2_en: A popular beach can damage the very coast people come to see.
example2_zh: 受欢迎的海滩可能破坏人们前来观看的那片海岸。
collocations: be popular with｜受……欢迎
