tip_zh: popular 后接 with 表示受某类人欢迎。

definition_en: to repair, or to decide
example1_en: Can you fix the clock in the hall?
example2_en: Cities should fix the crossing before they fix the paint on the school wall.
example2_zh: 城市应当先修好路口，再去刷学校墙上的漆。
collocations: fix a time｜确定时间 ; fix up｜安排；修理
tip_zh: fix 在美式口语里常指修理。确定日期也用 fix。

definition_en: a room for art, music, or broadcasting
example1_en: The art studio is on the top floor.
example2_en: A studio with one door still needs a window that opens.
example2_zh: 只有一扇门的工作室，仍然需要一扇能开的窗。
collocations: art studio｜美术工作室 ; recording studio｜录音室
tip_zh: studio 可数。复数是 studios。

definition_en: done in a short time
example1_en: We had a quick review before the test.
example1_zh: 测验前我们快速复习了一下。
example2_en: A quick warning is useless if the path to higher ground is not marked.
example2_zh: 如果通往高地的路没有标出，快速的警报也没有用。
collocations: be quick｜快点
tip_zh: quick 的副词是 quickly。fast 本身可作副词。

meanings_zh: prep. 穿过；在对面 | adv. 横过
definition_en: from one side to the other | from one side to the other
example1_en: There is a bookshop across the street.
example2_en: A bridge across the river can cut a student's journey from an hour to ten minutes.
example2_zh: 河上的一座桥可以把学生的路程从一小时缩短到十分钟。
collocations: come across｜偶然遇见 ; across from｜在……对面
tip_zh: across 强调从表面一边到另一边；through 强调从内部穿过。

meanings_zh: n. 邮件；岗位；柱 | v. 邮寄；张贴
definition_en: mail, a job, or a pole | to send by mail, or to put up a notice
example1_en: I will send the form by post.
example2_en: A post in a village school is hard to fill if the teacher must travel two hours each way.
example2_zh: 如果老师每天要单程走两小时，乡村学校的岗位就很难有人来。
collocations: post office｜邮局 ; by post｜邮寄
tip_zh: post 作动词是“邮寄”或“张贴”。美式邮件多用 mail。

definition_en: a container of soft material
example1_en: My bag is under the desk.
example2_en: A clear bag rule at the gate should still leave room for a student's medicine.
example2_zh: 门口的透明包规定，仍应当给学生的药留出位置。
collocations: school bag｜书包 ; a bag of｜一袋
tip_zh: bag 可数。a bag of 后接所装的东西。

definition_en: a stick used in some ball games, or a flying animal
example1_en: The bat is in the sports room.
example2_en: A bat in the school roof is a reason to call an adult, not to chase it.
example2_zh: 屋顶上的蝙蝠是叫成年人的理由，不是去追它。
collocations: a baseball bat｜棒球棒
tip_zh: 球棒和蝙蝠是同一个词。本条不写如何伤害动物。

definition_en: British spelling of organization
example1_en: The organisation runs the late bus.
example2_en: An organisation that hides its fees is harder for families to trust.
example2_zh: 隐瞒费用的组织更难让家庭信任。
collocations: an organisation of｜一个……组织
tip_zh: organisation 是英式，organization 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留。

definition_en: money paid for a service
example1_en: The fee is on the notice.
example2_en: A fee that is not written down is not a choice a family can make.
example2_zh: 没写下来的费用，不是家庭能够作出的选择。
collocations: a fee for｜……的费用 ; school fees｜学费
tip_zh: fee 可数。学费常用复数 fees。

meanings_zh: v. 适合；合身 | adj. 健康的；适合的
definition_en: to be the right size or kind | healthy, or suitable
example1_en: These shoes do not fit.
example2_en: A school timetable should fit the buses, or students will arrive after the lesson has started.
example2_zh: 课表应该配合公交，否则学生会在课开始后才到。
collocations: fit in｜适应 ; keep fit｜保持健康
tip_zh: fit 作形容词是“健康的”或“适合的”。过去式可以是 fitted。

definition_en: usual and expected
example1_en: It is normal to feel nervous before a test.
example2_en: A normal school day becomes unsafe when the road outside has no pavement.
example2_zh: 当外面的路没有人行道时，普通的上学日会变得不安全。
collocations: normal temperature｜正常体温 ; return to normal｜恢复正常
tip_zh: normal 是形容词；normally 是副词。

definition_en: a game played with a racket and a ball
example1_en: Tennis practice is at four.
example2_en: A tennis court that locks at dusk leaves the late class outside.
example2_zh: 黄昏就锁上的网球场，把下课晚的班级留在外面。
collocations: play tennis｜打网球
tip_zh: play tennis 不加 the。

definition_en: a person who takes photographs
example1_en: The photographer asked before taking the picture.
example2_en: A photographer at a school event should not post a face without permission.
example2_zh: 学校活动的摄影师不应当未经允许发布人脸。
collocations: a photographer for｜……的摄影师
tip_zh: 名词 photograph 是本批的另一词。

meanings_zh: v. 考虑；认为 | v. 认为；视为 | v. 顾及；考虑到
definition_en: to think about carefully | to have a particular opinion about someone or something | to take someone or something into account
example1_en: Please consider my advice before deciding.
example1_zh: 做决定前请考虑我的建议。
example2_en: Governments should consider the long-term environmental costs before approving major construction projects in sensitive coastal areas.
example2_zh: 政府在批准生态敏感沿海地区的大型建设项目之前，应考虑其长期环境成本。
collocations: consider doing something｜考虑做某事 ; consider the consequences｜考虑后果 ; consider all options｜考虑所有选择 ; be considered essential｜被认为必不可少
tip_zh: “考虑做”用consider doing，不用consider to do。

definition_en: trust in paying later, a school unit, or praise
example1_en: She got extra credit for the project.
example1_zh: 她因这个课题得到了额外学分。
example2_en: Credit for a cleaner river belongs to the people who stopped the waste, not only to the speech.
example2_zh: 把河变干净的功劳属于制止排污的人，而不只属于那篇讲话。
collocations: credit card｜信用卡 ; to one's credit｜值得表扬
tip_zh: credit 的几个义要靠搭配区分。

definition_en: connected with a god, or treated with great respect
example1_en: The visit included a sacred place for those who wanted it.
example1_zh: 参观包括一处圣地，给想去的人。
example2_en: A school can explain a sacred object without telling every student to believe.
example2_zh: 学校可以讲解一件圣物，而不要求每个学生去信。
collocations: sacred to｜对……神圣
tip_zh: 表里的中文写成了 scared（害怕）。音标是 sacred，本库按“神圣的”写。本条不是劝人信教。

meanings_zh: n. 口罩；面具 | v. 掩饰
definition_en: a cover for the face | to hide something
example1_en: The mask is by the clinic door.
example2_en: A mask in a health lesson is a tool, and the lesson should say when to change it.
example2_zh: 健康课里的口罩是工具，课上应当说明何时更换。
collocations: wear a mask｜戴口罩
tip_zh: mask 作动词是掩饰。本条不写如何伤害。

meanings_zh: v. 通过；传递；经过 | n. 通行证；及格
definition_en: to succeed, hand over, or go by | a permit, or a successful result
example1_en: I hope to pass the listening test.
example2_en: Students who pass a crowded junction every morning need a light, not only a higher test score.
example2_zh: 每天早晨经过拥挤路口的学生需要一盏灯，而不只是更高的考分。
collocations: pass on｜传递 ; pass by｜经过
tip_zh: pass 的过去式是 passed。past 是介词或名词，不要拼混。

definition_en: belonging to a king or queen
example1_en: The royal garden is open on Sunday.
example2_en: A royal visit fills the news, while the town's ordinary market still has to open on Monday.
example2_zh: 王室来访会占满新闻，而镇上的普通集市周一仍然得开。
collocations: the royal family｜王室
tip_zh: royal 是形容词。国王或女王用 king、queen。

definition_en: a sweet food made by bees
example1_en: There is honey in the tea.
example2_en: Honey that hides nuts should say so on the label.
example2_zh: 藏着坚果的蜂蜜应当在标签上写明。
collocations: a spoon of honey｜一勺蜂蜜
tip_zh: honey 通常不可数。表里这一行的音标是 honest，本库不用。

meanings_zh: n. 气候 | n. 社会环境；风气；氛围
definition_en: usual weather of a place | The general attitudes and conditions within a society or organisation.
example1_en: The climate here is warm and wet.
example2_en: A changing climate may force farmers to grow different crops and adopt more efficient irrigation methods.
example2_zh: 气候变化可能迫使农民改种其他作物，并采用更高效的灌溉方法。
collocations: climate change｜气候变化 ; mild climate｜温和的气候 ; political climate｜政治环境
tip_zh: climate指长期气候，weather指具体天气。

definition_en: a senior official who represents a country abroad
example1_en: The ambassador visited the school.
example2_en: A speech by an ambassador does not replace the bus the town was promised.
example2_zh: 大使的讲话代替不了城镇被承诺的那路公交。
collocations: an ambassador to｜驻……的大使
tip_zh: ambassador 可数。

definition_en: a small animal often kept as a pet
example1_en: The cat sleeps in the sunny window.
example1_zh: 猫睡在有阳光的窗台上。
example2_en: A school rule about the office cat should say who feeds it on holiday.
example2_zh: 关于办公室那只猫的规定，应当写明假期谁喂它。
collocations: pet cat｜宠物猫
tip_zh: cat 可数。雄猫是 tomcat，小猫是 kitten。

definition_en: a location, or a position
example1_en: This is a good place to wait for the bus.
example2_en: Every child needs a place to study that is safe, even if that place is a shared table.
example2_zh: 每个孩子都需要一个安全的学习地方，哪怕那只是一张共用的桌子。
collocations: take place｜发生 ; in place of｜代替 ; from place to place｜到处
tip_zh: take place 表示发生，没有被动语态。

meanings_zh: n. 连衣裙；服装 | v. 穿衣
definition_en: a piece of clothing, or clothes in general | to put clothes on
example1_en: She wore a blue dress to the concert.
example1_zh: 她穿着蓝裙子去听音乐会。
example2_en: A dress code that costs too much keeps some students out of the photo.
example2_zh: 花费过高的着装要求，会让一些学生进不了合影。
collocations: dress up｜装扮 ; evening dress｜晚礼服
tip_zh: dress 作动词是穿衣。给某人穿上用 dress sb。

definition_en: to travel through a place to learn about it, or to examine an idea
example1_en: Explore the map before the trip.
example2_en: Students explore a question better when the source is named.
example2_zh: 写明来源时，学生能更好地探究一个问题。
collocations: explore a place｜探索一个地方
tip_zh: explore 不用于“探索危险操作”。

definition_en: a small animal, or a device that moves a pointer
example1_en: The mouse is beside the keyboard.
example2_en: A mouse in the lab cupboard is a reason to close the food, not a joke.
example2_zh: 实验室柜子里的老鼠是把食物收起来的理由，不是笑话。
collocations: a computer mouse｜鼠标
tip_zh: 复数是 mice。动物和鼠标是同一个词。

definition_en: a show, or a plan of events; British spelling
example1_en: The programme starts at seven.
example2_en: A reading programme fails if the books never reach the classroom.
example2_zh: 如果书从来到不了教室，阅读计划就会失败。
collocations: a programme of｜一系列 ; TV programme｜电视节目
tip_zh: programme 是英式，常指节目或计划。计算机程序英美都常用 program，已在本库。两条都保留。

definition_en: a road vehicle with an engine
example1_en: My uncle drives a small car to work.
example1_zh: 我叔叔开一辆小汽车上班。
example2_en: Fewer car trips to school would clear the air on the narrow street outside the gate.
example2_zh: 减少开车上学的次数，能改善校门外窄街上的空气。
collocations: by car｜乘汽车 ; car park｜停车场
tip_zh: by car 不加冠词。

definition_en: the first meal of the day
example1_en: Breakfast is at seven in the hall.
example2_en: A student who skips breakfast often loses the first lesson, not only the meal.
example2_zh: 不吃早饭的学生常常丢掉的是第一节课，而不只是那一餐。
collocations: have breakfast｜吃早饭 ; at breakfast｜早餐时
tip_zh: breakfast 前通常不用 a。have breakfast 不加 the。

definition_en: help
example1_en: The office offers assistance with the form.
example2_en: Financial assistance for the trip should be quiet, so no student is named in public.
example2_zh: 出行的经济帮助应当安静地进行，这样就不会在公开场合点学生的名。
collocations: come to one's assistance｜来帮助某人 ; assistance with｜在……方面的帮助
tip_zh: assistance 通常不可数。assistant 已在本库。

definition_en: stories that are imagined, not fact
example1_en: The library keeps fiction on the left.
example1_zh: 图书馆把小说放在左边。
example2_en: Fiction about a flood can start a discussion, and the bus time still has to be fact.
example2_zh: 关于洪水的小说可以开启讨论，公交时间却必须是事实。
collocations: science fiction｜科幻小说
tip_zh: fiction 通常不可数。a work of fiction 是一部虚构作品。

definition_en: to write or say the letters of a word
example1_en: Spell your name on the form.
example1_zh: 在表格上拼写你的名字。
example2_en: Students who can spell the stop can also find it on the map.
example2_zh: 能拼出站名的学生，也能在地图上找到它。
collocations: spell out｜逐字母拼出；讲清楚
tip_zh: spell 的过去式是 spelt 或 spelled。表里这一行的音标是 speed，本库不用。

definition_en: a flat piece of wood, or a group that directs an organisation
example1_en: The teacher wrote the date on the board.
example1_zh: 老师把日期写在黑板上。
example2_en: A school board that never visits classrooms may not see why a class of forty is hard to teach.
example2_zh: 从不进教室的校董会，可能看不到四十人的班为什么难教。
collocations: on board｜在船/车上 ; notice board｜布告栏
tip_zh: board 作动词是“上船、上车”。

definition_en: to stop and hold, to be in time, or to get an illness
example1_en: Catch the ball with both hands.
example2_en: Students who catch the early bus avoid the crowd that builds up outside the gate.
example2_zh: 赶上早班车的学生，可以避开校门口越聚越多的人。
collocations: catch a cold｜感冒 ; catch up with｜赶上
tip_zh: catch 的过去式和过去分词是 caught。catch up with 表示追上。

definition_en: a person who speaks, or a device for sound
example1_en: The speaker asked for questions.
example2_en: A speaker at the back of the hall helps the student who cannot move forward.
example2_zh: 大厅后面的扬声器能帮助不能往前走的学生。
collocations: a native speaker｜母语使用者 ; guest speaker｜嘉宾
tip_zh: 动词 speak 已在本库。speaker 也可指说某种语言的人。

definition_en: a plan of action by a government or organisation
example1_en: The new policy limits cars near the school.
example1_zh: 新政策限制学校附近的汽车。
example2_en: A housing policy that ignores bus routes pushes workers farther from their jobs.
example2_zh: 忽视公交线路的住房政策，会把工人推得离工作更远。
collocations: foreign policy｜外交政策
tip_zh: policy 是可数名词：a policy。politics 是“政治”。

definition_en: a position in an organization or a list
example1_en: She rose to the rank of monitor.
example1_zh: 她升到了班长这个职位。
example2_en: Rank in a class should not decide who may use the library.
example2_zh: 班里的名次不应当决定谁可以用图书馆。
collocations: the rank of｜……的职衔
tip_zh: rank 作动词是排列或位列。

meanings_zh: v. 爱；喜爱 | n. 爱
definition_en: to feel deep affection, or to like very much | a strong feeling of affection
example1_en: I love the smell of the library in the morning.
example1_zh: 我喜欢早晨图书馆的气味。
example2_en: People who love a place are often the first to notice when its river or dialect is disappearing.
example2_zh: 热爱一个地方的人，往往最先注意到它的河流或方言正在消失。
collocations: love doing｜喜欢做 ; fall in love｜爱上
tip_zh: love 后可接 doing 或 to do，口语里 doing 更常见。

definition_en: a place, or a small mark
example1_en: This spot by the window is good for reading.
example1_zh: 窗边这个位置适合读书。
example2_en: A quiet spot in a noisy city can matter as much as a large park that is hard to reach.
example2_zh: 喧闹城市里一个安静的角落，可能和一座难以到达的大公园一样重要。
collocations: on the spot｜当场 ; a spot of｜少量
tip_zh: spot 作动词是“发现”或“弄上污点”。

definition_en: used to say what is right or expected
example1_en: You ought to lock the lab.
example2_en: A city ought to write the bus time before it asks families to trust the plan.
example2_zh: 城市在要求家庭信任计划之前，应该先写下公交时间。
collocations: ought to do｜应该做
tip_zh: ought 后接 to。否定是 ought not to。没有过去式变化。

meanings_zh: n. 改革 | v. 改革
definition_en: a change meant to improve a system | to improve a system by changing it
example1_en: The reform of the bus route is on the notice.
example1_zh: 公交线路的改革写在通知上。
example2_en: A reform that ignores the last bus will look modern and still fail.
example2_zh: 不考虑末班车的改革看起来现代，仍然会失败。
collocations: reform of｜对……的改革
tip_zh: reform 作动词是改革。

meanings_zh: v. 展示；表明 | n. 演出；展览
definition_en: to let someone see, or to prove | a public performance or display
example1_en: Show me your ticket, please.
example2_en: The data show that night markets bring noise as well as income to the streets around them.
example2_zh: 数据表明，夜市给周围街道带来收入的同时，也带来噪音。
collocations: show up｜出现 ; show sb around｜带某人参观 ; on show｜在展出
tip_zh: show sb sth 双宾语；过去分词是 shown。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……上方；超过 | adv. 在上面
definition_en: higher than, or more than | in a higher place
example1_en: The clock is above the door.
example2_en: Temperatures above forty degrees make outdoor sports unsafe for younger students.
example2_zh: 超过四十度的气温会让低龄学生的户外运动不安全。
collocations: above all｜尤其 ; above sea level｜海拔
tip_zh: above 强调位置更高，不一定垂直；over 常有“正上方”或“越过”的意思。

definition_en: ready to face danger or difficulty
example1_en: She was brave enough to report the broken step.
example1_zh: 她有勇气报告那级坏台阶。
example2_en: A brave reply still needs a fact, not only a loud voice.
example2_zh: 勇敢的回答仍然需要事实，而不只是大嗓门。
collocations: brave enough to｜勇敢得足以
tip_zh: brave 也可作动词“勇敢面对”。

definition_en: the fact of owning something
example1_en: Ownership of the lab books is the school.
example1_zh: 这些实验书的所有权属于学校。
example2_en: Clear ownership of a lost bag helps it return.
example2_zh: 遗失包的所有权写清楚，它才容易回到主人手里。
collocations: ownership of｜对……的所有权
tip_zh: owner 已在本库。ownership 通常不可数。

definition_en: a public performance of music
example1_en: The concert is in the hall on Friday.
example2_en: A free concert still needs a seat for the parent who comes straight from work.
example2_zh: 免费音乐会仍然要给刚下班赶来的家长留一个座位。
collocations: go to a concert｜去听音乐会 ; a concert of｜一场……音乐会
tip_zh: concert 可数。in concert 也可表示一致行动。

meanings_zh: v. 哭；喊 | n. 哭声；呼喊
definition_en: to produce tears, or to shout | a shout or a period of crying
example1_en: The child did not cry; he asked for help.
example2_en: A cry for help in a crowded hall needs a person, not only a camera.
example2_zh: 拥挤大厅里的呼救需要一个人，而不只是一台摄像机。
collocations: cry for｜哭着要；呼吁 ; cry out｜大声喊
tip_zh: cry 作名词是哭声或呼喊。

definition_en: to get something by paying money
example1_en: I will buy a notebook after class.
example1_zh: 课后我去买一本笔记本。
example2_en: Families buy less fresh food when the nearest market is an hour away by bus.
example2_zh: 当最近的市场要坐一小时公交时，家庭会少买新鲜食物。
collocations: buy sb sth｜给某人买 ; buy from｜从……购买
tip_zh: buy 的过去式和过去分词是 bought。

definition_en: the outside limit of something
example1_en: Stand back from the edge of the platform.
example2_en: Houses on the edge of town are the first to lose the bus when a route is cut.
example2_zh: 城镇边缘的房子，在线路被削减时最先失去公交。
collocations: on the edge of｜在……边缘 ; edge of｜……的边
tip_zh: on edge 表示紧张。at the edge 是在边上。

definition_en: not long, or not tall
example1_en: It is a short walk from here to the gate.
example1_zh: 从这里到门口走路不远。
example2_en: Short breaks between lessons help attention more than one long break at the end of the day.
example2_zh: 课间的短休息比一天结束时一次长休息更有助于注意力。
collocations: in short｜简言之 ; be short of｜缺少 ; short of｜缺乏
tip_zh: short 可指时间、长度或身材。shortly 是“不久”，不是“短地”。

meanings_zh: n. 句子 | v. 判决
definition_en: a group of words that expresses a complete idea | to state a punishment in court
example1_en: Write one sentence to explain the chart.
example2_en: A long sentence that hides the number is less honest than a short one.
example2_zh: 把数字藏起来的长句，不如短句诚实。
collocations: sentence structure｜句子结构
tip_zh: sentence 也可指判决。本条以语法义为主，法律义在第二个义项。

definition_en: by way of
example1_en: We came via the old bridge.
example2_en: News via a phone app is fast, but a named source is still necessary.
example2_zh: 通过手机应用传来的新闻很快，但署名的来源仍然必要。
collocations: via the Internet｜通过互联网
tip_zh: via 是介词，后接名词，多用于书面。

definition_en: to have clothes or glasses on the body
example1_en: Wear glasses in the lab.
example2_en: Students wear the same uniform, but their journeys to school are not the same length.
example2_zh: 学生穿同样的校服，但他们上学的路程并不一样长。
collocations: wear out｜穿破 ; wear glasses｜戴眼镜
tip_zh: wear 表示穿着的状态；put on 表示穿上的动作。过去式是 wore。

definition_en: money, or the management of money
example1_en: The club has no finance for a second trip.
example1_zh: 社团没有再出行一次的经费。
example2_en: School finance should be public enough for parents to see where the lunch money goes.
example2_zh: 学校财务应当公开到家长能看见午餐钱去了哪里。
collocations: finance a project｜为项目出资
tip_zh: finance 作动词是提供资金。形容词是 financial。

definition_en: gradual change over time
example1_en: The chapter explains evolution in simple words.
example1_zh: 这一章用简单的话解释进化。
example2_en: The evolution of the bus route is written on one sheet.
example2_zh: 公交线路的演变写在一张纸上。
collocations: the evolution of｜……的演变
tip_zh: evolution 通常不可数。

definition_en: a bar, or the railway
example1_en: Hold the rail on the stairs.
example2_en: Travel by rail fails if the station has no late train.
example2_zh: 如果车站没有晚班火车，乘铁路出行就会失败。
collocations: by rail｜乘火车 ; rail station｜火车站
tip_zh: railway 已在本库。by rail 不加冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 报告；报道 | v. 报告；报道
definition_en: a spoken or written account | to give an account of
example1_en: Please hand in the lab report tomorrow.
example2_en: A news report should show what is certain and what is still only a claim.
example2_zh: 新闻报道应该标明哪些是确定的，哪些仍只是说法。
collocations: weather report｜天气预报 ; report on｜关于……的报告
tip_zh: report 作动词是“报告”或“举报”：report sth to sb。

meanings_zh: n. 人行横道；十字路口
definition_en: a place where people cross a road
example1_en: The crossing needs a light.
example1_zh: 这个人行横道需要一盏灯。
example2_en: A crossing without a light pushes students into the road.
example2_zh: 没有灯的人行横道把学生挤到路上。
collocations: a pedestrian crossing｜人行横道
tip_zh: 动词 cross 已在本库。crossing 是名词。

meanings_zh: v. 覆盖；包括；报道 | n. 封面；盖子
definition_en: to put over, include, or report | the outside of a book, or a lid
example1_en: The map covers the whole town.
example1_zh: 这张地图覆盖整个城镇。
example2_en: News that covers only the city centre misses the villages where the flood starts.
example2_zh: 只报道市中心的新闻，会漏掉洪水开始的那些村子。
collocations: cover with｜用……覆盖 ; be covered with｜被……覆盖
tip_zh: cover 作名词是“封面”或“覆盖物”。

definition_en: a game played with a bat and a ball
example1_en: Baseball practice is after school.
example2_en: A baseball field that locks at dusk leaves the late class outside.
example2_zh: 黄昏就锁上的棒球场，把下课晚的班级留在外面。
collocations: play baseball｜打棒球
tip_zh: 球类前通常不加 the：play baseball。

definition_en: bravery
example1_en: It takes courage to speak in public.
example2_en: Young people need courage to challenge unfair practices, especially when their opinions differ from those of others.
example2_zh: 年轻人需要勇气来质疑不公平的做法，尤其是在自己的观点与他人不同时。
collocations: have the courage to do something｜有勇气做某事 ; show courage｜表现出勇气 ; take courage｜鼓起勇气
tip_zh: 通常不可数；做某事的勇气用courage to do。

meanings_zh: v. 处理 | n. 把手
definition_en: to deal with a situation | the part you hold
example1_en: She can handle the tickets for the trip.
example1_zh: 她能处理这次出行的票。
example2_en: Teachers handle a sudden illness better when the clinic number is on the wall.
example2_zh: 当医务室电话写在墙上时，老师能更好地处理突发疾病。
collocations: handle a problem｜处理问题
tip_zh: handle 作名词是“把手”。作动词是处理或用手操作。

definition_en: in all places
example1_en: There were books everywhere after the fair.
example2_en: Signs that appear everywhere and say nothing clear do not help a new student.
example2_zh: 到处都是却什么也没说清的牌子，帮不了新生。
collocations: everywhere else｜其他所有地方
tip_zh: everywhere 是副词，前面不加 in。

meanings_zh: n. 交换；交流 | v. 交换
definition_en: the act of giving one thing and receiving another | to give something and receive something else
example1_en: The language exchange meets on Thursday.
example1_zh: 语言交流活动周四举行。
example2_en: A fair exchange of ideas needs time for the quieter student to answer.
example2_zh: 公平的思想交流需要时间，让较安静的学生也能回答。
collocations: in exchange for｜作为对……的交换 ; exchange student｜交换生
tip_zh: exchange 作动词时，说 exchange A for B。

definition_en: money in coins or notes
example1_en: I paid in cash.
example2_en: A market that only takes cash still serves people who have no bank card.
example2_zh: 只收现金的市场，仍然服务没有银行卡的人。
collocations: in cash｜用现金 ; cash desk｜收银台
tip_zh: cash 不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 恩惠；帮助 | v. 赞成；偏爱
definition_en: a kind act; American spelling of favour | to support or prefer
example1_en: Could you do me a favor and hold the door?
example1_zh: 请帮个忙，扶一下门好吗？
example2_en: A favor that must be repaid in public is not a favor.
example2_zh: 必须当众偿还的忙，就不是帮忙。
collocations: do sb a favor｜帮某人一个忙 ; in favor of｜赞成；有利于
tip_zh: favor 是美式，favour 是英式。它不是 favourite。favourite 是“最喜爱的”，美式 favorite 已在本库。

definition_en: a gas that people need to live
example1_en: The textbook names oxygen as a gas.
example1_zh: 课本把氧气作为一种气体来讲。
example2_en: A lesson on oxygen should stay with the word and the warning, not a method.
example2_zh: 氧气课应当停在这个词和警告上，而不是做法。
collocations: oxygen of｜……的氧
tip_zh: oxygen 通常不可数。本条是科普词汇，不写实验步骤。

definition_en: a wild animal like a large dog
example1_en: The story has a wolf, not a pet.
example1_zh: 故事里有一只狼，不是宠物。
example2_en: A lesson about the wolf should say where it can live, not how to harm it.
example2_zh: 关于狼的课应当说它能住在哪里，而不是如何伤害它。
collocations: a wolf in｜一只狼
tip_zh: 复数是 wolves。

definition_en: without a plan or pattern
example1_en: The names were chosen at random.
example2_en: A random check of the lab list finds the bottle that nobody labelled.
example2_zh: 随机检查实验室清单，能发现没人贴标签的那瓶。
collocations: at random｜随机地
tip_zh: at random 表示任意地、随机地。

meanings_zh: v. 参观；拜访 | n. 参观；拜访
definition_en: to go to see a person or place | an act of visiting
example1_en: We will visit the museum on Friday.
example1_zh: 我们周五去参观博物馆。
example2_en: Leaders who visit a flooded street themselves ask better questions than those who only read a report.
example2_zh: 亲自走访积水街道的负责人，比只读报告的人问出更好的问题。
collocations: pay a visit｜拜访 ; visit to｜对……的访问
tip_zh: visit 可作动词或名词：a visit to。

meanings_zh: n. 报酬；奖赏 | v. 奖赏
definition_en: something given for good work | to give something for good work
example1_en: The reward is a book, not a speech.
example1_zh: 奖赏是一本书，不是一篇讲话。
example2_en: A reward that only the confident students can reach is not yet fair.
example2_zh: 只有自信的学生够得着的奖赏还不算公平。
collocations: a reward for｜对……的奖赏
tip_zh: reward 作动词是奖赏。

meanings_zh: n. 全体船员；一组工作人员
definition_en: a group of people working together on a ship, plane, or task
example1_en: The crew checked the doors before the trip.
example1_zh: 出发前工作人员检查了门。
example2_en: A film crew in the playground should not block the way to the clinic.
example2_zh: 操场上的摄制组不应当堵住去医务室的路。
collocations: a crew of｜一组
tip_zh: crew 是集体名词。谓语可用单数或复数。

meanings_zh: v. 防守；辩护 | v. 辩护；捍卫 | v. 防守
definition_en: to protect from attack | to give reasons supporting someone or something being criticised | to prevent opponents from scoring in a sport
example1_en: Soldiers defend the city from danger.
example1_zh: 士兵们保卫城市免受危险。
example2_en: Governments should defend citizens' rights while ensuring that public safety measures remain fair and proportionate.
example2_zh: 政府应捍卫公民权利，同时确保公共安全措施公平且适度。
collocations: defend against attack｜抵御攻击 ; defend human rights｜捍卫人权 ; defend a decision｜为某项决定辩护 ; defend a title｜卫冕
tip_zh: defend ... against/from ...表示保护……免受……。

definition_en: the part of the body where the arm joins
example1_en: She carried the bag on one shoulder.
example2_en: Pain in the shoulder after a long exam is a reason to stand up.
example2_zh: 长时间考试后肩膀疼，是站起来的理由。
collocations: shoulder to shoulder｜肩并肩
tip_zh: 路肩也叫 shoulder。

meanings_zh: n. 观众；听众 | n. 读者群；受众
definition_en: people watching or listening | People who read or receive particular content
example1_en: The audience clapped after the show.
example2_en: Online platforms enable museums to reach a wider audience, including people who cannot visit their collections in person.
example2_zh: 网络平台使博物馆能够接触更广泛的受众，包括无法亲自参观馆藏的人。
collocations: a large audience｜众多观众 ; a target audience｜目标受众 ; reach a wider audience｜触达更广泛的受众 ; audience participation｜观众参与
tip_zh: 观众多用large audience，不用many audiences。

definition_en: every person
example1_en: Everyone in our class has a reading partner.
example1_zh: 我们班每个人都有阅读伙伴。
example2_en: A park that looks open to everyone may still be hard to reach for people who use wheelchairs.
example2_zh: 一座看起来对所有人开放的公园，对使用轮椅的人仍可能很难到达。
collocations: everyone else｜其他所有人
tip_zh: everyone 作主语时谓语用单数。

definition_en: not correct
example1_en: I put the wrong date on the form.
example1_zh: 我在表格上写错了日期。
example2_en: It is wrong to judge a school only by one test if many students arrive already behind.
example2_zh: 如果许多学生入学时已经落后，只用一次考试评价学校是不对的。
collocations: go wrong｜出毛病 ; be wrong with｜……有毛病
tip_zh: wrong 作副词较少；做错事常用 do wrong 或副词 wrongly。

definition_en: a sudden dangerous situation
example1_en: The number for an emergency is on the wall.
example2_en: An emergency plan that nobody has practised is only a piece of paper.
example2_zh: 没人演练过的应急方案只是一张纸。
collocations: in an emergency｜在紧急情况下 ; emergency exit｜紧急出口
tip_zh: emergency 可数。in case of emergency 是常见告示。

definition_en: to pull something along the ground
example1_en: Drag the chair; do not lift it alone.
example1_zh: 把椅子拖过去，不要一个人抬。
example2_en: Do not drag a bag across the wet lab floor.
example2_zh: 不要在湿的实验室地板上拖包。
collocations: drag sth away｜把某物拖走
tip_zh: drag 是普通动词。本条用搬东西的意思。

definition_en: the physical world, or a person's character
example1_en: We walked in nature after the rain.
example1_zh: 雨后我们在大自然里走了走。
example2_en: Protecting nature along a river also protects the drinking water of the next town.
example2_zh: 保护河边的自然，也保护下一个城镇的饮用水。
collocations: by nature｜本性上 ; in nature｜在自然界
tip_zh: nature 通常不可数。

definition_en: something difficult that needs to be dealt with
example1_en: The main problem is the noise from the road.
example1_zh: 主要问题是路上的噪音。
example2_en: A traffic problem will not disappear if a city only widens the same road again.
example2_zh: 如果一座城市只是再次拓宽同一条路，交通问题不会消失。
collocations: no problem｜没问题 ; solve a problem｜解决问题
tip_zh: problem 是可数名词。question 是提出的问题；problem 是需要解决的困难。

definition_en: the brother of a parent, or the husband of a parent's sister
example1_en: Her uncle will meet the bus.
example2_en: A form that says uncle should also leave space for another adult.
example2_zh: 写着叔叔的表格，也应当给另一位成年人留出位置。
collocations: uncle and aunt｜叔婶
tip_zh: uncle 可数。具体是叔、伯、舅还是姑父，要看家庭。

meanings_zh: v. 答复 | n. 答复
definition_en: to answer | an answer
example1_en: Please reply to the e-mail today.
example1_zh: 请今天回复这封电子邮件。
example2_en: A reply that arrives after the bus has left is too late.
example2_zh: 公交已经开走之后才到的答复太晚了。
collocations: reply to｜回复 ; in reply to｜作为对……的答复
tip_zh: reply to something。名词也是 reply。

definition_en: a thick liquid used for fuel or cooking
example1_en: The bus uses less oil after the new route.
example1_zh: 新线路之后这辆公交更省油。
example2_en: Dependence on oil makes a town's bus fares rise whenever the world price jumps.
example2_zh: 对石油的依赖会让城镇的公交票价在世界油价跳跃时上涨。
collocations: oil price｜油价
tip_zh: oil 通常不可数。

definition_en: not to succeed, or not to pass a test
example1_en: She did not fail the test.
example2_en: A plan can fail and still teach the class what to change next time.
example2_zh: 一个计划可以失败，同时仍然教会班级下次改什么。
collocations: fail to do｜未能做 ; fail an exam｜考试不及格
tip_zh: fail 后可接考试：fail the exam。未能做某事用 fail to do。名词 failure 已在本库。

definition_en: a digital versatile disc
example1_en: The DVD of the concert is in the library.
example1_zh: 音乐会的影碟在图书馆。
example2_en: A DVD still helps when the network cannot play the film.
example2_zh: 网络放不了这部影片时，影碟仍然有用。
collocations: a DVD of｜一张……影碟
tip_zh: DVD 是 digital versatile disc 的缩写。书写常用大写。

definition_en: a short part of a text, or a way through
example1_en: Read the passage, then name the source.
example1_zh: 读这段文字，然后写出来源。
example2_en: A passage to the clinic should not be blocked by furniture.
example2_zh: 去医务室的通道不应当被家具挡住。
collocations: a passage from｜选自……的一段
tip_zh: 阅读理解里的 passage 是文章节选。

meanings_zh: n. 钥匙；关键 | adj. 关键的
definition_en: a metal piece for a lock, or the most important thing | most important
example1_en: I left my key in the classroom.
example2_en: The key to a later school start is a bus timetable that changes with it.
example2_zh: 推迟上学时间的关键，是一份随之改变的公交时刻表。
collocations: the key to｜……的关键 ; key word｜关键词
tip_zh: the key to 后接名词或 doing，介词是 to。

definition_en: to say words, or to talk a language
example1_en: She can speak English and Chinese.
example2_en: Leaders who speak only to cameras miss the questions people ask at the bus stop.
example2_zh: 只对镜头说话的负责人，听不到人们在车站提出的问题。
collocations: speak to｜对……说 ; speak English｜说英语
tip_zh: 说某种语言用 speak，不说 say English。

meanings_zh: v. 出价；投标 | n. 出价；投标
definition_en: to offer a price | an offer of a price
example1_en: The firm will bid for the roof repair.
example1_zh: 这家公司将投标修屋顶。
example2_en: A bid that hides the fee is not a bid the school should accept.
example2_zh: 隐瞒费用的投标，不是学校该接受的投标。
collocations: bid for｜投标争取
tip_zh: bid 作名词是出价。告别也有 bid somebody goodbye，本条以出价为主。

definition_en: to make someone known, or to bring something in
example1_en: Please introduce the new student.
example2_en: Cities introduce a new bus only after they write the time.
example2_zh: 城市在写下时间之后才推出新公交。
collocations: introduce sb to｜把某人介绍给 ; introduce sth into｜把……引进
tip_zh: 名词 introduction 已在本库。introduce A to B。

meanings_zh: n. 攻击；发作 | v. 攻击
definition_en: a violent act, or a sudden illness | to try to hurt or criticise
example1_en: The article is an attack on the new plan, not a description of it.
example1_zh: 这篇文章是对新计划的抨击，不是对它的描述。
example2_en: A heart attack far from a clinic is more dangerous than the same illness near one.
example2_zh: 远离诊所的心脏病发作，比在诊所附近更危险。
collocations: heart attack｜心脏病发作 ; under attack｜受到攻击
tip_zh: attack 作动词直接接宾语，不加 to。

definition_en: to send out air, or to be moved by the wind
example1_en: The wind can blow the door shut.
example2_en: If the wind blows the sign down, the crossing is still there and still needs a light.
example2_zh: 如果风把牌子吹倒，路口还在，仍然需要一盏灯。
collocations: blow out｜吹灭 ; blow up｜爆炸；给……打气
tip_zh: blow 的过去式是 blew，过去分词是 blown。blow up 表示爆炸时，本库不写方法。

definition_en: not able to happen or be done
example1_en: It is impossible to finish this in one minute.
example1_zh: 一分钟内完成这件事是不可能的。
example2_en: A timetable that looks impossible on paper may still work if two classes share a room.
example2_zh: 纸上看起来不可能的课表，如果两个班共用一间教室，仍可能行得通。
collocations: impossible to do｜不可能做
tip_zh: 说 It is impossible to do，不说 somebody is impossible to do。

meanings_zh: n. 杂草 | v. 除草
definition_en: a wild plant growing where it is not wanted | to remove weeds
example1_en: The weed is by the path.
example2_en: A weed in the school garden is easier to pull when the soil is wet.
example2_zh: 土湿的时候，学校园子里的杂草更好拔。
collocations: a weed of｜一种杂草
tip_zh: weed 可数。作动词是除草。本条不写药剂。

definition_en: in front, or in the future
example1_en: The museum is just ahead.
example2_en: Planning ahead for a flood is cheaper than repairing the same street every year.
example2_zh: 提前为洪水做计划，比每年修补同一条街更省。
collocations: ahead of｜在……前面 ; go ahead｜前进；请吧
tip_zh: ahead 是副词，不直接接宾语；要接宾语用 ahead of。

definition_en: to free someone or something from a problem
example1_en: We need to get rid of the broken chairs.
example1_zh: 我们需要处理掉坏椅子。
example2_en: A town cannot get rid of a flood by painting the wall.
example2_zh: 一座城镇不能靠刷墙来摆脱洪水。
collocations: get rid of｜摆脱；扔掉
tip_zh: 最常见的搭配是 get rid of。rid 的过去式和过去分词是 rid。

definition_en: to look at and understand written words
example1_en: I read the notice twice to be sure.
example1_zh: 我把通知读了两遍以确认。
example2_en: Children who read with an adult at home often arrive at school ready to enjoy longer books.
example2_zh: 在家有成年人和他们一起阅读的孩子，上学时往往已经准备好享受更长的书。
collocations: read aloud｜朗读 ; read through｜通读
tip_zh: read 的过去式和过去分词与原形拼写相同，但读作 /red/。

meanings_zh: v. 旋转 | n. 旋转
definition_en: to turn round quickly | a fast turn
example1_en: The wheel began to spin.
example2_en: Do not spin the chair in a crowded lab.
example2_zh: 不要在拥挤的实验室里转动椅子。
collocations: spin around｜转身
tip_zh: spin 的过去式和过去分词是 spun。

meanings_zh: v. 注意到 | n. 通知；注意
definition_en: to become aware of something | a written announcement, or attention
example1_en: Did you notice the new timetable?
example2_en: Teachers notice when a usually loud student becomes quiet for several days.
example2_zh: 一个平时很闹的学生连续几天变安静时，老师会注意到。
collocations: notice board｜布告栏 ; take notice of｜留意
tip_zh: notice 后可接名词或 that 从句。布告栏上的那张纸也叫 notice。

definition_en: very likely
example1_en: She will probably arrive before eight.
example2_en: A town will probably lose young workers if the only jobs are in a city two hours away.
example2_zh: 如果仅有的工作在两小时外的城市，城镇很可能会失去年轻工人。
collocations: most probably｜最可能
tip_zh: probably 是副词；形容词是 probable。

definition_en: used to stress that something is true
example1_en: The lab is small indeed, but it is clean.
example1_zh: 实验室确实小，但很干净。
example2_en: The path is longer, and it is indeed safer when the main road is icy.
example2_zh: 这条路更长，主路结冰时它确实更安全。
collocations: very useful indeed｜确实很有用
tip_zh: indeed 用来加强已经说过的话，多放在形容词或句末。

meanings_zh: n. 运输；交通 | v. 运输
definition_en: the system or act of carrying people or goods | to carry people or goods
example1_en: Public transport stops at the gate.
example2_en: Transport for a school trip fails if the return time is not written down.
example2_zh: 如果没有写下返回时间，学校出行的交通就会出问题。
collocations: public transport｜公共交通 ; means of transport｜交通方式
tip_zh: 英式名词常重读在前，动词重读在后。美式拼写是 transportation，名词更常见。

definition_en: to work out a number
example1_en: Can you calculate the total cost?

meanings_zh: n. 测试；试验 | v. 测试
definition_en: an exam, or a trial | to check something
example1_en: We have a short test on Friday.
example2_en: A listening test taken in a noisy hall does not measure what students can hear in a quiet room.
example2_zh: 在嘈杂大厅里进行的听力测试，测不出学生在安静房间里能听见什么。
collocations: test paper｜试卷 ; pass a test｜通过测试
tip_zh: test 作动词是“测试”。

definition_en: a title used before a married woman's surname
example1_en: Mrs. Chen teaches Class 3 this term.
example2_en: On an official form, Mrs. shows a title, and it should match the name the family actually uses.
example2_zh: 在正式表格上，Mrs. 是称谓，应当和家里实际使用的姓名一致。
collocations: Mrs. Smith｜史密斯夫人
tip_zh: Mrs. 后接姓，用于已婚女性。Mr. 已在本库单独列出。

definition_en: air taken into or sent out of the lungs
example1_en: Take a breath before you answer.
example2_en: Bad air in a closed room takes the breath out of a long class.
example2_zh: 关着的房间里空气不好，会让一节长课喘不过气。
collocations: hold one breath｜屏住呼吸 ; out of breath｜上气不接下气
tip_zh: 动词是 breathe，已在本库，末尾有 e。名词 breath 没有 e。

definition_en: to succeed in dealing with a problem
example1_en: We can overcome the delay if the time is written.
example1_zh: 如果时间写下来，我们就能克服这次延误。
example2_en: Students overcome a hard text better when the source is named.
example2_zh: 写明来源时，学生更能读懂一篇难的课文。
collocations: overcome a difficulty｜克服困难
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词是 overcame、overcome。

meanings_zh: v. 落下；丢下；下降 | n. 滴；下降
definition_en: to fall, or to let something fall | a small amount of liquid, or a fall
example1_en: Do not drop litter in the corridor.
example2_en: If bus fares drop, more students can reach the school they were offered.
example2_zh: 如果公交票价下降，更多学生能到达录取他们的学校。
collocations: drop in｜顺便拜访 ; drop out｜退出
tip_zh: drop 可作及物或不及物动词。

meanings_zh: n. 状态；国家；州 | v. 陈述
definition_en: a condition, or a country or region | to say or write something clearly
example1_en: The classroom was in a tidy state after the meeting.
example2_en: A state that invests in rural schools narrows the gap between villages and big cities.
example2_zh: 投资乡村学校的国家，会缩小乡村与大城市之间的差距。
collocations: in a state of｜处于……状态 ; state-owned｜国有的
tip_zh: the United States 中的 state 是州；泛指国家时也可作 state。

definition_en: to help someone remember
example1_en: Remind me to lock the door.
example2_en: A sign can remind students of the bus, and a person still has to update it.
example2_zh: 牌子能提醒学生公交，仍然得有人去更新它。
collocations: remind sb to do｜提醒某人做 ; remind sb of｜使某人想起
tip_zh: remind somebody to do。不要和 remember 混淆：remember 是自己记得。

definition_en: to help something develop, to raise in rank, or to advertise
example1_en: The club promotes reading, not only scores.
example1_zh: 社团促进的是阅读，而不只是分数。
example2_en: A company may promote a drink at school only if the label is honest.
example2_zh: 公司只有在标签诚实时，才可以在学校推销一种饮料。
collocations: promote sb to｜提拔某人担任 ; promote growth｜促进增长
tip_zh: promote 可指促进、晋升或推销。名词是 promotion。

definition_en: the number 0
example1_en: The temperature fell to zero.
example2_en: A score of zero should start a conversation, not end a student.
example2_zh: 零分应当打开一次谈话，而不是结束一个学生。
collocations: zero degrees｜零度
tip_zh: zero 也可作名词。美式有时用 zero 表示没有，英式常用 nought 或 nil。

definition_en: of the body, or of physics
example1_en: Physical exercise is part of the school day.
example1_zh: 体育锻炼是上学日的一部分。
example2_en: Physical distance from a clinic becomes dangerous at night, when taxis are scarce.
example2_zh: 夜里出租车稀少时，离诊所的实际距离会变得危险。
collocations: physical education｜体育 ; physical health｜身体健康
tip_zh: physical 可指身体或物理。physics 是学科“物理”。

definition_en: one more time
example1_en: Please read the sentence again, more slowly.
example1_zh: 请再读一遍这个句子，慢一点。
example2_en: If the same street floods again, the town should stop calling it bad luck and fix the drains.
example2_zh: 如果同一条街再次积水，城镇就不该再称之为运气不好，而应修排水系统。
collocations: again and again｜一再 ; once again｜再次
tip_zh: again 不与 repeat 叠用；repeat 本身已有“再做一次”的意思。

definition_en: a tube that carries liquid or gas
example1_en: The pipe is leaking.
example2_en: A leaking pipe under the hall is a reason to call an adult.
example2_zh: 礼堂下面漏水的管子是叫成年人的理由。
collocations: a pipe of｜一根管子
tip_zh: pipe 也可指烟斗。本条以管子为主，不写如何使用。

meanings_zh: v. 分享；分担 | n. 一份；份额
definition_en: to use or have something with others | a part of something
example1_en: We share one microscope in the lab.
example1_zh: 实验室里我们共用一台显微镜。
example2_en: Neighbours who share tools spend less and throw fewer things away.
example2_zh: 共用工具的邻居花得更少，扔掉的东西也更少。
collocations: share sth with sb｜与某人分享 ; share in｜分担
tip_zh: share 可作及物动词，后面直接接宾语。

definition_en: a greeting
example1_en: Hello, is this the school office?
example2_en: A hello at the gate costs nothing and tells a new student they are in the right place.
example2_zh: 门口一声你好不花钱，也能告诉新生他们没走错。
collocations: say hello to｜向……问好
tip_zh: hello 用于见面或打电话。写信开头不用 hello 代替 Dear。

definition_en: related to medicine or treatment
example1_en: She hopes to do medical work in a village.
example1_zh: 她希望在乡村做医疗工作。
example2_en: Medical care that exists only in the city leaves village families travelling for hours.
example2_zh: 只存在于城市的医疗，会让乡村家庭赶几小时的路。
collocations: medical care｜医疗 ; medical examination｜体检
tip_zh: medical 是形容词；medicine 是名词“药”或“医学”。

definition_en: a person who prepares text for publication
example1_en: The editor checked every name.
example1_zh: 编辑核对了每一个名字。
example2_en: A school editor who fixes a wrong score before printing saves a week of apology.
example2_zh: 在付印前改掉错误分数的校刊编辑，能省下一周的道歉。
collocations: chief editor｜主编
tip_zh: edition 是版本，已在本库。editor 是做这件事的人。

meanings_zh: n. 延误 | v. 推迟；耽搁
definition_en: a time when something happens later than planned | to make something later
example1_en: The delay was twenty minutes.
example2_en: A delay should be written on the notice before parents leave work.
example2_zh: 延误应当在家长下班之前写到通知上。
collocations: without delay｜立即 ; a delay of｜延误了
tip_zh: delay 作动词是推迟。

definition_en: the freedom to do what you want, within the law
example1_en: The text discusses liberty and also the bus.
example1_zh: 课文讨论自由，也讨论公交。
example2_en: Liberty to speak still has a limit: no one may threaten a classmate.
example2_zh: 说话的自由仍有界限：谁也不能威胁同学。
collocations: liberty of｜……的自由
tip_zh: freedom 已在本库，更常用。liberty 更正式。

definition_en: to rest on a chair or the ground
example1_en: Please sit near the window if you need light.
example1_zh: 如果你需要光线，请坐在靠窗的地方。
example2_en: Students who sit in the same seat all term may never meet the classmates behind them.
example2_zh: 整个学期都坐同一座位的学生，可能始终认识不到身后的同学。
collocations: sit down｜坐下 ; sit an exam｜参加考试
tip_zh: sit 的过去式和过去分词都是 sat。坐下常用 sit down。

definition_en: a feeling of pleasure in what you or others have done
example1_en: She spoke with pride about the class garden.
example1_zh: 她自豪地谈起班级的园子。
example2_en: Pride in a score should still name who watered the garden.
example2_zh: 为分数自豪时，仍然应当说出是谁给园子浇的水。
collocations: take pride in｜以……为自豪 ; pride of｜……的骄傲
tip_zh: 形容词 proud 已在本库。take pride in doing。

meanings_zh: v. 穿过；交叉 | n. 十字；交叉 | adj. 生气的
definition_en: to go from one side to the other | a mark or a place where things meet | angry
example1_en: Cross the road at the lights.
example2_en: Children cross a busy road more safely when the light gives them enough time.
example2_zh: 当信号灯给足时间时，孩子过繁忙的马路会更安全。
collocations: cross out｜划掉
tip_zh: cross 是动词；across 是介词。

definition_en: a soft hat, or a cover
example1_en: He left his cap on the chair.
example1_zh: 他把帽子落在椅子上了。
example2_en: A bottle cap that is loose in the lab is a reason to stop.
example2_zh: 实验室里松了的瓶盖是停下来的理由。
collocations: a baseball cap｜棒球帽
tip_zh: cap 多指无檐或只有前面有檐的帽子。hat 通常更有边，本批另有词条。

meanings_zh: n. 灾难 | n. 彻底的失败；糟糕的事
definition_en: a sudden serious event causing harm | Something that goes extremely badly or fails completely.
example1_en: An earthquake is a natural disaster.
example2_en: Effective early warning systems can reduce the damage caused by natural disasters and help communities recover more quickly.
example2_zh: 有效的预警系统可以减少自然灾害造成的损失，并帮助社区更快恢复。
collocations: natural disaster｜自然灾害 ; disaster relief｜灾害救援 ; avert disaster｜避免灾难 ; a complete disaster｜彻底的失败
tip_zh: 也可夸张形容失败：The party was a disaster。

definition_en: a period in a process, or a platform for performers
example1_en: We are at the first stage of the project.
example1_zh: 我们处在项目的第一阶段。
example2_en: The stage of a plan that nobody checks is often the one that fails in the rain.
example2_zh: 计划中没人检查的那个阶段，往往是在雨里失败的阶段。
collocations: on the stage｜在舞台上 ; at this stage｜在这个阶段
tip_zh: stage 作动词是“上演”。

meanings_zh: n. 座位 | v. 使坐下；容纳
definition_en: a place to sit | to give someone a place to sit, or to have room for
example1_en: Is this seat free?
example2_en: A reserved seat on the bus matters for a student who cannot stand the whole way.
example2_zh: 公交上的预留座位，对不能全程站着的学生很重要。
collocations: take a seat｜坐下 ; book a seat｜订座
tip_zh: seat 作动词是“使就座”，如 seat 30 people。

definition_en: towards the front
example1_en: Please step forward when your name is called.
example1_zh: 叫到你的名字时请向前走。
example2_en: Looking forward without asking residents can put a new road through the only playground.
example2_zh: 不询问居民就向前规划，可能会让新路穿过唯一的操场。
collocations: look forward to｜期待 ; put forward｜提出
tip_zh: look forward to 后接名词或 doing。

definition_en: a small container for drinks, or a prize
example1_en: There is a cup of tea on the desk.
example2_en: Winning a cup brings a town one happy evening, not a clinic or a bus.
example2_zh: 赢得奖杯给城镇带来一个快乐的晚上，而不是诊所或公交。
collocations: a cup of｜一杯 ; World Cup｜世界杯
tip_zh: a cup of 后接不可数名词。

definition_en: a promise, or the time you give to something
example1_en: The club needs a commitment to lock the door.
example1_zh: 社团需要有人承诺锁门。
example2_en: A commitment to the late bus should be written, not only spoken.
example2_zh: 对晚班车的承诺应当写下来，而不只是说一说。
collocations: a commitment to｜对……的承诺
tip_zh: commitment 可数也可不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 电影；胶卷 | v. 拍摄
definition_en: a moving picture, or thin material for cameras | to record moving pictures
example1_en: We watched a short film about the town.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部关于这个城镇的短片。
example2_en: A film about a flood can move people, but it does not repair the broken drain.
example2_zh: 一部关于洪水的电影可以打动人，但修不好破损的排水管。
collocations: see a film｜看电影 ; film star｜电影明星
tip_zh: 英式常用 film，美式常用 movie。

definition_en: a dirty or untidy state
example1_en: The lab was a mess after the experiment.
example1_zh: 实验之后实验室一片凌乱。
example2_en: A mess in the hallway is a safety problem if bags block the door.
example2_zh: 如果包堵住了门，走廊里的凌乱就是安全问题。
collocations: in a mess｜杂乱 ; make a mess｜弄乱
tip_zh: mess 可数。make a mess of 表示把……搞糟。

definition_en: a standard, height, or rank
example1_en: Her reading level has improved this term.
example1_zh: 她的阅读水平这学期提高了。
example2_en: Noise levels beside a main road can be high enough to disturb an open classroom window.
example2_zh: 主干道旁的噪音水平可以高到打扰开着窗的教室。
collocations: sea level｜海平面 ; at a high level｜在高水平
tip_zh: level 作形容词是“平坦的”。

definition_en: later, after an event
example1_en: We cleaned the lab afterwards.
example1_zh: 后来我们打扫了实验室。
example2_en: Afterwards the notice was corrected, but the class had already left.
example2_zh: 后来通知改了，班级却已经走了。
collocations: shortly afterwards｜不久以后
tip_zh: afterwards 是副词。美式也作 afterward。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

definition_en: the United States, or the American continents
example1_en: She hopes to visit America after university.
example1_zh: 她希望大学毕业后去美国看看。
example2_en: News from America reaches a classroom in minutes, but students still need to ask who wrote it.
example2_zh: 来自美国的新闻几分钟就能进课堂，但学生仍要问是谁写的。
collocations: North America｜北美洲
tip_zh: 国家名 America 前通常不加 the；the United States 要加 the。

definition_en: a smaller road off a main one
example1_en: We took a side road to avoid the traffic.
example1_zh: 我们走了一条支路以避开车流。
example2_en: A side road without a pavement still forces children into the same space as cars.
example2_zh: 没有人行道的支路，仍然把孩子推进和汽车相同的空间。
collocations: side road｜支路
tip_zh: side road 是主路旁边的小路，不要和 roadside（路边）混用。

meanings_zh: adj. 空的 | v. 倒空
definition_en: with nothing inside | to remove everything from something
example1_en: The bottle was empty.
example2_en: An empty seat on the late bus is useless if the stop has no light.
example2_zh: 如果车站没有灯，晚班车上的空座也没用。
collocations: empty of｜没有
tip_zh: empty 作动词是倒空。

meanings_zh: v. 联系；结交 | n. 同事；伙伴
definition_en: to connect in the mind, or to spend time with | a partner or colleague
example1_en: Students associate the bell with the end of class.
example1_zh: 学生把铃声和下课联系在一起。
example2_en: Do not associate one late bus with every driver.
example2_zh: 不要把一趟晚班车和每一位司机联系在一起。
collocations: associate A with B｜把 A 与 B 联系起来
tip_zh: association 已在本库。associate 作名词是同事，重音常在后。

definition_en: in addition, or different
example1_en: Would anyone else like to speak?
example2_en: If the bus is full, students have little else to do but wait in the rain.
example2_zh: 如果公交满了，学生几乎只能在雨里等。
collocations: or else｜否则 ; something else｜别的东西
tip_zh: else 放在疑问词或不定代词后面：what else、someone else。

definition_en: to get money or respect by work
example1_en: She earns her bus fare at the weekend.
example2_en: A city earns trust when the flood plan is practised, not only printed.
example2_zh: 当防汛方案被演练而不只是被印刷时，城市才赢得信任。
collocations: earn a living｜谋生 ; earn money｜挣钱
tip_zh: earn 后接钱、生活或尊重。

definition_en: an unusual and exciting experience
example1_en: The trip was an adventure, and everyone came back.
example1_zh: 这次出行是一次奇遇，而且每个人都回来了。
example2_en: An adventure on the river still needs life jackets.
example2_zh: 河上的冒险仍然需要救生衣。
collocations: an adventure story｜冒险故事
tip_zh: adventure 可数。

definition_en: a strip worn around the waist, or a region
example1_en: The belt on the bag is loose.
example2_en: A green belt around the town keeps a path for walking.
example2_zh: 城镇周围的绿化带留出一条步行的路。
collocations: a belt of｜一条地带 ; seat belt｜安全带
tip_zh: seat belt 是安全带。

meanings_zh: n. 混凝土 | adj. 具体的
definition_en: a hard building material | definite and real, not only an idea
example1_en: The path is concrete, not soil.
example1_zh: 这条路是混凝土的，不是土的。
example2_en: A concrete plan names who locks the door.
example2_zh: 一个具体的计划会写明谁锁门。
collocations: concrete building｜混凝土建筑
tip_zh: concrete 作形容词是具体的，和抽象相对。

meanings_zh: n. 顶部；最高位置 | adj. 最高的
definition_en: the highest part or rank | highest in position or degree
example1_en: My name is at the top of the list.
example1_zh: 我的名字在名单最上面。
example2_en: Standing at the top of a test list does not show whether a student can work with other people.
example2_zh: 站在成绩榜顶端，并不能说明一个学生能否与他人合作。
collocations: on top of｜在……上面 ; top student｜优等生
tip_zh: top 作形容词表示“顶级的”：top speed。

meanings_zh: n. 面试；采访 | v. 采访；面试
definition_en: a formal meeting of questions | to ask someone questions in a formal meeting
example1_en: She has an interview at the library on Friday.
example1_zh: 她周五在图书馆有一场面试。
example2_en: An interview that only rewards confidence can miss a quiet student who knows the work.
example2_zh: 只奖励自信的面试，可能错过一个懂业务但安静的学生。
collocations: job interview｜求职面试 ; interview sb｜采访某人
tip_zh: interview 可作名词或动词。采访和面试是同一个词。

definition_en: almost the same
example1_en: The two maps are similar, but not the same.
example1_zh: 两张地图相似，但并不相同。
example2_en: Similar test scores can hide very different chances to study at home.
example2_zh: 相似的考分可能掩盖在家学习机会的巨大差别。
collocations: be similar to｜与……相似
tip_zh: similar to 后接比较对象，不用 with。

definition_en: all of something
example1_en: I spent the whole morning in the lab.
example1_zh: 我整个上午都在实验室。
example2_en: Protecting a whole river means caring for farms and factories, not only the city section.
example2_zh: 保护整条河意味着要管农场和工厂，而不只是城区那一段。
collocations: on the whole｜总的来说 ; the whole of｜全部
tip_zh: whole 前面通常有 the 或物主代词：the whole day。

meanings_zh: n. 想法；思想 | v. 认为（think 的过去式）
definition_en: an idea or the act of thinking | past form of think
example1_en: That is a thoughtful question.
example1_zh: 那是一个有想法的问题。
example2_en: A single thoughtless comment online can follow a student longer than the mistake that caused it.
example2_zh: 网上一句欠考虑的话，可能比引发它的那个错误跟随学生更久。
collocations: at the thought of｜一想到 ; deep in thought｜陷入沉思
tip_zh: thought 也是 think 的过去式和过去分词。

meanings_zh: v. 钦佩；羡慕 | v. 欣赏；赞赏
definition_en: to respect or look up to someone | To look at something with pleasure because it is attractive
example1_en: I admire her courage in difficult times.
example1_zh: 我钦佩她在困难时期的勇气。
example2_en: People often admire successful athletes for their determination, but consistent training is equally important.
example2_zh: 人们常因成功运动员的毅力而钦佩他们，但坚持训练同样重要。
collocations: admire someone for something｜因某事钦佩某人 ; greatly admire｜十分钦佩 ; admire the view｜欣赏风景
tip_zh: admire sb for sth：因某事钦佩某人。

meanings_zh: n. 条件；状况 | n. 条件；环境 | n. 疾病；健康问题
definition_en: a state or requirement | A requirement, or circumstances affecting life or activity | A medical problem affecting someone's health
example1_en: The road is in poor condition.
example2_en: Improving working conditions can increase employee satisfaction and reduce the number of people leaving their jobs.
example2_zh: 改善工作条件可以提高员工满意度，并减少离职人数。
collocations: in good condition｜状况良好 ; working conditions｜工作条件 ; on condition that｜条件是 ; medical condition｜疾病；健康问题
tip_zh: 表状态通常不可数；表工作、生活环境常用复数。

meanings_zh: adj. 紫色的 | n. 紫色
definition_en: of a colour between red and blue | the colour purple
example1_en: The jacket is purple.
example2_en: A purple poster is not a plan if the words are too small.
example2_zh: 如果字太小，紫色海报也不是方案。
collocations: purple and blue｜紫色和蓝色
tip_zh: purple 也可作名词。

definition_en: a container for liquids, usually glass or plastic
example1_en: Please return the bottle to the bin.
example2_en: A labelled bottle in the lab is safer than a faster experiment.
example2_zh: 实验室里贴了标签的瓶子，比做得更快的实验更安全。
collocations: a bottle of｜一瓶
tip_zh: bottle 可数。作动词是把……装瓶。

meanings_zh: adj. 分开的；单独的 | v. 分开；分离
definition_en: not joined, or different | to divide or keep apart
example1_en: Keep the broken glass in a separate box.
example1_zh: 把碎玻璃放在单独的盒子里。
example2_en: Separate queues for the bus stop a crowd from pushing the smallest students aside.
example2_zh: 分开排队能避免人群把最小的学生挤到一边。
collocations: separate from｜与……分开
tip_zh: 形容词常读 /ˈsepərət/，动词“分开”常读 /ˈsepəreɪt/。

definition_en: not mixed with anything else
example1_en: The lab uses pure water.
example2_en: Pure luck does not explain a result that the same class can repeat.
example2_zh: 同一个班能重复的结果，不能只用纯运气解释。
collocations: pure water｜纯净水
tip_zh: purely 表示完全地、仅仅。pure 不要和 poor 混淆。

definition_en: how heavy something is
example1_en: The bag is light in weight.
example2_en: The weight of a full schoolbag is a daily load, especially for younger children on a long walk.
example2_zh: 装满的书包的重量是每天的负担，尤其对走远路的年幼孩子。
collocations: lose weight｜减肥 ; body weight｜体重
tip_zh: weight 是名词；weigh 是动词“称重”。

definition_en: to hit, to attack suddenly, or to stop work in protest
example1_en: The bell will strike at eight.
example2_en: When bus drivers strike, the school needs a written way for students to get home.
example2_zh: 公交司机罢工时，学校需要一份书面办法让学生回家。
collocations: go on strike｜罢工 ; strike a match｜划火柴
tip_zh: strike 的过去式和过去分词一般是 struck。罢工用 go on strike。本条不写任何伤害方法。

definition_en: to take something that is not yours
example1_en: He did not steal the book; it was a loan.
example2_en: A school should not call a hungry child a thief for taking bread.
example2_zh: 学校不应当因为一个饥饿的孩子拿了面包就把他叫做小偷。
collocations: steal sth from｜从……偷
tip_zh: steal 的过去式是 stole，过去分词是 stolen。本条不写偷窃方法。

meanings_zh: v. 转动；变成 | n. 轮流；转弯
definition_en: to move around, or to become | a chance to do something, or a change of direction
example1_en: Turn left at the bookshop.
example2_en: Parks can turn a hot street into a place where people are willing to walk.
example2_zh: 公园能把一条炎热的街道变成人们愿意步行的地方。
collocations: turn on｜打开 ; turn off｜关掉 ; turn into｜变成 ; in turn｜轮流
tip_zh: turn 加形容词表示变化：turn green。开灯用 turn on，不是 open the light。

definition_en: one part or one item
example1_en: May I have a piece of paper?
example2_en: A piece of false news can travel farther than the correction that follows it.
example2_zh: 一条假消息可以比随后的更正传得更远。
collocations: a piece of｜一张；一块 ; piece by piece｜逐件
tip_zh: 不可数名词要说数量时常用 a piece of。

definition_en: what a person thinks
example1_en: In my opinion, the second answer is better.
example1_zh: 在我看来，第二个答案更好。
example2_en: Public opinion changes when people see the flooded street, not only the plan.
example2_zh: 当人们看到积水的街道而不只是方案时，舆论会改变。
collocations: in one's opinion｜依某人看 ; public opinion｜舆论
tip_zh: opinion 是可数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 粉红色的 | n. 粉红色
definition_en: of a pale red colour | a pale red colour
example1_en: The pink notice is the new one.
example2_en: Pink paper does not make a wrong time correct.
example2_zh: 粉纸不能把写错的时间变成对的。
collocations: in pink｜穿着粉红衣服
tip_zh: pink 也可作名词。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

definition_en: a period of teaching, or something learned from experience
example1_en: The next lesson is history.
example2_en: The lesson of the late bus is to write the return time on the same sheet.
example2_zh: 晚班车的教训是把返回时间写在同一张纸上。
collocations: a lesson in｜一节……课；一个教训 ; teach sb a lesson｜给某人一个教训
tip_zh: lesson 可数。teach somebody a lesson 有时语气是教训某人。

definition_en: on the outside
example1_en: The outer door is locked.
example2_en: The outer wall needs a light at the crossing.
example2_zh: 外墙在路口需要一盏灯。
collocations: outer space｜外层空间
tip_zh: outer 只作定语，放在名词前。

meanings_zh: adj. 合法的；法律的 | adj. 合法的；法律允许的
definition_en: allowed by law | Allowed by the law
example1_en: Is this action legal?
example2_en: Access to affordable legal services is essential for ensuring that disadvantaged citizens can defend their rights.
example2_zh: 让人们获得负担得起的法律服务，对保障弱势公民维护自身权利至关重要。
collocations: legal advice｜法律意见 ; legal action｜法律诉讼 ; legal rights｜法定权利 ; perfectly legal｜完全合法
tip_zh: legal可指“法律相关的”，不一定指“合法的”。

definition_en: a piece of land for flowers or vegetables
example1_en: The class grows tomatoes in the garden.
example1_zh: 班级在园子里种西红柿。
example2_en: A school garden teaches seasons only if someone is there to water it in August.
example2_zh: 学校的园子只有在八月仍有人浇水时，才能教给学生季节。
collocations: in the garden｜在花园里
tip_zh: garden 可指花园、菜园或果园。

meanings_zh: n. 病人 | adj. 耐心的
definition_en: a person receiving medical care | able to wait without getting angry
example1_en: The patient waited in the school clinic.
example2_en: A patient teacher gives a second explanation without making the class feel small.
example2_zh: 有耐心的老师会再讲一遍，而不让全班觉得难堪。
collocations: be patient with｜对……有耐心
tip_zh: patient 作名词是病人，作形容词是耐心的。

definition_en: a machine that can do tasks by itself
example1_en: The robot in the lab is switched off.
example1_zh: 实验室里的机器人关着。
example2_en: A robot that answers the phone is not a person who can change the bus time.
example2_zh: 接电话的机器人不是一个能改公交时间的人。
collocations: a robot of｜一个机器人
tip_zh: robot 可数。

definition_en: complete disorder
example1_en: The hall was chaos when the bell failed.
example1_zh: 铃坏了的时候礼堂一片混乱。
example2_en: Chaos at the gate is what you get when nobody writes the bus time.
example2_zh: 没人写公交时间时，门口就会乱。
collocations: in chaos｜处于混乱中
tip_zh: chaos 通常不可数。

definition_en: a person who leads
example1_en: The team leader explained the plan.
example2_en: A good leader asks who will be harmed before a new road is approved.
example2_zh: 好的领导者在批准新路之前会问谁将受到伤害。
collocations: team leader｜队长
tip_zh: leader 是人；leadership 是领导能力。

definition_en: happy about something
example1_en: The teacher was pleased with the map.
example1_zh: 老师对这张地图感到高兴。
example2_en: Parents are pleased when a late bus is explained.
example2_zh: 晚班车得到解释时，家长会高兴。
collocations: be pleased with｜对……满意 ; pleased to do｜乐意做
tip_zh: pleased 形容人。pleasing 形容事物。pleasure 已在本库。

definition_en: the point where something begins
example1_en: The origin of the word is on the last line.
example1_zh: 这个词的来源在最后一行。
example2_en: The origin of a flood is not only the rain; it is also the blocked drain.
example2_zh: 洪水的起因不只是雨，也包括堵住的排水口。
collocations: the origin of｜……的起源 ; country of origin｜原产国
tip_zh: origin 可数。original 是形容词“原来的；独创的”。

definition_en: most important
example1_en: The main entrance is on the left.
example2_en: The main reason for late arrivals is the bus, not a lack of interest in the first lesson.
example2_zh: 迟到的主要原因是公交，不是对第一节课缺乏兴趣。
collocations: main idea｜主旨 ; main road｜主干道
tip_zh: main 没有比较级。mainly 是副词“主要地”。

definition_en: a white substance used to flavour food
example1_en: There is too much salt in the soup.
example2_en: Salt on an icy step helps, and it also damages the plants beside it.
example2_zh: 结冰台阶上的盐有帮助，也会伤害旁边的植物。
collocations: a pinch of salt｜一撮盐
tip_zh: salt 通常不可数。take something with a pinch of salt 表示不完全相信。

definition_en: more than two but not many
example1_en: Several students stayed to tidy the lab.
example1_zh: 几个学生留下来收拾实验室。
example2_en: Several small parks can serve a neighbourhood better than one large park that is hard to reach.
example2_zh: 几个小公园服务一个社区，可能好过一座很难到达的大公园。
collocations: several times｜几次 ; several of｜……中的几个
tip_zh: several 后接可数名词复数。

meanings_zh: n. 牺牲 | v. 牺牲
definition_en: something valuable that you give up | to give something up
example1_en: Sleep should not be the sacrifice before an exam.
example2_en: A sacrifice of one lunch break can keep the library open.
example2_zh: 牺牲一次午休，可以让图书馆继续开着。
collocations: sacrifice of｜对……的牺牲 ; sacrifice sth for｜为……牺牲
tip_zh: sacrifice 作动词是牺牲。本条不写伤害自己或他人的做法。

meanings_zh: prep. 直到……为止 | conj. 直到
definition_en: up to a particular time | up to the time when
example1_en: The shop is open until nine.
example2_en: A library that stays open until the last bus can serve students who cannot study at home.
example2_zh: 开到末班车的图书馆，可以服务那些无法在家学习的学生。
collocations: not...until｜直到……才 ; until now｜直到现在
tip_zh: until 可作介词或连词。not...until 表示直到……才。

definition_en: with no sound, or not speaking
example1_en: The hall was silent after the question.
example1_zh: 问题之后礼堂一片寂静。
example2_en: A silent student is not the same as a student who agrees.
example2_zh: 沉默的学生不等于同意的学生。
collocations: keep silent｜保持沉默
tip_zh: 名词 silence 已在本库。silent 是形容词。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

definition_en: every one separately
example1_en: Each student has a different seat number.
example1_zh: 每个学生的座位号都不一样。
example2_en: Each small shop that closes on a high street takes away a place where neighbours used to talk.
example2_zh: 商业街上每关掉一家小店，就少了一个邻居们曾经聊天的地方。
collocations: each other｜互相 ; each of｜……中的每一个
tip_zh: each of 加复数名词时，谓语常用单数。

definition_en: a person who buys goods or services
example1_en: The customer asked for a receipt.
example2_en: A school shop should treat a student as a customer and still say no to a harmful product.
example2_zh: 学校小卖部应当把学生当顾客，同时仍然拒绝有害的商品。
collocations: customer service｜客户服务
tip_zh: customer 可数。买东西的人。client 更常指服务的委托人。

meanings_zh: adv. 以某种方式；不知怎么地
definition_en: in a way that is not known
example1_en: We somehow caught the last bus.
example1_zh: 我们不知怎么赶上了末班车。
example2_en: A plan that says somehow is not a plan; write the step.
example2_zh: 只说“想办法”的方案不是方案，把步骤写出来。
collocations: somehow or other｜以某种方式
tip_zh: somehow 是副词。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

definition_en: an emotion or a physical sense
example1_en: I had a feeling that the answer was wrong.
example1_zh: 我有一种感觉，这个答案是错的。
example2_en: A feeling of safety on the walk home depends on lights, not only on a low crime number.
example2_zh: 回家路上的安全感取决于灯光，而不只是一个很低的犯罪数字。
collocations: a feeling of｜一种……的感觉
tip_zh: feeling 是可数名词。

definition_en: ordinary, happening each day
example1_en: These are everyday words, not exam tricks.
example1_zh: 这些是日常用词，不是考试陷阱。
example2_en: Everyday help, such as holding a door, matters as much as a speech.
example2_zh: 扶门这样的日常帮助，和一篇讲话一样重要。
collocations: everyday life｜日常生活
tip_zh: everyday 是一个词，作形容词。every day 分开写是“每天”。表里这一行的音标是 everybody，本库不用。

definition_en: to bring things together
example1_en: Collect the forms before you leave.
example2_en: Cities collect the same plastic for years and still need a bin that is emptied.
example2_zh: 城市多年收集同一种塑料，仍然需要一个会被清空的桶。
collocations: collect stamps｜集邮 ; collect data｜收集数据
tip_zh: collection 已在本库。

meanings_zh: n. 魔法；魔力 | adj. 有魔力的
definition_en: a power that seems impossible, or a wonderful quality | having a mysterious or wonderful power
example1_en: The story uses magic to solve the problem.
example1_zh: 这个故事用魔法解决问题。
example2_en: There is no magic timetable that gives every child a quiet desk at home.
example2_zh: 没有一种神奇课表能让每个孩子家里都有一张安静的书桌。
collocations: as if by magic｜像变魔术一样
tip_zh: magic 也可作形容词：a magic trick。

definition_en: a person's mood or courage, or a non-physical being
example1_en: The team spirit was better after the talk.
example1_zh: 谈话之后团队精神更好了。
example2_en: School spirit is real when students help a classmate, not only when they shout at a match.
example2_zh: 当学生帮助同学，而不只是在比赛中呐喊时，学校精神才是真的。
collocations: team spirit｜团队精神 ; in high spirits｜情绪高
tip_zh: spirit 表示精神时常不可数。in high spirits 表示兴高采烈。

definition_en: a plan, or the way things are organized
example1_en: The arrangement is on the sheet.
example2_en: An arrangement for the late bus should name who locks the gate.
example2_zh: 晚班车的安排应当写明谁锁门。
collocations: make an arrangement｜做安排
tip_zh: 动词 arrange 已在本库。

definition_en: a subject of speech or writing
example1_en: The topic of the essay is water.
example2_en: A topic that ignores the bus will not interest the students who miss it.
example2_zh: 无视公交的题目，不会让那些赶不上车的学生感兴趣。
collocations: the topic of｜……的题目 ; on the topic of｜关于
tip_zh: topic 可数。

definition_en: very unpleasant or frightening
example1_en: The smell from the bin was horrible.
example2_en: A horrible score on one quiz is information, not the end of a student.
example2_zh: 一次小测的糟糕分数是信息，不是一个学生的终点。
collocations: a horrible mistake｜严重的错误
tip_zh: horrible 程度很强。不要用来嘲笑同学。

definition_en: a particular way of doing something
example1_en: The technique is explained on the board.
example2_en: A technique for checking a source is more useful than a longer essay with none.
example2_zh: 核对来源的方法，比一篇更长却没有来源的文章更有用。
collocations: a technique for｜做……的方法
tip_zh: technique 可数。technical 已在本库。表里这一行的音标是 technical，本库不用。

definition_en: a large amount of money or resources
example1_en: The town wealth is not only its shops.
example1_zh: 这座城镇的财富不只是它的商店。
example2_en: Wealth that never reaches the clinic is not shared.
example2_zh: 到不了诊所的财富，就不是被分享的。
collocations: a wealth of｜大量的
tip_zh: wealth 通常不可数。a wealth of 表示大量。

definition_en: more than usual
example1_en: I need extra time to check the answers.
example1_zh: 我需要额外的时间检查答案。
example2_en: Extra lanes do not cut traffic if they only invite more cars.
example2_zh: 如果额外的车道只是招来更多汽车，它们并不能减少交通。
collocations: extra time｜加时 ; an extra｜额外的一个
tip_zh: extra 可作形容词或名词。

definition_en: to put something down
example1_en: Lay the map on the desk.
example2_en: Workers lay a new path before the rainy season, not after the first flood.
example2_zh: 工人在雨季之前铺新路，而不是等第一次洪水之后。
collocations: lay the table｜摆餐具
tip_zh: lay 是及物动词，过去式和过去分词是 laid。lie（躺）的过去式才是 lay。lie 已在本库。

meanings_zh: v. 看待 | n. 尊重；问候
definition_en: to think of someone or something in a particular way | respect, or good wishes
example1_en: We regard the library as a public room.
example1_zh: 我们把图书馆看作公共房间。
example2_en: Do not regard a low score as the whole student.
example2_zh: 不要把一个低分看成整个学生。
collocations: regard sb as｜把某人看作 ; with regard to｜关于
tip_zh: regard 作名词常用复数 regards，表示问候。

definition_en: a wash in a bathtub, or the tub itself
example1_en: The bath is at the end of the hall.
example2_en: A hot bath is not a plan for a school; a working shower is.
example2_zh: 热水澡不是学校的方案；能用的淋浴才是。
collocations: have a bath｜洗澡 ; bath towel｜浴巾
tip_zh: 英式 have a bath 是盆浴。美式更常说 take a bath。bathroom 已在本库。

definition_en: unhappy
example1_en: She felt sad after the team lost.
example1_zh: 队伍输了之后她很难过。
example2_en: A sad ending in a film can still teach a class how a choice affects other people.
example2_zh: 电影里悲伤的结局，仍然可以教一个班：一个选择如何影响别人。
collocations: feel sad｜感到悲伤
tip_zh: sad 的名词是 sadness。不要说 a sad。

definition_en: in opposition to, or touching
example1_en: Our team will play against Class Three.
example2_en: Laws against litter only work when bins are near and people see that the rules apply to everyone.
example2_zh: 禁止乱扔垃圾的法律，只有在附近有垃圾桶、而且人人都受约束时才有效。
collocations: against the law｜违法 ; be against｜反对
tip_zh: against 是介词，后面接名词、代词或 doing。

definition_en: a very short time
example1_en: Wait a moment, please.
example2_en: The moment a rumour is shared, it is harder to replace it with a correction.
example2_zh: 谣言一经转发，就更难用更正来替换它。
collocations: at the moment｜此刻 ; in a moment｜立刻 ; the moment｜一……就
tip_zh: the moment 可引导时间从句，相当于 as soon as。

meanings_zh: n. 力量；权力；电力 | v. 驱动；供电
definition_en: strength, control, or electricity | to supply energy to a machine
example1_en: The storm cut the power for two hours.
example1_zh: 暴风雨导致停电两小时。
example2_en: The power to change a bus route should sit with people who actually ride it, not only with planners.
example2_zh: 更改公交线路的权力，应该掌握在真正乘坐它的人手里，而不只是规划者。
collocations: power station｜发电站 ; come to power｜上台 ; solar power｜太阳能
tip_zh: power 表示电力时不可数。作动词是“驱动”或“供电”。

definition_en: to get something
example1_en: You can obtain the form at the office.
example1_zh: 你可以在办公室拿到表格。
example2_en: Students obtain a seat on the late bus by arriving, not by a poster.
example2_zh: 学生得到晚班车的座位是靠来到，不是靠一张海报。
collocations: obtain sth from｜从……获得
tip_zh: obtain 比 get 正式。

definition_en: extremely good
example1_en: Her map was outstanding.
example2_en: An outstanding score does not replace the student who kept the lab tidy.
example2_zh: 出色的分数代替不了那个让实验室保持整洁的学生。
collocations: outstanding work｜出色的工作
tip_zh: outstanding 也可表示未支付的：outstanding fees。

definition_en: related to race
example1_en: Racial equality is the principle on the form.
example1_zh: 种族平等是表格上的原则。
example2_en: A racial joke is not a joke the class should keep.
example2_zh: 种族笑话不是班级该保留的笑话。
collocations: racial discrimination｜种族歧视
tip_zh: race 已在本库。说话时要尊重。

definition_en: a large container, or a military vehicle
example1_en: The water tank is on the roof.
example2_en: A history photo of a tank should stay a photo, not a set of instructions.
example2_zh: 历史照片里的坦克应当只是照片，而不是一套说明。
collocations: water tank｜水箱 ; a tank of｜一箱
tip_zh: tank 可指容器或坦克。本条不写军事操作。

definition_en: of the west
example1_en: We compared a western folk story with a Chinese one.
example1_zh: 我们把一个西方民间故事和中国故事做了比较。
example2_en: Western visitors may admire an old street and still miss the rents that local families pay.
example2_zh: 西方游客可能欣赏一条老街，却仍然看不到本地家庭支付的房租。
collocations: western countries｜西方国家
tip_zh: western 是形容词，通常不大写，除非是专名的一部分。

definition_en: an area with a particular use or feature
example1_en: This street is a quiet zone.
example2_en: A school zone with a lower speed limit only works if drivers can see the sign.
example2_zh: 学校区域的低速限制只有在司机看得见标志时才有效。
collocations: time zone｜时区 ; school zone｜学校区域
tip_zh: zone 强调按用途或特征划分的区域。表里这一行的音标是 zoo，本库不用。

meanings_zh: n. 铁；熨斗 | v. 熨烫
definition_en: a strong metal, or a tool for smoothing clothes | to smooth clothes with an iron
example1_en: The gate is iron and heavy.
example2_en: An iron in a dormitory needs a clear rule, or a small burn becomes a fire.
example2_zh: 宿舍里的熨斗需要明确规定，否则一小块烫痕会变成火灾。
collocations: iron ore｜铁矿 ; electric iron｜电熨斗
tip_zh: iron 作动词是熨烫。化学符号相关的“铁”不可数。

definition_en: a group effort for change, or the act of moving
example1_en: The movement to save the river started at school.
example1_zh: 拯救这条河的运动从学校开始。
example2_en: Free movement to a clinic matters when the only road floods.
example2_zh: 当唯一的路积水时，能自由前往诊所就很重要。
collocations: freedom of movement｜行动自由
tip_zh: movement 可指社会运动，也可指动作。

definition_en: separated by distance or into pieces
example1_en: The two labs are only a corridor apart.
example1_zh: 两间实验室只隔一条走廊。
example2_en: Apart from the price, the later bus is the one that working students can actually catch.
example2_zh: 除了价格，晚一班的公交才是打工的学生真正赶得上的。
collocations: apart from｜除……之外 ; fall apart｜破裂
tip_zh: apart from 表示除……之外。tell apart 表示区分。

definition_en: to one side
example1_en: She stepped aside to let the class pass.
example1_zh: 她站到一边让班级过去。
example2_en: Set aside ten minutes, or the notice will be written in a hurry.
example2_zh: 留出十分钟，否则通知会写得很匆忙。
collocations: aside from｜除……之外 ; set aside｜留出
tip_zh: aside from 与 besides 相近。put aside 是把东西放到一边。

meanings_zh: n. 专家 | adj. 专业的；熟练的
definition_en: a person with special skill | Having or showing great knowledge or skill.
example1_en: Ask an expert for advice.
example2_en: Schools should seek expert advice before introducing new technology into classrooms to support student learning.
example2_zh: 学校在将新技术引入课堂以辅助学生学习之前，应征求专家意见。
collocations: an expert on｜某方面的专家 ; expert advice｜专家建议 ; medical expert｜医学专家
tip_zh: expert on/in表示某领域的专家。

definition_en: something given, or a natural ability
example1_en: The book was a gift from her uncle.
example1_zh: 这本书是她叔叔送的礼物。
example2_en: A gift for music still needs practice if the student wants a place in the band.
example2_zh: 如果学生想在乐队里有位置，音乐天赋仍然需要练习。
collocations: a gift for｜……的天赋 ; gift shop｜礼品店
tip_zh: gift 可指礼物，也可指天赋。a gift for doing 表示有做某事的天分。

definition_en: a special event for a happy occasion
example1_en: The celebration is on Friday.
example2_en: A celebration that starts after the last bus has already chosen who can come.
example2_zh: 在末班车之后才开始的庆祝，其实已经选定了谁能来。
collocations: a celebration of｜对……的庆祝
tip_zh: 动词 celebrate 已在本库。

definition_en: one more, or a different one
example1_en: May I ask another question?
example1_zh: 我可以再问一个问题吗？
example2_en: Another heatwave will test whether the city's new shelters are more than a promise on paper.
example2_zh: 又一轮热浪将检验这座城市的新避暑点是否不只是纸上的承诺。
collocations: one another｜互相 ; another two｜另外两个
tip_zh: another 后接单数名词；“另外两个”可以说 another two days。

definition_en: a structure with a roof and walls
example1_en: The new building has a lift.
example2_en: An empty building in the town centre is a wasted chance to house a clinic or a library.
example2_zh: 镇中心的空楼是浪费，本可以用来做诊所或图书馆。
collocations: office building｜办公楼
tip_zh: building 是名词；build 是动词，过去式 built。

definition_en: possibly
example1_en: Perhaps we can finish before lunch.
example1_zh: 也许我们能在午饭前做完。
example2_en: Perhaps a later school start would help, but only if the buses change too.
example2_zh: 也许推迟上学时间会有帮助，但只有公交也改才行。
collocations: perhaps so｜也许如此
tip_zh: perhaps 比 maybe 稍正式，意思接近。

definition_en: a drawing that shows information
example1_en: The chart shows the bus times.
example2_en: A chart without a source is only a picture.
example2_zh: 没有来源的图表只是一张图。
collocations: a chart of｜……的图表
tip_zh: chart 可数。也可作动词“绘制”。

definition_en: a natural ability
example1_en: She has a talent for drawing maps.
example2_en: A talent for music still needs a room and an instrument the student can borrow.
example2_zh: 音乐天赋仍然需要一间房和一件学生能借到的乐器。
collocations: a talent for｜……的天赋
tip_zh: talent 可数也可不可数。have a talent for doing。

definition_en: to work for someone, or to give food
example1_en: They serve lunch from eleven to one.
example1_zh: 他们十一点到一点供应午餐。
example2_en: Libraries that serve small towns often share one librarian among several buildings.
example2_zh: 服务小城镇的图书馆，常常是几栋楼共用一位馆员。
collocations: serve as｜充当 ; serve sb｜为某人服务
tip_zh: serve 后直接接人或食物。It serves you right 表示活该，语气重。

definition_en: millimetre
example1_en: The line is 5 mm wide.
example2_en: A map that uses mm without a scale still leaves the reader guessing.
example2_zh: 不用比例尺却用毫米的地图，仍然让读者猜。
collocations: 5 mm｜5 毫米
tip_zh: mm 是 millimetre 的缩写。数字和 mm 之间通常留空格。

definition_en: a person who knows a lot about one subject
example1_en: The specialist checked the clock.
example2_en: A specialist who names no source is harder to trust.
example2_zh: 不写来源的专家更难信任。
collocations: a specialist in｜……方面的专家
tip_zh: special 已在本库。

definition_en: knowledge from careful study and experiment
example1_en: Science class is in the lab today.
example1_zh: 今天的科学课在实验室。
example2_en: Science can measure dirty air, but a city still has to decide what to do about it.
example2_zh: 科学可以测量脏空气，但城市仍要决定对此做什么。
collocations: science museum｜科学博物馆
tip_zh: science 作学科通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 点击 | n. 点击；咔哒声
definition_en: to press a mouse or a button | a short sound or one press
example1_en: Click the title to open the article.
example2_en: A design that needs three clicks to find the nurse's number wastes time in a real emergency.
example2_zh: 要点击三次才能找到校医电话的设计，会在真正的紧急情况里浪费时间。
collocations: click on｜点击
tip_zh: click 也可作名词，指咔哒声或一次点击。

definition_en: soft white frozen water | to fall as snow
example1_en: Snow closed the path for a day.
example2_en: A town that plans for snow keeps the school open when the main road is still white.
example2_zh: 为雪做准备的城镇，在大路还是白的时候也能让学校开门。
collocations: snow in｜被雪困住
tip_zh: snow 作名词通常不可数。作动词：It snows。

definition_en: to fail to remember
example1_en: Do not forget to write the date.
example2_en: Towns forget a flood until the same street fills again.
example2_zh: 城镇会忘记洪水，直到同一条街再次积水。
collocations: forget to do｜忘记去做 ; forget doing｜忘记做过
tip_zh: forget to do 是忘了要做；forget doing 是忘了做过。

meanings_zh: adj. 平的 | n. 公寓
definition_en: level, without bumps | a set of rooms for living in, on one floor
example1_en: The pitch is flat and dry.
example2_en: A flat battery in the school bus is a morning problem, not a surprise at the gate.
example2_zh: 校车电池没电是早晨就要处理的问题，不该到门口才发现。
collocations: a flat tyre｜瘪了的轮胎 ; fall flat｜未达到效果
tip_zh: 英式 flat 作名词是公寓，美式常用 apartment。

meanings_zh: adv. 最少；最不 | det. 最少的
definition_en: the smallest amount or degree | the smallest in amount
example1_en: This is the least difficult of the three questions.
example1_zh: 这是三道题里最不难的。
example2_en: The least expensive food is not always the one that keeps students awake through the afternoon.
example2_zh: 最便宜的食物不一定能让学生整个下午保持清醒。
collocations: at least｜至少 ; least of all｜最不
tip_zh: at least 表示至少；not in the least 表示一点也不。

meanings_zh: n. 奖；奖品 | v. 授予
definition_en: a prize given for achievement | to give a prize or a sum officially
example1_en: She won an award for the science poster.
example2_en: An award for perfect attendance can hide the student who was ill and still caught up.
example2_zh: 全勤奖可能掩盖那个生过病却仍然补上进度的学生。
collocations: win an award｜获奖 ; award sb sth｜授予某人某物
tip_zh: award 作动词是“授予”。不要和 reward（酬谢）搞混。

definition_en: belonging to a whole country
example1_en: The national museum is free on Wednesdays.
example2_en: A national exam should not ignore students whose schools lack labs and libraries.
example2_zh: 一场全国性考试不该忽略那些学校缺少实验室和图书馆的学生。
collocations: national flag｜国旗 ; national day｜国庆节
tip_zh: national 是形容词；国家用 nation 或 country。

definition_en: not ordinary
example1_en: Today is a special day for our school.
example1_zh: 今天对我们学校是特别的一天。
example2_en: A special bus for students works only if it arrives before the first lesson, not after.
example2_zh: 学生专车只有在第一节课前到达才有用，而不是课后。
collocations: special offer｜特价 ; nothing special｜没什么特别的
tip_zh: specially 强调专门地；especially 强调尤其。

definition_en: of a city
example1_en: Urban schools share one crowded bus stop.
example1_zh: 城市学校共用一个拥挤的公交站。
example2_en: Urban growth that ignores the river will meet the water in the streets.
example2_zh: 不顾河流的城市扩张，会在街上遇见那河水。
collocations: urban area｜市区
tip_zh: urban 的反义是 rural。不要和 suburb（郊区）混淆。

definition_en: without war or violence, or calm
example1_en: The hall was peaceful after the bell.
example2_en: A peaceful protest still needs a clear request.
example2_zh: 和平的诉求仍然需要一个清楚的要求。
collocations: a peaceful place｜平静的地方
tip_zh: peace 已在本库。

meanings_zh: n. 植物 | v. 种植
definition_en: a living thing that grows in soil or water | to put seeds or trees in the ground
example1_en: Each class looks after one plant in the hallway.
example1_zh: 每个班在走廊里照料一盆植物。
example2_en: Cities that plant trees along school roads give children shade on the walk home.
example2_zh: 在上学的路边种树的城市，让孩子放学路上有树荫。
collocations: plant trees｜种树 ; power plant｜发电厂
tip_zh: plant 作动词是种植。power plant 是发电厂，不是植物。

meanings_zh: v. 到达；够到 | n. 够到的范围
definition_en: to arrive at, or to touch by stretching | the distance one can stretch
example1_en: We reached the museum before it closed.
example1_zh: 我们在闭馆前到达了博物馆。
example2_en: A warning that does not reach homes without a phone signal arrives too late.
example2_zh: 到不了没有手机信号的家庭的警报，来得太晚。
collocations: reach for｜伸手去拿 ; out of reach｜够不着
tip_zh: reach 是及物动词，后面直接接地点，不加 to。

meanings_zh: v. 向…挑战 | v. 质疑；提出异议 | v. 向…挑战；考验
definition_en: to invite someone to compete or try hard | Question whether something is true, fair, or acceptable. | Invite someone to compete or test their abilities.
