example1_en: This puzzle will challenge your mind.
example1_zh: 这道谜题会挑战你的思维。
example2_en: Providing affordable housing remains a major challenge for cities experiencing rapid population growth and rising land prices.
example2_zh: 对于人口快速增长、地价不断上涨的城市而言，提供可负担住房仍是一项重大挑战。
collocations: face a challenge｜面临挑战 ; meet a challenge｜成功应对挑战 ; challenge an assumption｜质疑假设 ; challenge someone to a contest｜向某人发起比赛挑战
tip_zh: challenge作动词可直接接观点，表示质疑。

definition_en: newspapers, television, and the internet as a group
example1_en: Social media spread the news within an hour.
example1_zh: 社交媒体在一小时内传播了这条消息。
example2_en: The media can help a town prepare for a flood, or they can only arrive to film the damage.
example2_zh: 媒体可以帮助一个城镇为洪水做准备，也可以只在事后前来拍摄损失。
collocations: social media｜社交媒体 ; mass media｜大众媒体
tip_zh: media 是 medium 的复数，谓语常用复数。

definition_en: the flesh of animals used as food
example1_en: Some students do not eat meat.
example2_en: A menu that hides meat in the sauce is not a choice for those students.
example2_zh: 把肉藏在酱里的菜单，对那些学生来说不是选择。
collocations: meat and vegetables｜荤素
tip_zh: meat 通常不可数。鱼有时不叫 meat。

definition_en: the part of the body between the head and the shoulders
example1_en: She wore a scarf around her neck.
example2_en: Pain in the neck after a long exam is a reason to stand up, not to ignore it.
example2_zh: 长时间考试后脖子疼，是站起来的理由，不是置之不理。
collocations: neck of｜……的颈部
tip_zh: a pain in the neck 也可比喻讨厌的人或事，语气不礼貌。

definition_en: a soft piece of paper, or a group of cells
example1_en: Take a tissue for the lab.
example2_en: The word tissue in a health lesson means body tissue, not only paper.
example2_zh: 健康课里的 tissue 指身体组织，而不只是纸。
collocations: a box of tissues｜一盒纸巾 ; body tissue｜身体组织
tip_zh: 纸巾常用复数 tissues。本条不写实验步骤。

definition_en: something said or written clearly
example1_en: The school made a short statement.
example1_zh: 学校发表了一则简短声明。
example2_en: A public statement about a flood should say which roads are closed.
example2_zh: 关于洪水的公开声明应该说明哪些路封闭了。
collocations: make a statement｜发表声明
tip_zh: statement 是可数名词。

definition_en: a common green plant, or a lawn
example1_en: The grass is wet.
example2_en: Grass along the path needs less water than a lawn that must stay perfect.
example2_zh: 路边的草比必须保持完美的草坪更省水。
collocations: a blade of grass｜一片草叶
tip_zh: grass 通常不可数。

definition_en: to help someone learn
example1_en: She will teach us the song.
example2_en: Schools teach more than the exam list when they show how to check a source.
example2_zh: 当学校展示如何核对来源时，它们教的就不只是考试清单。
collocations: teach sb sth｜教某人某事 ; teach oneself｜自学
tip_zh: teach 的过去式和过去分词是 taught。teacher 已在本库。表里这一行的音标是 tea，本库不用。

definition_en: to hold and move something
example1_en: Can you carry this box to the lab?
example1_zh: 你能把这个箱子搬到实验室吗？
example2_en: Buses that cannot carry wheelchairs leave some students outside the trip they helped to plan.
example2_zh: 不能运送轮椅的公交，会把一些学生留在他们参与策划的出行之外。
collocations: carry out｜执行 ; carry on｜继续
tip_zh: carry 强调随身带着走。搬重物也可用 carry。

definition_en: the threads that grow on the head
example1_en: Tie your hair back in the lab.
example1_zh: 在实验室里把头发扎起来。
example2_en: Hair colour tells you nothing about whether a student can solve the problem.
example2_zh: 头发的颜色说明不了一个学生能否解出这道题。
collocations: hair cut｜理发
tip_zh: hair 通常不可数。一根头发用 a hair。

meanings_zh: adj. 绿色的 | n. 绿色
definition_en: of the colour of grass | the colour green
example1_en: The green bike is mine.
example1_zh: 那辆绿色自行车是我的。
example2_en: Green space near a school gives children somewhere to play that is not a car park.
example2_zh: 学校附近的绿地给孩子一个玩耍的地方，而不是停车场。
collocations: green tea｜绿茶
tip_zh: green 也可表示环保的：green energy。

meanings_zh: v. 称呼；打电话；呼唤 | n. 通话；呼唤
definition_en: to name, phone, or shout to someone | a phone conversation or a shout
example1_en: We call our teacher Mr. Chen.
example1_zh: 我们称呼老师为陈老师。
example2_en: Parents who call the school only after a problem appears miss the chance to help earlier.
example2_zh: 只在问题出现后才给学校打电话的家长，错过了更早帮忙的机会。
collocations: call on｜号召；拜访 ; call off｜取消 ; give sb a call｜给某人打电话
tip_zh: call sb sth 表示把某人称作……，中间不加 as。

definition_en: a food made from milk
example1_en: The sandwich has cheese in it.
example2_en: Cheese left out of the fridge is a small thing that can close a canteen for a day.
example2_zh: 没放进冰箱的奶酪是小事，却可以让食堂停一天。
collocations: a piece of cheese｜一块奶酪
tip_zh: cheese 作物质名词通常不可数。a cheese 可指一种或一块。

meanings_zh: n. 最小量；最低限度 | adj. 最低的；最小的
definition_en: the smallest amount allowed or possible | the smallest that is allowed
example1_en: The minimum age for the trip is twelve.
example1_zh: 这次出行的最低年龄是十二岁。
example2_en: A minimum of sleep is not a luxury if the first lesson starts at seven.
example2_zh: 如果第一节课七点开始，最低限度的睡眠就不是奢侈。
collocations: a minimum of｜至少 ; minimum wage｜最低工资
tip_zh: minimum 也可作形容词：the minimum score。反义是 maximum。

definition_en: a metal container for cooking
example1_en: The pan is still hot.
example2_en: A pan without a cover in the canteen spills more than it saves.
example2_zh: 食堂里没有盖的锅洒出来的比省下的多。
collocations: a frying pan｜煎锅
tip_zh: pan 可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 长的；长久的 | v. 渴望
definition_en: measuring a great length or time | to want something very much
example1_en: It was a long walk from the station.
example2_en: A long commute can take away the evening hours that students need for sleep and reading.
example2_zh: 漫长的通勤会占去学生需要用于睡觉和阅读的晚上时间。
collocations: before long｜不久 ; no longer｜不再 ; as long as｜只要
tip_zh: how long 询问时间或长度。long 作动词是“渴望”。

meanings_zh: n. 脚步；步骤 | v. 迈步
definition_en: a movement of the foot, or one stage of a process | to move the foot
example1_en: The first step is to read the question.
example2_en: The next step after a flood warning is a lit path to higher ground, not only a message.
example2_zh: 洪水警报之后的下一步是一条有灯的通往高地的路，而不只是一条信息。
collocations: step by step｜逐步 ; take steps｜采取措施
tip_zh: step 作动词是“迈步”。

definition_en: a part of a bird or plane used for flying
example1_en: The bird hurt one wing.
example2_en: The east wing of the school is colder because that wall faces the wind.
example2_zh: 教学楼东翼更冷，因为那面墙迎着风。
collocations: on the wing｜在飞行中
tip_zh: 建筑的侧翼也叫 wing。

definition_en: an occasion when people come together
example1_en: The meeting starts at two.
example2_en: A public meeting about a new road should happen before the machines arrive.
example2_zh: 关于新路的公开会议应该在机器到来之前举行。
collocations: have a meeting｜开会 ; meeting room｜会议室
tip_zh: meeting 是可数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 双的；两倍的 | v. 加倍
definition_en: twice as much, or made of two parts | to become twice as much
example1_en: We need a double check of the names.
example1_zh: 我们需要把名字再核对一遍。
example2_en: A double fare after dark makes the night bus too costly for the workers who need it most.
example2_zh: 天黑后的双倍票价，让最需要夜班公交的工人负担不起。
collocations: double the price｜两倍的价格
tip_zh: double 作动词是“加倍”。

definition_en: a human-made waterway
example1_en: The path follows the canal.
example2_en: A canal without a rail is not a safe walk to school.
example2_zh: 没有栏杆的运河不是安全的上学路。
collocations: a canal of｜一条运河
tip_zh: canal 可数。

definition_en: a place for money, or the side of a river
example1_en: The bank is next to the post office.
example2_en: Houses on the bank of a river are cheap until the water reaches the door.
example2_zh: 河边的房子在水漫到门口之前显得便宜。
collocations: bank account｜银行账户 ; river bank｜河岸
tip_zh: bank 的两个常见义是银行和岸，要看搭配。

definition_en: animals and plants living in natural conditions
example1_en: The park protects wildlife.
example1_zh: 这个公园保护野生动物。
example2_en: Wildlife near a school needs a path that is not a road.
example2_zh: 学校附近的野生动物需要一条不是马路的小路。
collocations: wildlife park｜野生动物园
tip_zh: wildlife 通常不可数。

definition_en: the front of the body between the neck and the stomach, or a large box
example1_en: The pain is in his chest, so call the clinic.
example1_zh: 他胸口疼，所以去叫医务室。
example2_en: A chest of old maps can teach a town where the river used to run.
example2_zh: 一箱旧地图能告诉一座城镇河曾经从哪里流过。
collocations: chest of drawers｜五斗橱
tip_zh: 胸口和箱子是同一个词，要看语境。胸口疼应当告诉成年人或医务室。

definition_en: one of two children born at the same time
example1_en: Her twin sits in the next class.
example1_zh: 她的双胞胎兄弟姐妹坐在隔壁班。
example2_en: A form should leave space for a twin, not assume one child.
example2_zh: 表格应当给双胞胎留出位置，而不假定只有一个孩子。
collocations: a twin of｜……的双胞胎
tip_zh: twin 可数。表里这一行的音标是 twist，本库不用。

definition_en: almost not
example1_en: I can hardly hear the bell from here.
example1_zh: 我在这里几乎听不见铃。
example2_en: A rule that students can hardly read is not a rule they can follow.
example2_zh: 学生几乎读不懂的规定，不是他们能遵守的规定。
collocations: hardly ever｜几乎从不 ; hardly any｜几乎没有
tip_zh: hardly 已含否定，不要再加 not。它放在实义动词前、助动词后。不要和 hard（努力地）混淆。

definition_en: from one side to the other, or by means of
example1_en: We walked through the market on the way home.
example1_zh: 我们回家时穿过了市场。
example2_en: Students learn more through explaining an idea than through reading the same note again.
example2_zh: 学生通过讲解一个想法学到的，往往多于把同一条笔记再读一遍。
collocations: go through｜经历；检查 ; all through｜贯穿
tip_zh: through 强调从内部穿过；across 强调从表面一边到另一边。

definition_en: the state of being safe
example1_en: Road safety is part of the first lesson.
example1_zh: 交通安全是第一课的一部分。
example2_en: Safety on the walk home depends on lights and pavements, not only on advice.
example2_zh: 回家路上的安全取决于灯和人行道，而不只是劝告。
collocations: for safety｜为了安全 ; safety rules｜安全规则
tip_zh: safety 是名词，不可数。

definition_en: a senior member of a government
example1_en: The education minister visited the school.
example1_zh: 教育部长参观了这所学校。
example2_en: A minister who never rides the bus may not see why the last service matters.
example2_zh: 从不坐公交的部长，可能看不到为什么末班车重要。
collocations: prime minister｜首相
tip_zh: minister 也可指牧师，考纲里更常见的是政府部长。

definition_en: the activity of using one's mind
example1_en: Critical thinking is part of the history course.
example1_zh: 批判性思考是历史课的一部分。
example2_en: Quick thinking on social media is not the same as careful thinking about a source.
example2_zh: 社交媒体上的快速思考，不等于对来源的仔细思考。
collocations: way of thinking｜思维方式
tip_zh: thinking 是 think 的 -ing，也可作名词。

definition_en: legally acceptable, or based on good reason
example1_en: The ticket is valid until Friday.
example2_en: A valid reason for a late bus is a written fault, not a guess.
example2_zh: 晚班车的合理理由是写下来的故障，不是猜测。
collocations: valid for｜对……有效
tip_zh: valid 可指证件有效，也可指理由站得住。

meanings_zh: n. 计划 | v. 计划
definition_en: an idea for what to do | to decide what to do
example1_en: Our plan is to finish the poster today.
example1_zh: 我们的计划是今天完成海报。
example2_en: A flood plan that exists only on paper will fail the first night the river rises.
example2_zh: 只存在于纸上的防汛计划，会在河水上涨的第一个夜里失败。
collocations: plan to do｜计划做 ; make a plan｜制定计划
tip_zh: plan 作动词后接 to do，不接 doing。

meanings_zh: n. 麻烦；问题 | v. 使烦恼；麻烦
definition_en: difficulty or worry | to make someone worried or to disturb them
example1_en: We had trouble finding the right room.
example1_zh: 我们费了劲才找到那间教室。
example2_en: Asking for help early can keep a small trouble from becoming a missed exam.
example2_zh: 早点求助，可以避免一个小麻烦变成一场错过的考试。
collocations: in trouble｜处于困境 ; have trouble doing｜做某事有困难
tip_zh: have trouble doing 不说 have trouble to do。

definition_en: a public show of objects
example1_en: The exhibition is free on Sunday.
example2_en: An exhibition that closes before the last bus has already chosen its visitors.
example2_zh: 在末班车之前就关门的展览，其实已经选定了观众。
collocations: an exhibition of｜……的展览
tip_zh: exhibition 可数。

meanings_zh: n. 困难 | n. 难题；困境
definition_en: a problem | A problem that makes progress or success harder.
example1_en: She overcame great difficulty to succeed.
example1_zh: 她克服巨大困难获得成功。
example2_en: Students with limited internet access may have difficulty completing assignments that require extensive online research.
example2_zh: 网络使用受限的学生可能难以完成需要大量网上研究的作业。
collocations: have difficulty doing something｜做某事有困难 ; overcome difficulties｜克服困难 ; financial difficulties｜经济困难 ; with difficulty｜费力地
tip_zh: 用have difficulty doing，不用difficulty to do。

meanings_zh: n. 蒸汽 | v. 蒸；冒热气
definition_en: the gas from boiling water | to cook with steam, or to give off steam
example1_en: Steam rose from the pot.
example2_en: Steam in a closed kitchen is a reason to open a window.
example2_zh: 关着的厨房里的蒸汽，是打开窗户的理由。
collocations: steam engine｜蒸汽机
tip_zh: steam 通常不可数。作动词是蒸或冒热气。

definition_en: not in danger
example1_en: Is the bridge safe after the rain?
example2_en: A street is not safe for children if cars park on the only pavement.
example2_zh: 如果汽车停在唯一的人行道上，这条街对孩子就不安全。
collocations: safe and sound｜安然无恙 ; keep safe｜保持安全
tip_zh: safe 是形容词；safety 是名词。

definition_en: causing laughter, or strange
example1_en: The story was funny, and we still learned the word.
example1_zh: 故事很滑稽，我们仍然学会了那个词。
example2_en: It is funny that a town boasts of a new mall while its oldest school still leaks.
example2_zh: 一座城镇吹嘘新商场，而最老的学校仍在漏雨，这很奇怪。
collocations: funny story｜滑稽的故事
tip_zh: funny 是“滑稽的”或“奇怪的”；fun 是名词“乐趣”。

definition_en: the way someone acts; British spelling
example1_en: The behaviour in the hall was calm.
example2_en: Fair rules look at behaviour, not at who arrived in a quiet car.
example2_zh: 公平的规定看行为，而不是看谁坐着安静的车来的。
collocations: good behaviour｜良好行为
tip_zh: behaviour 是英式，behavior 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留。通常不可数。

definition_en: happening most often
example1_en: She took the usual bus.
example2_en: The usual route fails on the day the bridge closes, so the notice must say the other way.
example2_zh: 桥关闭的那天平时的路线走不通，所以通知必须写出另一条路。
collocations: as usual｜照例
tip_zh: as usual 表示和往常一样。usually 是副词。

definition_en: a planned way of doing something
example1_en: This method makes the experiment clearer.
example1_zh: 这个方法让实验更清楚。
example2_en: A teaching method that works in a small class may fail when forty students share one room.
example2_zh: 小班有效的教学方法，在四十个学生共用一间教室时可能失败。
collocations: a method of｜……的方法 ; teaching method｜教学法
tip_zh: method 后接 of doing 或 for doing。

meanings_zh: v. 支付；付出 | n. 工资
definition_en: to give money for something | money received for work
example1_en: I paid for the tickets online.
example2_en: Families who pay a large share of their income for rent have less left for books and clinics.
example2_zh: 把收入的很大一部分用来付房租的家庭，留给书和看病的钱就更少。
collocations: pay for｜为……付款 ; pay attention to｜注意 ; pay off｜还清；得到回报
tip_zh: pay 的过去式和过去分词是 paid。人作主语：sb pays for sth。

meanings_zh: n. 广场 | adj. 方形的；平方的
definition_en: an open public place in a town | having four equal sides, or multiplied by itself
example1_en: We met in the square outside the museum.
example1_zh: 我们在博物馆外的广场见面。
example2_en: A town square that bans bikes may feel tidy and still be harder for students to reach.
example2_zh: 禁止自行车的城镇广场也许看起来整齐，学生却更难到达。
collocations: public square｜广场 ; square metre｜平方米
tip_zh: square 作形容词是方形的，也可指数学上的平方。

definition_en: having lived long, or not new
example1_en: This is an old map, but the river is the same.
example1_zh: 这是一张旧地图，但那条河还是一样的。
example2_en: Old buildings can teach a city what to keep when everything else is being rebuilt.
example2_zh: 当其他一切都在重建时，老建筑可以告诉一座城市该保留什么。
collocations: years old｜……岁 ; as old as｜和……一样老
tip_zh: 表示年龄用数字加 years old。兄姐用 elder 或 older 都可以。

definition_en: the lowest part
example1_en: The key is at the bottom of the bag.
example2_en: Notes at the bottom of a chart often explain the number that the headline left out.
example2_zh: 图表底部的注释，常常解释标题没写的那个数字。
collocations: at the bottom of｜在……底部
tip_zh: bottom 是最下面。from the bottom of one's heart 表示衷心。

meanings_zh: n. 错误 | v. 弄错
definition_en: something done wrongly | to be wrong about something
example1_en: I made a mistake in the date.
example2_en: A mistake in the bus time should be corrected before parents leave work to meet it.
example2_zh: 公交时间的错误应当在家长下班来接之前改掉。
collocations: by mistake｜错误地 ; make a mistake｜犯错
tip_zh: by mistake 表示无意中做错。过去式 mistook，过去分词 mistaken。

definition_en: to say or do again
example1_en: Please repeat the time.
example2_en: Teachers repeat a warning when the first one was on a poster nobody could see.
example2_zh: 当第一次警告写在没人看得见的海报上时，老师会再讲一遍。
collocations: repeat sth｜重复
tip_zh: repeat 后直接接内容，不说 repeat again 除非强调又一次。

meanings_zh: v. 欢迎 | adj. 受欢迎的 | n. 欢迎
definition_en: to greet someone in a friendly way | gladly received | a friendly greeting
example1_en: We welcome new students on the first day.
example1_zh: 我们在第一天欢迎新生。
example2_en: A town should welcome questions about a new road before the machines arrive.
example2_zh: 在机器到来之前，城镇应该欢迎关于新路的提问。
collocations: welcome to｜欢迎来到 ; be welcome｜受欢迎
tip_zh: welcome 作形容词是“受欢迎的”：You are welcome。

definition_en: to answer or react
example1_en: Please respond to the e-mail today.
example1_zh: 请今天回复这封电子邮件。
example2_en: Schools should respond to a broken step before they respond to a complaint about paint.
example2_zh: 学校应当先回应坏掉的台阶，再回应关于油漆的投诉。
collocations: respond to｜回应
tip_zh: respond to something。表里这一行的音标是 respect，本库不用。

definition_en: a shared decision, or the state of agreeing
example1_en: The two classes reached an agreement about the hall.
example1_zh: 两个班就礼堂的使用达成了协议。
example2_en: An agreement on water use fails if nobody writes down who may pump on a dry day.
example2_zh: 如果没人写下干旱日谁可以抽水，用水协议就会失败。
collocations: reach an agreement｜达成协议 ; in agreement｜意见一致
tip_zh: 达成协议用 reach 或 come to an agreement。

definition_en: a period of seven days
example1_en: We have a test next week.
example2_en: A four-day school week may cut costs, but it can also lengthen each remaining day beyond what children can manage.
example2_zh: 每周上四天课也许能省钱，但也可能把剩下的每天拉长到孩子承受不了。
collocations: next week｜下周 ; once a week｜每周一次
tip_zh: next week 前不加 the。

definition_en: a set of connected people, computers, or routes
example1_en: The bus network does not reach our village.
example1_zh: 公交网络到不了我们村。
example2_en: A phone network that fails in a storm leaves the people who need a warning without one.
example2_zh: 在风暴中失灵的电话网络，会让最需要警报的人收不到警报。
collocations: network of｜……的网络
tip_zh: network 可指计算机网络，也可指交通或人际网络。

meanings_zh: v. 包含 | v. 控制；遏制
definition_en: to have inside | to prevent something from spreading or becoming stronger
example1_en: This box may contain old letters.
example1_zh: 这个盒子里可能装有旧信。
example2_en: Processed foods often contain large amounts of salt, which can contribute to serious health problems.
example2_zh: 加工食品往往含有大量盐分，可能导致严重的健康问题。
collocations: contain ingredients｜含有成分 ; contain the spread｜遏制蔓延 ; contain costs｜控制成本 ; contain your excitement｜抑制兴奋
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接宾语；表示“含有”时通常不用进行时。

meanings_zh: n. 惊慌 | v. 惊慌
definition_en: a sudden feeling of fear | to feel sudden fear
example1_en: There was no need to panic.
example2_en: A clear alarm prevents panic better than a shout.
example2_zh: 清楚的警报比一声喊叫更能避免惊慌。
collocations: in panic｜惊慌地
tip_zh: panic 作动词是惊慌。过去式 panicked。本条不写制造恐慌的做法。

definition_en: difficult, or strong and not easily broken
example1_en: The first chapter is tough, but it gets clearer.
example1_zh: 第一章很难，但后面会清楚些。
example2_en: A tough timetable is fairer when every class, not only the top set, can use the lab.
example2_zh: 艰难的课表若让每个班而不只是尖子班都能用实验室，就更公平。
collocations: a tough question｜难题
tip_zh: tough 可形容任务难，也可形容人或材料结实。表里音标是 totally，本库不用。

definition_en: very bad or strict
example1_en: The storm caused severe damage.
example1_zh: 暴风雨造成了严重损失。
example2_en: Severe rules without an explanation teach fear more than safety.
example2_zh: 没有解释的严厉规定，教给人们的是害怕多于安全。
collocations: severe pain｜剧痛 ; severe weather｜恶劣天气
tip_zh: severe 比 serious 语气更强。

definition_en: before noon
example1_en: The reading room opens at 7 a.m.
example2_en: Starting lessons at 7 a.m. may suit adults, but many teenagers are still at their sleepiest then.
example2_zh: 早上七点上课也许适合成年人，但许多青少年那时仍处于最困的时候。
collocations: 7 a.m.｜早上七点
tip_zh: a.m. 表示午夜到中午；书写时数字与 a.m. 之间留空格。

definition_en: an informal hello
example1_en: She said hi to the new student.
example2_en: A friendly hi at the gate does not replace a safe road, but it can make the first day easier.
example2_zh: 门口一声友好的嗨替代不了安全的路，但能让第一天容易些。
collocations: say hi｜打招呼
tip_zh: hi 比 hello 更随意，正式场合少用。

definition_en: a set of beliefs in a god or gods
example1_en: The class studies religion as history, not as a test of faith.
example1_zh: 这个班把宗教当历史来学，而不是信仰测验。
example2_en: A public school can explain a religion without telling students to join it.
example2_zh: 公立学校可以讲解一种宗教，而不要求学生加入。
collocations: freedom of religion｜宗教自由
tip_zh: 形容词 religious 已在本库。

definition_en: a talk in which people share opinions
example1_en: The discussion lasted twenty minutes.
example2_en: A discussion about the bus route should include the students who miss it.
example2_zh: 关于公交路线的讨论应当包括那些赶不上车的学生。
collocations: under discussion｜在讨论中 ; a discussion about｜关于……的讨论
tip_zh: 动词是 discuss，已在本库。discuss 后不加 about，名词 discussion 后常用 about 或 of。

definition_en: a marriage ceremony
example1_en: The wedding is in the town hall.
example2_en: A school should not assume every family celebrates a wedding in the same way.
example2_zh: 学校不应当假定每个家庭都以同样的方式庆祝婚礼。
collocations: wedding ring｜结婚戒指
tip_zh: wedding 是仪式。婚姻关系用 marriage。

definition_en: a thin string of cotton or similar material | to put thread through
example1_en: The button needs a stronger thread.
example1_zh: 这颗扣子需要更结实的线。
example2_en: A thread of the story is the late bus, not the joke.
example2_zh: 故事的一条线索是晚班车，不是那个笑话。
collocations: a thread of｜一条线；一缕
tip_zh: thread 也可比喻线索。作动词是穿线。

definition_en: the act of finding something, or the thing found
example1_en: The discovery is explained in the last chapter.
example1_zh: 这个发现在最后一章说明。
example2_en: A discovery in the lab is useful only when the notes can be read by the next class.
example2_zh: 实验室里的发现，只有在下一班能读懂笔记时才有用。
collocations: a discovery of｜对……的发现
tip_zh: 动词 discover 已在本库。discovery 可数。

definition_en: the red liquid in the body
example1_en: The nurse stopped the blood with a clean cloth.
example1_zh: 护士用干净的布止住了血。
example2_en: Loss of blood is one reason a village clinic must be close, not an hour away.
example2_zh: 失血是乡村诊所必须在近处、而不是一小时之外的原因之一。
collocations: blood pressure｜血压
tip_zh: blood 不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 过程 | v. 加工；处理
definition_en: a series of actions | to treat or deal with something in stages
example1_en: Learning a word is a slow process.
example1_zh: 学会一个词是一个缓慢的过程。
example2_en: The process of cleaning a river includes factories upstream, not only the park in the city.
example2_zh: 清理一条河的过程包括上游的工厂，而不只是城里的公园。
collocations: in the process of｜在……过程中
tip_zh: process 作动词是“加工、处理”，名词重音常在前，动词重音可在后。

definition_en: films, music, and other things people enjoy
example1_en: The entertainment starts after the speeches.
example1_zh: 娱乐节目在讲话之后开始。
example2_en: Free entertainment in the square still needs a toilet and a way home.
example2_zh: 广场上的免费娱乐仍然需要厕所和回家的办法。
collocations: entertainment industry｜娱乐业
tip_zh: entertainment 通常不可数。具体一场节目有时可用 an entertainment。

definition_en: parents and children, or relatives
example1_en: My family has dinner together on Sundays.
example1_zh: 我们家周日一起吃晚饭。
example2_en: When housing is too expensive, a family may spend so much on rent that little remains for books or clinics.
example2_zh: 当住房太贵时，一个家庭可能把太多钱花在房租上，书籍和看病就所剩无几。
collocations: family name｜姓 ; family member｜家庭成员
tip_zh: family 作整体时谓语用单数；强调家庭成员时有时用复数。

meanings_zh: v. 想知道；感到惊讶 | n. 惊奇；奇迹
definition_en: to want to know, or to feel surprise | a feeling of surprise, or something wonderful
example1_en: I wonder whether the museum is open.
example1_zh: 我想知道博物馆是否开着。
example2_en: Residents wonder why a new mall was finished before the leaking school roof.
example2_zh: 居民想知道为什么新商场比漏雨的校舍屋顶先完工。
collocations: wonder if｜想知道是否 ; no wonder｜难怪
tip_zh: wonder 后常接 if 或 whether。

definition_en: something added, or the process of adding
example1_en: The new lab is a useful addition to the school.
example1_zh: 新实验室是学校有用的增添。
example2_en: In addition to more roads, the town needs pavements if children are to walk safely.
example2_zh: 除了更多的路，如果孩子要安全走路，城镇还需要人行道。
collocations: in addition｜另外 ; in addition to｜除……之外
tip_zh: in addition to 后接名词或 doing。

meanings_zh: v. 递送；发表 | v. 发表；讲授 | v. 兑现；实现
definition_en: to take to a place; to give a speech | to give a speech, lecture, or presentation | to produce the results or benefits that were promised
example1_en: The post office will deliver the package.
example2_en: Public transport projects must deliver clear benefits to local residents if they are to justify substantial investment.
example2_zh: 公共交通项目必须为当地居民带来明确的益处，才能证明大规模投资是合理的。
collocations: deliver a parcel｜递送包裹 ; deliver a speech｜发表演讲 ; deliver results｜取得成效 ; deliver on a promise｜兑现承诺
tip_zh: 递送用deliver sth to sb；兑现承诺可用deliver on。

meanings_zh: v. 憎恨；讨厌 | n. 憎恨
definition_en: to dislike very strongly | a strong dislike
example1_en: I hate waiting in the rain.
example2_en: People hate a rule they do not understand more than a rule that is strict but clear.
example2_zh: 人们对不理解的规则的反感，超过对严格但清楚的规则。
collocations: hate doing｜讨厌做
tip_zh: hate 后接 doing 或 to do。

meanings_zh: n. 人群 | v. 挤满
definition_en: a large group of people in one place | to fill a place
example1_en: A crowd waited at the gate.
example2_en: A crowd at a school gate is a design problem if the pavement is too narrow.
example2_zh: 如果人行道太窄，校门口的人群就是一个设计问题。
collocations: in the crowd｜在人群中 ; a crowd of｜一群
tip_zh: crowd 作动词是拥挤。crowded 是形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 愿望；欲望 | v. 渴望
definition_en: a strong wish | to want something strongly
example1_en: Her desire to study medicine is clear.
example2_en: A desire for a high score should not cancel a night of sleep.
example2_zh: 想得高分的愿望不应当取消一夜睡眠。
collocations: a desire for｜对……的渴望 ; desire to do｜渴望做
tip_zh: desire 比 wish 更强，也更正式。作动词直接接名词或 to do。

meanings_zh: v. 睡觉 | n. 睡眠
definition_en: to rest with the eyes closed | the rest you get at night
example1_en: I sleep for eight hours on school nights.
example1_zh: 上学的晚上我睡八小时。
example2_en: Teenagers sleep better when phones stay out of the bedroom.
example2_zh: 手机不放在卧室时，青少年睡得更好。
collocations: go to sleep｜入睡 ; sleep well｜睡得好
tip_zh: sleep 是动词或不可数名词。睡着了用 asleep。

definition_en: a piece of furniture, or a list of figures
example1_en: Please clear the table after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后请把桌子收拾干净。
example2_en: A table of bus times is useless if the last bus leaves before school ends.
example2_zh: 如果末班车在放学前离开，一份公交时刻表就没有用。
collocations: at table｜在吃饭 ; table tennis｜乒乓球
tip_zh: table 也可指表格。

definition_en: to happen
example1_en: The delay occurred after lunch.
example2_en: Floods occur in the same streets when the drain stays blocked.
example2_zh: 排水口一直堵着时，洪水就发生在同样的街道上。
collocations: occur to sb｜某人想到 ; occur in｜发生在
tip_zh: occur 比 happen 正式。It occurred to me that... 表示我想到。

definition_en: to tell someone you are grateful
example1_en: I want to thank you for your help.
example2_en: Cities should thank the workers who collect rubbish before dawn, not only the people who design the posters.
example2_zh: 城市应该感谢黎明前收垃圾的工人，而不只是设计海报的人。
collocations: thank sb for｜因……感谢 ; thanks to｜多亏
tip_zh: thank 是动词，后面接人；名词用 thanks。

definition_en: to become a member, or to connect
example1_en: I want to join the choir.
example2_en: A new road that does not join the bus network still leaves many people walking.
example2_zh: 不与公交网络相连的新路，仍然让许多人走路。
collocations: join in｜参加 ; join sb｜和某人一起
tip_zh: join 后接团体表示加入；join in 后接活动。

definition_en: a reduction in price
example1_en: The discount is for students.
example2_en: A discount that is not written down is not a price a family can check.
example2_zh: 没写下来的折扣，不是家庭能核对的价格。
collocations: a discount on｜对……的折扣 ; at a discount｜打折
tip_zh: discount 作动词是打折。

meanings_zh: v. 租用；雇用 | n. 租用
definition_en: to pay to use something, or to employ someone | an act of hiring
example1_en: The school will hire a bus.
example2_en: Do not hire a driver who has already worked a full night.
example2_zh: 不要雇用已经上了一整夜班的司机。
collocations: hire sb to do｜雇某人做 ; for hire｜供租用
tip_zh: 英式 hire 可指租用。美式 hire 多指雇用，租用常用 rent。

meanings_zh: adj. 主要的 | n. 首领
definition_en: most important | a leader
example1_en: The chief reason for the delay was the rain.
example1_zh: 延误的主要原因是下雨。
example2_en: The chief cost of a new road may be the playground it replaces, not the stone it uses.
example2_zh: 一条新路的主要代价，可能是它取代的操场，而不是它用的石头。
collocations: chief editor｜主编
tip_zh: chief 作名词是“首领”。

definition_en: helpful for a purpose
example1_en: The map was useful on the trip.
example1_zh: 这张地图在旅途中很有用。
example2_en: A useful rule is one a new student can follow on the first day.
example2_zh: 有用的规定是新生第一天就能照做的。
collocations: be useful for｜对……有用 ; useful to sb｜对某人有用
tip_zh: 说 sth is useful to sb，或 useful for doing。

definition_en: hopeful, or certain
example1_en: She gave a positive answer.
example2_en: A positive test result should be explained in words a family can understand.
example2_zh: 阳性的检测结果应该用一个家庭能懂的话来解释。
collocations: be positive about｜对……有把握 ; positive attitude｜积极的态度
tip_zh: positive 在检测里表示阳性，在态度里表示积极。

meanings_zh: n. 笔记；便条；音符 | v. 注意；记下
definition_en: a short piece of writing | to notice or write down
example1_en: I wrote a note to remind myself.
example1_zh: 我写了张便条提醒自己。
example2_en: A note in the margin of a shared textbook can help the next reader if the handwriting is clear.
example2_zh: 如果字迹清楚，共用课本页边的笔记能帮助下一个读者。
collocations: take notes｜记笔记 ; note down｜记下
tip_zh: note 作动词是“注意”或“记下”。

meanings_zh: v. 落下；跌倒 | n. 落下；秋天（美）
definition_en: to drop down | a drop, or autumn in American English
example1_en: Leaves fall from the tree in autumn.
example2_en: If wages fall while rents rise, families move farther from the schools they wanted.
example2_zh: 如果工资下降而房租上升，家庭会搬得离他们想去的学校更远。
collocations: fall asleep｜入睡 ; fall behind｜落后 ; fall down｜跌倒
tip_zh: fall 的过去式是 fell，过去分词是 fallen。秋天是 autumn，美式常用 fall。

definition_en: higher in position
example1_en: The upper floor is for the art rooms.
example2_en: Students on the upper floor need a plan for when the lift stops.
example2_zh: 楼上的学生需要电梯停运时的方案。
collocations: upper class｜上层阶级 ; the Upper｜高年级（有的学校）
tip_zh: upper 是形容词，不单独作名词表示“上面”。

meanings_zh: n. 激增；隆隆声 | v. 激增；发出隆隆声
definition_en: a sudden increase, or a deep loud sound | to increase suddenly, or to make a deep sound
example1_en: The boom in bus use started in September.
example1_zh: 公交使用量的激增从九月开始。
example2_en: A boom in new flats still needs a clinic and a late bus.
example2_zh: 新公寓的激增仍然需要诊所和晚班车。
collocations: a boom in｜……的激增
tip_zh: boom 作动词是激增或发出隆隆声。

definition_en: having a value that makes something sensible
example1_en: The museum is worth a visit.
example2_en: A long meeting is worth the time if it stops a road being built in the wrong place.
example2_zh: 如果一次长会能避免路修在错误的地方，它就值得花时间。
collocations: be worth doing｜值得做 ; worth of｜价值
tip_zh: be worth doing 用主动形式表示被动含义，不说 worth to be done。

definition_en: harm to the body
example1_en: The injury kept him out of the match.
example1_zh: 这次受伤让他没能参赛。
example2_en: A small injury reported early is easier to treat than one hidden until Friday.
example2_zh: 早报告的小伤比拖到周五才说的更容易处理。
collocations: serious injury｜重伤 ; injury to｜对……的伤害
tip_zh: injury 可数。动词是 injure。

definition_en: able to be trusted
example1_en: The clock is reliable.
example2_en: A reliable bus is one whose time is written down.
example2_zh: 可靠的公交是时间被写下来的那种。
collocations: reliable information｜可靠的信息
tip_zh: 动词 rely 是本批的另一词。

definition_en: an electronic machine for storing and using information
example1_en: The computer in the library is free to use.
example1_zh: 图书馆的电脑可以免费使用。
example2_en: A computer in a school helps only when students are also taught how to check a source.
example2_zh: 学校里的电脑只有在同时教会学生核对来源时才有帮助。
collocations: computer room｜计算机房
tip_zh: computer 是可数名词。

definition_en: the outside or top layer
example1_en: The surface of the desk is still wet.
example2_en: Oil on the surface of a river is a warning, even when the water below looks calm.
example2_zh: 河面上的油是警告，即使下面的水看起来平静。
collocations: on the surface｜表面上 ; surface area｜表面积
tip_zh: on the surface 常比喻“表面上”，和 in reality 相对。

definition_en: a person who trains a team, or a bus for long trips
example1_en: The coach spoke after the match.
example2_en: A coach who listens can improve a team more than one who only shouts.
example2_zh: 肯听的教练比只会喊的教练更能提高一支队伍。
collocations: football coach｜足球教练
tip_zh: coach 也可指长途客车。作动词是“指导”。

definition_en: a machine that produces power to move something
example1_en: The engine of the old bus is loud.
example1_zh: 这辆旧公交的发动机声音很大。
example2_en: An electric engine changes the noise of a street, and it still needs a clean source of power.
example2_zh: 电动机改变一条街的噪音，它仍然需要清洁的电力来源。
collocations: search engine｜搜索引擎 ; engine failure｜发动机故障
tip_zh: search engine 是搜索引擎，不是机械发动机。

definition_en: the activity of buying things
example1_en: We do the shopping on Saturday.
example2_en: Online shopping arrives at a door, and someone still has to carry the box upstairs.
example2_zh: 网购送到门口，仍然得有人把箱子搬上楼。
collocations: go shopping｜去购物 ; shopping list｜购物清单
tip_zh: shopping 是名词。商店是 shop，已在本库。

definition_en: a rule made by a government, or a scientific rule
example1_en: The new law limits plastic bags in shops.
example1_zh: 新法律限制商店使用塑料袋。
example2_en: A law that nobody can understand is hard to follow, even when its aim is fair.
example2_zh: 一部没人读得懂的法律很难被遵守，即使它的目的是公平的。
collocations: by law｜依法 ; break the law｜违法 ; law and order｜法治
tip_zh: law 表示法律时可不可数；一条法律用 a law。

meanings_zh: n. 地址；演讲 | v. 对……发表讲话；处理
definition_en: the details of where someone lives, or a formal speech | to speak to, or to deal with
example1_en: Write your address on the form.
example2_en: An address that a delivery van cannot find is also a problem for an ambulance.
example2_zh: 快递车找不到的地址，对救护车也是问题。
collocations: email address｜电子邮件地址 ; address a problem｜处理一个问题
tip_zh: address 作动词是“对……说话”或“处理”。

definition_en: a form of something that is slightly different
example1_en: This is the latest version of the form.
example2_en: An online version of a warning helps only people who can open it.
example2_zh: 警报的网络版本只帮助打得开它的人。
collocations: a version of｜……的一个版本
tip_zh: version 是可数名词。

definition_en: a list of money owed, or a proposed law
example1_en: The electricity bill was higher this month.
example1_zh: 这个月的电费账单更高。
example2_en: A bill that limits plastic bags needs shops that will actually follow it.
example2_zh: 限制塑料袋的法案需要真正会执行的商店。
collocations: pay the bill｜付账 ; bill for｜……的账单
tip_zh: 美式英语里 bill 也可指纸币。

definition_en: a computer for one person
example1_en: The lab has one personal computer for two students.
example1_zh: 实验室里两名学生共用一台个人电脑。
example2_en: A personal computer at home does not replace a quiet place to read.
example2_zh: 家里的个人电脑代替不了一个安静的阅读角落。
collocations: personal computer｜个人电脑
tip_zh: 常缩写为 PC。表里没有这一条的音标，本库用 espeak-ng。

definition_en: connected with a god or religion
example1_en: Visitors should be quiet in the holy place.
example1_zh: 参观者在圣地应当保持安静。
example2_en: A holy day for one community may be an ordinary school day for another.
example2_zh: 对一个群体是圣日的日子，对另一个群体可能只是普通上学日。
collocations: holy place｜圣地
tip_zh: holy 描述宗教上的神圣。不要用来泛指“很好”。

definition_en: an organization for education or research
example1_en: The institute offers a Saturday lab.
example1_zh: 这个研究所周六开放实验室。
example2_en: An institute near a factory can train local students for work that already exists.
example2_zh: 工厂附近的学院可以为当地学生培训已经存在的工作。
collocations: research institute｜研究所
tip_zh: institute 常指专科院校或研究所。institution 更泛，可以是制度或较大的机构。

meanings_zh: adj. 完美的 | v. 使完善
definition_en: as good as possible | to make something as good as it can be
example1_en: Nobody expects a perfect first draft.
example1_zh: 没人指望第一稿就完美。
example2_en: A perfect score on one test does not show whether a student can work with other people.
example2_zh: 一次考试的满分并不能说明学生能否与他人合作。
collocations: perfect for｜对……很合适
tip_zh: perfect 作动词是“使完善”，重音常在第二音节。

definition_en: to be the best or to get a prize
example1_en: Our team wants to win the basketball match.
example2_en: A city does not win public trust by announcing a plan it never carries out.
example2_zh: 一座城市不会因为宣布一个从不执行的计划就赢得公众信任。
collocations: win a prize｜获奖 ; win against｜战胜
tip_zh: win 的宾语是比赛、奖品或胜利，不是对手。打败某人用 beat sb。

definition_en: to become larger, or to raise plants
example1_en: Tomatoes grow well on this side of the wall.
example1_zh: 西红柿在墙的这一侧长得好。
example2_en: Cities that grow too fast may run out of classrooms before they run out of building plans.
example2_zh: 发展太快的城市，可能在规划还没用完之前教室就不够了。
collocations: grow up｜长大 ; grow into｜长成
tip_zh: grow 的过去式是 grew，过去分词是 grown。grow up 表示长大。

definition_en: great happiness, or something that causes it
example1_en: The concert was a joy.
example1_zh: 这场音乐会是一件乐事。
example2_en: Joy at a win should still leave room to thank the person who passed the ball.
example2_zh: 胜利的欢乐仍然应当留出位置，去谢谢传球的人。
collocations: to one joy｜令某人高兴的是 ; jump for joy｜高兴得跳起来
tip_zh: joy 作情感时常不可数。a joy 表示一件令人高兴的事。

definition_en: a container with straight sides
example1_en: Put the bottles in the recycling box.
example2_en: A box of shared books can keep a village reading when the library bus comes only once a month.
example2_zh: 当图书车每月只来一次时，一箱共用的书能让村子继续有书读。
collocations: a box of｜一盒 ; post box｜邮箱
tip_zh: box 的复数是 boxes。

definition_en: difficult in an interesting or demanding way
example1_en: The question is challenging, and it has a source.
example1_zh: 这道题有挑战性，而且有来源。
example2_en: A challenging timetable still fails if it hides the last bus.
example2_zh: 有挑战性的课表如果藏起末班车，仍然会失败。
collocations: a challenging task｜有挑战性的任务
tip_zh: challenge 已在本库。challenging 形容事物。

meanings_zh: n. 守卫；防护 | v. 守卫；防范
definition_en: a person or thing that protects | to watch and protect
example1_en: A guard stands at the stadium gate.
example1_zh: 体育场门口站着一名守卫。
example2_en: A guard at a school gate should know how to help, not only how to stop people.
example2_zh: 校门口的守卫应当知道如何帮忙，而不只是如何拦人。
collocations: on guard｜值班；警惕
tip_zh: guard 作动词是守卫。be on your guard 表示提防。

meanings_zh: adj. 每周的 | adv. 每周 | n. 周刊
definition_en: happening once a week | once a week | a magazine published every week
example1_en: The weekly meeting is on Monday.
example2_en: A weekly bus pass helps the student who travels every day, not only the one who travels once.
example2_zh: 周票帮助每天都坐车的学生，而不只是一周坐一次的人。
collocations: a weekly visit｜每周一次的访问
tip_zh: weekly 也可作副词或名词“周刊”。week 已在本库。

definition_en: to cause death
example1_en: The late frost can kill young plants.
example2_en: Dirty water can kill fish long before people notice a change in the colour.
example2_zh: 脏水可以在人们注意到颜色变化之前很久就杀死鱼。
collocations: kill time｜打发时间
tip_zh: kill 是及物动词，后面直接接宾语。

definition_en: a small river, or a flow
example1_en: The stream runs behind the school.
example2_en: A stream of cars at four is a reason to move the gate, not only to shout.
example2_zh: 四点的车流是挪门的理由，而不只是喊一声。
collocations: a stream of｜一连串；一流
tip_zh: stream 也可指数据流。作动词是流动或在线播放。

definition_en: enjoyment
example1_en: The game was fun, and we also learned the words.
example1_zh: 游戏很有趣，我们还学了单词。
example2_en: Fun at a festival should not depend on so much plastic that the square is buried in waste the next day.
example2_zh: 节日的乐趣不该依赖那么多塑料，以至于第二天广场被垃圾淹没。
collocations: have fun｜玩得开心 ; for fun｜为了好玩
tip_zh: fun 是不可数名词，一般不说 a fun。funny 是“滑稽的”，不等于 fun。

definition_en: to move something toward you
example1_en: Pull the door; do not push it.
example2_en: It is hard to pull a cart of books up the hill without a second person.
example2_zh: 没有第二个人，很难把一车书拉上山。
collocations: pull out｜拔出；驶出
tip_zh: 门上的 pull 和 push 是一对。

definition_en: vehicles moving on a road
example1_en: Traffic is heavy near the school at four.
example1_zh: 四点钟学校附近交通拥挤。
example2_en: Heavy traffic outside a gate is a reason to move the crossing, not only to tell children to hurry.
example2_zh: 校门口车流大，是挪动斑马线的理由，而不只是催孩子快走。
collocations: traffic jam｜交通堵塞 ; traffic lights｜红绿灯
tip_zh: traffic 不可数。不说 a traffic。

definition_en: in the direction of; American spelling
example1_en: She walked toward the library.
example2_en: Attitude toward mistakes matters as much as the number of correct answers.
example2_zh: 对待错误的态度和正确答案的数量一样重要。
collocations: toward the end｜将近结束时
tip_zh: toward 是美式，towards 是英式，已在本库。意思相同。

definition_en: behaviour that hurts people
example1_en: The school rule forbids violence.
example2_en: News about violence should leave out details that teach a method, and still tell people it happened.
example2_zh: 关于暴力的新闻应当略去会教人方法的细节，同时仍然说明事情发生了。
collocations: violence against｜针对……的暴力
tip_zh: violence 通常不可数。

definition_en: covered with or full of water
example1_en: The path is wet after the rain.
example2_en: Wet coats in a pile stay wet; coats on hooks dry.
example2_zh: 堆着的湿外套一直湿，挂起来的会干。
collocations: wet through｜湿透
tip_zh: wet 作动词是弄湿。

definition_en: a large body that moves around a star
example1_en: Earth is the planet we live on.
example1_zh: 地球是我们居住的行星。
example2_en: A lesson about another planet is clearer when students can compare its day with ours.
example2_zh: 关于另一颗行星的课，如果学生能把它的一天和我们的相比，会更清楚。
collocations: planet Earth｜地球
tip_zh: planet 可数。the planet 有时指地球。

meanings_zh: n. 呼吁；吸引力 | v. 呼吁；吸引；上诉
definition_en: an urgent request, or a quality that attracts | to ask urgently, to attract, or to ask a court to change a decision
example1_en: The appeal for books filled the box in a day.
example1_zh: 募书的呼吁一天就把箱子装满了。
example2_en: The appeal of a late bus is simple: students can stay for the club and still get home.
example2_zh: 晚班车的吸引力很简单：学生可以留下参加社团，并且还能回家。
collocations: appeal for｜呼吁得到 ; appeal to｜对……有吸引力
tip_zh: appeal to somebody 表示吸引某人或向某人呼吁。也可指上诉。

definition_en: the fact of losing something
example1_en: The loss of the old tree changed the street.
example1_zh: 那棵老树的失去改变了这条街。
example2_en: The loss of a night bus is also a loss of safe journeys home.
example2_zh: 夜班公交的取消，也是安全回家路程的损失。
collocations: at a loss｜不知所措 ; loss of｜……的损失
tip_zh: loss 是名词；lose 是动词。

definition_en: following what has been done for a long time
example1_en: The traditional dance opens the school fair.
example1_zh: 传统舞蹈为学校义卖开场。
example2_en: A traditional recipe can change when the market no longer sells the old grain.
example2_zh: 当市场不再卖那种老谷物时，传统食谱也会变。
collocations: traditional festival｜传统节日
tip_zh: traditional 是形容词。名词传统是 tradition。表里这一行的音标少了词尾，本库改用 espeak。

definition_en: coins and notes used to buy things
example1_en: I do not have enough money for two tickets.
example2_en: Money spent on early reading support can reduce the cost of failure later in secondary school.
example2_zh: 花在早期阅读辅导上的钱，可以减少中学阶段失败带来的后续成本。
collocations: pocket money｜零花钱 ; make money｜赚钱 ; save money｜省钱
tip_zh: money 不可数，不说 moneys 或 a money。

meanings_zh: n. 成就 | n. 实现；达成
definition_en: something successfully done | The successful completion of a goal through effort.
example1_en: Winning the prize was a great achievement.
example2_en: Schools should recognise creative achievements alongside examination results to encourage a wider range of student abilities.
example2_zh: 学校应在重视考试成绩的同时认可创造性成果，以鼓励学生发展多方面的能力。
collocations: a major achievement｜重大成就 ; a sense of achievement｜成就感 ; academic achievement｜学业成绩 ; the achievement of goals｜目标的实现
tip_zh: 具体成就可数；表示目标的实现时通常不可数。

definition_en: programs used by a computer
example1_en: The software saves the class list.
example1_zh: 这个软件保存班级名单。
example2_en: Free software helps a school only if someone can update it when it fails.
example2_zh: 免费软件只有在出故障时有人能更新，才对学校有帮助。
collocations: software update｜软件更新
tip_zh: software 不可数，不说 a software。表里这一行的音标是 soft，本库不用。

definition_en: used for the future or for a suggestion
example1_en: Shall we start the meeting now?
example1_zh: 我们现在开始开会好吗？
example2_en: A town shall not call a road safe until children can cross it without an adult.
example2_zh: 在孩子能不靠成年人过马路之前，城镇不该称一条路是安全的。
collocations: shall we｜我们……好吗
tip_zh: Shall I / Shall we 用来提议。陈述将来现在更常用 will。

definition_en: actually existing, or genuine
example1_en: Is this a real diamond or a glass one?
example1_zh: 这是真钻石还是玻璃的？
example2_en: Real progress on air quality is measured in hospital visits, not only in official announcements.
example2_zh: 空气质量的真正进步要用就诊人数来衡量，而不只是官方通报。
collocations: real life｜现实生活 ; for real｜真正地
tip_zh: real 强调实际存在；true 强调与事实相符。

meanings_zh: adj. 锋利的；敏锐的；急剧的
definition_en: having a thin edge, or sudden and clear
example1_en: The knife in the kitchen is sharp.
example2_en: A sharp rise in the fare hits the students who already walk.
example2_zh: 票价急剧上涨，打击的是那些已经在步行的学生。
collocations: a sharp turn｜急转弯 ; at seven sharp｜七点整
tip_zh: sharp 也可表示正点：at seven sharp。

definition_en: a bank record, or a description of events
example1_en: She opened a bank account for her savings.
example1_zh: 她开了一个银行账户存钱。
example2_en: An honest account of a flood includes the families who lost homes, not only the official numbers.
example2_zh: 对洪水的诚实叙述包括失去家园的家庭，而不只是官方数字。
collocations: account for｜解释；占 ; on account of｜因为 ; take into account｜考虑到
tip_zh: account for 表示解释原因，或占一定比例。

definition_en: a person who is not named
example1_en: Someone left a notebook on the piano.
example1_zh: 有人把笔记本落在钢琴上了。
example2_en: Someone has to decide which bus routes stay open when a city cannot fund them all.
example2_zh: 当一座城市无法资助所有公交线路时，必须有人决定哪些线路继续开。
collocations: someone else｜其他人
tip_zh: someone 后面的形容词要后置：someone important。

definition_en: a complete lack of noise or speech
example1_en: There was silence after the question.
example2_en: Silence in a meeting is not agreement if nobody was invited to speak.
example2_zh: 如果没人被邀请发言，会上的沉默就不是同意。
collocations: in silence｜沉默地
tip_zh: silence 通常不可数。

definition_en: to receive sound, or to be told
example1_en: I can hear the bell from the playground.
example1_zh: 我在操场上能听见铃声。
example2_en: People hear about a flood on their phones long before they see the water in their own street.
example2_zh: 人们在自己街上看到水之前很久，就从手机上听说了洪水。
collocations: hear of｜听说 ; hear from｜收到……的信
tip_zh: hear 是听见的结果；listen 是听的动作。过去式是 heard。

definition_en: the line between two countries or areas
example1_en: The river is the border between the two counties.
example2_en: A school near a border may have students who travel across it every morning.
example2_zh: 边界附近的学校，可能有学生每天早晨跨过边界来上课。
collocations: across the border｜越过边界 ; on the border｜在边界上
tip_zh: border 可指国界，也可指页边。作动词是与……接壤。

definition_en: a net of threads, or a system of linked pages
example1_en: A spider web hung in the window.
example2_en: The web makes a village library larger, but only while the connection stays up.
example2_zh: 网络能让乡村图书馆变大，但前提是连接不断。
collocations: a web of｜一张……的网 ; on the web｜在网上
tip_zh: the Web 常指万维网。website 已在本库。

meanings_zh: adv. 请 | v. 使高兴
definition_en: used to make a request polite | to make someone happy
example1_en: Please close the window before you leave.
example2_en: Signs that say please are not enough if the bins are too far from where people finish their food.
example2_zh: 如果垃圾桶离人们吃完东西的地方太远，写着“请”的标牌是不够的。
collocations: yes, please｜好的，请
tip_zh: please 可放在句首或句末。pleased 表示人感到高兴。

meanings_zh: adj. 困难的；硬的；努力的 | adv. 努力地
definition_en: difficult, solid, or needing effort | with a lot of effort
example1_en: This question is hard, but not impossible.
example1_zh: 这道题难，但不是做不出。
example2_en: Hard plastic that cannot be repaired becomes waste faster than a simple tool made of wood.
example2_zh: 无法修理的硬塑料，会比一件简单的木制工具更快变成垃圾。
collocations: work hard｜努力工作 ; hard work｜艰苦的工作 ; be hard on｜对……严厉
tip_zh: hard 可以是“努力地”；hardly 是否定副词“几乎不”，二者完全不同。

definition_en: a long story
example1_en: The novel is on the reading list.
example1_zh: 这本小说在阅读清单上。
example2_en: A novel about a flood can start a discussion that a chart alone does not.
example2_zh: 一本关于洪水的小说能开启图表单独做不到的讨论。
collocations: a novel by｜……写的小说
tip_zh: novel 作形容词是新颖的。本条以名词“长篇小说”为主。

definition_en: the system of tracks and trains
example1_en: The railway station is two stops away.
example2_en: A railway that skips the town leaves the school bus to do the whole job.
example2_zh: 不停这个镇的铁路，会把整件事留给校车。
collocations: by railway｜乘火车 ; railway station｜火车站
tip_zh: 英式 railway，美式常用 railroad。

definition_en: able to judge well
example1_en: It was wise to write the time twice.
example1_zh: 把时间写两遍是明智的。
example2_en: A wise rule names who locks the door.
example2_zh: 明智的规定会写明谁锁门。
collocations: a wise choice｜明智的选择
tip_zh: wise 的名词是 wisdom。It is wise to do。

definition_en: a society or school for a particular subject
example1_en: The art academy is open on Saturday.
example2_en: An academy that takes only the already confident students misses the point of a public school.
example2_zh: 只收已经自信的学生的学院，偏离了公立学校的意义。
collocations: an academy of｜……学会
tip_zh: academy 可数。Academy 作专名时常大写。

definition_en: a round container for cooking or holding things
example1_en: The pot is still hot.
example2_en: A pot without a label in the lab should not be used.
example2_zh: 实验室里没有标签的罐子不应当使用。
collocations: a pot of｜一锅；一罐
tip_zh: pot 可数。

definition_en: the legal relationship of being married
example1_en: They announced their marriage in the spring.
example2_en: Laws about marriage affect housing, tax and the way a family is recorded at school.
example2_zh: 关于婚姻的法律会影响住房、税收，以及学校如何登记一个家庭。
collocations: marriage certificate｜结婚证
tip_zh: 结婚的动词是 marry，不说 marriage with。

definition_en: a series of games to find a winner
example1_en: The tournament is next month.
example2_en: A tournament that starts after the last bus has already chosen who can play.
example2_zh: 在末班车之后才开始的锦标赛，其实已经选定了谁能参赛。
collocations: a tennis tournament｜网球锦标赛
tip_zh: tournament 可数。比单一的 match 更长。

definition_en: the direction between south and west
example1_en: The wind came from the south-west.
example2_en: Towns in the south-west share one hospital, so the road between them matters in bad weather.
example2_zh: 西南部的城镇共用一家医院，所以它们之间的路在坏天气里很重要。
collocations: in the south-west｜在西南
tip_zh: south-west 也可写作 southwest。

definition_en: having a baby developing inside the body
example1_en: The form asks whether the patient is pregnant.
example1_zh: 表格询问病人是否怀孕。
example2_en: A pregnant teacher needs a chair and a timetable that does not pretend she is not.
example2_zh: 怀孕的老师需要一把椅子，以及一份不假装她没有怀孕的课表。
collocations: pregnant with｜怀着
tip_zh: pregnant 是形容词。本条用医务和学校场景，不写生理细节。

definition_en: a journey by air, or the act of flying
example1_en: Our flight leaves at seven in the morning.
example1_zh: 我们的航班早上七点起飞。
example2_en: A cancelled flight can separate a school group if nobody has written a meeting place.
example2_zh: 如果没人写下集合地点，取消的航班会把学校旅行团拆散。
collocations: flight number｜航班号 ; a flight of stairs｜一段楼梯
tip_zh: a flight of stairs 是一段楼梯，不是飞机。

definition_en: what a person knows
example1_en: Local knowledge of the river saved time.
example1_zh: 对这条河的本地知识节省了时间。
example2_en: Knowledge from a textbook and knowledge from a flooded street are both useful.
example2_zh: 来自课本的知识和来自积水街道的知识都有用。
collocations: knowledge of｜对……的知识
tip_zh: knowledge 不可数，不说 a knowledge，除非说 a knowledge of。

meanings_zh: n. 顺序；命令；订单 | v. 命令；订购
definition_en: arrangement, a command, or a request for goods | to command, or to ask for goods
example1_en: Put the books back in the right order.
example1_zh: 把书按正确顺序放回去。
example2_en: An order to close street markets at dusk can cut noise and also cut the income of small sellers.
example2_zh: 黄昏关闭街头市场的命令能减少噪音，也会减少小贩的收入。
collocations: in order｜按顺序；状况良好 ; in order to｜为了 ; out of order｜出故障
tip_zh: in order to do 表示目的；in order that 后接句子。

definition_en: very bad or frightening
example1_en: The noise was terrible during the drill.
example2_en: A terrible result on one quiz is information, not a final judgement of a student.
example2_zh: 一次小测的糟糕成绩是信息，不是对学生的最终判决。
collocations: a terrible mistake｜严重的错误
tip_zh: terrible 程度很强。terribly 在口语里也可表示“非常”。

definition_en: to experience a feeling or opinion
example1_en: I feel nervous before I speak in class.
example1_zh: 我在课堂上发言前感到紧张。
example2_en: Residents feel the effect of a new airport long before the official noise report is published.
example2_zh: 居民在官方噪音报告公布之前很久，就能感到新机场的影响。
collocations: feel like｜想要；感觉像 ; feel at home｜感觉自在
tip_zh: feel 作连系动词，后面接形容词：feel tired，不接 tiredly。

meanings_zh: v. 按；压 | n. 按；新闻界
definition_en: to push something firmly | a push, or newspapers and journalists
example1_en: Press the button to open the door.
example2_en: If editors press reporters to publish before they check, false stories spread faster.
example2_zh: 如果编辑催记者在核对之前发表，假消息会传得更快。
collocations: press conference｜记者招待会
tip_zh: the press 表示新闻界。

definition_en: the surface of the earth, or an area for sport
example1_en: The bag fell to the ground.
example2_en: A sports ground that floods every spring is a sign the drains need work.
example2_zh: 每年春天都积水的运动场，说明排水需要整修。
collocations: on the ground｜在地上 ; playground｜操场
tip_zh: ground 作“地面”时常不可数。grounds 可指场地或理由。

definition_en: an object for a child to play with
example1_en: The toy is under the desk.
example2_en: A toy left on the stairs is a reason to move it before someone falls.
example2_zh: 留在楼梯上的玩具，是在有人摔倒之前把它挪开的理由。
collocations: a toy of｜一个……玩具
tip_zh: toy 可数。

meanings_zh: v. 爬；攀登 | n. 攀登
definition_en: to go up using your hands and feet | an act of climbing
example1_en: Climb the stairs, and hold the rail.
example2_en: Do not climb a loose wall.
example2_zh: 不要爬松动的墙。
collocations: climb up｜爬上
tip_zh: climb 也可作名词。本条只作普通动作，不写危险攀爬的做法。

definition_en: a device meant to explode
example1_en: The station closed after a bomb scare.
example1_zh: 炸弹恐吓之后车站关闭了。
example2_en: A history lesson can name a bomb as an event and still refuse to explain how one is made.
example2_zh: 历史课可以把炸弹作为一个事件来写，同时拒绝说明它是怎么做成的。
collocations: bomb scare｜炸弹恐吓
tip_zh: 本条只作词汇。不提供制造、使用或隐藏爆炸物的任何方法。

definition_en: all people born around the same time
example1_en: This generation grew up with the internet.
example1_zh: 这一代人在互联网中长大。
example2_en: A generation that leaves school during a drought may carry that memory into later votes.
example2_zh: 在干旱中离开学校的一代人，可能把这段记忆带进后来的投票。
collocations: the younger generation｜年轻一代 ; from generation to generation｜世代相传
tip_zh: generation 也可指产生，如 the generation of electricity。

definition_en: an animal with feathers and wings
example1_en: A bird nested in the school tree.
example1_zh: 一只鸟在学校的树上筑了巢。
example2_en: Birds leave a street when the trees leave, even if the signs stay.
example2_zh: 树走了，鸟也会离开那条街，即使牌子还在。
collocations: a bird of｜一种鸟
tip_zh: bird 可数。鸟类总称可用 birds。

definition_en: an activity with rules, often for fun or sport
example1_en: Our class won the basketball game.
example2_en: A game that rewards only speed may discourage students who think carefully but slowly.
example2_zh: 只奖励速度的游戏，可能会让思考仔细但较慢的学生失去信心。
collocations: play a game｜玩游戏 ; video game｜电子游戏
tip_zh: game 可指一场比赛；match 更常用于正式体育赛事。

meanings_zh: n. 负担 | v. 使负担
definition_en: a heavy duty or worry | to give someone a heavy duty
example1_en: The fee is a burden.
example2_en: A burden of forms should not fall only on the parent who works nights.
example2_zh: 一堆表格的负担不应当只落在上夜班的家长身上。
collocations: a burden on｜对……的负担
tip_zh: burden 作动词是使负担。

definition_en: an act that breaks the law
example1_en: Stealing a bike is a crime.
example2_en: A city reduces crime more reliably by lighting streets and offering work than by fear alone.
example2_zh: 城市若想更稳妥地减少犯罪，靠路灯和工作机会比只靠恐惧更有效。
collocations: commit a crime｜犯罪 ; crime rate｜犯罪率
tip_zh: crime 可数也可指犯罪这一类行为。不要把 crime 和 sin 混用。

meanings_zh: v. 逃跑；逃脱 | n. 逃脱；出口
definition_en: to get away from a place or danger | an act of escaping, or a way out
example1_en: The cat escaped through the open window.
example2_en: A fire escape that is locked is not an escape.
example2_zh: 锁上的消防通道就不是出口。
collocations: escape from｜从……逃脱 ; fire escape｜消防通道
tip_zh: escape 作名词是逃脱或出口。后接 from，也可直接接表示逃脱的事物。

definition_en: only one, or not married
example1_en: A single mistake in the date can spoil the form.
example1_zh: 日期上的一个错误就能让表格作废。
example2_en: A single tree cannot cool a playground, but a row of them can.
example2_zh: 一棵树凉不了一座操场，但一排树可以。
collocations: every single｜每一个
tip_zh: single 强调仅一个；only 强调限制范围。

definition_en: not cooked, or not yet processed
example1_en: Do not eat the raw meat.
example2_en: Raw numbers without a source are not yet a report.
example2_zh: 没有来源的原始数字还不是一份报告。
collocations: raw material｜原料 ; raw data｜原始数据
tip_zh: raw 可形容食物，也可形容未经处理的资料。

meanings_zh: n. 公园 | v. 停车
definition_en: a public garden in a town | to leave a vehicle somewhere
example1_en: The park is a short walk from school.
example2_en: A park on the edge of town helps little if children cannot cross the road to reach it.
example2_zh: 如果孩子过不了马路，城边的公园就帮不上什么忙。
collocations: national park｜国家公园 ; park a car｜停车
tip_zh: park 作动词是“停放车辆”。

definition_en: a male child
example1_en: The boy by the door is new.
example2_en: A boy who wants to study nursing should see men doing that work, not only hear that it is allowed.
example2_zh: 想学护理的男孩应该看到有男性在做这份工作，而不只是听说这是允许的。
collocations: little boy｜小男孩
tip_zh: boy 的复数是 boys。

definition_en: a farm bird, or its meat
example1_en: The soup has chicken in it.
example2_en: Chicken that is not kept cold is a health problem, not only a smell.
example2_zh: 没有冷藏的鸡肉是健康问题，而不只是气味。
collocations: chicken soup｜鸡汤
tip_zh: chicken 作肉不可数，作一只鸡可数。

meanings_zh: n. 牛奶 | v. 挤奶
definition_en: the white drink from cows | to take milk from an animal
example1_en: There is milk in the fridge.
example2_en: Milk that sits out all morning is not a safe drink for the afternoon class.
example2_zh: 放了一上午的牛奶，不适合下午的课再喝。
collocations: a glass of milk｜一杯牛奶
tip_zh: milk 作物质名词不可数。作动词是挤奶。

definition_en: right for a purpose
example1_en: The room is suitable for a quiet test.
example1_zh: 这个房间适合安静的测验。
example2_en: A suitable time for parents is not the middle of their shift.
example2_zh: 适合家长的时间不是他们班次的正中间。
collocations: suitable for｜适合于
tip_zh: 动词 suit 已在本库。suitable for something。

definition_en: the organ where food goes, or the front of the body
example1_en: His stomach hurt after lunch.
example2_en: A stomach pain is a reason to call the clinic, not to finish the match.
example2_zh: 胃疼是叫医务室的理由，不是把比赛打完。
collocations: stomach ache｜胃疼
tip_zh: stomach 可数。

meanings_zh: n. 形式；表格 | v. 形成；组成
definition_en: a type or shape, or a printed document | to make or shape
example1_en: Please fill in the form in pen.
example2_en: Friendship can take the form of sharing notes, not only of sitting together at lunch.
example2_zh: 友谊可以表现为分享笔记，而不只是午饭坐在一起。
collocations: fill in a form｜填表 ; in the form of｜以……的形式
tip_zh: form 作动词是“形成”或“组成”。

definition_en: an account of events, true or imagined
example1_en: The teacher told a short story before class ended.
example1_zh: 老师在下课前讲了一个短故事。
example2_en: A news story should name its sources, or readers cannot judge whether it is fair.
example2_zh: 一篇新闻报道应该写明来源，否则读者无法判断它是否公正。
collocations: tell a story｜讲故事 ; short story｜短篇小说
tip_zh: story 的复数是 stories。美式里 story 也可表示楼层。

meanings_zh: adj. 安全的；安心的 | v. 获得；使安全
definition_en: safe, or free from worry | to get, or to make safe
example1_en: The lab door is secure at night.
example1_zh: 实验室的门夜里是锁好的。
example2_en: A secure job for one parent can decide whether a child stays at the same school.
example2_zh: 父母一方有稳定的工作，可以决定孩子是否留在同一所学校。
collocations: feel secure｜感到安心 ; secure a place｜获得一个名额
tip_zh: secure 作动词是获得或使牢固。名词安全是 security，已在本库。

definition_en: careful listening or looking
example1_en: Pay attention to the last sentence.
example2_en: Public attention lasts a day after a flood, but the damaged road lasts for months.
example2_zh: 洪水之后公众的注意只持续一天，但损坏的路会持续数月。
collocations: pay attention to｜注意 ; attract attention｜引起注意
tip_zh: attention 不可数。pay attention to 后接名词或 doing。

meanings_zh: n. 类型 | v. 打字
definition_en: a kind or sort | to write with a keyboard
example1_en: This type of question appears every year.
example2_en: The type of housing a city builds decides who can live near work and school.
example2_zh: 一座城市建造的住房类型，决定谁能住在工作和学校附近。
collocations: type of｜……的类型 ; a type of｜一种
tip_zh: type 作动词是“打字”。

definition_en: a set of actions done in order
example1_en: The procedure is on the lab door.
example2_en: A fire procedure that nobody has practised is only a piece of paper.
example2_zh: 没人演练过的消防程序只是一张纸。
collocations: follow a procedure｜按程序做
tip_zh: procedure 可数。本条不写危险操作的具体步骤。

definition_en: a round fruit
example1_en: She brought an apple for the break.
example1_zh: 她带了一个苹果当课间点心。
example2_en: An apple sold at the school gate should be washed, and the price should be clear.
example2_zh: 校门口卖的苹果应当洗过，价格也应当写清。
collocations: apple juice｜苹果汁
tip_zh: apple 可数。an apple，不是 a apple。

meanings_zh: v. 确认 | v. 确认安排；正式批准
definition_en: to make sure something is true | To make an arrangement certain or give it official approval.
example1_en: Please confirm your email address.
example1_zh: 请确认你的电子邮箱地址。
example2_en: Further research is needed to confirm whether smaller classes consistently improve learning outcomes in primary schools.
example2_zh: 还需要进一步研究，以证实小学小班教学是否能持续改善学习效果。
collocations: confirm a booking｜确认预订 ; confirm that｜证实…… ; confirm a diagnosis｜确诊 ; confirm receipt｜确认收到
tip_zh: 可接名词或that从句；不要用confirm to do。

definition_en: the outer covering of a body or fruit
example1_en: Cold wind can dry the skin on your hands.
example1_zh: 冷风会让手上的皮肤变干。
example2_en: Schools that teach sun safety help students protect their skin without fearing a normal day outside.
example2_zh: 教防晒的学校能帮助学生保护皮肤，又不必害怕正常的户外活动。
collocations: skin care｜皮肤护理 ; banana skin｜香蕉皮
tip_zh: skin 通常不可数。果皮、兽皮有时可用 a skin。

meanings_zh: n. 别针 | v. 别住
definition_en: a thin piece of metal with a sharp point | to fasten with a pin
example1_en: The pin is in the drawer.
example2_en: A pin on the floor of the lab is a reason to pick it up with care.
example2_zh: 实验室地上的别针，是小心地捡起来的理由。
collocations: a pin of｜一根别针
tip_zh: pin 作动词是别住。本条不写如何伤人。

definition_en: causing pain
example1_en: The step is painful to climb.
example2_en: A painful knee is a reason to see the clinic.
example2_zh: 膝盖疼是去医务室的理由。
collocations: painful to｜做……很痛苦
tip_zh: pain 已在本库。painful 形容事物或经历。

definition_en: American spelling of theatre
example1_en: The class visits the theater on Thursday.
example2_en: A theater that starts after the last bus has already chosen who can come.
example2_zh: 在末班车之后才开演的剧院，其实已经选定了谁能来。
collocations: go to the theater｜去看戏
tip_zh: theater 是美式，theatre 是英式，已在本库。两条都保留。

meanings_zh: n. 法官；裁判 | v. 判断
definition_en: a person who decides in a court or a competition | to form an opinion
example1_en: The judge asked both sides to speak.
example2_en: A judge of a school contest should look at the work, not at who the student's parents are.
example2_zh: 学校比赛的裁判应该看作品，而不是看学生的父母是谁。
collocations: judge of｜……的裁判
tip_zh: judge 作动词是“判断”。

definition_en: making a lot of noise
example1_en: The bell is loud enough.
example2_en: A loud hallway makes the quiet student miss the instruction.
example2_zh: 吵闹的走廊会让安静的学生听漏说明。
collocations: in a loud voice｜大声地
tip_zh: loud 也可作副词，但 loudly 更常见。

definition_en: the gas around the earth
example1_en: Open a window and let in some fresh air.
example2_en: Dirty air around a school is not a small local problem when thousands of children breathe it daily.
example2_zh: 当数千名孩子每天呼吸学校周围的脏空气时，这就不是一件小事。
collocations: by air｜乘飞机 ; fresh air｜新鲜空气 ; in the air｜在空中
tip_zh: air 通常不可数。by air 表示乘飞机。

definition_en: something you must do
example1_en: It is my duty to lock up.
example2_en: Duty on imported books can decide whether a school library grows.
example2_zh: 进口书的税可以决定学校图书馆是否增长。
collocations: on duty｜值班 ; a sense of duty｜责任感
tip_zh: on duty 是值班。off duty 是下班。duty 也可指关税。

meanings_zh: n. 申请；应用 | n. 应用；运用 | n. 应用程序
definition_en: a formal request; a use | the practical use of knowledge, skills, or methods | a computer program designed to perform particular tasks
example1_en: Send your application before Friday.
example2_en: Simplifying the application process could encourage more students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for university scholarships.
example2_zh: 简化申请流程可能鼓励更多来自弱势家庭的学生申请大学奖学金。
collocations: submit an application｜提交申请 ; application form｜申请表 ; practical application｜实际应用 ; software application｜软件应用程序
tip_zh: 申请某物用application for，向机构申请用to。

definition_en: a chemical element found in all living things
example1_en: The lesson names carbon, not a recipe.
example1_zh: 这一课只讲碳这个名称，不讲配方。
example2_en: Cities cut carbon by changing buses, not only by printing a poster.
example2_zh: 城市减少碳排放靠的是改公交，而不只是印一张海报。
collocations: carbon dioxide｜二氧化碳
tip_zh: carbon 通常不可数。本条只作元素词汇，不写任何制备方法。

definition_en: the joint in the middle of the leg
example1_en: His knee hurt after the match.
example2_en: Pain in the knee is a reason to stop, not to finish the race.
example2_zh: 膝盖疼是停下来的理由，不是把比赛跑完。
collocations: on your knees｜跪着
tip_zh: knee 可数。k 不发音。

definition_en: a group working or playing together
example1_en: Our team practises on Wednesday evenings.
example2_en: A rescue team is only as fast as the roads and phone signals that connect it to a village.
example2_zh: 救援队的速度，取决于连接它和村庄的道路与手机信号。
collocations: team spirit｜团队精神 ; team member｜队员
tip_zh: team 作整体时谓语可用单数；强调成员时可用复数。

definition_en: the state of being equal
example1_en: Equality means the same entrance, not the same speech.
example1_zh: 平等是同一个入口，不是同一篇讲话。
example2_en: Equality on a poster fails if the late bus never comes.
example2_zh: 如果晚班车从未来过，海报上的平等就失败了。
collocations: equality of｜……的平等
tip_zh: equal 已在本库。equality 通常不可数。

definition_en: the time when you are a child
example1_en: She spent her childhood in this town.
example1_zh: 她的童年在这座城镇度过。
example2_en: A safe path to school is part of childhood, not an extra.
example2_zh: 一条安全的上学路是童年的一部分，不是额外的东西。
collocations: in one childhood｜在某人童年 ; early childhood｜幼年
tip_zh: childhood 通常不可数。child 已在本库。

meanings_zh: n. 领带；关系；平局 | v. 系；打成平局
definition_en: a necktie, a connection, or an equal result | to fasten with a string, or to finish equal
example1_en: He wore a tie for the photo.
example2_en: The match ended in a tie, and both classes still needed the same bus.
example2_zh: 比赛以平局结束，两个班仍然需要同一班车。
collocations: tie sth to｜把……系在 ; a tie between｜……之间的关系
tip_zh: tie 作动词是系、打成平局。

definition_en: a person who is not named
example1_en: Somebody left a bag in the lab.
example1_zh: 有人把包落在实验室了。
example2_en: Somebody has to lock the hall, or the lights stay on all night.
example2_zh: 必须有人锁礼堂，否则灯会亮一整夜。
collocations: somebody else｜别人
tip_zh: somebody 后接单数动词。和 someone 同义，本库两条都保留。

meanings_zh: n. 公司 | adj. 坚定的；坚固的
definition_en: a business company | strong, or not changing your decision
example1_en: Her aunt works at a small design firm.
example1_zh: 她阿姨在一家小型设计公司工作。
example2_en: A firm that trains local students can keep jobs in the town after they graduate.
example2_zh: 培训当地学生的公司，可以在他们毕业后把工作留在镇上。
collocations: a law firm｜律师事务所
tip_zh: firm 作形容词是“坚定的；坚固的”。作名词多指公司。

meanings_zh: n. 购买 | v. 购买
definition_en: the act of buying | to buy
example1_en: Keep the receipt for every purchase.
example2_en: A large purchase for the lab should be checked by more than one person.
example2_zh: 实验室的大额采购应当由不止一个人核对。
collocations: make a purchase｜购买
tip_zh: purchase 比 buy 正式。作动词直接接所买的东西。

definition_en: a human being
example1_en: She is the right person to ask about the map.
example1_zh: 问地图的事，她是合适的人。
example2_en: A person who cannot afford the bus may never see the museum the city is proud of.
example2_zh: 付不起公交费的人，可能永远看不到这座城市引以为傲的博物馆。
collocations: in person｜亲自 ; a person of｜一个……的人
tip_zh: person 的复数通常是 people，不常说 persons。

definition_en: a road in a town with buildings
example1_en: Our school is on a quiet street.
example1_zh: 我们学校在一条安静的街上。
example2_en: A street without a pavement pushes children into the same space as cars.
example2_zh: 没有人行道的街道，把孩子推进和汽车相同的空间。
collocations: on the street｜在街上 ; street light｜路灯
tip_zh: in the street 和 on the street 都可以，英式更常用 in。

definition_en: to have something as a part
example1_en: The price includes lunch.
example2_en: A transport plan should include the walk from the last bus stop to the school gate.
example2_zh: 交通计划应该包括从末班车站走到校门的那段路。
collocations: include doing｜包括做
tip_zh: including 是介词，后面接名词。

definition_en: to go to live somewhere, or to end a problem
example1_en: They settled in the town last year.
example1_zh: 他们去年在这座城镇定居。
example2_en: Settle the bus argument in writing.
example2_zh: 把公交的争论用书面解决。
collocations: settle down｜安顿下来 ; settle a problem｜解决问题
tip_zh: 名词 settlement 已在本库。

meanings_zh: n. 头脑；心思 | v. 介意；当心
definition_en: the part of a person that thinks | to be annoyed by, or to be careful
example1_en: I changed my mind after I read the article.
example1_zh: 读完那篇文章后我改变了主意。
example2_en: A tired mind makes careless mistakes, which is why sleep belongs in any study plan.
example2_zh: 疲惫的头脑会犯粗心的错误，所以任何学习计划都该包括睡眠。
collocations: change one's mind｜改变主意 ; make up one's mind｜下定决心 ; never mind｜没关系
tip_zh: mind 作动词是“介意”：Would you mind doing...?

definition_en: a device or system for sending sound
example1_en: The weather news is on the radio.
example2_en: A radio warning still reaches homes that have lost the phone signal.
example2_zh: 收音机警报仍然能到达失去手机信号的家庭。
collocations: on the radio｜在广播中 ; radio station｜广播电台
tip_zh: listen to the radio，要用 to。

definition_en: having drunk too much alcohol
example1_en: He was not drunk; he was ill.
example2_en: A school event should not treat getting drunk as a joke.
example2_zh: 学校活动不应当把喝醉当成笑话。
collocations: get drunk｜喝醉
tip_zh: drunk 是 drink 的过去分词，也可作形容词。drink 已在本库。本条不写如何喝醉。

definition_en: very small
example1_en: A tiny crack can leak all night.
example1_zh: 一条极小的裂缝可以漏一整夜。
example2_en: A tiny school still needs a way to call a doctor.
example2_zh: 极小的学校仍然需要叫到医生的办法。
collocations: a tiny bit｜一点点
tip_zh: tiny 比 small 更小。比较级 tinier，最高级 tiniest。

definition_en: a pity, or a feeling of guilt
example1_en: It is a shame that the library closes at five.
example1_zh: 图书馆五点关门，真可惜。
example2_en: Shame is a poor way to teach a student who already knows the answer was wrong.
example2_zh: 对已经知道答案错了的学生，羞愧是很差的教法。
collocations: what a shame｜真遗憾 ; a sense of shame｜羞耻心
tip_zh: It is a shame 常表示可惜，不一定是道德上的羞耻。

definition_en: ready and happy to do something
example1_en: She is willing to share her notes.
example2_en: A town is willing to fund a library when residents can see who uses it.
example2_zh: 当居民能看到谁在用图书馆时，城镇就更愿意出钱。
collocations: be willing to do｜愿意做
tip_zh: willing 后接 to do。名词是 willingness。

definition_en: frozen water
example1_en: There was ice on the path this morning.
example2_en: Ice on the only road to school can close a village for a day.
example2_zh: 唯一上学路上的冰，可以让一个村子停课一天。
collocations: ice cream｜冰淇淋 ; on ice｜被搁置
tip_zh: ice 通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 检查；核对 | n. 检查；支票（美）
definition_en: to examine to see if something is correct | an examination, or an American bank form
example1_en: Check your name before you hand in the paper.
example2_en: Cities should check air quality outside schools, not only in the parks that look good in photos.
example2_zh: 城市应该检查学校外面的空气质量，而不只是照片里好看的公园。
collocations: check in｜办理入住 ; check out｜结账离开
tip_zh: check 直接接宾语。支票是 cheque（英）或 check（美）。

definition_en: the end of the day and the early night
example1_en: We have choir practice in the evening.
example2_en: Evening classes let working adults study without leaving their daytime jobs.
example2_zh: 夜校让上班的成年人不必辞去白天的工作也能学习。
collocations: in the evening｜在晚上 ; yesterday evening｜昨天晚上
tip_zh: 泛指晚上用 in the evening。具体某一天的晚上用 on Monday evening。

definition_en: coming at the end
example1_en: This is the final day to hand in the form.
example1_zh: 今天是交表的最后一天。
example2_en: A final decision on a new road should wait until residents have seen the plan.
example2_zh: 关于新路的最终决定，应该等到居民看过方案之后。
collocations: final exam｜期末考试 ; the final｜决赛
tip_zh: final 强调不可再改的最后；last 强调顺序上的最后一个。

definition_en: all things
example1_en: Everything is ready for the open day.
example1_zh: 开放日的一切都准备好了。
example2_en: A school cannot control everything a child sees online, so it should teach how to pause and check.
example2_zh: 学校无法控制孩子在网上看到的一切，所以应该教他们如何停下来核对。
collocations: everything else｜其他一切
tip_zh: everything 作主语时谓语用单数。

definition_en: not common
example1_en: This bird is rare in our city.
example1_zh: 这种鸟在我们城市很罕见。
example2_en: A rare book in a school library needs a rule about who may take it home.
example2_zh: 学校图书馆里的珍本书需要规定谁可以借回家。
collocations: rare species｜稀有物种
tip_zh: rarely 放在实义动词前、助动词后。

definition_en: a skilled cook, especially the head cook
example1_en: The chef labelled the nuts.
example2_en: A chef who leaves early still needs the late bus.
example2_zh: 早离开的厨师长仍然需要晚班车。
collocations: a chef at｜在……的厨师长
tip_zh: chef 可数。ch 读 /ʃ/。

meanings_zh: n. 西；西方 | adj. 西方的
definition_en: the direction where the sun goes down | in or towards the west
example1_en: The sun sets in the west.
example2_en: Towns in the west of the region share one hospital, so the road between them matters.
example2_zh: 该地区西部的城镇共用一家医院，所以它们之间的路很重要。
collocations: in the west｜在西方 ; west of｜在……以西
tip_zh: western 是形容词。the West 有时特指西方国家。

meanings_zh: adj. 公民的；民用的；文明的
definition_en: of citizens, or polite
example1_en: Civil society groups helped after the flood.
example1_zh: 民间团体在洪水后提供了帮助。
example2_en: Civil talk in a meeting still needs someone to record who will do the work.
example2_zh: 会议上文明的谈话，仍然需要有人记下谁来干活。
collocations: civil rights｜公民权利 ; civil servant｜公务员
tip_zh: civil 不是“国内战争”本身；内战是 civil war。

meanings_zh: n. 缺乏 | v. 缺乏
definition_en: the state of not having enough | to not have enough
example1_en: The lack of light makes the road unsafe.
example1_zh: 缺少灯光让这条路不安全。
example2_en: A lack of buses, not a lack of effort, explains why some students arrive late.
example2_zh: 一些学生迟到，原因是缺少公交，不是缺少努力。
collocations: lack of｜缺乏 ; for lack of｜因缺少
tip_zh: lack 作动词直接接宾语：lack time，不加 of。

definition_en: a boy or man with the same parents
example1_en: My brother walks to school with me.
example1_zh: 我哥哥和我一起走路上学。
example2_en: A brother who leaves for the city may send money home, but the family loses his daily help.
example2_zh: 去城市的兄弟也许会寄钱回家，但家里失去了他日常的帮忙。
collocations: elder brother｜哥哥
tip_zh: brother 的复数是 brothers。

meanings_zh: n. 失败 | n. 故障；衰竭 | n. 未做；未履行
definition_en: lack of success | a situation in which a machine or organ stops working | not doing something that is expected or required
example1_en: failure can teach useful lessons.
example1_zh: 失败能教会有用的功课。
example2_en: Schools should treat failure as an opportunity for learning rather than as evidence of a student's limited ability.
example2_zh: 学校应将失败视为学习的机会，而不是学生能力有限的证明。
collocations: end in failure｜以失败告终 ; power failure｜停电 ; heart failure｜心力衰竭 ; failure to comply｜未遵守
tip_zh: 泛指失败通常不可数；a failure可指失败的事物。

definition_en: to take part
example1_en: Every class may participate.
example2_en: Students participate more when the meeting is not only for the loud voices.
example2_zh: 当会议不只是给嗓门大的人时，学生会更多地参加。
collocations: participate in｜参加
tip_zh: participate in something。比 join 更正式。

meanings_zh: n. 怀疑；疑惑 | v. 怀疑
definition_en: a feeling of not being sure | to feel unsure
example1_en: I have no doubt that she prepared well.
example1_zh: 我毫不怀疑她准备得很充分。
example2_en: A useful doubt makes a reader check a number twice instead of sharing it at once.
example2_zh: 有用的怀疑会让读者把数字核对两遍，而不是立刻转发。
collocations: no doubt｜无疑 ; in doubt｜感到怀疑
tip_zh: doubt 作动词时，肯定句后的从句常用 whether 或 if。

meanings_zh: adj. 人的；人类的 | n. 人
definition_en: of people | a person
example1_en: Clean water is a basic human need.
example1_zh: 干净的水是人的基本需要。
example2_en: Human activity along a river, from farms to factories, decides whether the water stays drinkable.
example2_zh: 河边的人类活动，从农场到工厂，决定水是否还能饮用。
collocations: human being｜人 ; human nature｜人性
tip_zh: human 可作形容词或名词；一个人更常说 a person 或 a human being。

definition_en: good sense gained from experience
example1_en: Wisdom is not the same as a high score.
example2_en: The wisdom of writing the bus time is that parents can check it.
example2_zh: 把公交时间写下来的道理，是家长可以核对。
collocations: wisdom of｜……的智慧
tip_zh: wise 已在本库。wisdom 通常不可数。

definition_en: a very high hill
example1_en: Snow stays on the mountain in May.
example2_en: A school on the far side of a mountain needs a road that works in winter.
example2_zh: 山那一边的学校需要一条冬天也能走的路。
collocations: in the mountains｜在山区
tip_zh: mountain 比 hill 高。山脉常用 the ... Mountains。

definition_en: a time without war, or quiet
example1_en: The square was at peace after the fair.
example1_zh: 义卖之后广场安静下来。
example2_en: Peace in a neighbourhood also means a street where children can walk without fear.
example2_zh: 社区的安宁也意味着一条孩子可以不怕地走路的街。
collocations: in peace｜和平地 ; at peace｜处于平静
tip_zh: peace 不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 挥手；波动 | n. 波浪；波
definition_en: to move your hand, or to move like water | a moving line of water, or a form of energy
example1_en: Wave when you see the bus.
example2_en: A heat wave closes sport sooner than a poster about water.
example2_zh: 热浪比一张关于喝水的海报更快让体育课停下来。
collocations: wave to sb｜向某人挥手 ; heat wave｜热浪
tip_zh: wave 作名词是波浪、电波或一阵。heat wave 已在前面批次的搭配里出现过，这里作为本词的名词义。

meanings_zh: v. 打；撞击；达到 | n. 打击；热门
definition_en: to strike, or to reach a level | a blow, or something very popular
example1_en: The ball hit the window but did not break it.
example1_zh: 球打到窗户，但没有打破。
example2_en: When summer temperatures hit a new high, schools without fans struggle to keep lessons going.
example2_zh: 当夏天气温创下新高时，没有风扇的学校很难把课继续下去。
collocations: hit sb on the head｜打某人的头
tip_zh: hit 的过去式和过去分词都是 hit。打在某人某个部位用 hit sb on the + 部位。

definition_en: a country ruled by a king or queen
example1_en: The story is set in a small kingdom.
example1_zh: 故事发生在一个小王国。
example2_en: A history of a kingdom should also say who grew the food.
example2_zh: 王国的历史也应当写是谁种的粮食。
collocations: the United Kingdom｜英国
tip_zh: the United Kingdom 缩写是 the UK。king 已在本库。

definition_en: to come together, or to collect
example1_en: Gather the forms before you leave.
example2_en: Students gather at the gate when the bus time is unclear.
example2_zh: 公交时间不清楚时，学生会聚集在门口。
collocations: gather information｜收集信息
tip_zh: gather 可及物也可不及物。

definition_en: fairly hot, or friendly
example1_en: The classroom is warm enough.
example2_en: A warm welcome matters, and so does a seat for the parent who came straight from work.
example2_zh: 热情的欢迎很重要，刚下班赶来的家长有没有座位也很重要。
collocations: warm up｜热身；变暖
tip_zh: warm 比 hot 温度低、语气也更温和。

definition_en: the time after now
example1_en: We talked about our future plans.
example2_en: The future of a riverside town depends on whether the water stays clean enough to drink.
example2_zh: 河边城镇的未来，取决于水是否仍然干净到可以饮用。
collocations: in the future｜在将来 ; in future｜从今以后
tip_zh: in the future 指将来；in future 常表示“今后”，带有从现在改起的意味。

definition_en: anything, or no matter what
example1_en: Take whatever you need from the box.
example1_zh: 盒子里你需要什么就拿什么。
example2_en: Whatever a poster promises, the bus still has to arrive before the first lesson.
example2_zh: 无论海报承诺什么，公交仍必须在第一节课前到达。
collocations: whatever happens｜无论发生什么
tip_zh: whatever 可引导让步状语从句，相当于 no matter what。

definition_en: a photograph of the inside of the body
example1_en: The clinic sent the X-ray to the hospital.
example1_zh: 诊所把 X 光片送到了医院。
example2_en: An X-ray is a medical record, not a picture for the notice board.
example2_zh: X 光片是医疗记录，不是布告栏上的图片。
collocations: an X-ray of｜……的 X 光片
tip_zh: X-ray 的 X 要大写。也可作动词“给……拍 X 光”。

definition_en: to move towards the speaker or a place
example1_en: Come to the hall when you hear the bell.
example2_en: New businesses come to a town only when roads, power, and schools are already reliable.
example2_zh: 只有当道路、电力和学校已经可靠时，新的商家才会来到一个城镇。
collocations: come from｜来自 ; come true｜实现 ; come up with｜想出
tip_zh: come 的过去式是 came，过去分词是 come。

definition_en: to take food into the body
example1_en: We eat lunch in the classroom on rainy days.
example1_zh: 下雨天我们在教室吃午饭。
example2_en: Students eat more packaged food when the school canteen closes before the last lesson.
example2_zh: 当食堂在最后一节课前关闭时，学生会吃更多包装食品。
collocations: eat up｜吃完
tip_zh: eat 的过去式是 ate，过去分词是 eaten。

meanings_zh: n. 亲戚 | adj. 相对的
definition_en: a member of your family | considered in relation to something else
example1_en: A relative will meet her at the station.
example1_zh: 一位亲戚会在车站接她。
example2_en: A form that asks for a relative should also leave space if there is none nearby.
example2_zh: 要求填写亲戚的表格，如果附近没有亲戚，也应当留出说明的地方。
collocations: a relative of｜……的亲戚 ; relative to｜与……相比
tip_zh: relative 作形容词是相对的。relative to 表示与……相比或相关。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……附近 | adj. 近的 | adv. 近
definition_en: close to | not far | at a short distance
example1_en: There is a bus stop near the gate.
example1_zh: 门口附近有一个公交站。
example2_en: Clinics near schools make it easier for a sick child to be seen and then return home.
